book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּ/עֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּ/בְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּ/בְ/מוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב
verses.translit: 'shry h'ysh 'shr l' hlkh b'tst rsh'ym vbdrkh cht'ym l' 'md vbmvshb ltsym l' yshb
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥/וֹ וּֽ/בְ/תוֹרָת֥/וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָ/לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: khy 'm btvrt yhvh chptsv vbtvrtv yhgh yvmm vlylh
verses.translation: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָיָ֗ה כְּ/עֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨/וֹ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּ/עִתּ֗/וֹ וְ/עָלֵ֥/הוּ לֹֽא יִבּ֑וֹל וְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vhyh kh'ts shtvl 'l plgy mym 'shr pryv ytn b'tv v'lhv l' ybvl vkhl 'shr y'shh ytslych
verses.translation: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

verses.original: לֹא כֵ֥ן הָ/רְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם כַּ֝/מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר תִּדְּפֶ֥/נּוּ רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: l' khn hrsh'ym khy 'm khmts 'shr tdpnv rvch
verses.translation: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֤ן לֹא יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝/חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּ/עֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: 'l khn l' yqmv rsh'ym bmshpt vcht'ym b'dt tsdyqym
verses.translation: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.original: כִּֽי יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
verses.translit: khy yvd' yhvh drkh tsdyqym vdrkh rsh'ym t'bd
verses.translation: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.original: לָ֭/מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝/לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ רִֽיק
verses.translit: lmh rgshv gvym vl'mym yhgv ryq
verses.translation: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

verses.original: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ מַלְכֵי אֶ֗רֶץ וְ/רוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ יָ֑חַד עַל יְ֝הוָה וְ/עַל מְשִׁיחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ytytsbv mlkhy 'rts vrvznym nvsdv ychd 'l yhvh v'l mshychv
verses.translation: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD , and against his anointed, saying ,

verses.original: נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑י/מוֹ וְ/נַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽי/מוֹ
verses.translit: nntqh 't mvsrvtymv vnshlykhh mmnv 'btymv
verses.translation: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.original: יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗/י יִלְעַג לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: yvshb bshmym yshchq 'dny yl'g lmv
verses.translation: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

verses.original: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣י/מוֹ בְ/אַפּ֑/וֹ וּֽ/בַ/חֲרוֹנ֥/וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: 'z ydbr 'lymv b'pv vbchrvnv ybhlmv
verses.translation: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

verses.original: וַ֭/אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑/י עַל צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: v'ny nskhty mlkhy 'l tsyvn hr qdshy
verses.translation: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥/י בְּנִ֥/י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַ/יּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'sprh 'l chq yhvh 'mr 'ly bny 'th 'ny hyvm yldtykh
verses.translation: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

verses.original: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗/נִּי וְ/אֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑/ךָ וַ֝/אֲחֻזָּתְ/ךָ֗ אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: sh'l mmny v'tnh gvym nchltkh v'chztkh 'psy 'rts
verses.translation: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.original: תְּ֭רֹעֵ/ם בְּ/שֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּ/כְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: tr'm bshbt brzl khkhly yvtsr tnptsm
verses.translation: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

verses.original: וְ֭/עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'th mlkhym hshkhylv hvsrv shpty 'rts
verses.translation: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/יִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝/גִ֗ילוּ בִּ/רְעָדָֽה
verses.translit: 'bdv 't yhvh byr'h vgylv br'dh
verses.translation: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.original: נַשְּׁקוּ בַ֡ר פֶּן יֶאֱנַ֤ף וְ/תֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי יִבְעַ֣ר כִּ/מְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑/וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל ח֥וֹסֵי בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nshqv br pn y'nf vt'bdv drkh khy yb'r khm't 'pv 'shry khl chvsy bv
verses.translation: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִ֑ד בְּ֝/בָרְח֗/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֤י אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd bbrchv mpny 'bshlvm bnv
verses.translation: LORD , how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה מָֽה רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑/י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh mh rbv tsry rbym qmym 'ly
verses.translation: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

verses.original: רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְ/נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָ/ה לּ֬/וֹ בֵֽ/אלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: rbym 'mrym lnpshy 'yn yshv'th lv b'lhym slh
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑/י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗/י וּ/מֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: v'th yhvh mgn b'dy khbvdy vmrym r'shy
verses.translation: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.original: ק֭וֹלִ/י אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַ/יַּֽעֲנֵ֨/נִי מֵ/הַ֖ר קָדְשׁ֣/וֹ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: qvly 'l yhvh 'qr' vy'nny mhr qdshv slh
verses.translation: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽ/אִ֫ישָׁ֥נָ/ה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'ny shkhbty v'yshnh hqytsvty khy yhvh ysmkhny
verses.translation: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.original: לֹֽא אִ֭ירָא מֵ/רִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: l' 'yr' mrbbvt 'm 'shr sbyb shtv 'ly
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD ; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤/ה יְהוָ֨ה הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤/נִי אֱלֹהַ֗/י כִּֽי הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת כָּל אֹיְבַ֣/י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh hvshy'ny 'lhy khy hkhyt 't khl 'yby lchy shny rsh'ym shbrt
verses.translation: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD : thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּ/נְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynvt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.translit: bqr'y 'nny 'lhy tsdqy btsr hrchbt ly chnny vshm' tplty
verses.translation: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣/י לִ֭/כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּ/ן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: bny 'ysh 'd mh khbvdy lkhlmh t'hbvn ryq tbqshv khzb slh
verses.translation: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

verses.original: וּ/דְע֗וּ כִּֽי הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּ/קָרְאִ֥/י אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vd'v khy hplh yhvh chsyd lv yhvh yshm' bqr'y 'lyv
verses.translation: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.original: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽ/אַל תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭/לְבַבְ/כֶם עַֽל מִשְׁכַּבְ/כֶ֗ם וְ/דֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: rgzv v'l tcht'v 'mrv blbbkhm 'l mshkhbkhm vdmv slh
verses.translation: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD .

verses.original: זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝/בִטְח֗וּ אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: zbchv zbchy tsdq vbtchv 'l yhvh
verses.translation: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD , lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי יַרְאֵ֪/נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָ/ה עָ֭לֵי/נוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rbym 'mrym my yr'nv tvb nsh 'lynv 'vr pnykh yhvh
verses.translation: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

verses.original: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְ/לִבִּ֑/י מֵ/עֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖/ם וְ/תִֽירוֹשָׁ֣/ם רָֽבּוּ
verses.translit: ntth shmchh blby m't dgnm vtyrvshm rbv
verses.translation: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD , only makest me dwell in safety.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל הַ/נְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l hnchylvt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Give ear to my words, O LORD , consider my meditation.

verses.original: אֲמָרַ֖/י הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָ/ה הֲגִֽיגִ/י
verses.translit: 'mry h'zynh yhvh bynh hgygy
verses.translation: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָ/ה לְ/ק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗/י מַלְכִּ֥/י וֵ/אלֹהָ֑/י כִּֽי אֵ֝לֶ֗י/ךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל
verses.translit: hqshybh lqvl shv'y mlkhy v'lhy khy 'lykh 'tpll
verses.translation: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD ; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑/י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ לְ֝/ךָ֗ וַ/אֲצַפֶּֽה
verses.translit: yhvh bqr tshm' qvly bqr ''rkh lkh v'tsph
verses.translation: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א אֵֽל חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְ/ךָ֣ רָֽע
verses.translit: khy l' 'l chpts rsh' 'th l' ygrkh r'
verses.translation: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְ/נֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: l' ytytsbv hvllym lngd 'ynykh shn't khl p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

verses.original: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ דָּמִ֥ים וּ/מִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: t'bd dbry khzb 'ysh dmym vmrmh yt'b yhvh
verses.translation: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י בְּ/רֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּ/ךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑/ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל הֵֽיכַל קָ֝דְשְׁ/ךָ֗ בְּ/יִרְאָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny brb chsdkh 'bv' bytkh 'shtchvh 'l hykhl qdshkh byr'tkh
verses.translation: Lead me, O LORD , in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה נְחֵ֬/נִי בְ/צִדְקָתֶ֗/ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑/י הושר הַיְשַׁ֖ר לְ/פָנַ֣/י דַּרְכֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh nchny btsdqtkh lm'n shvrry hvshr hyshr lpny drkhkh
verses.translation: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּ/פִ֡י/הוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪/ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑/ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗/ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּ/ן
verses.translit: khy 'yn bpyhv nkhvnh qrbm hvvt qbr ptvch grvnm lshvnm ychlyqvn
verses.translation: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

verses.original: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨/ם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽ/מֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫י/הֶ֥ם בְּ/רֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵי/הֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑/מוֹ כִּי מָ֥רוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: h'shymm 'lhym yplv mm'tsvtyhm brb psh'yhm hdychmv khy mrv bkh
verses.translation: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡/ךְ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְ/תָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑י/מוֹ וְֽ/יַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝/ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshmchv khl chvsy bkh l'vlm yrnnv vtskh 'lymv vy'ltsv bkh 'hby shmkh
verses.translation: For thou, LORD , wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭/נְגִינוֹת עַֽל הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynvt 'l hshmynyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: O LORD , rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּ/אַפְּ/ךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑/נִי וְֽ/אַל בַּ/חֲמָתְ/ךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yhvh 'l b'pkh tvkhychny v'l bchmtkh tysrny
verses.translation: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; for I am weak: O LORD , heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥/נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: chnny yhvh khy 'mll 'ny rp'ny yhvh khy nbhlv 'tsmy
verses.translation: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD , how long?

verses.original: וְ֭/נַפְשִׁ/י נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד ו/את וְ/אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד מָתָֽי
verses.translit: vnpshy nbhlh m'd v't v'th yhvh 'd mty
verses.translation: Return, O LORD , deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣/ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗/נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shvbh yhvh chltsh npshy hvshy'ny lm'n chsdkh
verses.translation: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּ/מָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑/ךָ בִּ֝/שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy 'yn bmvt zkhrkh bsh'vl my yvdh lkh
verses.translation: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.original: יָגַ֤עְתִּי בְּֽ/אַנְחָתִ֗/י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְ/כָל לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑/י בְּ֝/דִמְעָתִ֗/י עַרְשִׂ֥/י אַמְסֶֽה
verses.translit: yg'ty b'nchty 'shchh bkhl lylh mtty bdm'ty 'rshy 'msh
verses.translation: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

verses.original: עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִ/כַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑/י עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּ/כָל צוֹרְרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shshh mkh's 'yny 'tqh bkhl tsvrry
verses.translation: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּ/נִּי כָּל פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽ/י
verses.translit: svrv mmny khl p'ly 'vn khy shm' yhvh qvl bkhyy
verses.translation: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑/י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥/י יִקָּֽח
verses.translit: shm' yhvh tchnty yhvh tplty yqch
verses.translation: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

verses.original: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֥ר לַ/יהוָ֑ה עַל דִּבְרֵי כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן יְמִינִֽי
verses.translit: shgyvn ldvd 'shr shr lyhvh 'l dbry khvsh bn ymyny
verses.translation: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַ/י בְּ/ךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥/נִי מִ/כָּל רֹ֝דְפַ֗/י וְ/הַצִּילֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy bkh chsyty hvshy'ny mkhl rdpy vhtsylny
verses.translation: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.original: פֶּן יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּ/אַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: pn ytrf kh'ryh npshy prq v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַ/י אִם עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם יֶשׁ עָ֥וֶל בְּ/כַפָּֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'm 'shyty z't 'm ysh 'vl bkhpy
verses.translation: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

verses.original: אִם גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥/י רָ֑ע וָ/אֲחַלְּצָ֖/ה צוֹרְרִ֣/י רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: 'm gmlty shvlmy r' v'chltsh tsvrry ryqm
verses.translation: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.original: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב נַפְשִׁ֡/י וְ/יַשֵּׂ֗ג וְ/יִרְמֹ֣ס לָ/אָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑/י וּ/כְבוֹדִ֓/י לֶ/עָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yrdf 'vyb npshy vyshg vyrms l'rts chyy vkhbvdy l'pr yshkhn slh
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD , in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤/ה יְהוָ֨ה בְּ/אַפֶּ֗/ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּ/עַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑/י וְ/ע֥וּרָ/ה אֵ֝לַ֗/י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh b'pkh hnsh' b'brvt tsvrry v'vrh 'ly mshpt tsvyt
verses.translation: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

verses.original: וַ/עֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑/ךָּ וְ֝/עָלֶ֗י/הָ לַ/מָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָ/ה
verses.translit: v'dt l'mym tsvbbkh v'lyh lmrvm shvbh
verses.translation: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD , according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/צִדְקִ֖/י וּ/כְ/תֻמִּ֣/י עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh ydyn 'mym shptny yhvh khtsdqy vkhtmy 'ly
verses.translation: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.original: יִגְמָר נָ֬א רַ֨ע רְשָׁעִים֮ וּ/תְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּ/בֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּ/כְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: ygmr n' r' rsh'ym vtkhvnn tsdyq vbchn lbvt vkhlyvt 'lhym tsdyq
verses.translation: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

verses.original: מָֽגִנִּ֥/י עַל אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: mgny 'l 'lhym mvshy' yshry lb
verses.translation: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝/אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּ/כָל יֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'lhym shvpt tsdyq v'l z'm bkhl yvm
verses.translation: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣/וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥/וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽ/יְכוֹנְנֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: 'm l' yshvb chrbv yltvsh qshtv drkh vykhvnnh
verses.translation: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.original: וְ֭/ל/וֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗י/ו לְֽ/דֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל
verses.translit: vlv hkhyn khly mvt chtsyv ldlqym yp'l
verses.translation: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל אָ֑וֶן וְ/הָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְ/יָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: hnh ychbl 'vn vhrh 'ml vyld shqr
verses.translation: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.translit: bvr khrh vychprhv vypl bshcht yp'l
verses.translation: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣/וֹ בְ/רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/עַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗/וֹ חֲמָס֥/וֹ יֵרֵֽד
verses.translit: yshvb 'mlv br'shv v'l qdqdv chmsv yrd
verses.translation: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַ/גִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l hgtyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗י/נוּ מָֽה אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְ/ךָ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥/ה ה֝וֹדְ/ךָ֗ עַל הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: yhvh 'dnynv mh 'dyr shmkh bkhl h'rts 'shr tnh hvdkh 'l hshmym
verses.translation: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.original: מִ/פִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים וְֽ/יֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑י/ךָ לְ/הַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּ/מִתְנַקֵּֽם
verses.translit: mpy 'vllym vynqym ysdt 'z lm'n tsvrrykh lhshbyt 'vyb vmtnqm
verses.translation: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.original: כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶי/ךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑י/ךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝/כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה
verses.translit: khy 'r'h shmykh m'shy 'tsb'tykh yrch vkhvkhbym 'shr khvnnth
verses.translation: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.original: מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי תִזְכְּרֶ֑/נּוּ וּ/בֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mh 'nvsh khy tzkhrnv vbn 'dm khy tpqdnv
verses.translation: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.original: וַ/תְּחַסְּרֵ֣/הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/כָב֖וֹד וְ/הָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vtchsrhv m't m'lhym vkhbvd vhdr t'trhv
verses.translation: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.original: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵ/הוּ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑י/ךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: tmshylhv bm'shy ydykh khl shth tcht rglyv
verses.translation: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

verses.original: צֹנֶ֣ה וַ/אֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑/ם וְ֝/גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי
verses.translit: tsnh v'lpym khlm vgm bhmvt shdy
verses.translation: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.original: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּ/דְגֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים
verses.translit: tspvr shmym vdgy hym 'br 'rchvt ymym
verses.translation: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'lmvt lbn mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: I will praise thee , O LORD , with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּ/כָל לִבִּ֑/י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'vdh yhvh bkhl lby 'sprh khl npl'vtykh
verses.translation: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.original: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְ/אֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑/ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'shmchh v''ltsh bkh 'zmrh shmkh 'lyvn
verses.translation: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.original: בְּ/שׁוּב אוֹיְבַ֥/י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝/יֹאבְד֗וּ מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bshvb 'vyby 'chvr ykhshlv vy'bdv mpnykh
verses.translation: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣/י וְ/דִינִ֑/י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝/כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: khy 'shyt mshpty vdyny yshbt lkhs' shvpt tsdq
verses.translation: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.original: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥/ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: g'rt gvym 'bdt rsh' shmm mchyt l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

verses.original: הָֽ/אוֹיֵ֨ב תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫/נֶ֥צַח וְ/עָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣/ם הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: h'vyb tmv chrbvt lntsch v'rym ntsht 'bd zkhrm hmh
verses.translation: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יהוָה לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhvh l'vlm yshb khvnn lmshpt khs'v
verses.translation: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.original: וְ/ה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּ/צֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּ/מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: vhv' yshpt tbl btsdq ydyn l'mym bmyshrym
verses.translation: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.original: וִ֘/יהִ֤י יְהוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַ/דָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְ/עִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh mshgb ldkh mshgb l'tvt btsrh
verses.translation: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.original: וְ/יִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭/ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybtchv bkh yvd'y shmkh khy l' 'zbt drshykh yhvh
verses.translation: Sing praises to the LORD , which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.original: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭/יהוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝/עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh yshb tsyvn hgydv b'mym 'lylvtyv
verses.translation: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.original: כִּֽי דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣/ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת עניים עֲנָוִֽים
verses.translit: khy drsh dmym 'vtm zkhr l' shkhch ts'qt 'nyym 'nvym
verses.translation: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.original: חָֽנְנֵ֬/נִי יְהוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִ/י מִ/שֹּׂנְאָ֑/י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗/י מִ/שַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: chnnny yhvh r'h 'nyy mshn'y mrvmmy msh'ry mvt
verses.translation: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כָּֽל תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥י/ךָ בְּ/שַֽׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּ/ישׁוּעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lm'n 'sprh khl thltykh bsh'ry bt tsyvn 'gylh byshv'tkh
verses.translation: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.original: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּ/שַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּ/רֶֽשֶׁת ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: tb'v gvym bshcht 'shv brsht zv tmnv nlkhdh rglm
verses.translation: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.original: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע יְהוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּ/פֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּי/ו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: nvd' yhvh mshpt 'shh bp'l khpyv nvqsh rsh' hgyvn slh
verses.translation: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִ/שְׁא֑וֹלָ/ה כָּל גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: yshvbv rsh'ym lsh'vlh khl gvym shkhchy 'lhym
verses.translation: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭/נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת ענוים עֲ֝נִיִּ֗ים תֹּאבַ֥ד לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: khy l' lntsch yshkhch 'byvn tqvt 'nvym 'nyym t'bd l'd
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD ; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה אַל יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh 'l y'z 'nvsh yshptv gvym 'l pnykh
verses.translation: Put them in fear, O LORD : that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

verses.original: לָ/מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּ/רָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְ/עִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה
verses.translit: lmh yhvh t'md brchvq t'lym l'tvt btsrh
verses.translation: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

verses.original: בְּ/גַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ בִּ/מְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: bg'vt rsh' ydlq 'ny ytpshv bmzmvt zv chshbv
verses.translation: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/בֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hll rsh' 'l t'vt npshv vbts' brkh n'ts yhvh
verses.translation: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּ/גֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּ/וֹ בַּל יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: rsh' khgbh 'pv bl ydrsh 'yn 'lhym khl mzmvtyv
verses.translation: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

verses.original: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דרכ/ו דְרָכָ֨י/ו בְּ/כָל עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶי/ךָ מִ/נֶּגְדּ֑/וֹ כָּל צ֝וֹרְרָ֗י/ו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: ychylv drkhv drkhyv bkhl 't mrvm mshptykh mngdv khl tsvrryv ypych bhm
verses.translation: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭/לִבּ/וֹ בַּל אֶמּ֑וֹט לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ֝/דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בְ/רָֽע
verses.translit: 'mr blbv bl 'mvt ldr vdr 'shr l' br'
verses.translation: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

verses.original: אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣י/הוּ מָ֭לֵא וּ/מִרְמ֣וֹת וָ/תֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗/וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָ/אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'lh pyhv ml' vmrmvt vtkh tcht lshvnv 'ml v'vn
verses.translation: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב בְּ/מַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭/מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗י/ו לְֽ/חֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ
verses.translit: yshb bm'rb chtsrym bmstrym yhrg nqy 'ynyv lchlkhh ytspnv
verses.translation: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

verses.original: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּ/מִּסְתָּ֨ר כְּ/אַרְיֵ֬ה בְ/סֻכֹּ֗/ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַ/חֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּ/מָשְׁכ֥/וֹ בְ/רִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'rb bmstr kh'ryh bskhh y'rb lchtvf 'ny ychtf 'ny bmshkhv brshtv
verses.translation: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

verses.original: ו/דכה יִדְכֶּ֥ה יָשֹׁ֑חַ וְ/נָפַ֥ל בַּ֝/עֲצוּמָ֗י/ו חלכאים חֵ֣יל כָּאִֽים
verses.translit: vdkhh ydkhh yshch vnpl b'tsvmyv chlkh'ym chyl kh'ym
verses.translation: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭/לִבּ/וֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗י/ו בַּל רָאָ֥ה לָ/נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: 'mr blbv shkhch 'l hstyr pnyv bl r'h lntsch
verses.translation: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it .

verses.original: קוּמָ֤/ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑/ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עניים עֲנָוִֽים
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh 'l nsh' ydkh 'l tshkhch 'nyym 'nvym
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD ; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

verses.original: עַל מֶ֤ה נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝/לִבּ֗/וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'l mh n'ts rsh' 'lhym 'mr blbv l' tdrsh
verses.translation: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it .

verses.original: רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה עָ֘מָ֤ל וָ/כַ֨עַס תַּבִּיט֮ לָ/תֵ֪ת בְּ/יָ֫דֶ֥/ךָ עָ֭לֶי/ךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר
verses.translit: r'th khy 'th 'ml vkh's tbyt ltt bydkh 'lykh y'zb chlkhh ytvm 'th hyyt 'vzr
verses.translation: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

verses.original: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝/רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ רִשְׁע֥/וֹ בַל תִּמְצָֽא
verses.translit: shbr zrv' rsh' vr' tdrvsh rsh'v bl tmts'
verses.translation: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָ/עֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh 'vlm v'd 'bdv gvym m'rtsv
verses.translation: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗/ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: t'vt 'nvym shm't yhvh tkhyn lbm tqshyb 'znkh
verses.translation: LORD , thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫/דָ֥ךְ בַּל יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַ/עֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lshpt ytvm vdkh bl yvsyf 'vd l'rts 'nvsh mn h'rts
verses.translation: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽ/יהוָ֨ה חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְ/נַפְשִׁ֑/י נודו נ֝֗וּדִי הַרְ/כֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd byhvh chsyty 'ykh t'mrv lnpshy nvdv nvdy hrkhm tspvr
verses.translation: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָ/רְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּ/ן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣/ם עַל יֶ֑תֶר לִ/יר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְ/יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: khy hnh hrsh'ym ydrkhvn qsht khvnnv chtsm 'l ytr lyrvt bmv 'pl lyshry lb
verses.translation: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֭/שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּ/ן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה פָּעָֽל
verses.translit: khy hshtvt yhrsvn tsdyq mh p'l
verses.translation: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה בְּֽ/הֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗/וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥/וֹ עֵינָ֥י/ו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥י/ו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yhvh bhykhl qdshv yhvh bshmym khs'v 'ynyv ychzv 'p'pyv ybchnv bny 'dm
verses.translation: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD’s throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭/רָשָׁע וְ/אֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh tsdyq ybchn vrsh' v'hb chms shn'h npshv
verses.translation: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.original: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭/גָפְרִית וְ/ר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ymtr 'l rsh'ym pchym 'sh vgpryt vrvch zl'pvt mnt khvsm
verses.translation: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.original: כִּֽי צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽי/מוֹ
verses.translit: khy tsdyq yhvh tsdqvt 'hb yshr ychzv pnymv
verses.translation: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l hshmynyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Help, LORD ; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.original: הוֹשִׁ֣יעָ/ה יְ֭הוָה כִּי גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ/בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: hvshy'h yhvh khy gmr chsyd khy psv 'mvnym mbny 'dm
verses.translation: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת רֵ֫עֵ֥/הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּ/לֵ֖ב וָ/לֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: shv' ydbrv 'ysh 't r'hv shpt chlqvt blb vlb ydbrv
verses.translation: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

verses.original: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: ykhrt yhvh khl shpty chlqvt lshvn mdbrt gdlvt
verses.translation: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ לִ/לְשֹׁנֵ֣/נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣י/נוּ אִתָּ֑/נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'shr 'mrv llshnnv ngbyr shptynv 'tnv my 'dvn lnv
verses.translation: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD ; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

verses.original: מִ/שֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵ/אַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝/יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mshd 'nyym m'nqt 'byvnym 'th 'qvm y'mr yhvh 'shyt bysh' ypych lv
verses.translation: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.original: אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּ/עֲלִ֣יל לָ/אָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'mrvt yhvh 'mrvt thrvt khsf tsrvf b'lyl l'rts mzqq shb'tym
verses.translation: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD , thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.original: אַתָּֽה יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑/ם תִּצְּרֶ֓/נּוּ מִן הַ/דּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'th yhvh tshmrm ttsrnv mn hdvr zv l'vlm
verses.translation: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD ? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

verses.original: עַד אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣/נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד אָ֓נָה תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: 'd 'nh yhvh tshkhchny ntsch 'd 'nh tstyr 't pnykh mmny
verses.translation: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

verses.original: עַד אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּ/נַפְשִׁ֗/י יָג֣וֹן בִּ/לְבָבִ֣/י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד אָ֓נָה יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣/י עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'd 'nh 'shyt 'tsvt bnpshy ygvn blbby yvmm 'd 'nh yrvm 'yby 'ly
verses.translation: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.original: הַבִּ֣יטָֽ/ה עֲ֭נֵ/נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י הָאִ֥ירָ/ה עֵ֝ינַ֗/י פֶּן אִישַׁ֥ן הַ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: hbyth 'nny yhvh 'lhy h'yrh 'yny pn 'yshn hmvt
verses.translation: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.original: פֶּן יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣/י יְכָלְתִּ֑י/ו צָרַ֥/י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: pn y'mr 'yby ykhltyv tsry ygylv khy 'mvt
verses.translation: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י בְּ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗/י בִּֽ/ישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥/ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַ/יהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny bchsdkh btchty ygl lby byshv'tkh 'shyrh lyhvh khy gml 'ly
verses.translation: I will sing unto the LORD , because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭/לִבּ/וֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd 'mr nbl blbv 'yn 'lhym hshchytv ht'ybv 'lylh 'yn 'shh tvb
verses.translation: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִ/שָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵי אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭/רְאוֹת הֲ/יֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: yhvh mshmym hshqyf 'l bny 'dm lr'vt hysh mshkhyl drsh 't 'lhym
verses.translation: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: hkhl sr ychdv n'lchv 'yn 'shh tvb 'yn gm 'chd
verses.translation: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּ/י אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: hl' yd'v khl p'ly 'vn 'khly 'my 'khlv lchm yhvh l' qr'v
verses.translation: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD .

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּ/ד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: shm pchdv pchd khy 'lhym bdvr tsdyq
verses.translation: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.original: עֲצַת עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'tst 'ny tbyshv khy yhvh mchshv
verses.translation: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

verses.original: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִ/צִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּ/שׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑/וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל
verses.translit: my ytn mtsyvn yshv't yshr'l bshvb yhvh shbvt 'mv ygl y'qb yshmch yshr'l
verses.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי יָג֣וּר בְּ/אָהֳלֶ֑/ךָ מִֽי יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּ/הַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh my ygvr b'hlkh my yshkhn bhr qdshkh
verses.translation: LORD , who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּ/פֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְ/דֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּ/לְבָבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvlkh tmym vp'l tsdq vdbr 'mt blbbv
verses.translation: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

verses.original: לֹֽא רָגַ֨ל עַל לְשֹׁנ֗/וֹ לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה לְ/רֵעֵ֣/הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝/חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא נָשָׂ֥א עַל קְרֹֽב/וֹ
verses.translit: l' rgl 'l lshnv l' 'shh lr'hv r'h vchrph l' nsh' 'l qrbv
verses.translation: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

verses.original: נִבְזֶ֤ה בְּֽ/עֵ֘ינָ֤י/ו נִמְאָ֗ס וְ/אֶת יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝/הָרַ֗ע וְ/לֹ֣א יָמִֽר
verses.translit: nbzh b'ynyv nm's v't yr'y yhvh ykhbd nshb' lhr' vl' ymr
verses.translation: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD . He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

verses.original: כַּסְפּ֤/וֹ לֹא נָתַ֣ן בְּ/נֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְ/שֹׁ֥חַד עַל נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khspv l' ntn bnshkh vshchd 'l nqy l' lqch 'shh 'lh l' ymvt l'vlm
verses.translation: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

verses.original: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְ/דָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥/נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: mkhtm ldvd shmrny 'l khy chsyty bkh
verses.translation: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭/יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣/י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗/י בַּל עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'mrt lyhvh 'dny 'th tvbty bl 'lykh
verses.translation: O my soul , thou hast said unto the LORD , Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

verses.original: לִ֭/קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝/אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל חֶפְצִ/י בָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lqdvshym 'shr b'rts hmh v'dyry khl chptsy bm
verses.translation: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

verses.original: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָ/ם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֣ם מִ/דָּ֑ם וּֽ/בַל אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗/ם עַל שְׂפָתָֽ/י
verses.translit: yrbv 'tsbvtm 'chr mhrv bl 'sykh nskhyhm mdm vbl 'sh' 't shmvtm 'l shpty
verses.translation: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת חֶלְקִ֥/י וְ/כוֹסִ֑/י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh mnt chlqy vkhvsy 'th tvmykh gvrly
verses.translation: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

verses.original: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ לִ֭/י בַּ/נְּעִמִ֑ים אַף נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: chblym nplv ly bn'mym 'f nchlt shprh 'ly
verses.translation: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.original: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑/נִי אַף לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּ/נִי כִלְיוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'brkh 't yhvh 'shr y'tsny 'f lylvt ysrvny khlyvty
verses.translation: I will bless the LORD , who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְ/נֶגְדִּ֣/י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝/ימִינִ֗/י בַּל אֶמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: shvyty yhvh lngdy tmyd khy mymyny bl 'mvt
verses.translation: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֤ן שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּ/י וַ/יָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑/י אַף בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗/י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָ/בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: lkhn shmch lby vygl khbvdy 'f bshry yshkhn lbtch
verses.translation: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣/י לִ/שְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְ/ךָ֗ לִ/רְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת
verses.translit: khy l' t'zb npshy lsh'vl l' ttn chsydkh lr'vt shcht
verses.translation: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

verses.original: תּֽוֹדִיעֵ/נִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּ/ימִינְ/ךָ֣ נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: tvdy'ny 'rch chyym shb' shmchvt 't pnykh n'mvt bymynkh ntsch
verses.translation: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤/ה יְהוָ֨ה צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָ/ה רִנָּתִ֗/י הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה תְפִלָּתִ֑/י בְּ֝/לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: tplh ldvd shm'h yhvh tsdq hqshybh rnty h'zynh tplty bl' shpty mrmh
verses.translation: Hear the right, O LORD , attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

verses.original: מִ֭/לְּ/פָנֶי/ךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣/י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗י/ךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: mlpnykh mshpty yts' 'ynykh tchzynh myshrym
verses.translation: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

verses.original: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨/י פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥/נִי בַל תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל יַעֲבָר פִּֽ/י
verses.translit: bchnt lby pqdt lylh tsrptny bl tmts' zmty bl y'br py
verses.translation: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.original: לִ/פְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּ/דְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑י/ךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ
verses.translit: lp'lvt 'dm bdbr shptykh 'ny shmrty 'rchvt pryts
verses.translation: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

verses.original: תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַ/י בְּ/מַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑י/ךָ בַּל נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: tmkh 'shry bm'glvtykh bl nmvtv p'my
verses.translation: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

verses.original: אֲנִֽי קְרָאתִ֣י/ךָ כִֽי תַעֲנֵ֣/נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט אָזְנְ/ךָ֥ לִ֝֗/י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ny qr'tykh khy t'nny 'l ht 'znkh ly shm' 'mrty
verses.translation: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

verses.original: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶי/ךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝/מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽ/ימִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hplh chsdykh mvshy' chvsym mmtqvmmym bymynkh
verses.translation: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them .

verses.original: שָׁ֭מְרֵ/נִי כְּ/אִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת עָ֑יִן בְּ/צֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗י/ךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shmrny kh'yshvn bt 'yn btsl khnpykh tstyrny
verses.translation: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

verses.original: מִ/פְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּ/נִי אֹיְבַ֥/י בְּ֝/נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: mpny rsh'ym zv shdvny 'yby bnpsh yqypv 'ly
verses.translation: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

verses.original: חֶלְבָּ֥/מוֹ סָּגְר֑וּ פִּ֝֗י/מוֹ דִּבְּר֥וּ בְ/גֵאֽוּת
verses.translit: chlbmv sgrv pymv dbrv bg'vt
verses.translation: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.original: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵי/נוּ עַתָּ֣ה סבבו/ני סְבָב֑וּ/נוּ עֵינֵי/הֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִ/נְט֥וֹת בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'shrynv 'th sbbvny sbbvnv 'ynyhm yshytv lntvt b'rts
verses.translation: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

verses.original: דִּמְיֹנ֗/וֹ כְּ֭/אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִ/טְר֑וֹף וְ֝/כִ/כְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/מִסְתָּרִֽים
verses.translit: dmynv kh'ryh ykhsvf ltrvf vkhkhpyr yshb bmstrym
verses.translation: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.original: קוּמָ֤/ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣/ה פָ֭נָי/ו הַכְרִיעֵ֑/הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥/ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י מֵ/רָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh qdmh pnyv hkhry'hv plth npshy mrsh' chrbkh
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD , disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

verses.original: מִֽ/מְתִ֥ים יָדְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽ/מְתִ֬ים מֵ/חֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥/ם בַּֽ/חַיִּים֮ ו/צפינ/ך וּֽ/צְפוּנְ/ךָ֮ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥/ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְ/הִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗/ם לְ/עוֹלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: mmtym ydkh yhvh mmtym mchld chlqm bchyym vtspynkh vtspvnkh tml' btnm yshb'v bnym vhnychv ytrm l'vllyhm
verses.translation: From men which are thy hand, O LORD , from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭/צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑י/ךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝/הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'ny btsdq 'chzh pnykh 'shb'h bhqyts tmvntkh
verses.translation: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֤חַ לְ/עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר לַ/יהוָ֗ה אֶת דִּ֭בְרֵי הַ/שִּׁירָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את בְּ/י֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥/וֹ מִ/כַּ֥ף כָּל אֹ֝יְבָ֗י/ו וּ/מִ/יַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: lmntsch l'bd yhvh ldvd 'shr dbr lyhvh 't dbry hshyrh hz't byvm htsyl yhvh 'vtv mkhf khl 'ybyv vmyd sh'vl
verses.translation: I will love thee, O LORD , my strength.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rchmkh yhvh chzqy
verses.translation: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה סַֽלְעִ֥/י וּ/מְצוּדָתִ֗/י וּ/מְפַ֫לְטִ֥/י אֵלִ֣/י צ֭וּרִ/י אֶֽחֱסֶה בּ֑/וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥/י וְ/קֶֽרֶן יִ֝שְׁעִ֗/י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh sl'y vmtsvdty vmplty 'ly tsvry 'chsh bv mgny vqrn ysh'y mshgby
verses.translation: I will call upon the LORD , who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.original: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מִן אֹ֝יְבַ֗/י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
verses.translit: mhll 'qr' yhvh vmn 'yby 'vsh'
verses.translation: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.original: אֲפָפ֥וּ/נִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֑וֶת וְֽ/נַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: 'ppvny chbly mvt vnchly bly'l yb'tvny
verses.translation: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּ/נִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּ/נִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: chbly sh'vl sbbvny qdmvny mvqshy mvt
verses.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD , and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

verses.original: בַּ/צַּר לִ֤/י אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְ/אֶל אֱלֹהַ֪/י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵ/הֵיכָל֣/וֹ קוֹלִ֑/י וְ֝/שַׁוְעָתִ֗/י לְ/פָנָ֤י/ו תָּב֬וֹא בְ/אָזְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: btsr ly 'qr' yhvh v'l 'lhy 'shv' yshm' mhykhlv qvly vshv'ty lpnyv tbv' b'znyv
verses.translation: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.original: וַ/תִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַ/תִּרְעַ֨שׁ הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וּ/מוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝/יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי חָ֥רָה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtg'sh vtr'sh h'rts vmvsdy hrym yrgzv vytg'shv khy chrh lv
verses.translation: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.original: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן בְּ/אַפּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֵשׁ מִ/פִּ֥י/ו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'lh 'shn b'pv v'sh mpyv t'khl gchlym b'rv mmnv
verses.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַ/יֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝/עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyt shmym vyrd v'rpl tcht rglyv
verses.translation: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל כְּ֭רוּב וַ/יָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝/יֵּ֗דֶא עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'l khrvb vy'f vyd' 'l khnpy rvch
verses.translation: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.original: יָ֤שֶׁת חֹ֨שֶׁךְ סִתְר֗/וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥י/ו סֻכָּת֑/וֹ חֶשְׁכַת מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: ysht chshkh strv sbybvtyv skhtv chshkht mym 'by shchqym
verses.translation: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.original: מִ/נֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥/וֹ עָבָ֥י/ו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְ/גַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: mngh ngdv 'byv 'brv brd vgchly 'sh
verses.translation: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם יְֽהוָ֗ה וְ֭/עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑/וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְ/גַֽחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyr'm bshmym yhvh v'lyvn ytn qlv brd vgchly 'sh
verses.translation: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּי/ו וַ/יְפִיצֵ֑/ם וּ/בְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝ב וַ/יְהֻמֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshlch chtsyv vypytsm vbrqym rb vyhmm
verses.translation: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD , at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤רָא֨וּ אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽ/יִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֪וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִ/גַּעֲרָ֣תְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝/נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'pyqy mym vyglv mvsdvt tbl mg'rtkh yhvh mnshmt rvch 'pkh
verses.translation: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭/מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑/נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗/נִי מִ/מַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: yshlch mmrvm yqchny ymshny mmym rbym
verses.translation: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֗/נִי מֵ/אֹיְבִ֥/י עָ֑ז וּ֝/מִ/שֹּׂנְאַ֗/י כִּֽי אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: ytsylny m'yby 'z vmshn'y khy 'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.original: יְקַדְּמ֥וּ/נִי בְ/יוֹם אֵידִ֑/י וַֽ/יְהִי יְהוָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: yqdmvny byvm 'ydy vyhy yhvh lmsh'n ly
verses.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִיאֵ֥/נִי לַ/מֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗/נִי כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyvtsy'ny lmrchb ychltsny khy chpts by
verses.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֣/נִי יְהוָ֣ה כְּ/צִדְקִ֑/י כְּ/בֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗/י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽ/י
verses.translit: ygmlny yhvh khtsdqy khbr ydy yshyb ly
verses.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.original: כִּֽי שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵ/אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy shmrty drkhy yhvh vl' rsh'ty m'lhy
verses.translation: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל מִשְׁפָּטָ֣י/ו לְ/נֶגְדִּ֑/י וְ֝/חֻקֹּתָ֗י/ו לֹא אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּ/י
verses.translit: khy khl mshptyv lngdy vchqtyv l' 'syr mny
verses.translation: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.original: וָ/אֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑/וֹ וָ֝/אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵ/עֲוֺנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'hy tmym 'mv v'shtmr m'vny
verses.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.original: וַ/יָּֽשֶׁב יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣/י כְ/צִדְקִ֑/י כְּ/בֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗/י לְ/נֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb yhvh ly khtsdqy khbr ydy lngd 'ynyv
verses.translation: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

verses.original: עִם חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם
verses.translit: 'm chsyd ttchsd 'm gbr tmym ttmm
verses.translation: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

verses.original: עִם נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְ/עִם עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל
verses.translit: 'm nbr ttbrr v'm 'qsh ttptl
verses.translation: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה עַם עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְ/עֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל
verses.translit: khy 'th 'm 'ny tvshy' v'ynym rmvt tshpyl
verses.translation: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑/י יְהוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗/י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th t'yr nry yhvh 'lhy ygyh chshkhy
verses.translation: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.original: כִּֽי בְ֭/ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝/בֵֽ/אלֹהַ֗/י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר
verses.translit: khy bkh 'rts gdvd vb'lhy 'dlg shvr
verses.translation: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

verses.original: הָ/אֵל֮ תָּמִ֪ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥/וֹ אִמְרַֽת יְהוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְ/כֹ֤ל הַ/חֹסִ֬ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: h'l tmym drkhv 'mrt yhvh tsrvph mgn hv' lkhl hchsym bv
verses.translation: For who is God save the LORD ? or who is a rock save our God?

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥/י אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy my 'lvh mbl'dy yhvh vmy tsvr zvlty 'lhynv
verses.translation: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

verses.original: הָ֭/אֵל הַ/מְאַזְּרֵ֣/נִי חָ֑יִל וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: h'l hm'zrny chyl vytn tmym drkhy
verses.translation: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet , and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַ/י כָּ/אַיָּל֑וֹת וְ/עַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗/י יַעֲמִידֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mshvh rgly kh'ylvt v'l bmty y'mydny
verses.translation: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַ/י לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽ/נִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: mlmd ydy lmlchmh vnchth qsht nchvshh zrv'ty
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֶּן לִ/י֮ מָגֵ֪ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥/ךָ וִֽ/ימִינְ/ךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑/נִי וְֽ/עַנְוַתְ/ךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vttn ly mgn ysh'kh vymynkh ts'dny v'nvtkh trbny
verses.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣/י תַחְתָּ֑/י וְ/לֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽ/י
verses.translit: trchyb ts'dy tchty vl' m'dv qrsly
verses.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.original: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַ/י וְ/אַשִּׂיגֵ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא אָ֝שׁוּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'rdvf 'vyby v'shygm vl' 'shvb 'd khlvtm
verses.translation: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.original: אֶ֭מְחָצֵ/ם וְ/לֹא יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mchtsm vl' ykhlv qvm yplv tcht rgly
verses.translation: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

verses.original: וַ/תְּאַזְּרֵ֣/נִי חַ֭יִל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣/י תַּחְתָּֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'zrny chyl lmlchmh tkhry' qmy tchty
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֹיְבַ֗/י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣/י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝/מְשַׂנְאַ֗/י אַצְמִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'yby ntth ly 'rf vmshn'y 'tsmytm
verses.translation: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.

verses.original: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְ/אֵין מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְ/לֹ֣א עָנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshv'v v'yn mvshy' 'l yhvh vl' 'nm
verses.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶשְׁחָקֵ֗/ם כְּ/עָפָ֥ר עַל פְּנֵי ר֑וּחַ כְּ/טִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shchqm kh'pr 'l pny rvch khtyt chvtsvt 'ryqm
verses.translation: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.original: תְּפַלְּטֵ/נִי֮ מֵ/רִ֪יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵ/נִי לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: tpltny mryby 'm tshymny lr'sh gvym 'm l' yd'ty y'bdvny
verses.translation: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

verses.original: לְ/שֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑/י בְּנֵֽי נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: lshm' 'zn yshm'v ly bny nkhr ykhchshv ly
verses.translation: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

verses.original: בְּנֵי נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝/יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽ/מִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bny nkhr yblv vychrgv mmsgrvtyhm
verses.translation: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.original: חַי יְ֭הוָה וּ/בָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑/י וְ֝/יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽ/י
verses.translit: chy yhvh vbrvkh tsvry vyrvm 'lvhy ysh'y
verses.translation: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

verses.original: הָ/אֵ֗ל הַ/נּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑/י וַ/יַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽ/י
verses.translit: h'l hnvtn nqmvt ly vydbr 'mym tchty
verses.translation: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.original: מְפַלְּטִ֗/י מֵ/אֹ֫יְבָ֥/י אַ֣ף מִן קָ֭מַ/י תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑/נִי מֵ/אִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mplty m'yby 'f mn qmy trvmmny m'ysh chms ttsylny
verses.translation: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD , among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֤ן אוֹדְ/ךָ֖ בַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
verses.translit: 'l khn 'vdkh bgvym yhvh vlshmkh 'zmrh
verses.translation: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

verses.original: הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד אֵ֑ל וּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗י/ו מַגִּ֥יד הָ/רָקִֽיעַ
verses.translit: hshmym msprym khbvd 'l vm'shh ydyv mgyd hrqy'
verses.translation: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

verses.original: י֣וֹם לְ֭/יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְ/לַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝/לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: yvm lyvm yby' 'mr vlylh llylh ychvh d't
verses.translation: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

verses.original: אֵֽין אֹ֭מֶר וְ/אֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'yn 'mr v'yn dbrym bly nshm' qvlm
verses.translation: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.original: בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗/ם וּ/בִ/קְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּי/הֶ֑ם לַ֝/שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם אֹ֥הֶל בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bkhl h'rts yts' qvm vbqtsh tbl mlyhm lshmsh shm 'hl bhm
verses.translation: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

verses.original: וְ/ה֗וּא כְּ֭/חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵ/חֻפָּת֑/וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝/גִבּ֗וֹר לָ/ר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח
verses.translit: vhv' khchtn yts' mchptv yshysh khgbvr lrvts 'rch
verses.translation: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.original: מִ/קְצֵ֤ה הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם מֽוֹצָא֗/וֹ וּ/תְקוּפָת֥/וֹ עַל קְצוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽ/חַמָּת/וֹ
verses.translit: mqtsh hshmym mvts'v vtqvptv 'l qtsvtm v'yn nstr mchmtv
verses.translation: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.original: תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי
verses.translit: tvrt yhvh tmymh mshybt npsh 'dvt yhvh n'mnh mchkhymt pty
verses.translation: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.original: פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם
verses.translit: pqvdy yhvh yshrym mshmchy lb mtsvt yhvh brh m'yrt 'ynym
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫/עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: yr't yhvh thvrh 'vmdt l'd mshpty yhvh 'mt tsdqv ychdv
verses.translation: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.original: הַֽ/נֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭/זָּהָב וּ/מִ/פַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּ/מְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝/דְּבַ֗שׁ וְ/נֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים
verses.translit: hnchmdym mzhb vmpz rb vmtvqym mdbsh vnpt tsvpym
verses.translation: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.original: גַּֽם עַ֭בְדְּ/ךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּ/הֶ֑ם בְּ֝/שָׁמְרָ֗/ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב
verses.translit: gm 'bdkh nzhr bhm bshmrm 'qb rb
verses.translation: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults .

verses.original: שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי יָבִ֑ין מִֽ/נִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shgy'vt my ybyn mnstrvt nqny
verses.translation: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם מִ/זֵּדִ֨ים חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗/ךָ אַֽל יִמְשְׁלוּ בִ֣/י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝/נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִ/פֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב
verses.translit: gm mzdym chshkh 'bdkh 'l ymshlv by 'z 'ytm vnqyty mpsh' rb
verses.translation: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD , my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

verses.original: יַֽעַנְ/ךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּ/י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְ/ךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: y'nkh yhvh byvm tsrh yshgbkh shm 'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.translit: yshlch 'zrkh mqdsh vmtsyvn ys'dkh
verses.translation: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.original: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל מִנְחֹתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עוֹלָתְ/ךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣/ה סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yzkhr khl mnchtkh v'vltkh ydshnh slh
verses.translation: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.original: יִֽתֶּן לְ/ךָ֥ כִ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ וְֽ/כָל עֲצָתְ/ךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא
verses.translit: ytn lkh khlbbkh vkhl 'tstkh yml'
verses.translation: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.original: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה בִּ֘/ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗/ךָ וּ/בְ/שֵֽׁם אֱלֹהֵ֥י/נוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: nrnnh byshv'tkh vbshm 'lhynv ndgl yml' yhvh khl msh'lvtykh
verses.translation: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥/וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵ/הוּ מִ/שְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ בִּ֝/גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'th yd'ty khy hvshy' yhvh mshychv y'nhv mshmy qdshv bgbrvt ysh' ymynv
verses.translation: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭/רֶכֶב וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה בַ/סּוּסִ֑ים וַ/אֲנַ֓חְנוּ בְּ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י/נוּ נַזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: 'lh brkhb v'lh bsvsym v'nchnv bshm yhvh 'lhynv nzkhyr
verses.translation: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְ/נָפָ֑לוּ וַ/אֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַ/נִּתְעוֹדָֽד
verses.translit: hmh khr'v vnplv v'nchnv qmnv vnt'vdd
verses.translation: Save, LORD : let the king hear us when we call.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD ; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּ/עָזְּ/ךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝/בִ/ישׁ֥וּעָתְ/ךָ֗ מַה יגיל יָּ֥גֶל מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: yhvh b'zkh yshmch mlkh vbyshv'tkh mh ygyl ygl m'd
verses.translation: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּ/וֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑/וֹ וַ/אֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו בַּל מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: t'vt lbv ntth lv v'rsht shptyv bl mn't slh
verses.translation: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.original: כִּֽי תְ֭קַדְּמֶ/נּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝/רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז
verses.translit: khy tqdmnv brkhvt tvb tshyt lr'shv 'trt pz
verses.translation: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.original: חַיִּ֤ים שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּ/ךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑/וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: chyym sh'l mmkh ntth lv 'rkh ymym 'vlm v'd
verses.translation: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹד/וֹ בִּ/ישׁוּעָתֶ֑/ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝/הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: gdvl khbvdv byshv'tkh hvd vhdr tshvh 'lyv
verses.translation: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

verses.original: כִּֽי תְשִׁיתֵ֣/הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָ/עַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥/הוּ בְ֝/שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy tshythv brkhvt l'd tchdhv bshmchh 't pnykh
verses.translation: For the king trusteth in the LORD , and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.original: כִּֽי הַ֭/מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/בְ/חֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: khy hmlkh btch byhvh vbchsd 'lyvn bl ymvt
verses.translation: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.original: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְ/ךָ לְ/כָל אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ יְ֝מִֽינְ/ךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tmts' ydkh lkhl 'ybykh ymynkh tmts' shn'ykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.original: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤/מוֹ כְּ/תַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְ/עֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥י/ךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּ/אַפּ֣/וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑/ם וְֽ/תֹאכְלֵ֥/ם אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: tshytmv khtnvr 'sh l't pnykh yhvh b'pv ybl'm vt'khlm 'sh
verses.translation: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.original: פִּ֭רְיָ/מוֹ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝/זַרְעָ֗/ם מִ/בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: prymv m'rts t'bd vzr'm mbny 'dm
verses.translation: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform .

verses.original: כִּי נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣י/ךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל יוּכָֽלוּ
verses.translit: khy ntv 'lykh r'h chshbv mzmh bl yvkhlv
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

verses.original: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣/מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝/מֵֽיתָרֶ֗י/ךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy tshytmv shkhm bmytrykh tkhvnn 'l pnyhm
verses.translation: Be thou exalted, LORD , in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ עַל אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַ/שַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l 'ylt hshchr mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

verses.original: אֵלִ֣/י אֵ֭לִ/י לָ/מָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑/נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝/ישׁוּעָתִ֗/י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ly 'ly lmh 'zbtny rchvq myshv'ty dbry sh'gty
verses.translation: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗/י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְ/לֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝/לַ֗יְלָה וְֽ/לֹא דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'lhy 'qr' yvmm vl' t'nh vlylh vl' dvmyh ly
verses.translation: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th qdvsh yvshb thlvt yshr'l
verses.translation: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

verses.original: בְּ֭/ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽ/תְּפַלְּטֵֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: bkh btchv 'btynv btchv vtpltmv
verses.translation: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְ/נִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּ/ךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְ/לֹא בֽוֹשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'lykh z'qv vnmltv bkh btchv vl' bvshv
verses.translation: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְ/לֹא אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּ/בְז֥וּי עָֽם
verses.translit: v'nkhy tvl't vl' 'ysh chrpt 'dm vbzvy 'm
verses.translation: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying ,

verses.original: כָּל רֹ֭אַ/י יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑/י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝/שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: khl r'y yl'gv ly yptyrv bshph yny'v r'sh
verses.translation: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑/הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗/הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gl 'l yhvh yplthv ytsylhv khy chpts bv
verses.translation: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣/י מִ/בָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗/י עַל שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th gchy mbtn mbtychy 'l shdy 'my
verses.translation: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

verses.original: עָ֭לֶי/ךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵ/רָ֑חֶם מִ/בֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗/י אֵ֣לִ/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: 'lykh hshlkhty mrchm mbtn 'my 'ly 'th
verses.translation: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

verses.original: אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּ/נִּי כִּי צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר
verses.translit: 'l trchq mmny khy tsrh qrvbh khy 'yn 'vzr
verses.translation: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.original: סְ֭בָבוּ/נִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: sbbvny prym rbym 'byry bshn khtrvny
verses.translation: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.original: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣/י פִּי/הֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְ/שֹׁאֵֽג
verses.translit: ptsv 'ly pyhm 'ryh trf vsh'g
verses.translation: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

verses.original: כַּ/מַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְ/הִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥/י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּ/י כַּ/דּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽ/י
verses.translit: khmym nshpkhty vhtprdv khl 'tsmvty hyh lby khdvng nms btvkh m'y
verses.translation: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

verses.original: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּ/חֶ֨רֶשׂ כֹּחִ֗/י וּ֭/לְשׁוֹנִ/י מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑/י וְֽ/לַ/עֲפַר מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ybsh khchrsh khchy vlshvny mdbq mlqvchy vl'pr mvt tshptny
verses.translation: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.original: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּ/נִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּ/נִי כָּ֝/אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥/י וְ/רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy sbbvny khlbym 'dt mr'ym hqypvny kh'ry ydy vrgly
verses.translation: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

verses.original: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑/י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'spr khl 'tsmvty hmh ybytv yr'v by
verses.translation: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.original: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣/י לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/עַל לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗/י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל
verses.translit: ychlqv bgdy lhm v'l lbvshy ypylv gvrl
verses.translation: But be not thou far from me, O LORD : O my strength, haste thee to help me.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗/י לְ/עֶזְרָ֥תִ/י חֽוּשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'l trchq 'ylvty l'zrty chvshh
verses.translation: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

verses.original: הַצִּ֣ילָ/ה מֵ/חֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑/י מִ/יַּד כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: htsylh mchrb npshy myd khlb ychydty
verses.translation: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
