verses.original: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ/נִי מִ/פִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּ/מִ/קַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hvshy'ny mpy 'ryh vmqrny rmym 'nytny
verses.translation: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ לְ/אֶחָ֑/י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'sprh shmkh l'chy btvkh qhl 'hllkh
verses.translation: Ye that fear the LORD , praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה הַֽלְל֗וּ/הוּ כָּל זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּ/הוּ וְ/ג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗/נּוּ כָּל זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: yr'y yhvh hllvhv khl zr' y'qb khbdvhv vgvrv mmnv khl zr' yshr'l
verses.translation: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא בָזָ֨ה וְ/לֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְ/לֹא הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣י/ו מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וּֽ/בְ/שַׁוְּע֖/וֹ אֵלָ֣י/ו שָׁמֵֽעַ
verses.translit: khy l' bzh vl' shqts 'nvt 'ny vl' hstyr pnyv mmnv vbshv'v 'lyv shm'
verses.translation: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.original: מֵ֥/אִתְּ/ךָ֗ תְֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥/י בְּ/קָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥/י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: m'tkh thlty bqhl rb ndry 'shlm ngd yr'yv
verses.translation: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

verses.original: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים וְ/יִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑י/ו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְ/כֶ֣ם לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: y'khlv 'nvym vyshb'v yhllv yhvh drshyv ychy lbbkhm l'd
verses.translation: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD : and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

verses.original: יִזְכְּר֤וּ וְ/יָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: yzkhrv vyshbv 'l yhvh khl 'psy 'rts vyshtchvv lpnykh khl mshpchvt gvym
verses.translation: For the kingdom is the LORD’s : and he is the governor among the nations.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַ֭/יהוָה הַ/מְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝/מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: khy lyhvh hmlvkhh vmshl bgvym
verses.translation: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

verses.original: אָכְל֬וּ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ כָּֽל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶ֗רֶץ לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝/נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה
verses.translit: 'khlv vyshtchvv khl dshny 'rts lpnyv ykhr'v khl yvrdy 'pr vnpshv l' chyh
verses.translation: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑/נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽ/אדֹנָ֣/י לַ/דּֽוֹר
verses.translit: zr' y'bdnv yspr l'dny ldvr
verses.translation: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this .

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗/י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh r'y l' 'chsr
verses.translation: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.original: בִּ/נְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑/נִי עַל מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: bn'vt dsh' yrbytsny 'l my mnchvt ynhlny
verses.translation: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥/י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥/נִי בְ/מַעְגְּלֵי צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: npshy yshvbb ynchny bm'gly tsdq lm'n shmv
verses.translation: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּ/גֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑/י שִׁבְטְ/ךָ֥ וּ֝/מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗/ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: gm khy 'lkh bgy' tslmvt l' 'yr' r' khy 'th 'mdy shbtkh vmsh'ntkh hmh ynchmny
verses.translation: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

verses.original: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְ/פָנַ֨/י שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑/י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַ/שֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗/י כּוֹסִ֥/י רְוָיָֽה
verses.translit: t'rkh lpny shlchn ngd tsrry dshnt bshmn r'shy khvsy rvyh
verses.translation: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ ט֤וֹב וָ/חֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּ/נִי כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑/י וְ/שַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּ/בֵית יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְ/אֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: 'kh tvb vchsd yrdpvny khl ymy chyy vshbty bbyt yhvh l'rkh ymym
verses.translation: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭/יהוָה הָ/אָ֣רֶץ וּ/מְלוֹאָ֑/הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְ/יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: ldvd mzmvr lyhvh h'rts vmlv'h tbl vyshby bh
verses.translation: The earth is the LORD’s , and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.original: כִּי ה֭וּא עַל יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑/הּ וְ/עַל נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: khy hv' 'l ymym ysdh v'l nhrvt ykhvnnh
verses.translation: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.original: מִֽי יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְ/הַר יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מִי יָ֝קוּם בִּ/מְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: my y'lh bhr yhvh vmy yqvm bmqvm qdshv
verses.translation: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD ? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.original: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽ/בַר לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא נָשָׂ֣א לַ/שָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/לֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְ/מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: nqy khpym vbr lbb 'shr l' nsh' lshv' npshy vl' nshb' lmrmh
verses.translation: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝/צְדָקָ֗ה מֵ/אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ysh' brkhh m't yhvh vtsdqh m'lhy ysh'v
verses.translation: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD , and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.original: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דרש/ו דֹּרְשָׁ֑י/ו מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖י/ךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: zh dvr drshv drshyv mbqshy pnykh y'qb slh
verses.translation: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁי/כֶ֗ם וְֽ֭/הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝/יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: sh'v sh'rym r'shykhm vhnsh'v ptchy 'vlm vybv' mlkh hkhbvd
verses.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.original: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַ/כָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְ/גִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: my zh mlkh hkhbvd yhvh 'zvz vgbvr yhvh gbvr mlchmh
verses.translation: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים רָֽאשֵׁי/כֶ֗ם וּ֭/שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝/יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: sh'v sh'rym r'shykhm vsh'v ptchy 'vlm vyb' mlkh hkhbvd
verses.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.original: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַ/כָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַ/כָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: my hv' zh mlkh hkhbvd yhvh tsb'vt hv' mlkh hkhbvd slh
verses.translation: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥/י אֶשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: ldvd 'lykh yhvh npshy 'sh'
verses.translation: Unto thee, O LORD , do I lift up my soul.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗/י בְּ/ךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣/י לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'lhy bkh btchty 'l 'bvshh 'l y'ltsv 'yby ly
verses.translation: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כָּל קֹ֭וֶי/ךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַ/בּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: gm khl qvykh l' ybshv ybshv hbvgdym ryqm
verses.translation: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֣י/ךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑/נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣י/ךָ לַמְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: drkhykh yhvh hvdy'ny 'rchvtykh lmdny
verses.translation: Shew me thy ways, O LORD ; teach me thy paths.

verses.original: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤/נִי בַ/אֲמִתֶּ֨/ךָ וְֽ/לַמְּדֵ֗/נִי כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑/י אוֹתְ/ךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: hdrykhny b'mtkh vlmdny khy 'th 'lhy ysh'y 'vtkh qvyty khl hyvm
verses.translation: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

verses.original: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶ֣י/ךָ יְ֭הוָה וַ/חֲסָדֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֖י מֵ/עוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: zkhr rchmykh yhvh vchsdykh khy m'vlm hmh
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD , thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

verses.original: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨/י וּ/פְשָׁעַ֗/י אַל תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ זְכָר לִ/י אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: cht'vt n'vry vpsh'y 'l tzkhr khchsdkh zkhr ly 'th lm'n tvbkh yhvh
verses.translation: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD .

verses.original: טוֹב וְ/יָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: tvb vyshr yhvh 'l khn yvrh cht'ym bdrkh
verses.translation: Good and upright is the LORD : therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.original: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽ/ילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ydrkh 'nvym bmshpt vylmd 'nvym drkhv
verses.translation: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.original: כָּל אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֑ת לְ/נֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗/וֹ וְ/עֵדֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khl 'rchvt yhvh chsd v'mt lntsry brytv v'dtyv
verses.translation: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽ/סָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝/עֲוֺנִ֗/י כִּ֣י רַב הֽוּא
verses.translit: lm'n shmkh yhvh vslcht l'vny khy rb hv'
verses.translation: For thy name’s sake, O LORD , pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

verses.original: מִי זֶ֣ה הָ֭/אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗/נּוּ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר
verses.translit: my zh h'ysh yr' yhvh yvrnv bdrkh ybchr
verses.translation: What man is he that feareth the LORD ? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ בְּ/ט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝/זַרְע֗/וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: npshv btvb tlyn vzr'v yyrsh 'rts
verses.translation: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.original: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִ/ירֵאָ֑י/ו וּ֝/בְרִית֗/וֹ לְ/הוֹדִיעָֽ/ם
verses.translit: svd yhvh lyr'yv vbrytv lhvdy'm
verses.translation: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

verses.original: עֵינַ֣/י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא יוֹצִ֖יא מֵ/רֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yny tmyd 'l yhvh khy hv' yvtsy' mrsht rgly
verses.translation: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD ; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.original: פְּנֵה אֵלַ֥/י וְ/חָנֵּ֑/נִי כִּֽי יָחִ֖יד וְ/עָנִ֣י אָֽנִי
verses.translit: pnh 'ly vchnny khy ychyd v'ny 'ny
verses.translation: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.original: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣/י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝/מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗/י הוֹצִיאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: tsrvt lbby hrchybv mmtsvqvty hvtsy'ny
verses.translation: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִ/י וַ/עֲמָלִ֑/י וְ֝/שָׂ֗א לְ/כָל חַטֹּאותָֽ/י
verses.translit: r'h 'nyy v'mly vsh' lkhl cht'vty
verses.translation: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.original: רְאֵֽה אוֹיְבַ֥/י כִּי רָ֑בּוּ וְ/שִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: r'h 'vyby khy rbv vshn't chms shn'vny
verses.translation: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.original: שָׁמְרָ֣/ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י וְ/הַצִּילֵ֑/נִי אַל אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shmrh npshy vhtsylny 'l 'bvsh khy chsyty bkh
verses.translation: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

verses.original: תֹּם וָ/יֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּ/נִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tm vyshr ytsrvny khy qvytykh
verses.translation: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

verses.original: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝/כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָי/ו
verses.translit: pdh 'lhym 't yshr'l mkhl tsrvtyv
verses.translation: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד שָׁפְטֵ֤/נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי בְּ/תֻמִּ֣/י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּ/בַ/יהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד
verses.translit: ldvd shptny yhvh khy 'ny btmy hlkhty vbyhvh btchty l' 'm'd
verses.translation: Judge me, O LORD ; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD ; therefore I shall not slide.

verses.original: בְּחָנֵ֣/נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְ/נַסֵּ֑/נִי צרופ/ה צָרְפָ֖/ה כִלְיוֹתַ֣/י וְ/לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: bchnny yhvh vnsny tsrvph tsrph khlyvty vlby
verses.translation: Examine me, O LORD , and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.translit: khy chsdkh lngd 'yny vhthlkhty b'mtkh
verses.translation: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

verses.original: לֹא יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְ/עִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: l' yshbty 'm mty shv' v'm n'lmym l' 'bv'
verses.translation: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.original: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְ/עִם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: shn'ty qhl mr'ym v'm rsh'ym l' 'shb
verses.translation: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.original: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּ/נִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑/י וַ/אֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת מִזְבַּחֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'rchts bnqyvn khpy v'sbbh 't mzbchkh yhvh
verses.translation: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD :

verses.original: לַ֭/שְׁמִעַ בְּ/ק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝/לְ/סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: lshm' bqvl tvdh vlspr khl npl'vtykh
verses.translation: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'hbty m'vn bytkh vmqvm mshkhn khbvdkh
verses.translation: LORD , I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.original: אַל תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/עִם אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l t'sf 'm cht'ym npshy v'm 'nshy dmym chyy
verses.translation: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר בִּ/ידֵי/הֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִֽ֝/ימִינָ֗/ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד
verses.translit: 'shr bydyhm zmh vymynm ml'h shchd
verses.translation: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.translit: v'ny btmy 'lkh pdny vchnny
verses.translation: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.original: רַ֭גְלִ/י עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְ/מִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝/מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rgly 'mdh bmyshvr bmqhlym 'brkh yhvh
verses.translation: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD .

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד יְהוָ֤ה אוֹרִ֣/י וְ֭/יִשְׁעִ/י מִ/מִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז חַ֝יַּ֗/י מִ/מִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד
verses.translit: ldvd yhvh 'vry vysh'y mmy 'yr' yhvh m'vz chyy mmy 'pchd
verses.translation: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.original: בִּ/קְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨/י מְרֵעִים֮ לֶ/אֱכֹ֪ל אֶת בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥/י צָרַ֣/י וְ/אֹיְבַ֣/י לִ֑/י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְ/נָפָֽלוּ
verses.translit: bqrb 'ly mr'ym l'khl 't bshry tsry v'yby ly hmh khshlv vnplv
verses.translation: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.original: אִם תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨/י מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥/י אִם תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַ/י מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝/זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ
verses.translit: 'm tchnh 'ly mchnh l' yyr' lby 'm tqvm 'ly mlchmh bz't 'ny bvtch
verses.translation: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽ/אֵת יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪/הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣/י בְּ/בֵית יְ֭הוָה כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑/י לַ/חֲז֥וֹת בְּ/נֹֽעַם יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּ/לְ/בַקֵּ֥ר בְּ/הֵיכָלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'cht sh'lty m't yhvh 'vth 'bqsh shbty bbyt yhvh khl ymy chyy lchzvt bn'm yhvh vlbqr bhykhlv
verses.translation: One thing have I desired of the LORD , that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD , and to enquire in his temple.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨/נִי בְּ/סֻכֹּ/ה֮ בְּ/י֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵ/נִי בְּ/סֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑/וֹ בְּ֝/צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy ytspnny bskhh byvm r'h ystrny bstr 'hlv btsvr yrvmmny
verses.translation: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡/י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬/י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗/י וְ/אֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭/אָהֳל/וֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝/אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th yrvm r'shy 'l 'yby sbybvty v'zbchh b'hlv zbchy trv'h 'shyrh v'zmrh lyhvh
verses.translation: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD .

verses.original: שְׁמַע יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥/י אֶקְרָ֗א וְ/חָנֵּ֥/נִי וַ/עֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shm' yhvh qvly 'qr' vchnny v'nny
verses.translation: Hear, O LORD , when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֤ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּ/י בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑/י אֶת פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: lkh 'mr lby bqshv pny 't pnykh yhvh 'bqsh
verses.translation: When thou saidst , Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD , will I seek.

verses.original: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ מִמֶּ/נִּי֮ אַֽל תַּט בְּ/אַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥/ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥/י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל תִּטְּשֵׁ֥/נִי וְ/אַל תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗/נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l tstr pnykh mmny 'l tt b'f 'bdkh 'zrty hyyt 'l ttshny v'l t'zbny 'lhy ysh'y
verses.translation: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.original: כִּי אָבִ֣/י וְ/אִמִּ֣/י עֲזָב֑וּ/נִי וַֽ/יהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy 'by v'my 'zbvny vyhvh y'spny
verses.translation: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

verses.original: ה֤וֹרֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥/ךָ וּ֭/נְחֵ/נִי בְּ/אֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽ/י
verses.translit: hvrny yhvh drkhkh vnchny b'rch myshvr lm'n shvrry
verses.translation: Teach me thy way, O LORD , and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּ֭תְּנֵ/נִי בְּ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑/י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ בִ֥/י עֵֽדֵי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִ/יפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס
verses.translit: 'l ttnny bnpsh tsry khy qmv by 'dy shqr vypch chms
verses.translation: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.original: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִ/רְא֥וֹת בְּֽ/טוּב יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: lvl' h'mnty lr'vt btvb yhvh b'rts chyym
verses.translation: I had fainted , unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.original: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְ/יַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: qvh 'l yhvh chzq vy'mts lbkh vqvh 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Wait on the LORD : be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD .

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤י/ךָ יְהוָ֨ה אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִ/י֮ אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥/נִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וְ֝/נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: ldvd 'lykh yhvh 'qr' tsvry 'l tchrsh mmny pn tchshh mmny vnmshlty 'm yvrdy bvr
verses.translation: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַ/י בְּ/שַׁוְּעִ֣/י אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/נָשְׂאִ֥/י יָ֝דַ֗/י אֶל דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm' qvl tchnvny bshv'y 'lykh bnsh'y ydy 'l dbyr qdshkh
verses.translation: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

verses.original: אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣/נִי עִם רְשָׁעִים֮ וְ/עִם פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם רֵֽעֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/רָעָ֗ה בִּ/לְבָבָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l tmshkhny 'm rsh'ym v'm p'ly 'vn dbry shlvm 'm r'yhm vr'h blbbm
verses.translation: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

verses.original: תֶּן לָ/הֶ֣ם כְּ/פָעֳלָ/ם֮ וּ/כְ/רֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫י/הֶ֥ם כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵי/הֶם תֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣/ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: tn lhm khp'lm vkhr' m'llyhm khm'shh ydyhm tn lhm hshb gmvlm lhm
verses.translation: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְ/אֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑י/ו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗/ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy l' ybynv 'l p'lt yhvh v'l m'shh ydyv yhrsm vl' ybnm
verses.translation: Because they regard not the works of the LORD , nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh khy shm' qvl tchnvny
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD , because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה עֻזִּ֥/י וּ/מָגִנִּ/י֮ בּ֤/וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗/י וְֽ/נֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַ/יַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑/י וּֽ/מִ/שִּׁירִ֥/י אֲהוֹדֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: yhvh 'zy vmgny bv btch lby vn'zrty vy'lz lby vmshyry 'hvdnv
verses.translation: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז לָ֑/מוֹ וּ/מָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣/וֹ הֽוּא
verses.translit: yhvh 'z lmv vm'vz yshv'vt mshychv hv'
verses.translation: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.original: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָ/ה אֶת עַמֶּ֗/ךָ וּ/בָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶ֑/ךָ וּֽ/רְעֵ֥/ם וְ֝/נַשְּׂאֵ֗/ם עַד הָ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hvshy'h 't 'mkh vbrkh 't nchltkh vr'm vnsh'm 'd h'vlm
verses.translation: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭/יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָ/עֹֽז
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd hbv lyhvh bny 'lym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD , O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭/יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑/וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה בְּ/הַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrt qdsh
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל הַ֫/מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל הַ/כָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: qvl yhvh 'l hmym 'l hkhbvd hr'ym yhvh 'l mym rbym
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

verses.original: קוֹל יְהוָ֥ה בַּ/כֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּ/הָדָֽר
verses.translit: qvl yhvh bkhch qvl yhvh bhdr
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַ/יְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת אַרְזֵ֥י הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: qvl yhvh shbr 'rzym vyshbr yhvh 't 'rzy hlbnvn
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְקִידֵ֥/ם כְּמוֹ עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝/שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן רְאֵמִֽים
verses.translit: vyrqydm khmv 'gl lbnvn vshryn khmv bn r'mym
verses.translation: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.original: קוֹל יְהוָ֥ה חֹצֵ֗ב לַהֲב֥וֹת אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: qvl yhvh chtsb lhbvt 'sh
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: qvl yhvh ychyl mdbr ychyl yhvh mdbr qdsh
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽ/יֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּ/בְ/הֵיכָל֑/וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗/וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: qvl yhvh ychvll 'ylvt vychshf y'rvt vbhykhlv khlv 'mr khbvd
verses.translation: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה לַ/מַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: yhvh lmbvl yshb vyshb yhvh mlkh l'vlm
verses.translation: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְ/עַמּ֣/וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת עַמּ֣/וֹ בַ/שָּׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: yhvh 'z l'mv ytn yhvh ybrkh 't 'mv bshlvm
verses.translation: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁיר חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַ/בַּ֣יִת לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: mzmvr shyr chnkht hbyt ldvd
verses.translation: I will extol thee, O LORD ; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.original: אֲרוֹמִמְ/ךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑/נִי וְ/לֹא שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣/י לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rvmmkh yhvh khy dlytny vl' shmcht 'yby ly
verses.translation: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗י/ךָ וַ/תִּרְפָּאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy shv'ty 'lykh vtrp'ny
verses.translation: O LORD , thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑/י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗/נִי מ/יורדי מִ/יָּֽרְדִ/י בֽוֹר
verses.translit: yhvh h'lyt mn sh'vl npshy chyytny myvrdy myrdy bvr
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD , O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑י/ו וְ֝/הוֹד֗וּ לְ/זֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh chsydyv vhvdv lzkhr qdshv
verses.translation: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

verses.original: כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע בְּ/אַפּ/וֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּ/רְצ֫וֹנ֥/וֹ בָּ֭/עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְ/לַ/בֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: khy rg' b'pv chyym brtsvnv b'rb ylyn bkhy vlbqr rnh
verses.translation: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.original: וַ֭/אֲנִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְ/שַׁלְוִ֑/י בַּל אֶמּ֥וֹט לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty bshlvy bl 'mvt l'vlm
verses.translation: LORD , by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בִּ/רְצוֹנְ/ךָ֮ הֶעֱמַ֪דְתָּה לְֽ/הַרְרִ֫/י עֹ֥ז הִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ פָנֶ֗י/ךָ הָיִ֥יתִי נִבְהָֽל
verses.translit: yhvh brtsvnkh h'mdth lhrry 'z hstrt pnykh hyyty nbhl
verses.translation: I cried to thee, O LORD ; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וְ/אֶל אֲ֝דֹנָ֗/י אֶתְחַנָּֽן
verses.translit: 'lykh yhvh 'qr' v'l 'dny 'tchnn
verses.translation: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.original: מַה בֶּ֥צַע בְּ/דָמִ/י֮ בְּ/רִדְתִּ֪/י אֶ֫ל שָׁ֥חַת הֲ/יוֹדְ/ךָ֥ עָפָ֑ר הֲ/יַגִּ֥יד אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mh bts' bdmy brdty 'l shcht hyvdkh 'pr hygyd 'mtkh
verses.translation: Hear, O LORD , and have mercy upon me: LORD , be thou my helper.

verses.original: שְׁמַע יְהוָ֥ה וְ/חָנֵּ֑/נִי יְ֝הוָה הֱֽיֵה עֹזֵ֥ר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm' yhvh vchnny yhvh hyh 'zr ly
verses.translation: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.translit: hpkht mspdy lmchvl ly ptcht shqy vt'zrny shmchh
verses.translation: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.original: בְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם בְּ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: bkh yhvh chsyty 'l 'bvshh l'vlm btsdqtkh pltny
verses.translation: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨/י אָזְנְ/ךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥/נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨/י לְֽ/צוּר מָ֭עוֹז לְ/בֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְ/הוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hth 'ly 'znkh mhrh htsylny hyh ly ltsvr m'vz lbyt mtsvdvt lhvshy'ny
verses.translation: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.original: כִּֽי סַלְעִ֣/י וּ/מְצוּדָתִ֣/י אָ֑תָּה וּ/לְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְ/ךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥/נִי וּֽ/תְנַהֲלֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy sl'y vmtsvdty 'th vlm'n shmkh tnchny vtnhlny
verses.translation: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

verses.original: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗/נִי מֵ/רֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑/י כִּֽי אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽ/י
verses.translit: tvtsy'ny mrsht zv tmnv ly khy 'th m'vzy
verses.translation: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

verses.original: בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥/י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥/י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: bydkh 'pqyd rvchy pdyth 'vty yhvh 'l 'mt
verses.translation: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD .

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַ/שֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝/אֲנִ֗י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: shn'ty hshmrym hbly shv' v'ny 'l yhvh btchty
verses.translation: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.original: אָגִ֥ילָה וְ/אֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּ/חַ֫סְדֶּ֥/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִ֑/י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּ/צָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: 'gylh v'shmchh bchsdkh 'shr r'yt 't 'nyy yd't btsrvt npshy
verses.translation: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּ/נִי בְּ/יַד אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַ/מֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vl' hsgrtny byd 'vyb h'mdt bmrchb rgly
verses.translation: Have mercy upon me, O LORD , for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea , my soul and my belly.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥/נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר לִ֥/י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְ/כַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗/י נַפְשִׁ֥/י וּ/בִטְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: chnny yhvh khy tsr ly 'shshh bkh's 'yny npshy vbtny
verses.translation: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְ/יָג֡וֹן חַיַּ/י֮ וּ/שְׁנוֹתַ֪/י בַּ/אֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּ/עֲוֺנִ֣/י כֹחִ֑/י וַ/עֲצָמַ֥/י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ
verses.translit: khy khlv bygvn chyy vshnvty b'nchh khshl b'vny khchy v'tsmy 'shshv
verses.translation: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.original: מִ/כָּל צֹרְרַ֨/י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְ/לִ/שֲׁכֵנַ֨/י מְאֹד֮ וּ/פַ֪חַד לִֽ/מְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥/י רֹאַ֥/י בַּ/ח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: mkhl tsrry hyyty chrph vlshkhny m'd vpchd lmyd'y r'y bchvts nddv mmny
verses.translation: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.original: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּ/מֵ֣ת מִ/לֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּ/כְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: nshkhchty khmt mlb hyyty khkhly 'bd
verses.translation: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִ/סָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּ/הִוָּסְדָ֣/ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑/י לָ/קַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣/י זָמָֽמוּ
verses.translit: khy shm'ty dbt rbym mgvr msbyb bhvsdm ychd 'ly lqcht npshy zmmv
verses.translation: But I trusted in thee, O LORD : I said, Thou art my God.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י עָלֶ֣י/ךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: v'ny 'lykh btchty yhvh 'mrty 'lhy 'th
verses.translation: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.original: בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑/י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤/נִי מִ/יַּד א֝וֹיְבַ֗/י וּ/מֵ/רֹדְפָֽ/י
verses.translit: bydkh 'tty htsylny myd 'vyby vmrdpy
verses.translation: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.original: הָאִ֣ירָ/ה פָ֭נֶי/ךָ עַל עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣/נִי בְ/חַסְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: h'yrh pnykh 'l 'bdkh hvshy'ny bchsdkh
verses.translation: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD ; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑י/ךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִ/שְׁאֽוֹל
verses.translit: yhvh 'l 'bvshh khy qr'tykh ybshv rsh'ym ydmv lsh'vl
verses.translation: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.original: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַ/דֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּ/גַאֲוָ֥ה וָ/בֽוּז
verses.translit: t'lmnh shpty shqr hdbrvt 'l tsdyq 'tq bg'vh vbvz
verses.translation: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.original: מָ֤ה רַֽב טוּבְ/ךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽ/ירֵ֫אֶ֥י/ךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַ/חֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑/ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם
verses.translit: mh rb tvbkh 'shr tspnt lyr'ykh p'lt lchsym bkh ngd bny 'dm
verses.translation: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.original: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤/ם בְּ/סֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶי/ךָ֮ מֵֽ/רֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥/ם בְּ/סֻכָּ֗ה מֵ/רִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת
verses.translit: tstyrm bstr pnykh mrkhsy 'ysh ttspnm bskhh mryb lshnvt
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD : for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥/וֹ לִ֝֗/י בְּ/עִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh khy hply' chsdv ly b'yr mtsvr
verses.translation: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְ/חָפְזִ֗/י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִ/נֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥י/ךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗/י בְּ/שַׁוְּעִ֥/י אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty bchpzy ngrzty mngd 'ynykh 'khn shm't qvl tchnvny bshv'y 'lykh
verses.translation: O love the LORD , all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.original: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל חֲסִ֫ידָ֥י/ו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה
verses.translit: 'hbv 't yhvh khl chsydyv 'mvnym ntsr yhvh vmshlm 'l ytr 'shh g'vh
verses.translation: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD .

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה
verses.translit: ldvd mshkhyl 'shry nshvy psh' khsvy cht'h
verses.translation: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣/וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְ/אֵ֖ין בְּ/רוּח֣/וֹ רְמִיָּה
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm l' ychshb yhvh lv 'vn v'yn brvchv rmyh
verses.translation: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.original: כִּֽי הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑/י בְּ֝/שַׁאֲגָתִ֗/י כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy hchrshty blv 'tsmy bsh'gty khl hyvm
verses.translation: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗/י יָ֫דֶ֥/ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑/י בְּ/חַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: khy yvmm vlylh tkhbd 'ly ydkh nhpkh lshdy bchrbny qyts slh
verses.translation: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.original: חַטָּאתִ֨/י אוֹדִ֪יעֲ/ךָ֡ וַ/עֲוֺ֘נִ֤/י לֹֽא כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַ/י לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣/י סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: cht'ty 'vdy'kh v'vny l' khsyty 'mrty 'vdh 'ly psh'y lyhvh v'th nsh't 'vn cht'ty slh
verses.translation: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD ; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.original: עַל זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל חָסִ֨יד אֵלֶי/ךָ֮ לְ/עֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭/שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ
verses.translit: 'l z't ytpll khl chsyd 'lykh l't mts' rq lshtf mym rbym 'lyv l' ygy'v
verses.translation: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה סֵ֥תֶר לִ/י֮ מִ/צַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥/נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣/נִי סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'th str ly mtsr ttsrny rny plt tsvbbny slh
verses.translation: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּֽילְ/ךָ֨ וְֽ/אוֹרְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/דֶֽרֶךְ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣י/ךָ עֵינִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shkhylkh v'vrkh bdrkh zv tlkh 'y'tsh 'lykh 'yny
verses.translation: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽהְי֤וּ כְּ/ס֥וּס כְּ/פֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּ/מֶֽתֶג וָ/רֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣/וֹ לִ/בְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l thyv khsvs khprd 'yn hbyn bmtg vrsn 'dyv lblvm bl qrb 'lykh
verses.translation: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָ/רָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְ/הַ/בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּ/יהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: rbym mkh'vbym lrsh' vhbvtch byhvh chsd ysvbbnv
verses.translation: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD , mercy shall compass him about.

verses.original: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽ/יהוָ֣ה וְ֭/גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝/הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: shmchv byhvh vgylv tsdyqym vhrnynv khl yshry lb
verses.translation: Be glad in the LORD , and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.original: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה לַ֝/יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה
verses.translit: rnnv tsdyqym byhvh lyshrym n'vh thlh
verses.translation: Rejoice in the LORD , O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה בְּ/כִנּ֑וֹר בְּ/נֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh bkhnvr bnbl 'shvr zmrv lv
verses.translation: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭/וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּ/תְרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: shyrv lv shyr chdsh hytybv ngn btrv'h
verses.translation: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כָל מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗/הוּ בֶּ/אֱמוּנָֽה
verses.translit: khy yshr dbr yhvh vkhl m'shhv b'mvnh
verses.translation: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

verses.original: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'hb tsdqh vmshpt chsd yhvh ml'h h'rts
verses.translation: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD .

verses.original: בִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּ/בְ/ר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗י/ו כָּל צְבָאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bdbr yhvh shmym n'shv vbrvch pyv khl tsb'm
verses.translation: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.original: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭/נֵּד מֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּ/אֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: khns khnd my hym ntn b'tsrvt thvmvt
verses.translation: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.original: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭/יְהוָה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥/נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל
verses.translit: yyr'v myhvh khl h'rts mmnv ygvrv khl yshby tbl
verses.translation: Let all the earth fear the LORD : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַ/יֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: khy hv' 'mr vyhy hv' tsvh vy'md
verses.translation: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: yhvh hpyr 'tst gvym hny' mchshbvt 'mym
verses.translation: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.original: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗/וֹ לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: 'tst yhvh l'vlm t'md mchshbvt lbv ldr vdr
verses.translation: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭/גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו הָ/עָ֓ם בָּחַ֖ר לְ/נַחֲלָ֣ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shry hgvy 'shr yhvh 'lhyv h'm bchr lnchlh lv
verses.translation: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.original: מִ֭/שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: mshmym hbyt yhvh r'h 't khl bny h'dm
verses.translation: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.original: מִֽ/מְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּ֥/וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mmkhvn shbtv hshgych 'l khl yshby h'rts
verses.translation: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.original: הַ/יֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑/ם הַ֝/מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hytsr ychd lbm hmbyn 'l khl m'shyhm
verses.translation: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.original: אֵֽין הַ֭/מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּ/רָב חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּ/רָב כֹּֽחַ
verses.translit: 'yn hmlkh nvsh' brb chyl gbvr l' yntsl brb khch
verses.translation: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭/סּוּס לִ/תְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּ/בְ/רֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
verses.translit: shqr hsvs ltshv'h vbrb chylv l' ymlt
verses.translation: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל יְרֵאָ֑י/ו לַֽ/מְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְ/חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh 'yn yhvh 'l yr'yv lmychlym lchsdv
verses.translation: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.original: לְ/הַצִּ֣יל מִ/מָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וּ֝/לְ/חַיּוֹתָ֗/ם בָּ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: lhtsyl mmvt npshm vlchyvtm br'b
verses.translation: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.original: נַ֭פְשֵׁ/נוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖/נוּ וּ/מָגִנֵּ֣/נוּ הֽוּא
verses.translit: npshnv chkhth lyhvh 'zrnv vmgnnv hv'
verses.translation: Our soul waiteth for the LORD : he is our help and our shield.

verses.original: כִּי ב֭/וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑/נוּ כִּ֤י בְ/שֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣/וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: khy bv yshmch lbnv khy bshm qdshv btchnv
verses.translation: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.original: יְהִֽי חַסְדְּ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כַּ֝/אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yhy chsdkh yhvh 'lynv kh'shr ychlnv lkh
verses.translation: Let thy mercy, O LORD , be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֗ד בְּ/שַׁנּוֹת֣/וֹ אֶת טַ֭עְמ/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝/יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗/הוּ וַ/יֵּלַֽךְ
verses.translit: ldvd bshnvtv 't t'mv lpny 'bymlkh vygrshhv vylkh
verses.translation: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.original: אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/כָל עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥/וֹ בְּ/פִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'brkhh 't yhvh bkhl 't tmyd thltv bpy
verses.translation: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD : the humble shall hear thereof , and be glad.

verses.original: בַּ֭/יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑/י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְ/יִשְׂמָֽחוּ
verses.translit: byhvh tthll npshy yshm'v 'nvym vyshmchv
verses.translation: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.original: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑/י וּ/נְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣/וֹ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: gdlv lyhvh 'ty vnrvmmh shmv ychdv
verses.translation: I sought the LORD , and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.original: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת יְהוָ֣ה וְ/עָנָ֑/נִי וּ/מִ/כָּל מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗/י הִצִּילָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: drshty 't yhvh v'nny vmkhl mgvrvty htsylny
verses.translation: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.original: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣י/ו וְ/נָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם אַל יֶחְפָּֽרוּ
verses.translit: hbytv 'lyv vnhrv vpnyhm 'l ychprv
verses.translation: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him , and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַ/יהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּ/מִ/כָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗י/ו הוֹשִׁיעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zh 'ny qr' vyhvh shm' vmkhl tsrvtyv hvshy'v
verses.translation: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.original: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽ/ירֵאָ֗י/ו וַֽ/יְחַלְּצֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: chnh ml'kh yhvh sbyb lyr'yv vychltsm
verses.translation: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.original: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭/רְאוּ כִּי ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝/גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: t'mv vr'v khy tvb yhvh 'shry hgbr ychsh bv
verses.translation: O fear the LORD , ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.original: יְר֣אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑י/ו כִּי אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִ/ירֵאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yr'v 't yhvh qdshyv khy 'yn mchsvr lyr'yv
verses.translation: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing .

verses.original: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְ/רָעֵ֑בוּ וְ/דֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל טֽוֹב
verses.translit: khpyrym rshv vr'bv vdrshy yhvh l' ychsrv khl tvb
verses.translation: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD .

verses.original: לְֽכוּ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑/י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhv bnym shm'v ly yr't yhvh 'lmdkhm
verses.translation: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

verses.original: מִֽי הָ֭/אִישׁ הֶ/חָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִ/רְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב
verses.translit: my h'ysh hchpts chyym 'hb ymym lr'vt tvb
verses.translation: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְ/ךָ֣ מֵ/רָ֑ע וּ֝/שְׂפָתֶ֗י/ךָ מִ/דַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: ntsr lshvnkh mr' vshptykh mdbr mrmh
verses.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭/רָע וַ/עֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְ/רָדְפֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: svr mr' v'shh tvb bqsh shlvm vrdphv
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝/אָזְנָ֗י/ו אֶל שַׁוְעָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'yny yhvh 'l tsdyqym v'znyv 'l shv'tm
verses.translation: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.original: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּ/עֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְ/הַכְרִ֖ית מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: pny yhvh b'shy r' lhkhryt m'rts zkhrm
verses.translation: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.original: צָעֲק֣וּ וַ/יהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּ/מִ/כָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗/ם הִצִּילָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ts'qv vyhvh shm' vmkhl tsrvtm htsylm
verses.translation: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְ/נִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵ֑ב וְֽ/אֶת דַּכְּאֵי ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: qrvb yhvh lnshbry lb v't dkh'y rvch yvshy'
verses.translation: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

verses.original: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝/מִ/כֻּלָּ֗/ם יַצִּילֶ֥/נּוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rbvt r'vt tsdyq vmkhlm ytsylnv yhvh
verses.translation: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑י/ו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝/הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה
verses.translit: shmr khl 'tsmvtyv 'cht mhnh l' nshbrh
verses.translation: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.original: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְ/שֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
verses.translit: tmvtt rsh' r'h vshn'y tsdyq y'shmv
verses.translation: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד רִיבָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת יְרִיבַ֑/י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת לֹֽחֲמָֽ/י
verses.translit: ldvd rybh yhvh 't yryby lchm 't lchmy
verses.translation: Plead my cause , O LORD , with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְ/צִנָּ֑ה וְ֝/ק֗וּמָ/ה בְּ/עֶזְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hchzq mgn vtsnh vqvmh b'zrty
verses.translation: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭/סְגֹר לִ/קְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑/י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝/נַפְשִׁ֗/י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥/ךְ אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vhrq chnyt vsgr lqr't rdpy 'mr lnpshy ysh'tkh 'ny
verses.translation: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְ/יִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְ/יַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: ybshv vykhlmv mbqshy npshy ysgv 'chvr vychprv chshby r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.original: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּ/מֹ֥ץ לִ/פְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּ/מַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה
verses.translit: yhyv khmts lpny rvch vml'kh yhvh dvchh
verses.translation: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them .

verses.original: יְֽהִי דַרְכָּ֗/ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַ/חֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּ/מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhy drkhm chshkh vchlqlqvt vml'kh yhvh rdpm
verses.translation: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

verses.original: כִּֽי חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ לִ֭/י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑/ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְ/נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: khy chnm tmnv ly shcht rshtm chnm chprv lnpshy
verses.translation: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.original: תְּבוֹאֵ֣/הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְ/רִשְׁתּ֣/וֹ אֲשֶׁר טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑/וֹ בְּ֝/שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tbv'hv shv'h l' yd' vrshtv 'shr tmn tlkhdv bshv'h ypl bh
verses.translation: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.original: וְ֭/נַפְשִׁ/י תָּגִ֣יל בַּ/יהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּ/ישׁוּעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnpshy tgyl byhvh tshysh byshv'tv
verses.translation: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD : it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.original: כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨/י תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹ/ךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵ/חָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/עָנִ֥י וְ֝/אֶבְי֗וֹן מִ/גֹּזְלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl 'tsmvty t'mrnh yhvh my khmvkh mtsyl 'ny mchzq mmnv v'ny v'byvn mgzlv
verses.translation: All my bones shall say, LORD , who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.original: יְ֭קוּמוּ/ן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: yqvmvn 'dy chms 'shr l' yd'ty ysh'lvny
verses.translation: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּ/נִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְ/נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: yshlmvny r'h tcht tvbh shkhvl lnpshy
verses.translation: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י בַּ/חֲלוֹתָ֡/ם לְב֬וּשִׁ/י שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַ/צּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑/י וּ֝/תְפִלָּתִ֗/י עַל חֵיקִ֥/י תָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: v'ny bchlvtm lbvshy shq 'nyty btsvm npshy vtplty 'l chyqy tshvb
verses.translation: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

verses.original: כְּ/רֵֽעַ כְּ/אָ֣ח לִ֭/י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּ/אֲבֶל אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי
verses.translit: khr' kh'ch ly hthlkhty kh'bl 'm qdr shchvty
verses.translation: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/צַלְעִ/י֮ שָׂמְח֪וּ וְֽ/נֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣/י נֵ֭כִים וְ/לֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְ/לֹא דָֽמּוּ
verses.translit: vbtsl'y shmchv vn'spv n'spv 'ly nkhym vl' yd'ty qr'v vl' dmv
verses.translation: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea , the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me , and ceased not:

verses.original: בְּ֭/חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣/י שִׁנֵּֽי/מוֹ
verses.translit: bchnpy l'gy m'vg chrq 'ly shnymv
verses.translation: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ/י֮ כַּ/מָּ֪ה תִּ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָ/ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י מִ/שֹּׁאֵי/הֶ֑ם מִ֝/כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'dny khmh tr'h hshybh npshy msh'yhm mkhpyrym ychydty
verses.translation: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.original: א֭וֹדְ/ךָ בְּ/קָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּ/עַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'vdkh bqhl rb b'm 'tsvm 'hllkh
verses.translation: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

verses.original: אַֽל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֣/י אֹיְבַ֣/י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥/י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ עָֽיִן
verses.translit: 'l yshmchv ly 'yby shqr shn'y chnm yqrtsv 'yn
verses.translation: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְ/עַ֥ל רִגְעֵי אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: khy l' shlvm ydbrv v'l rg'y 'rts dbry mrmvt ychshbvn
verses.translation: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗/י פִּ֫י/הֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyrchybv 'ly pyhm 'mrv h'ch h'ch r'th 'ynynv
verses.translation: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it .

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הוָה אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗/י אֲל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: r'yth yhvh 'l tchrsh 'dny 'l trchq mmny
verses.translation: This thou hast seen, O LORD : keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.original: הָעִ֣ירָ/ה וְ֭/הָקִיצָ/ה לְ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֑/י אֱלֹהַ֖/י וַֽ/אדֹנָ֣/י לְ/רִיבִֽ/י
verses.translit: h'yrh vhqytsh lmshpty 'lhy v'dny lryby
verses.translation: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.original: שָׁפְטֵ֣/נִי כְ֭/צִדְקְ/ךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗/י וְ/אַל יִשְׂמְחוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: shptny khtsdqkh yhvh 'lhy v'l yshmchv ly
verses.translation: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.original: אַל יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭/לִבָּ/ם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑/נוּ אַל יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'l y'mrv blbm h'ch npshnv 'l y'mrv bl'nvhv
verses.translation: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְ/יַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥/י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֥שֶׁת וּ/כְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽ/מַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv ychdv shmchy r'ty ylbshv bsht vkhlmh hmgdylym 'ly
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

verses.original: יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְ/יִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥/י וְ/יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝/חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yrnv vyshmchv chptsy tsdqy vy'mrv tmyd ygdl yhvh hchpts shlvm 'bdv
verses.translation: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.original: וּ֭/לְשׁוֹנִ/י תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑/ךָ כָּל הַ֝/יּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vlshvny thgh tsdqkh khl hyvm thltkh
verses.translation: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ לְ/עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֬ה לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch l'bd yhvh ldvd
verses.translation: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.original: נְאֻֽם פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭/רָשָׁע בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑/י אֵֽין פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְ/נֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: n'm psh' lrsh' bqrb lby 'yn pchd 'lhym lngd 'ynyv
verses.translation: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.original: כִּֽי הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו לִ/מְצֹ֖א עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ לִ/שְׂנֹֽא
verses.translit: khy hchlyq 'lyv b'ynyv lmts' 'vnv lshn'
verses.translation: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵי פִ֭י/ו אָ֣וֶן וּ/מִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְ/הַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְ/הֵיטִֽיב
verses.translit: dbry pyv 'vn vmrmh chdl lhshkhyl lhytyb
verses.translation: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

verses.original: אָ֤וֶן יַחְשֹׁ֗ב עַֽל מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥/וֹ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא ט֑וֹב רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס
verses.translit: 'vn ychshb 'l mshkhbv ytytsb 'l drkh l' tvb r' l' ym's
verses.translation: Thy mercy, O LORD , is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה בְּ/הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְ/ךָ֗ עַד שְׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: yhvh bhshmym chsdkh 'mvntkh 'd shchqym
verses.translation: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD , thou preservest man and beast.

verses.original: צִדְקָֽתְ/ךָ֨ כְּֽ/הַרְרֵי אֵ֗ל מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶ/ךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה אָ֤דָֽם וּ/בְהֵמָ֖ה תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: tsdqtkh khhrry 'l mshptkh thvm rbh 'dm vbhmh tvshy' yhvh
verses.translation: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.original: מַה יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּ/ךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם בְּ/צֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗י/ךָ יֶחֱסָיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: mh yqr chsdkh 'lhym vbny 'dm btsl khnpykh ychsyvn
verses.translation: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.original: יִ֭רְוְיֻ/ן מִ/דֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/נַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣י/ךָ תַשְׁקֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: yrvyn mdshn bytkh vnchl 'dnykh tshqm
verses.translation: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.original: כִּֽי עִ֭מְּ/ךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝/אוֹרְ/ךָ֗ נִרְאֶה אֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy 'mkh mqvr chyym b'vrkh nr'h 'vr
verses.translation: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.original: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּ/ךָ לְ/יֹדְעֶ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/צִדְקָֽתְ/ךָ֗ לְ/יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: mshkh chsdkh lyd'ykh vtsdqtkh lyshry lb
verses.translation: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.original: אַל תְּ֭בוֹאֵ/נִי רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְ/יַד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַל תְּנִדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'l tbv'ny rgl g'vh vyd rsh'ym 'l tndny
verses.translation: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּ/מְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּ/עֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: ldvd 'l ttchr bmr'ym 'l tqn' b'shy 'vlh
verses.translation: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֭/חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּ/כְ/יֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: khy khchtsyr mhrh ymlv vkhyrq dsh' ybvlvn
verses.translation: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭/יהוָה וַ/עֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּ/רְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה
verses.translit: btch byhvh v'shh tvb shkhn 'rts vr'h 'mvnh
verses.translation: Trust in the LORD , and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/יִֽתֶּן לְ֝/ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vht'ng 'l yhvh vytn lkh msh'lt lbkh
verses.translation: Delight thyself also in the LORD ; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.original: גּ֣וֹל עַל יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/בְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗י/ו וְ/ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: gvl 'l yhvh drkhkh vbtch 'lyv vhv' y'shh
verses.translation: Commit thy way unto the LORD ; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצִ֣יא כָ/א֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗/ךָ כַּֽ/צָּהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhvtsy' kh'vr tsdqkh vmshptkh khtshrym
verses.translation: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.original: דּ֤וֹם לַ/יהוָה֮ וְ/הִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥/וֹ אַל תִּ֭תְחַר בְּ/מַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ בְּ֝/אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: dvm lyhvh vhtchvll lv 'l ttchr bmtslych drkhv b'ysh 'shh mzmvt
verses.translation: Rest in the LORD , and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.original: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭/אַף וַ/עֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ לְ/הָרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: hrf m'f v'zb chmh 'l ttchr 'kh lhr'
verses.translation: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.original: כִּֽי מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּ/ן וְ/קֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy mr'ym ykhrtvn vqvy yhvh hmh yyrshv 'rts
verses.translation: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD , they shall inherit the earth.

verses.original: וְ/ע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְ/אֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ/הִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל מְקוֹמ֣/וֹ וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: v'vd m't v'yn rsh' vhtbvnnt 'l mqvmv v'ynnv
verses.translation: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be .

verses.original: וַ/עֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝/הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'nvym yyrshv 'rts vht'ngv 'l rb shlvm
verses.translation: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.original: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַ/צַּדִּ֑יק וְ/חֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣י/ו שִׁנָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: zmm rsh' ltsdyq vchrq 'lyv shnyv
verses.translation: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥/י יִשְׂחַק ל֑/וֹ כִּֽי רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'dny yshchq lv khy r'h khy yb' yvmv
verses.translation: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.original: חֶ֤רֶב פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְ/דָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥/ם לְ֭/הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְ/אֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝/טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי דָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: chrb ptchv rsh'ym vdrkhv qshtm lhpyl 'ny v'byvn ltbvch yshry drkh
verses.translation: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.original: חַ֭רְבָּ/ם תָּב֣וֹא בְ/לִבָּ֑/ם וְ֝/קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗/ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה
verses.translit: chrbm tbv' blbm vqshtvtm tshbrnh
verses.translation: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.original: טוֹב מְ֭עַט לַ/צַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝/הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: tvb m't ltsdyq mhmvn rsh'ym rbym
verses.translation: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְ/סוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy zrv'vt rsh'ym tshbrnh vsvmkh tsdyqym yhvh
verses.translation: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝/נַחֲלָתָ֗/ם לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: yvd' yhvh ymy tmymm vnchltm l'vlm thyh
verses.translation: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.original: לֹֽא יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּ/עֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּ/בִ/ימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: l' ybshv b't r'h vbymy r'bvn yshb'v
verses.translation: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.original: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְ/אֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּ/יקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶ/עָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: khy rsh'ym y'bdv v'yby yhvh khyqr khrym khlv b'shn khlv
verses.translation: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.original: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְ/לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝/צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְ/נוֹתֵֽן
verses.translit: lvh rsh' vl' yshlm vtsdyq chvnn vnvtn
verses.translation: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָי/ו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝/מְקֻלָּלָ֗י/ו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: khy mbrkhyv yyrshv 'rts vmqllyv ykhrtv
verses.translation: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.original: מֵ֭/יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְ/דַרְכּ֥/וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ
verses.translit: myhvh mts'dy gbr khvnnv vdrkhv ychpts
verses.translation: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD : and he delighteth in his way.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ypl l' yvtl khy yhvh svmkh ydv
verses.translation: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.original: נַ֤עַר הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽ/לֹא רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝/זַרְע֗/וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: n'r hyyty gm zqnty vl' r'yty tsdyq n'zb vzr'v mbqsh lchm
verses.translation: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּ/מַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝/זַרְע֗/וֹ לִ/בְרָכָֽה
verses.translit: khl hyvm chvnn vmlvh vzr'v lbrkhh
verses.translation: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭/רָע וַ/עֲשֵׂה ט֗וֹב וּ/שְׁכֹ֥ן לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: svr mr' v'shh tvb vshkhn l'vlm
verses.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְ/לֹא יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת חֲ֭סִידָי/ו לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְ/זֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'hb mshpt vl' y'zb 't chsydyv l'vlm nshmrv vzr' rsh'ym nkhrt
verses.translation: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.original: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָ/עַ֣ד עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: tsdyqym yyrshv 'rts vyshkhnv l'd 'lyh
verses.translation: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.original: פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝/לְשׁוֹנ֗/וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: py tsdyq yhgh chkhmh vlshvnv tdbr mshpt
verses.translation: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣י/ו בְּ/לִבּ֑/וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָי/ו
verses.translit: tvrt 'lhyv blbv l' tm'd 'shryv
verses.translation: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.original: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַ/צַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝/מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַ/הֲמִית/וֹ
verses.translit: tsvph rsh' ltsdyq vmbqsh lhmytv
verses.translation: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה לֹא יַעַזְבֶ֣/נּוּ בְ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗/נּוּ בְּ/הִשָּׁפְטֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh l' y'zbnv bydv vl' yrshy'nv bhshptv
verses.translation: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.original: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל יְהוָ֨ה וּ/שְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗/וֹ וִֽ֭/ירוֹמִמְ/ךָ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּ/הִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: qvh 'l yhvh vshmr drkhv vyrvmmkh lrsht 'rts bhkhrt rsh'ym tr'h
verses.translation: Wait on the LORD , and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it .

verses.original: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝/מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּ/אֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: r'yty rsh' 'ryts vmt'rh kh'zrch r'nn
verses.translation: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּֽעֲבֹר וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ וָֽ֝/אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗/הוּ וְ/לֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא
verses.translit: vy'br vhnh 'ynnv v'bqshhv vl' nmts'
verses.translation: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.original: שְׁמָר תָּ֭ם וּ/רְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי אַחֲרִ֖ית לְ/אִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: shmr tm vr'h yshr khy 'chryt l'ysh shlvm
verses.translation: Mark the perfect man , and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.original: וּֽ֭/פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה
verses.translit: vpsh'ym nshmdv ychdv 'chryt rsh'ym nkhrth
verses.translation: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.original: וּ/תְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵ/יְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗/ם בְּ/עֵ֣ת צָרָֽה
verses.translit: vtshv't tsdyqym myhvh m'vzm b't tsrh
verses.translation: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD : he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעְזְרֵ֥/ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽ/יְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥/ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣/ם מֵ֭/רְשָׁעִים וְ/יוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/ם כִּי חָ֥סוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'zrm yhvh vypltm ypltm mrsh'ym vyvshy'm khy chsv bv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.original: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְ/דָוִ֣ד לְ/הַזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd lhzkhyr
verses.translation: O LORD , rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּ/קֶצְפְּ/ךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑/נִי וּֽ/בַ/חֲמָתְ/ךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yhvh 'l bqtspkh tvkhychny vbchmtkh tysrny
verses.translation: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.original: כִּֽי חִ֭צֶּי/ךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑/י וַ/תִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣/י יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy chtsykh nchtv by vtncht 'ly ydkh
verses.translation: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.original: אֵין מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭/בְשָׂרִ/י מִ/פְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑/ךָ אֵין שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝/עֲצָמַ֗/י מִ/פְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yn mtm bbshry mpny z'mkh 'yn shlvm b'tsmy mpny cht'ty
verses.translation: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַ/י עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑/י כְּ/מַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: khy 'vnty 'brv r'shy khmsh' khbd ykhbdv mmny
verses.translation: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.original: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑/י מִ֝/פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hb'yshv nmqv chbvrty mpny 'vlty
verses.translation: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.original: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי
verses.translit: n'vyty shchty 'd m'd khl hyvm qdr hlkhty
verses.translation: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.original: כִּֽי כְ֭סָלַ/י מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּ/בְשָׂרִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy khsly ml'v nqlh v'yn mtm bbshry
verses.translation: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.original: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְ/נִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽ/נַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: npvgvty vndkhyty 'd m'd sh'gty mnhmt lby
verses.translation: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.original: אֲֽדֹנָ/י נֶגְדְּ/ךָ֥ כָל תַּאֲוָתִ֑/י וְ֝/אַנְחָתִ֗/י מִמְּ/ךָ֥ לֹא נִסְתָּֽרָה
verses.translit: 'dny ngdkh khl t'vty v'nchty mmkh l' nstrh
verses.translation: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.original: לִבִּ֣/י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣/נִי כֹחִ֑/י וְֽ/אוֹר עֵינַ֥/י גַּם הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: lby schrchr 'zbny khchy v'vr 'yny gm hm 'yn 'ty
verses.translation: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.original: אֹֽהֲבַ֨/י וְ/רֵעַ֗/י מִ/נֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣/י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝/קְרוֹבַ֗/י מֵ/רָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'hby vr'y mngd ng'y y'mdv vqrvby mrchq 'mdv
verses.translation: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַקְשׁ֤וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗/י וְ/דֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִ/י דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝/מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל הַ/יּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ
verses.translit: vynqshv mbqshy npshy vdrshy r'ty dbrv hvvt vmrmvt khl hyvm yhgv
verses.translation: But I, as a deaf man , heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י כְ֭/חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝/כְ/אִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'ny khchrsh l' 'shm' vkh'lm l' yptch pyv
verses.translation: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.original: וָ/אֱהִ֗י כְּ֭/אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְ/אֵ֥ין בְּ֝/פִ֗י/ו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'hy kh'ysh 'shr l' shm' v'yn bpyv tvkhchvt
verses.translation: For in thee, O LORD , do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.original: כִּֽי לְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥/י אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy lkh yhvh hvchlty 'th t'nh 'dny 'lhy
verses.translation: For I said, Hear me , lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֑/י בְּ/מ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗/י עָלַ֥/י הִגְדִּֽילוּ
verses.translit: khy 'mrty pn yshmchv ly bmvt rgly 'ly hgdylv
verses.translation: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי לְ/צֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּ/מַכְאוֹבִ֖/י נֶגְדִּ֣/י תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: khy 'ny ltsl' nkhvn vmkh'vby ngdy tmyd
verses.translation: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.original: כִּֽי עֲוֺנִ֥/י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽ/חַטָּאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'vny 'gyd 'd'g mcht'ty
verses.translation: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/אֹיְבַ/י חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְ/רַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣/י שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: v'yby chyym 'tsmv vrbv shn'y shqr
verses.translation: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is .

verses.original: וּ/מְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּ/נִי תַּ֣חַת רדופ/י רָֽדְפִ/י טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vmshlmy r'h tcht tvbh yshtnvny tcht rdvpy rdpy tvb
verses.translation: Forsake me not, O LORD : O my God, be not far from me.

verses.original: אַל תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗/י אַל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: 'l t'zbny yhvh 'lhy 'l trchq mmny
verses.translation: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ ל/ידיתון לִֽ/ידוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch lydytvn lydvtvn mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.original: אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶֽשְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַ/י֮ מֵ/חֲט֪וֹא בִ/לְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥/י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְ/פִ֥/י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּ/עֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְ/נֶגְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mrty 'shmrh drkhy mchtv' blshvny 'shmrh lpy mchsvm b'd rsh' lngdy
verses.translation: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.original: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִ/טּ֑וֹב וּ/כְאֵבִ֥/י נֶעְכָּֽר
verses.translit: n'lmty dvmyh hchshyty mtvb vkh'by n'khr
verses.translation: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

verses.original: חַם לִבִּ֨/י בְּ/קִרְבִּ֗/י בַּ/הֲגִיגִ֥/י תִבְעַר אֵ֑שׁ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּ/לְשֽׁוֹנִ/י
verses.translit: chm lby bqrby bhgygy tb'r 'sh dbrty blshvny
verses.translation: LORD , make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am .

verses.original: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤/נִי יְהוָ֨ה קִצִּ֗/י וּ/מִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣/י מַה הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי
verses.translit: hvdy'ny yhvh qtsy vmdt ymy mh hy' 'd'h mh chdl 'ny
