verses.translation: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗/י וְ/חֶלְדִּ֣/י כְ/אַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑/ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל הֶ֥בֶל כָּל אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: hnh tpchvt ntth ymy vchldy kh'yn ngdkh 'kh khl hbl khl 'dm ntsb slh
verses.translation: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches , and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ/צֶ֤לֶם יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּ/ן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽ/לֹא יֵדַ֥ע מִי אֹסְפָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'kh btslm ythlkh 'ysh 'kh hbl yhmyvn ytsbr vl' yd' my 'spm
verses.translation: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה מַה קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑/י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗/י לְ/ךָ֣ הִֽיא
verses.translit: v'th mh qvyty 'dny tvchlty lkh hy'
verses.translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.original: מִ/כָּל פְּשָׁעַ֥/י הַצִּילֵ֑/נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל תְּשִׂימֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mkhl psh'y htsylny chrpt nbl 'l tshymny
verses.translation: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it .

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח פִּ֑/י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ
verses.translit: n'lmty l' 'ptch py khy 'th 'shyt
verses.translation: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר מֵ/עָלַ֣/י נִגְעֶ֑/ךָ מִ/תִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְ/ךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי
verses.translit: hsr m'ly ng'kh mtgrt ydkh 'ny khlyty
verses.translation: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

verses.original: בְּֽ/תוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל עָוֺ֨ן יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַ/תֶּ֣מֶס כָּ/עָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑/וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כָּל אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: btvkhchvt 'l 'vn ysrt 'ysh vtms kh'sh chmvdv 'kh hbl khl 'dm slh
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O LORD , and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were .

verses.original: שִֽׁמְעָ֥/ה תְפִלָּתִ֨/י יְהוָ֡ה וְ/שַׁוְעָתִ֨/י הַאֲזִינָ/ה֮ אֶֽל דִּמְעָתִ֗/י אַֽל תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑/ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּ/כָל אֲבוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'h tplty yhvh vshv'ty h'zynh 'l dm'ty 'l tchrsh khy gr 'nkhy 'mkh tvshb khkhl 'bvty
verses.translation: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.original: לַ֝/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְ/דָוִ֥ד מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd mzmvr
verses.translation: I waited patiently for the LORD ; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.original: קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗/י וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: qvh qvyty yhvh vyt 'ly vyshm' shv'ty
verses.translation: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֤/נִי מִ/בּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִ/טִּ֪יט הַ/יָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַ/יָּ֖קֶם עַל סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗/י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'lny mbvr sh'vn mtyt hyvn vyqm 'l sl' rgly khvnn 'shry
verses.translation: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֬ן בְּ/פִ֨/י שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽ/אלֹ֫הֵ֥י/נוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְ/יִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝/יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytn bpy shyr chdsh thlh l'lhynv yr'v rbym vyyr'v vybtchv byhvh
verses.translation: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַ/גֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑/וֹ וְֽ/לֹא פָנָ֥ה אֶל רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְ/שָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב
verses.translit: 'shry hgbr 'shr shm yhvh mbtchv vl' pnh 'l rhbym vshty khzb
verses.translation: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them , they are more than can be numbered.

verses.original: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ/י֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥י/ךָ וּ/מַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗י/ךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥י/נוּ אֵ֤ין עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַ/אֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִ/סַּפֵּֽר
verses.translit: rbvt 'shyt 'th yhvh 'lhy npl'tykh vmchshbtykh 'lynv 'yn 'rkh 'lykh 'gydh v'dbrh 'tsmv mspr
verses.translation: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.original: זֶ֤בַח וּ/מִנְחָ֨ה לֹֽא חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑/י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝/חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: zbch vmnchh l' chptst 'znym khryt ly 'vlh vcht'h l' sh'lt
verses.translation: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

verses.original: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה בָ֑אתִי בִּ/מְגִלַּת סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'z 'mrty hnh b'ty bmglt spr khtvb 'ly
verses.translation: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.original: לַֽ/עֲשֽׂוֹת רְצוֹנְ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣/י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝/ת֥וֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽ/י
verses.translit: l'shvt rtsvnkh 'lhy chptsty vtvrtkh btvkh m'y
verses.translation: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD , thou knowest.

verses.original: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק בְּ/קָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַ/י לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: bshrty tsdq bqhl rb hnh shpty l' 'khl' yhvh 'th yd't
verses.translation: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.original: צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֬ לֹא כִסִּ֨יתִי בְּ/ת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗/י אֱמוּנָתְ/ךָ֣ וּ/תְשׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ וַ֝/אֲמִתְּ/ךָ֗ לְ/קָהָ֥ל רָֽב
verses.translit: tsdqtkh l' khsyty btvkh lby 'mvntkh vtshv'tkh 'mrty l' khchdty chsdkh v'mtkh lqhl rb
verses.translation: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD : let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣י/ךָ מִמֶּ֑/נִּי חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ וַ֝/אֲמִתְּ/ךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: 'th yhvh l' tkhl' rchmykh mmny chsdkh v'mtkh tmyd ytsrvny
verses.translation: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ עָלַ֨/י רָע֡וֹת עַד אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּ/נִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַ/י וְ/לֹא יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִ/רְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִ/שַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗/י וְ/לִבִּ֥/י עֲזָבָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy 'ppv 'ly r'vt 'd 'yn mspr hshygvny 'vnty vl' ykhlty lr'vt 'tsmv msh'rvt r'shy vlby 'zbny
verses.translation: Be pleased, O LORD , to deliver me: O LORD , make haste to help me.

verses.original: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְ/הַצִּילֵ֑/נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְ/עֶזְרָ֥תִ/י חֽוּשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: rtsh yhvh lhtsylny yhvh l'zrty chvshh
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְ/יַחְפְּר֨וּ יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗/י לִ/סְפּ֫וֹתָ֥/הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְ/יִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv ychd mbqshy npshy lspvth ysgv 'chvr vykhlmv chptsy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.original: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑/ם הָ/אֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗/י הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח
verses.translit: yshmv 'l 'qb bshtm h'mrym ly h'ch h'ch
verses.translation: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְ/יִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּ/ךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥י/ךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yshyshv vyshmchv bkh khl mbqshykh y'mrv tmyd ygdl yhvh 'hby tshv'tkh
verses.translation: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל דָּ֑ל בְּ/י֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'shry mshkhyl 'l dl byvm r'h ymlthv yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה יִשְׁמְרֵ֣/הוּ וִֽ֭/יחַיֵּ/הוּ יאשר וְ/אֻשַּׁ֣ר בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אַֽל תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗/הוּ בְּ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yhvh yshmrhv vychyhv y'shr v'shr b'rts v'l ttnhv bnpsh 'ybyv
verses.translation: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶ/נּוּ עַל עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗/וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְ/חָלְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh ys'dnv 'l 'rsh dvy khl mshkhbv hpkht bchlyv
verses.translation: I said, LORD , be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.original: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑/נִי רְפָאָ֥/ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י כִּי חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ny 'mrty yhvh chnny rp'h npshy khy cht'ty lkh
verses.translation: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.original: אוֹיְבַ֗/י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑/י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְ/אָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'vyby y'mrv r' ly mty ymvt v'bd shmv
verses.translation: And if he come to see me , he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it .

verses.original: וְ/אִם בָּ֤א לִ/רְא֨וֹת שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗/וֹ יִקְבָּץ אָ֥וֶן ל֑/וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַ/ח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'm b' lr'vt shv' ydbr lbv yqbts 'vn lv yts' lchvts ydbr
verses.translation: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.original: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣/י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל שֹׂנְאָ֑/י עָלַ֓/י יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: ychd 'ly ytlchshv khl shn'y 'ly ychshbv r'h ly
verses.translation: An evil disease, say they , cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.original: דְּֽבַר בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא יוֹסִ֥יף לָ/קֽוּם
verses.translit: dbr bly'l ytsvq bv v'shr shkhb l' yvsyf lqvm
verses.translation: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.original: גַּם אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨/י אֲשֶׁר בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭/וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑/י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣/י עָקֵֽב
verses.translit: gm 'ysh shlvmy 'shr btchty bv 'vkhl lchmy hgdyl 'ly 'qb
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD , be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥/נִי וַ/הֲקִימֵ֑/נִי וַֽ/אֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th yhvh chnny vhqymny v'shlmh lhm
verses.translation: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.original: בְּ/זֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑/י כִּ֤י לֹֽא יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣/י עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: bz't yd'ty khy chptst by khy l' yry' 'yby 'ly
verses.translation: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭/תֻמִּ/י תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑/י וַ/תַּצִּיבֵ֖/נִי לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'ny btmy tmkht by vttsybny lpnykh l'vlm
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לִ/בְנֵי קֹֽרַח
verses.translit: lmntsch mshkhyl lbny qrch
verses.translation: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

verses.original: כְּ/אַיָּ֗ל תַּעֲרֹ֥ג עַל אֲפִֽיקֵי מָ֑יִם כֵּ֤ן נַפְשִׁ֨/י תַעֲרֹ֖ג אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: kh'yl t'rg 'l 'pyqy mym khn npshy t'rg 'lykh 'lhym
verses.translation: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.original: צָמְאָ֬ה נַפְשִׁ֨/י לֵ/אלֹהִים֮ לְ/אֵ֪ל חָ֥י מָתַ֥י אָב֑וֹא וְ֝/אֵרָאֶ֗ה פְּנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: tsm'h npshy l'lhym l'l chy mty 'bv' v'r'h pny 'lhym
verses.translation: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.original: הָֽיְתָה לִּ֬/י דִמְעָתִ֣/י לֶ֭חֶם יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לָ֑יְלָה בֶּ/אֱמֹ֥ר אֵלַ֥/י כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hyth ly dm'ty lchm yvmm vlylh b'mr 'ly khl hyvm 'yh 'lhykh
verses.translation: When I remember these things , I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה אֶזְכְּרָ֨ה וְ/אֶשְׁפְּכָ֬ה עָלַ֨/י נַפְשִׁ֗/י כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בַּ/סָּךְ֮ אֶדַּדֵּ֗/ם עַד בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים בְּ/קוֹל רִנָּ֥ה וְ/תוֹדָ֗ה הָמ֥וֹן חוֹגֵֽג
verses.translit: 'lh 'zkhrh v'shpkhh 'ly npshy khy ''br bskh 'ddm 'd byt 'lhym bqvl rnh vtvdh hmvn chvgg
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.original: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁ/י֮ וַ/תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥/י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭/אלֹהִים כִּי ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗/נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mh tshtvchchy npshy vthmy 'ly hvchyly l'lhym khy 'vd 'vdnv yshv'vt pnyv
verses.translation: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗/י עָלַ/י֮ נַפְשִׁ֪/י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְ/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝/חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵ/הַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר
verses.translit: 'lhy 'ly npshy tshtvchch 'l khn 'zkhrkh m'rts yrdn vchrmvnym mhr mts'r
verses.translation: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.original: תְּהֽוֹם אֶל תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְ/ק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑י/ךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥י/ךָ וְ֝/גַלֶּ֗י/ךָ עָלַ֥/י עָבָֽרוּ
verses.translit: thvm 'l thvm qvr' lqvl tsnvrykh khl mshbrykh vglykh 'ly 'brv
verses.translation: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהוָ֨ה חַסְדּ֗/וֹ וּ֭/בַ/לַּיְלָה שיר/ה שִׁיר֣/וֹ עִמִּ֑/י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְ/אֵ֣ל חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: yvmm ytsvh yhvh chsdv vblylh shyrh shyrv 'my tplh l'l chyy
verses.translation: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.original: אוֹמְרָ֤ה לְ/אֵ֥ל סַלְעִ/י֮ לָ/מָ֪ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥/נִי לָֽ/מָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּ/לַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: 'vmrh l'l sl'y lmh shkhchtny lmh qdr 'lkh blchts 'vyb
verses.translation: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.original: בְּ/רֶ֤צַח בְּֽ/עַצְמוֹתַ֗/י חֵרְפ֥וּ/נִי צוֹרְרָ֑/י בְּ/אָמְרָ֥/ם אֵלַ֥/י כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: brtsch b'tsmvty chrpvny tsvrry b'mrm 'ly khl hyvm 'yh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.original: שָׁפְטֵ֤/נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים וְ/רִ֘יבָ֤/ה רִיבִ֗/י מִ/גּ֥וֹי לֹא חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤/אִישׁ מִרְמָ֖ה וְ/עַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shptny 'lhym vrybh ryby mgvy l' chsyd m'ysh mrmh v'vlh tpltny
verses.translation: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּ/י֮ לָ/מָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥/נִי לָֽ/מָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּ/לַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: khy 'th 'lhy m'vzy lmh znchtny lmh qdr 'thlkh blchts 'vyb
verses.translation: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.original: שְׁלַח אוֹרְ/ךָ֣ וַ֭/אֲמִתְּ/ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּ/נִי יְבִיא֥וּ/נִי אֶל הַֽר קָ֝דְשְׁ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֶל מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shlch 'vrkh v'mtkh hmh ynchvny yby'vny 'l hr qdshkh v'l mshkhnvtykh
verses.translation: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.original: וְ/אָב֤וֹאָה אֶל מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥/י וְ/אוֹדְ/ךָ֥ בְ/כִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'bv'h 'l mzbch 'lhym 'l 'l shmcht gyly v'vdkh bkhnvr 'lhym 'lhy
verses.translation: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

verses.original: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁ/י֮ וּֽ/מַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥/י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭/אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑/נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗/י וֵֽ/אלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: mh tshtvchchy npshy vmh thmy 'ly hvchyly l'lhym khy 'vd 'vdnv yshv't pny v'lhy
verses.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: lmntsch lbny qrch mshkhyl
verses.translation: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים בְּ/אָזְנֵ֬י/נוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥י/נוּ סִפְּרוּ לָ֑/נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝/ימֵי/הֶ֗ם בִּ֣/ימֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: 'lhym b'znynv shm'nv 'bvtynv sprv lnv p'l p'lt bymyhm bymy qdm
verses.translation: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יָדְ/ךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַ/תִּטָּעֵ֑/ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽ/תְּשַׁלְּחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'th ydkh gvym hvrsht vtt'm tr' l'mym vtshlchm
verses.translation: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְ/חַרְבָּ֡/ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּ/זְרוֹעָ/ם֮ לֹא הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥/מוֹ כִּֽי יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֣ וּ֭/זְרוֹעֲ/ךָ וְ/א֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗י/ךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy l' bchrbm yrshv 'rts vzrv'm l' hvshy'h lmv khy ymynkh vzrv'kh v'vr pnykh khy rtsytm
verses.translation: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.original: אַתָּה ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣/י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: 'th hv' mlkhy 'lhym tsvh yshv'vt y'qb
verses.translation: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.original: בְּ֭/ךָ צָרֵ֣י/נוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝/שִׁמְ/ךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: bkh tsrynv nngch bshmkh nbvs qmynv
verses.translation: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ/קַשְׁתִּ֣/י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝/חַרְבִּ֗/י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy l' bqshty 'btch vchrby l' tvshy'ny
verses.translation: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּ/נוּ מִ/צָּרֵ֑י/נוּ וּ/מְשַׂנְאֵ֥י/נוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ
verses.translit: khy hvsh'tnv mtsrynv vmshn'ynv hbyshvt
verses.translation: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭/אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֓ לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: b'lhym hllnv khl hyvm vshmkh l'vlm nvdh slh
verses.translation: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.original: אַף זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַ/תַּכְלִימֵ֑/נוּ וְ/לֹא תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּ/צִבְאוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'f zncht vtkhlymnv vl' tts' btsb'vtynv
verses.translation: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.original: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣/נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי צָ֑ר וּ֝/מְשַׂנְאֵ֗י/נוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: tshybnv 'chvr mny tsr vmshn'ynv shsv lmv
verses.translation: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

verses.original: תִּ֭תְּנֵ/נוּ כְּ/צֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝/בַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: ttnnv khts'n m'khl vbgvym zrytnv
verses.translation: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

verses.original: תִּמְכֹּֽר עַמְּ/ךָ֥ בְ/לֹא ה֑וֹן וְ/לֹ֥א רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּ/מְחִירֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: tmkhr 'mkh bl' hvn vl' rbyt bmchyryhm
verses.translation: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣/נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִ/שְׁכֵנֵ֑י/נוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝/קֶ֗לֶס לִ/סְבִיבוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: tshymnv chrph lshkhnynv l'g vqls lsbybvtynv
verses.translation: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣/נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: tshymnv mshl bgvym mnvd r'sh bl 'mym
verses.translation: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.original: כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣/י נֶגְדִּ֑/י וּ/בֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣/י כִּסָּֽתְ/נִי
verses.translit: khl hyvm khlmty ngdy vbsht pny khstny
verses.translation: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.original: מִ֭/קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּ/מְגַדֵּ֑ף מִ/פְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּ/מִתְנַקֵּֽם
verses.translit: mqvl mchrf vmgdf mpny 'vyb vmtnqm
verses.translation: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.original: כָּל זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְ/נוּ וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּ/ךָ וְ/לֹֽא שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּ/בְרִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khl z't b'tnv vl' shkhchnvkh vl' shqrnv bbrytkh
verses.translation: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

verses.original: לֹא נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑/נוּ וַ/תֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗י/נוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' nsvg 'chvr lbnv vtt 'shrynv mny 'rchkh
verses.translation: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.original: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָ/נוּ בִּ/מְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַ/תְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣י/נוּ בְ/צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: khy dkhytnv bmqvm tnym vtkhs 'lynv btslmvt
verses.translation: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.original: אִם שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/נִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗י/נוּ לְ/אֵ֣ל זָֽר
verses.translit: 'm shkhchnv shm 'lhynv vnprsh khpynv l'l zr
verses.translation: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר זֹ֑את כִּֽי ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב
verses.translit: hl' 'lhym ychqr z't khy hv' yd' t'lmvt lb
verses.translation: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָ֭לֶי/ךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל הַ/יּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּ/צֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'lykh hrgnv khl hyvm nchshbnv khts'n tbchh
verses.translation: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.original: ע֤וּרָ/ה לָ֖/מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֑/י הָ֝קִ֗יצָ/ה אַל תִּזְנַ֥ח לָ/נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: 'vrh lmh tyshn 'dny hqytsh 'l tznch lntsch
verses.translation: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.original: לָֽ/מָּה פָנֶ֥י/ךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣/נוּ וְֽ/לַחֲצֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: lmh pnykh tstyr tshkhch 'nynv vlchtsnv
verses.translation: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶ/עָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑/נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָ/אָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khy shchh l'pr npshnv dbqh l'rts btnnv
verses.translation: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l shshnym lbny qrch mshkhyl shyr ydydt
verses.translation: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.original: רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨/י דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣/י לְ/מֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗/י עֵ֤ט סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר
verses.translit: rchsh lby dbr tvb 'mr 'ny m'shy lmlkh lshvny 't svpr mhyr
verses.translation: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.original: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִ/בְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּ/שְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑י/ךָ עַל כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְ/ךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: ypypyt mbny 'dm hvtsq chn bshptvtykh 'l khn brkhkh 'lhym l'vlm
verses.translation: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.original: חֲגֽוֹר חַרְבְּ/ךָ֣ עַל יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְ/ךָ֗ וַ/הֲדָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chgvr chrbkh 'l yrkh gbvr hvdkh vhdrkh
verses.translation: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

verses.original: וַ/הֲדָ֬רְ/ךָ֨ צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל דְּבַר אֱ֭מֶת וְ/עַנְוָה צֶ֑דֶק וְ/תוֹרְ/ךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhdrkh tslch rkhb 'l dbr 'mt v'nvh tsdq vtvrkh nvr'vt ymynkh
verses.translation: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

verses.original: חִצֶּ֗י/ךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣י/ךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝/לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: chtsykh shnvnym 'mym tchtykh yplv blb 'vyby hmlkh
verses.translation: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

verses.original: כִּסְאֲ/ךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָ/עֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khs'kh 'lhym 'vlm v'd shbt myshr shbt mlkhvtkh
verses.translation: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַ/תִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל כֵּ֤ן מְשָׁחֲ/ךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶי/ךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵֽ/חֲבֵרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'hbt tsdq vtshn' rsh' 'l khn mshchkh 'lhym 'lhykh shmn shshvn mchbrykh
verses.translation: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.original: מֹר וַ/אֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כָּל בִּגְדֹתֶ֑י/ךָ מִֽן הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: mr v'hlvt qtsy'vt khl bgdtykh mn hykhly shn mny shmchvkh
verses.translation: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּ/יִקְּרוֹתֶ֑י/ךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִֽ֝/ימִינְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר
verses.translit: bnvt mlkhym byqrvtykh ntsbh shgl lymynkh bkhtm 'vpyr
verses.translation: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house;

verses.original: שִׁמְעִי בַ֣ת וּ֭/רְאִי וְ/הַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑/ךְ וְ/שִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗/ךְ וּ/בֵ֥ית אָבִֽי/ךְ
verses.translit: shm'y bt vr'y vhty 'znkh vshkhchy 'mkh vbyt 'bykh
verses.translation: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.original: וְ/יִתְאָ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑/ךְ כִּי ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִ/ךְ וְ/הִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyt'v hmlkh ypykh khy hv' 'dnykh vhshtchvy lv
verses.translation: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.original: וּ/בַֽת צֹ֨ר בְּ֭/מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִ/ךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם
verses.translit: vbt tsr bmnchh pnykh ychlv 'shyry 'm
verses.translation: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

verses.original: כָּל כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽ/מִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: khl khbvdh bt mlkh pnymh mmshbtsvt zhb lbvshh
verses.translation: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.original: לִ/רְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫/מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶי/הָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑י/הָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lrqmvt tvbl lmlkh btvlvt 'chryh r'vtyh mvb'vt lkh
verses.translation: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.original: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּ/שְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָ/גִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּ/הֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: tvblnh bshmcht vgyl tb'ynh bhykhl mlkh
verses.translation: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶי/ךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑י/ךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥/מוֹ לְ֝/שָׂרִ֗ים בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tcht 'btykh yhyv bnykh tshytmv lshrym bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֑רַח עַֽל עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch lbny qrch 'l 'lmvt shyr
verses.translation: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭/נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָ/עֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝/צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'lhym lnv mchsh v'z 'zrh btsrvt nmts' m'd
verses.translation: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֣ן לֹא נִ֭ירָא בְּ/הָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּ/בְ/מ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּ/לֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'l khn l' nyr' bhmyr 'rts vbmvt hrym blb ymym
verses.translation: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.original: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑י/ו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ הָרִ֖ים בְּ/גַאֲוָת֣/וֹ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yhmv ychmrv mymyv yr'shv hrym bg'vtv slh
verses.translation: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.original: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗י/ו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: nhr plgyv yshmchv 'yr 'lhym qdsh mshkhny 'lyvn
verses.translation: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭/קִרְבָּ/הּ בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥/הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִ/פְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: 'lhym bqrbh bl tmvt y'zrh 'lhym lpnvt bqr
verses.translation: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.original: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝/קוֹל֗/וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hmv gvym mtv mmlkhvt ntn bqvlv tmvg 'rts
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑/נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב לָ֝/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt 'mnv mshgb lnv 'lhy y'qb slh
verses.translation: Come, behold the works of the LORD , what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.original: לְֽכוּ חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lkhv chzv mp'lvt yhvh 'shr shm shmvt b'rts
verses.translation: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְ/קִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: mshbyt mlchmvt 'd qtsh h'rts qsht yshbr vqtsts chnyt 'glvt yshrf b'sh
verses.translation: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.original: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭/דְעוּ כִּי אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝/גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hrpv vd'v khy 'nkhy 'lhym 'rvm bgvym 'rvm b'rts
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch lbny qrch mzmvr
verses.translation: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.original: כָּֽל הָ֭/עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝/אלֹהִ֗ים בְּ/ק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: khl h'mym tq'v khf hry'v l'lhym bqvl rnh
verses.translation: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דוֹל עַל כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lyvn nvr' mlkh gdvl 'l khl h'rts
verses.translation: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑י/נוּ וּ֝/לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: ydbr 'mym tchtynv vl'mym tcht rglynv
verses.translation: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.original: יִבְחַר לָ֥/נוּ אֶת נַחֲלָתֵ֑/נוּ אֶ֥ת גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: ybchr lnv 't nchltnv 't g'vn y'qb 'shr 'hb slh
verses.translation: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.original: עָלָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים בִּ/תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּ/ק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
verses.translit: 'lh 'lhym btrv'h yhvh bqvl shvpr
verses.translation: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְ/מַלְכֵּ֣/נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: zmrv 'lhym zmrv zmrv lmlkhnv zmrv
verses.translation: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ אֱלֹהִ֗ים זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: khy mlkh khl h'rts 'lhym zmrv mshkhyl
verses.translation: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.original: מָלַ֣ךְ אֱ֭לֹהִים עַל גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב עַל כִּסֵּ֬א קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: mlkh 'lhym 'l gvym 'lhym yshb 'l khs' qdshv
verses.translation: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִ֝זְמוֹר לִ/בְנֵי קֹֽרַח
verses.translit: shyr mzmvr lbny qrch
verses.translation: Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּ/מְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּ/עִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י/נוּ הַר קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd b'yr 'lhynv hr qdshv
verses.translation: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.original: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֪וֹשׂ כָּל הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ הַר צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב
verses.translit: yph nvf mshvsh khl h'rts hr tsyvn yrkhty tspvn qryt mlkh rb
verses.translation: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּ/אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֗י/הָ נוֹדַ֥ע לְ/מִשְׂגָּֽב
verses.translit: 'lhym b'rmnvtyh nvd' lmshgb
verses.translation: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה הַ֭/מְּלָכִים נֽוֹעֲד֑וּ עָבְר֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: khy hnh hmlkhym nv'dv 'brv ychdv
verses.translation: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ
verses.translit: hmh r'v khn tmhv nbhlv nchpzv
verses.translation: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.original: רְ֭עָדָה אֲחָזָ֣תַ/ם שָׁ֑ם חִ֝֗יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵֽדָה
verses.translit: r'dh 'chztm shm chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.original: בְּ/ר֥וּחַ קָדִ֑ים תְּ֝שַׁבֵּ֗ר אֳנִיּ֥וֹת תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ
verses.translit: brvch qdym tshbr 'nyvt trshysh
verses.translation: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּ/עִיר יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּ/עִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖/הָ עַד עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: kh'shr shm'nv khn r'ynv b'yr yhvh tsb'vt b'yr 'lhynv 'lhym ykhvnnh 'd 'vlm slh
verses.translation: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.original: דִּמִּ֣ינוּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ בְּ֝/קֶ֗רֶב הֵיכָלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: dmynv 'lhym chsdkh bqrb hykhlkh
verses.translation: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.original: כְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְ/ךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khshmkh 'lhym khn thltkh 'l qtsvy 'rts tsdq ml'h ymynkh
verses.translation: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֤ח הַר צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yshmch hr tsyvn tglnh bnvt yhvdh lm'n mshptykh
verses.translation: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.original: סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְ/הַקִּיפ֑וּ/הָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: sbv tsyvn vhqypvh sprv mgdlyh
verses.translation: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.original: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּ/כֶ֨ם לְֽ/חֵילָ֗/ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְ/ד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן
verses.translit: shytv lbkhm lchylh psgv 'rmnvtyh lm'n tsprv ldvr 'chrvn
verses.translation: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch lbny qrch mzmvr
verses.translation: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֭את כָּל הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כָּל יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד
verses.translit: shm'v z't khl h'mym h'zynv khl yshby chld
verses.translation: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.original: גַּם בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם בְּנֵי אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: gm bny 'dm gm bny 'ysh ychd 'shyr v'byvn
verses.translation: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.original: פִּ֭/י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חָכְמ֑וֹת וְ/הָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣/י תְבוּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: py ydbr chkhmvt vhgvt lby tbvnvt
verses.translation: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.original: אַטֶּ֣ה לְ/מָשָׁ֣ל אָזְנִ֑/י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝/כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'th lmshl 'zny 'ptch bkhnvr chydty
verses.translation: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣/ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣/י יְסוּבֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: lmh 'yr' bymy r' 'vn 'qby ysvbny
verses.translation: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.original: הַ/בֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל חֵילָ֑/ם וּ/בְ/רֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗/ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: hbtchym 'l chylm vbrb 'shrm ythllv
verses.translation: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.original: אָ֗ח לֹא פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים כָּפְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ch l' pdh ypdh 'ysh l' ytn l'lhym khprv
verses.translation: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

verses.original: וְ֭/יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗/ם וְ/חָדַ֥ל לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyqr pdyvn npshm vchdl l'vlm
verses.translation: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.original: וִֽ/יחִי ע֥וֹד לָ/נֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַ/שָּֽׁחַת
verses.translit: vychy 'vd lntsch l' yr'h hshcht
verses.translation: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָ/בַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְ/עָזְב֖וּ לַ/אֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy yr'h chkhmym ymvtv ychd khsyl vb'r y'bdv v'zbv l'chrym chylm
verses.translation: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.original: קִרְבָּ֤/ם בָּתֵּ֨י/מוֹ לְֽ/עוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָ/ם לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝/שְׁמוֹתָ֗/ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: qrbm btymv l'vlm mshkhntm ldr vdr qr'v bshmvtm 'ly 'dmvt
verses.translation: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.original: וְ/אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭/יקָר בַּל יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּ/בְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ
verses.translit: v'dm byqr bl ylyn nmshl khbhmvt ndmv
verses.translation: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּ/ם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑/מוֹ וְ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֓ם בְּ/פִי/הֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: zh drkhm khsl lmv v'chryhm bpyhm yrtsv slh
verses.translation: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.original: כַּ/צֹּ֤אן לִֽ/שְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥/ם וַ/יִּרְדּ֘וּ בָ֤/ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים לַ/בֹּ֗קֶר ו/ציר/ם וְ֭/צוּרָ/ם לְ/בַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִ/זְּבֻ֥ל לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khts'n lsh'vl shtv mvt yr'm vyrdv bm yshrym lbqr vtsyrm vtsvrm lblvt sh'vl mzbl lv
verses.translation: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.original: אַךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י מִֽ/יַּד שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣/נִי סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'kh 'lhym ypdh npshy myd sh'vl khy yqchny slh
verses.translation: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.original: אַל תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּֽי יִ֝רְבֶּה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tyr' khy y'shr 'ysh khy yrbh khbvd bytv
verses.translation: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭/מוֹת/וֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַ/כֹּ֑ל לֹא יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣י/ו כְּבוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy l' bmvtv yqch hkhl l' yrd 'chryv khbvdv
verses.translation: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

verses.original: כִּֽי נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ בְּ/חַיָּ֣י/ו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝/יוֹדֻ֗/ךָ כִּי תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy npshv bchyyv ybrkh vyvdkh khy tytyb lkh
verses.translation: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.original: תָּ֭בוֹא עַד דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑י/ו עַד נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ אֽוֹר
verses.translit: tbv' 'd dvr 'bvtyv 'd ntsch l' yr'v 'vr
verses.translation: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַ/יִּקְרָא אָ֑רֶץ מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'l 'lhym yhvh dbr vyqr' 'rts mmzrch shmsh 'd mb'v
verses.translation: The mighty God, even the LORD , hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.original: מִ/צִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ
verses.translit: mtsyvn mkhll ypy 'lhym hvpy'
verses.translation: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

verses.original: יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ וְֽ/אַל יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ לְ/פָנָ֥י/ו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝/סְבִיבָ֗י/ו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: yb' 'lhynv v'l ychrsh 'sh lpnyv t'khl vsbybyv nsh'rh m'd
verses.translation: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.original: יִקְרָ֣א אֶל הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵ/עָ֑ל וְ/אֶל הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ לָ/דִ֥ין עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yqr' 'l hshmym m'l v'l h'rts ldyn 'mv
verses.translation: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.original: אִסְפוּ לִ֥/י חֲסִידָ֑/י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣/י עֲלֵי זָֽבַח
verses.translit: 'spv ly chsydy khrty bryty 'ly zbch
verses.translation: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑/וֹ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֓ים שֹׁפֵ֖ט ה֣וּא סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: vygydv shmym tsdqv khy 'lhym shpt hv' slh
verses.translation: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֤/ה עַמִּ֨/י וַ/אֲדַבֵּ֗רָה יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל וְ/אָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑/ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֶ֣י/ךָ אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: shm'h 'my v'dbrh yshr'l v''ydh bkh 'lhym 'lhykh 'nkhy
verses.translation: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

verses.original: לֹ֣א עַל זְ֭בָחֶי/ךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עוֹלֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/נֶגְדִּ֣/י תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: l' 'l zbchykh 'vkhychkh v'vltykh lngdy tmyd
verses.translation: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

verses.original: לֹא אֶקַּ֣ח מִ/בֵּיתְ/ךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝/מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗י/ךָ עַתּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: l' 'qch mbytkh pr mmkhl'tykh 'tvdym
verses.translation: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

verses.original: כִּי לִ֥/י כָל חַיְת/וֹ יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּ/הַרְרֵי אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: khy ly khl chytv y'r bhmvt bhrry 'lf
verses.translation: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתִּי כָּל ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְ/זִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: yd'ty khl 'vf hrym vzyz shdy 'mdy
verses.translation: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.original: אִם אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא אֹ֣מַר לָ֑/ךְ כִּי לִ֥/י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּ/מְלֹאָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'm 'r'b l' 'mr lkh khy ly tbl vml'h
verses.translation: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.original: הַֽ֭/אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְ/דַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: h'vkhl bshr 'byrym vdm 'tvdym 'shth
verses.translation: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.original: זְבַ֣ח לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְ/שַׁלֵּ֖ם לְ/עֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: zbch l'lhym tvdh vshlm l'lyvn ndrykh
verses.translation: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

verses.original: וּ֭/קְרָאֵ/נִי בְּ/י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְ/ךָ֗ וּֽ/תְכַבְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vqr'ny byvm tsrh 'chltskh vtkhbdny
verses.translation: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֤/רָשָׁ֨ע אָ֘מַ֤ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים מַה לְּ֭/ךָ לְ/סַפֵּ֣ר חֻקָּ֑/י וַ/תִּשָּׂ֖א בְרִיתִ֣/י עֲלֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vlrsh' 'mr 'lhym mh lkh lspr chqy vtsh' bryty 'ly pykh
verses.translation: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.original: וְ֭/אַתָּה שָׂנֵ֣אתָ מוּסָ֑ר וַ/תַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ דְּבָרַ֣/י אַחֲרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th shn't mvsr vtshlkh dbry 'chrykh
verses.translation: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

verses.original: אִם רָאִ֣יתָ גַ֭נָּב וַ/תִּ֣רֶץ עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/עִ֖ם מְנָאֲפִ֣ים חֶלְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm r'yt gnb vtrts 'mv v'm mn'pym chlqkh
verses.translation: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.original: פִּ֭י/ךָ שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ בְ/רָעָ֑ה וּ֝/לְשׁוֹנְ/ךָ֗ תַּצְמִ֥יד מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: pykh shlcht br'h vlshvnkh ttsmyd mrmh
verses.translation: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

verses.translit: tshb b'chykh tdbr bbn 'mkh ttn dpy
verses.translation: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה עָשִׂ֨יתָ וְֽ/הֶחֱרַ֗שְׁתִּי דִּמִּ֗יתָ הֱֽיוֹת אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה כָמ֑וֹ/ךָ אוֹכִיחֲ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶֽעֶרְכָ֣ה לְ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'lh 'shyt vhchrshty dmyt hyvt 'hyh khmvkh 'vkhychkh v''rkhh l'ynykh
verses.translation: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

verses.original: בִּֽינוּ נָ֣א זֹ֭את שֹׁכְחֵ֣י אֱל֑וֹהַּ פֶּן אֶ֝טְרֹ֗ף וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: bynv n' z't shkhchy 'lvh pn 'trf v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ תּוֹדָ֗ה יְֽכַ֫בְּדָ֥/נְנִי וְ/שָׂ֥ם דֶּ֑רֶךְ אַ֝רְאֶ֗/נּוּ בְּ/יֵ֣שַׁע אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: zbch tvdh ykhbdnny vshm drkh 'r'nv bysh' 'lhym
verses.translation: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.original: בְּֽ/בוֹא אֵ֭לָי/ו נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֑יא כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֝֗א אֶל בַּת שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: bbv' 'lyv ntn hnby' kh'shr b' 'l bt shb'
verses.translation: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֣/נִי אֱלֹהִ֣ים כְּ/חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ כְּ/רֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗י/ךָ מְחֵ֣ה פְשָׁעָֽ/י
verses.translit: chnny 'lhym khchsdkh khrb rchmykh mchh psh'y
verses.translation: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.original: הרבה הֶ֭רֶב כַּבְּסֵ֣/נִי מֵ/עֲוֺנִ֑/י וּֽ/מֵ/חַטָּאתִ֥/י טַהֲרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hrbh hrb khbsny m'vny vmcht'ty thrny
verses.translation: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

verses.original: כִּֽי פְ֭שָׁעַ/י אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְ/חַטָּאתִ֖/י נֶגְדִּ֣/י תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: khy psh'y 'ny 'd' vcht'ty ngdy tmyd
verses.translation: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֤ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֨ חָטָאתִי֮ וְ/הָ/רַ֥ע בְּ/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ עָ֫שִׂ֥יתִי לְ֭מַעַן תִּצְדַּ֥ק בְּ/דָבְרֶ֗/ךָ תִּזְכֶּ֥ה בְ/שָׁפְטֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkh lbdkh cht'ty vhr' b'ynykh 'shyty lm'n ttsdq bdbrkh tzkhh bshptkh
verses.translation: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

verses.original: הֵן בְּ/עָו֥וֹן חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי וּ֝/בְ/חֵ֗טְא יֶֽחֱמַ֥תְ/נִי אִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hn b'vvn chvllty vbcht' ychmtny 'my
verses.translation: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.original: הֵן אֱ֭מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַ/טֻּח֑וֹת וּ֝/בְ/סָתֻ֗ם חָכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hn 'mt chptst btchvt vbstm chkhmh tvdy'ny
verses.translation: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.original: תְּחַטְּאֵ֣/נִי בְ/אֵז֣וֹב וְ/אֶטְהָ֑ר תְּ֝כַבְּסֵ֗/נִי וּ/מִ/שֶּׁ֥לֶג אַלְבִּֽין
verses.translit: tcht'ny b'zvb v'thr tkhbsny vmshlg 'lbyn
verses.translation: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.original: תַּ֭שְׁמִיעֵ/נִי שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה תָּ֝גֵ֗לְנָה עֲצָמ֥וֹת דִּכִּֽיתָ
verses.translit: tshmy'ny shshvn vshmchh tglnh 'tsmvt dkhyt
verses.translation: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.original: הַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶי/ךָ מֵ/חֲטָאָ֑/י וְֽ/כָל עֲוֺ֖נֹתַ֣/י מְחֵֽה
verses.translit: hstr pnykh mcht'y vkhl 'vnty mchh
verses.translation: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב טָ֭הוֹר בְּרָא לִ֣/י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/ר֥וּחַ נָ֝כ֗וֹן חַדֵּ֥שׁ בְּ/קִרְבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: lb thvr br' ly 'lhym vrvch nkhvn chdsh bqrby
verses.translation: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

verses.original: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵ֥/נִי מִ/לְּ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/ר֥וּחַ קָ֝דְשְׁ/ךָ֗ אַל תִּקַּ֥ח מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: 'l tshlykhny mlpnykh vrvch qdshkh 'l tqch mmny
verses.translation: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.original: הָשִׁ֣יבָ/ה לִּ֭/י שְׂשׂ֣וֹן יִשְׁעֶ֑/ךָ וְ/ר֖וּחַ נְדִיבָ֣ה תִסְמְכֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hshybh ly shshvn ysh'kh vrvch ndybh tsmkhny
verses.translation: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.original: אֲלַמְּדָ֣ה פֹשְׁעִ֣ים דְּרָכֶ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/חַטָּאִ֗ים אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ יָשֽׁוּבוּ
verses.translit: 'lmdh psh'ym drkhykh vcht'ym 'lykh yshvbv
verses.translation: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

verses.original: הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤/נִי מִ/דָּמִ֨ים אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְּשׁוּעָתִ֑/י תְּרַנֵּ֥ן לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗/י צִדְקָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: htsylny mdmym 'lhym 'lhy tshv'ty trnn lshvny tsdqtkh
verses.translation: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.original: אֲ֭דֹנָ/י שְׂפָתַ֣/י תִּפְתָּ֑ח וּ֝/פִ֗/י יַגִּ֥יד תְּהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'dny shpty tptch vpy ygyd thltkh
verses.translation: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא תַחְפֹּ֣ץ זֶ֣בַח וְ/אֶתֵּ֑נָה ע֝וֹלָ֗ה לֹ֣א תִרְצֶֽה
verses.translit: khy l' tchpts zbch v'tnh 'vlh l' trtsh
verses.translation: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.original: זִֽבְחֵ֣י אֱלֹהִים֮ ר֪וּחַ נִשְׁבָּ֫רָ֥ה לֵב נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְ/נִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה
verses.translit: zbchy 'lhym rvch nshbrh lb nshbr vndkhh 'lhym l' tbzh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mshkhyl ldvd
verses.translation: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

verses.original: בְּ/ב֤וֹא דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָ/אֲדֹמִי֮ וַ/יַּגֵּ֪ד לְ/שָׁ֫א֥וּל וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑/וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: bbv' dv'g h'dmy vygd lsh'vl vy'mr lv b' dvd 'l byt 'chymlkh
verses.translation: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.original: מַה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭/רָעָה הַ/גִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: mh tthll br'h hgbvr chsd 'l khl hyvm
verses.translation: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.original: הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑/ךָ כְּ/תַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: hvvt tchshb lshvnkh kht'r mltsh 'shh rmyh
verses.translation: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִ/טּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר מִ/דַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'hbt r' mtvb shqr mdbr tsdq slh
verses.translation: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.original: אָהַ֥בְתָּ כָֽל דִּבְרֵי בָ֗לַע לְשׁ֣וֹן מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: 'hbt khl dbry bl' lshvn mrmh
verses.translation: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.original: גַּם אֵל֮ יִתָּצְ/ךָ֪ לָ֫/נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/יִסָּחֲ/ךָ֣ מֵ/אֹ֑הֶל וְ/שֵֽׁרֶשְׁ/ךָ֨ מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: gm 'l yttskh lntsch ychtkh vyschkh m'hl vshrshkh m'rts chyym slh
verses.translation: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.original: וְ/יִרְא֖וּ צַדִּיקִ֥ים וְ/יִירָ֗אוּ וְ/עָלָ֥י/ו יִשְׂחָֽקוּ
verses.translit: vyr'v tsdyqym vyyr'v v'lyv yshchqv
verses.translation: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/גֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָֽע֫וּזּ֥/וֹ וַ֭/יִּבְטַח בְּ/רֹ֣ב עָשְׁר֑/וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּ/הַוָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh hgbr l' yshym 'lhym m'vzv vybtch brb 'shrv y'z bhvtv
verses.translation: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l mchlt mshkhyl ldvd
verses.translation: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

verses.original: אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭/לִבּ/וֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְ/הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה טֽוֹב
verses.translit: 'mr nbl blbv 'yn 'lhym hshchytv vht'ybv 'vl 'yn 'shh tvb
verses.translation: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ/שָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭/רְאוֹת הֲ/יֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'lhym mshmym hshqyf 'l bny 'dm lr'vt hysh mshkhyl drsh 't 'lhym
verses.translation: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.original: כֻּלּ֥/וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: khlv sg ychdv n'lchv 'yn 'shh tvb 'yn gm 'chd
verses.translation: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּ/י אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: hl' yd'v p'ly 'vn 'khly 'my 'khlv lchm 'lhym l' qr'v
verses.translation: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם פָּֽחֲדוּ פַחַד֮ לֹא הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑/ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shm pchdv pchd l' hyh pchd khy 'lhym pzr 'tsmvt chnkh hbshth khy 'lhym m'sm
verses.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּ/נְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynt mshkhyl ldvd
verses.translation: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

verses.original: בְּ/ב֣וֹא הַ֭/זִּיפִים וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לְ/שָׁא֑וּל הֲ/לֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: bbv' hzypym vy'mrv lsh'vl hl' dvd msttr 'mnv
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי וּ/בִ/גְבוּרָתְ/ךָ֥ תְדִינֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'lhym bshmkh hvshy'ny vbgbvrtkh tdynny
verses.translation: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑/י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָ/ה לְ/אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'lhym shm' tplty h'zynh l'mry py
verses.translation: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗/י וְֽ֭/עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑/י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/נֶגְדָּ֣/ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: khy zrym qmv 'ly v'rytsym bqshv npshy l' shmv 'lhym lngdm slh
verses.translation: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑/י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗/י בְּֽ/סֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hnh 'lhym 'zr ly 'dny bsmkhy npshy
verses.translation: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD ; for it is good.

verses.original: ישוב יָשִׁ֣יב הָ֭/רַע לְ/שֹׁרְרָ֑/י בַּ֝/אֲמִתְּ/ךָ֗ הַצְמִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshvb yshyb hr' lshrry b'mtkh htsmytm
verses.translation: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּ/נְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynt mshkhyl ldvd
verses.translation: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָ/ה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑/י וְ/אַל תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִ/תְּחִנָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: h'zynh 'lhym tplty v'l tt'lm mtchnty
verses.translation: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָ/ה לִּ֣/י וַ/עֲנֵ֑/נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּ/שִׂיחִ֣/י וְ/אָהִֽימָה
verses.translit: hqshybh ly v'nny 'ryd bshychy v'hymh
verses.translation: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִ/פְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥/י אָ֝֗וֶן וּ/בְ/אַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: mqvl 'vyb mpny 'qt rsh' khy ymytv 'ly 'vn vb'f yshtmvny
verses.translation: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.original: לִ֭בִּ/י יָחִ֣יל בְּ/קִרְבִּ֑/י וְ/אֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: lby ychyl bqrby v'ymvt mvt nplv 'ly
verses.translation: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.original: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭/רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑/י וַ֝/תְּכַסֵּ֗/נִי פַּלָּצֽוּת
verses.translit: yr'h vr'd yb' by vtkhsny pltsvt
verses.translation: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר מִֽי יִתֶּן לִּ֣/י אֵ֭בֶר כַּ/יּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְ/אֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה
verses.translit: v'mr my ytn ly 'br khyvnh ''vph v'shkhnh
verses.translation: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד אָלִ֖ין בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: hnh 'rchyq ndd 'lyn bmdbr slh
verses.translation: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.original: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑/י מֵ/ר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִ/סָּֽעַר
verses.translit: 'chyshh mplt ly mrvch s'h ms'r
verses.translation: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.original: בַּלַּ֣ע אֲ֭דֹנָ/י פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑/ם כִּֽי רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְ/רִ֣יב בָּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: bl' 'dny plg lshvnm khy r'yty chms vryb b'yr
verses.translation: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם וָ/לַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥/הָ עַל חוֹמֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אָ֖וֶן וְ/עָמָ֣ל בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: yvmm vlylh ysvbbh 'l chvmtyh v'vn v'ml bqrbh
verses.translation: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.original: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּ/קִרְבָּ֑/הּ וְֽ/לֹא יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝/רְחֹבָ֗/הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּ/מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: hvvt bqrbh vl' ymysh mrchbh tkh vmrmh
verses.translation: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗/נִי וְ/אֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא מְ֭שַׂנְאִ/י עָלַ֣/י הִגְדִּ֑יל וְ/אֶסָּתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy l' 'vyb ychrpny v'sh' l' mshn'y 'ly hgdyl v'str mmnv
verses.translation: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּ/עֶרְכִּ֑/י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗/י וּ/מְיֻדָּֽעִ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'nvsh kh'rkhy 'lvpy vmyd'y
verses.translation: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַ֭חְדָּו נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּ/רָֽגֶשׁ
verses.translit: 'shr ychdv nmtyq svd bbyt 'lhym nhlkh brgsh
verses.translation: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.original: ישימות יַשִּׁ֤י מָ֨וֶת עָלֵ֗י/מוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי רָע֖וֹת בִּ/מְגוּרָ֣/ם בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshymvt yshy mvt 'lymv yrdv sh'vl chyym khy r'vt bmgvrm bqrbm
verses.translation: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וַ֝/יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'ny 'l 'lhym 'qr' vyhvh yvshy'ny
verses.translation: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.original: עֶ֤רֶב וָ/בֹ֣קֶר וְ֭/צָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂ֣יחָה וְ/אֶהֱמֶ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rb vbqr vtshrym 'shychh v'hmh vyshm' qvly
verses.translation: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.original: פָּ֘דָ֤ה בְ/שָׁל֣וֹם נַ֭פְשִׁ/י מִ/קֲּרָב לִ֑/י כִּֽי בְ֝/רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: pdh bshlvm npshy mqrb ly khy brbym hyv 'mdy
verses.translation: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֵ֨ל וְֽ/יַעֲנֵ/ם֮ וְ/יֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑/מוֹ וְ/לֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: yshm' 'l vy'nm vyshb qdm slh 'shr 'yn chlypvt lmv vl' yr'v 'lhym
verses.translation: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָי/ו בִּ/שְׁלֹמָ֗י/ו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shlch ydyv bshlmyv chll brytv
verses.translation: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.original: חָלְק֤וּ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּי/ו֮ וּֽ/קֲרָב לִ֫בּ֥/וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥י/ו מִ/שֶּׁ֗מֶן וְ/הֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת
verses.translit: chlqv mchm't pyv vqrb lbv rkhv dbryv mshmn vhmh ptchvt
verses.translation: Cast thy burden upon the LORD , and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.original: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל יְהוָ֨ה יְהָבְ/ךָ֮ וְ/ה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥/ךָ לֹא יִתֵּ֖ן לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַ/צַּדִּֽיק
verses.translit: hshlkh 'l yhvh yhbkh vhv' ykhlkhlkh l' ytn l'vlm mvt ltsdyq
verses.translation: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֤חַ עַל י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְ/דָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּֽ/אֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖/וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּ/גַֽת
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l yvnt 'lm rchqym ldvd mkhtm b'chz 'tv plshtym bgt
verses.translation: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֣/נִי אֱ֭לֹהִים כִּֽי שְׁאָפַ֣/נִי אֱנ֑וֹשׁ כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם לֹחֵ֥ם יִלְחָצֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: chnny 'lhym khy sh'pny 'nvsh khl hyvm lchm ylchtsny
verses.translation: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

verses.original: שָׁאֲפ֣וּ שׁ֭וֹרְרַ/י כָּל הַ/יּ֑וֹם כִּֽי רַבִּ֨ים לֹחֲמִ֖ים לִ֣/י מָרֽוֹם
verses.translit: sh'pv shvrry khl hyvm khy rbym lchmym ly mrvm
verses.translation: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.original: י֥וֹם אִירָ֑א אֲ֝נִ֗י אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ אֶבְטָֽח
verses.translit: yvm 'yr' 'ny 'lykh 'btch
verses.translation: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.original: בֵּ/אלֹהִים֮ אֲהַלֵּ֪ל דְּבָ֫ר֥/וֹ בֵּ/אלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בָשָׂ֣ר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: b'lhym 'hll dbrv b'lhym btchty l' 'yr' mh y'shh bshr ly
verses.translation: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם דְּבָרַ֣/י יְעַצֵּ֑בוּ עָלַ֖/י כָּל מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֣/ם לָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: khl hyvm dbry y'tsbv 'ly khl mchshbtm lr'
verses.translation: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ יצפינו יִצְפּ֗וֹנוּ הֵ֭מָּה עֲקֵבַ֣/י יִשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כַּ֝/אֲשֶׁ֗ר קִוּ֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: ygvrv ytspynv ytspvnv hmh 'qby yshmrv kh'shr qvv npshy
verses.translation: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.original: עַל אָ֥וֶן פַּלֶּט לָ֑/מוֹ בְּ֝/אַ֗ף עַמִּ֤ים הוֹרֵ֬ד אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'l 'vn plt lmv b'f 'mym hvrd 'lhym
verses.translation: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

verses.original: נֹדִ/י֮ סָפַ֪רְתָּ֫ה אָ֥תָּה שִׂ֣ימָ/ה דִמְעָתִ֣/י בְ/נֹאדֶ֑/ךָ הֲ֝/לֹ֗א בְּ/סִפְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ndy sprth 'th shymh dm'ty bn'dkh hl' bsprtkh
verses.translation: When I cry unto thee , then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

verses.original: אָ֥֨ז יָ֘שׁ֤וּבוּ אוֹיְבַ֣/י אָ֭חוֹר בְּ/י֣וֹם אֶקְרָ֑א זֶה יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'z yshvbv 'vyby 'chvr byvm 'qr' zh yd'ty khy 'lhym ly
verses.translation: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.

verses.original: בֵּֽ֭/אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּ֝/יהוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: b'lhym 'hll dbr byhvh 'hll dbr
verses.translation: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.original: בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֣ים בָּ֭טַחְתִּי לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אָדָ֣ם לִֽ/י
verses.translit: b'lhym btchty l' 'yr' mh y'shh 'dm ly
verses.translation: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.original: עָלַ֣/י אֱלֹהִ֣ים נְדָרֶ֑י/ךָ אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם תּוֹדֹ֣ת לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ly 'lhym ndrykh 'shlm tvdt lkh
verses.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְ/דָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּ/בָרְח֥/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵי שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּ/מְּעָרָֽה
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l tshcht ldvd mkhtm bbrchv mpny sh'vl bm'rh
verses.translation: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֤/נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים חָנֵּ֗/נִי כִּ֥י בְ/ךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י וּ/בְ/צֵֽל כְּנָפֶ֥י/ךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת
verses.translit: chnny 'lhym chnny khy bkh chsyh npshy vbtsl khnpykh 'chsh 'd y'br hvvt
verses.translation: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

verses.original: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝/אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'qr' l'lhym 'lyvn l'l gmr 'ly
verses.translation: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם וְֽ/יוֹשִׁיעֵ֗/נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣/י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥/וֹ וַ/אֲמִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yshlch mshmym vyvshy'ny chrf sh'py slh yshlch 'lhym chsdv v'mtv
verses.translation: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤/י בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּי/הֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְ/חִצִּ֑ים וּ֝/לְשׁוֹנָ֗/ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה
verses.translit: npshy btvkh lb'm 'shkhbh lhtym bny 'dm shnyhm chnyt vchtsym vlshvnm chrb chdh
verses.translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.original: ר֣וּמָ/ה עַל הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: rvmh 'l hshmym 'lhym 'l khl h'rts khbvdkh
verses.translation: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves . Selah.

verses.original: רֶ֤שֶׁת הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִ/פְעָמַ/י֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י כָּר֣וּ לְ/פָנַ֣/י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְ/תוֹכָ֣/הּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: rsht hkhynv lp'my khpf npshy khrv lpny shychh nplv btvkhh slh
verses.translation: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.original: נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣/י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑/י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַ/אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
verses.translit: nkhvn lby 'lhym nkhvn lby 'shyrh v'zmrh
verses.translation: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.original: ע֤וּרָ/ה כְבוֹדִ֗/י ע֭וּרָֽ/ה הַ/נֵּ֥בֶל וְ/כִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר
verses.translit: 'vrh khbvdy 'vrh hnbl vkhnvr ''yrh shchr
verses.translation: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.original: אוֹדְ/ךָ֖ בָ/עַמִּ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑/י אֲ֝זַמֶּרְ/ךָ֗ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'vdkh b'mym 'dny 'zmrkh bl 'mym
verses.translation: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.original: כִּֽי גָדֹ֣ל עַד שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְֽ/עַד שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy gdl 'd shmym chsdkh v'd shchqym 'mtkh
verses.translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת לְ/דָוִ֥ד מִכְתָּֽם
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l tshcht ldvd mkhtm
verses.translation: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.original: הַֽ/אֻמְנָ֗ם אֵ֣לֶם צֶ֭דֶק תְּדַבֵּר֑וּ/ן מֵישָׁרִ֥ים תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: h'mnm 'lm tsdq tdbrvn myshrym tshptv bny 'dm
verses.translation: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.original: אַף בְּ/לֵב֮ עוֹלֹ֪ת תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּ/ן בָּ/אָ֡רֶץ חֲמַ֥ס יְ֝דֵי/כֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'f blb 'vlt tp'lvn b'rts chms ydykhm tplsvn
verses.translation: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.original: זֹ֣רוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מֵ/רָ֑חֶם תָּע֥וּ מִ֝/בֶּ֗טֶן דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב
verses.translit: zrv rsh'ym mrchm t'v mbtn dbry khzb
verses.translation: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

verses.original: חֲמַת לָ֗/מוֹ כִּ/דְמ֥וּת חֲמַת נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chmt lmv khdmvt chmt nchsh khmv ptn chrsh y'tm 'znv
verses.translation: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יִ֭שְׁמַע לְ/ק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים מְחֻכָּֽם
verses.translit: 'shr l' yshm' lqvl mlchshym chvbr chbrym mchkhm
verses.translation: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD .

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס שִׁנֵּ֥י/מוֹ בְּ/פִ֑י/מוֹ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים נְתֹ֣ץ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'lhym hrs shnymv bpymv mlt'vt khpyrym ntts yhvh
verses.translation: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.original: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ לָ֑/מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חצ/ו חִ֝צָּ֗י/ו כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ
verses.translit: ym'sv khmv mym ythlkhv lmv ydrkh chtsv chtsyv khmv ytmllv
verses.translation: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

verses.original: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל תֶּ֣מֶס יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ נֵ֥פֶל אֵ֝֗שֶׁת בַּל חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khmv shblvl tms yhlkh npl 'sht bl chzv shmsh
verses.translation: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֤רֶם יָבִ֣ינוּ סִּֽירֹתֵי/כֶ֣ם אָטָ֑ד כְּמוֹ חַ֥י כְּמוֹ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: btrm ybynv syrtykhm 'td khmv chy khmv chrvn ysh'rnv
verses.translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֭דִּיק כִּי חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥י/ו יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ בְּ/דַ֣ם הָ/רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: yshmch tsdyq khy chzh nqm p'myv yrchts bdm hrsh'
verses.translation: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְ/דָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּ/שְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת הַ֝/בַּ֗יִת לַ/הֲמִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l tshcht ldvd mkhtm bshlch sh'vl vyshmrv 't hbyt lhmytv
verses.translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֖/נִי מֵ/אֹיְבַ֥/י אֱלֹהָ֑/י מִּ/מִתְקוֹמְמַ֥/י תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: htsylny m'yby 'lhy mmtqvmmy tshgbny
verses.translation: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.original: הַ֭צִּילֵ/נִי מִ/פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽ/מֵ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: htsylny mp'ly 'vn vm'nshy dmym hvshy'ny
verses.translation: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְ/נַפְשִׁ֗/י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣/י עַזִ֑ים לֹא פִשְׁעִ֖/י וְ/לֹא חַטָּאתִ֣/י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hnh 'rbv lnpshy ygvrv 'ly 'zym l' psh'y vl' cht'ty yhvh
verses.translation: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.original: בְּֽלִי עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּ/ן וְ/יִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָ/ה לִ/קְרָאתִ֣/י וּ/רְאֵה
verses.translit: bly 'vn yrvtsvn vykhvnnv 'vrh lqr'ty vr'h
verses.translation: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהִ֥ים צְבָא֡וֹת אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָקִ֗יצָ/ה לִ/פְקֹ֥ד כָּֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם אַל תָּחֹ֨ן כָּל בֹּ֖גְדֵי אָ֣וֶן סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhym tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hqytsh lpqd khl hgvym 'l tchn khl bgdy 'vn slh
verses.translation: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭/עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַ/כָּ֗לֶב וִ/יס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר
verses.translit: yshvbv l'rb yhmv khkhlb vysvbbv 'yr
verses.translation: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they , doth hear?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יַבִּ֘יע֤וּ/ן בְּ/פִי/הֶ֗ם חֲ֭רָבוֹת בְּ/שִׂפְתוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּי מִ֥י שֹׁמֵֽעַ
verses.translit: hnh yby'vn bpyhm chrbvt bshptvtyhm khy my shm'
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD , shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׂחַק לָ֑/מוֹ תִּ֝לְעַ֗ג לְ/כָל גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: v'th yhvh tshchq lmv tl'g lkhl gvym
verses.translation: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

verses.original: עֻ֭זּ/וֹ אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑רָה כִּֽי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִשְׂגַּבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'zv 'lykh 'shmrh khy 'lhym mshgby
verses.translation: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֣י חסד/ו חַסְדִּ֣/י יְקַדְּמֵ֑/נִי אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַרְאֵ֥/נִי בְ/שֹׁרְרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'lhy chsdv chsdy yqdmny 'lhym yr'ny bshrry
