verses.translation: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.original: אַל תַּהַרְגֵ֤/ם פֶּֽן יִשְׁכְּח֬וּ עַמִּ֗/י הֲנִיעֵ֣/מוֹ בְ֭/חֵילְ/ךָ וְ/הוֹרִידֵ֑/מוֹ מָֽגִנֵּ֣/נוּ אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l thrgm pn yshkhchv 'my hny'mv bchylkh vhvrydmv mgnnv 'dny
verses.translation: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.original: חַטַּאת פִּ֗י/מוֹ דְּֽבַר שְׂפָ֫תֵ֥י/מוֹ וְ/יִלָּכְד֥וּ בִ/גְאוֹנָ֑/ם וּ/מֵ/אָלָ֖ה וּ/מִ/כַּ֣חַשׁ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: cht't pymv dbr shptymv vylkhdv bg'vnm vm'lh vmkhchsh ysprv
verses.translation: Consume them in wrath, consume them , that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.original: כַּלֵּ֥ה בְ/חֵמָה֮ כַּלֵּ֪ה וְֽ/אֵ֫ינֵ֥/מוֹ וְֽ/יֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אֱ֭לֹהִים מֹשֵׁ֣ל בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְ/אַפְסֵ֖י הָ/אָ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: khlh bchmh khlh v'ynmv vyd'v khy 'lhym mshl by'qb l'psy h'rts slh
verses.translation: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.original: וְ/יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לָ֭/עֶרֶב יֶהֱמ֥וּ כַ/כָּ֗לֶב וִ/יס֥וֹבְבוּ עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyshvbv l'rb yhmv khkhlb vysvbbv 'yr
verses.translation: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה ינועו/ן יְנִיע֣וּ/ן לֶ/אֱכֹ֑ל אִם לֹ֥א יִ֝שְׂבְּע֗וּ וַ/יָּלִֽינוּ
verses.translit: hmh ynv'vn yny'vn l'khl 'm l' yshb'v vylynv
verses.translation: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י אָשִׁ֣יר עֻזֶּ/ךָ֮ וַ/אֲרַנֵּ֥ן לַ/בֹּ֗קֶר חַ֫סְדֶּ֥/ךָ כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לִ֑/י וּ֝/מָנ֗וֹס בְּ/י֣וֹם צַר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny 'shyr 'zkh v'rnn lbqr chsdkh khy hyyt mshgb ly vmnvs byvm tsr ly
verses.translation: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ עַל שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְ/דָוִ֣ד לְ/לַמֵּֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l shvshn 'dvt mkhtm ldvd llmd
verses.translation: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.original: בְּ/הַצּוֹת֨/וֹ אֶ֥ת אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְ/אֶת אֲרַ֪ם צ֫וֹבָ֥ה וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֶת אֱד֣וֹם בְּ/גֵיא מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: bhtsvtv 't 'rm nhrym v't 'rm tsvbh vyshb yv'b vykh 't 'dvm bgy' mlch shnym 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣/נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑/נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשׁ֣וֹבֵ֥ב לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'lhym znchtnv prtstnv 'npt tshvbb lnv
verses.translation: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.original: הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑/הּ רְפָ֖/ה שְׁבָרֶ֣י/הָ כִי מָֽטָה
verses.translit: hr'shth 'rts ptsmth rph shbryh khy mth
verses.translation: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.original: הִרְאִ֣יתָה עַמְּ/ךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗/נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה
verses.translit: hr'yth 'mkh qshh hshqytnv yyn tr'lh
verses.translation: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.original: נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּ/ירֵאֶ֣י/ךָ נֵּ֭ס לְ/הִתְנוֹסֵ֑ס מִ֝/פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: ntth lyr'ykh ns lhtnvss mpny qsht slh
verses.translation: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּ/ן יְדִידֶ֑י/ךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָ/ה יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֣ ו/ענ/נו וַ/עֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: lm'n ychltsvn ydydykh hvshy'h ymynkh v'nnv v'nny
verses.translation: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּ/קָדְשׁ֗/וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְ/עֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד
verses.translit: 'lhym dbr bqdshv ''lzh 'chlqh shkhm v'mq skhvt 'mdd
verses.translation: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

verses.original: לִ֤/י גִלְעָ֨ד וְ/לִ֬/י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭/אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑/י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִ/י
verses.translit: ly gl'd vly mnshh v'prym m'vz r'shy yhvdh mchqqy
verses.translation: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗/י עַל אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑/י עָ֝לַ֗/י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי
verses.translit: mv'b syr rchtsy 'l 'dvm 'shlykh n'ly 'ly plsht htr''y
verses.translation: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou , O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵ/נִי עִ֣יר מָצ֑וֹר מִ֖י נָחַ֣/נִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: my yblny 'yr mtsvr my nchny 'd 'dvm
verses.translation: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑/נוּ וְֽ/לֹא תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּ/צִבְאוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hl' 'th 'lhym znchtnv vl' tts' 'lhym btsb'vtynv
verses.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל נְגִינַ֬ת לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l ngynt ldvd
verses.translation: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֣/ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִנָּתִ֑/י הַ֝קְשִׁ֗יבָ/ה תְּפִלָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'h 'lhym rnty hqshybh tplty
verses.translation: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.original: מִ/קְצֵ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּ/עֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑/י בְּ/צוּר יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣/נִּי תַנְחֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mqtsh h'rts 'lykh 'qr' b'tf lby btsvr yrvm mmny tnchny
verses.translation: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑/י מִגְדַּל עֹ֝֗ז מִ/פְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: khy hyyt mchsh ly mgdl 'z mpny 'vyb
verses.translation: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.original: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭/אָהָלְ/ךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְ/סֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣י/ךָ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: 'gvrh b'hlkh 'vlmym 'chsh bstr khnpykh slh
verses.translation: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִ/נְדָרָ֑/י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'lhym shm't lndry ntt yrsht yr'y shmkh
verses.translation: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

verses.original: יָמִ֣ים עַל יְמֵי מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗י/ו כְּמוֹ דֹ֥ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: ymym 'l ymy mlkh tvsyf shnvtyv khmv dr vdr
verses.translation: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝/אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: yshb 'vlm lpny 'lhym chsd v'mt mn yntsrhv
verses.translation: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l ydvtvn mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶל אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י מִ֝מֶּ֗/נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'kh 'l 'lhym dvmyh npshy mmnv yshv'ty
verses.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.original: אַךְ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִ/י וִֽ/ישׁוּעָתִ֑/י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗/י לֹא אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: 'kh hv' tsvry vyshv'ty mshgby l' 'mvt rbh
verses.translation: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

verses.original: עַד אָ֤נָה תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּ/כֶ֥ם כְּ/קִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַ/דְּחוּיָֽה
verses.translit: 'd 'nh thvttv 'l 'ysh trtschv khlkhm khqyr ntvy gdr hdchvyh
verses.translation: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ מִ/שְּׂאֵת֨/וֹ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְ/הַדִּיחַ֮ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּ/פִ֥י/ו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ וּ֝/בְ/קִרְבָּ֗/ם יְקַלְלוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'kh msh'tv y'tsv lhdych yrtsv khzb bpyv ybrkhv vbqrbm yqllv slh
verses.translation: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֵ֭/אלֹהִים דּ֣וֹמִּי נַפְשִׁ֑/י כִּי מִ֝מֶּ֗/נּוּ תִּקְוָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'kh l'lhym dvmy npshy khy mmnv tqvty
verses.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.original: אַךְ ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִ/י וִֽ/ישׁוּעָתִ֑/י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗/י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: 'kh hv' tsvry vyshv'ty mshgby l' 'mvt
verses.translation: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.original: עַל אֱ֭לֹהִים יִשְׁעִ֣/י וּ/כְבוֹדִ֑/י צוּר עֻזִּ֥/י מַ֝חְסִ֗/י בֵּֽ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'l 'lhym ysh'y vkhbvdy tsvr 'zy mchsy b'lhym
verses.translation: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.original: בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤/וֹ בְ/כָל עֵ֨ת עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ לְ/פָנָ֥י/ו לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה לָּ֣/נוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: btchv bv bkhl 't 'm shpkhv lpnyv lbbkhm 'lhym mchsh lnv slh
verses.translation: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵֽי אָדָם֮ כָּזָ֪ב בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/מֹאזְנַ֥יִם לַ/עֲל֑וֹת הֵ֝֗מָּה מֵ/הֶ֥בֶל יָֽחַד
verses.translit: 'kh hbl bny 'dm khzb bny 'ysh bm'znym l'lvt hmh mhbl ychd
verses.translation: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them .

verses.original: אַל תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְ/עֹשֶׁק֮ וּ/בְ/גָזֵ֪ל אַל תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ חַ֤יִל כִּֽי יָנ֑וּב אַל תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'l tbtchv b'shq vbgzl 'l thblv chyl khy ynvb 'l tshytv lb
verses.translation: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'cht dbr 'lhym shtym zv shm'ty khy 'z l'lhym
verses.translation: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִ֑ד בִּ֝/הְיוֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd bhyvtv bmdbr yhvdh
verses.translation: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֵלִ֥/י אַתָּ֗ה אֲֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥/ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְ/ךָ֨ נַפְשִׁ֗/י כָּמַ֣הּ לְ/ךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑/י בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ צִיָּ֖ה וְ/עָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'lhym 'ly 'th 'shchrkh tsm'h lkh npshy khmh lkh bshry b'rts tsyh v'yf bly mym
verses.translation: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן בַּ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑י/ךָ לִ/רְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּ/ךָ֗ וּ/כְבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khn bqdsh chzytykh lr'vt 'zkh vkhbvdkh
verses.translation: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.original: כִּי ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּ/ךָ מֵֽ/חַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥/י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּ/נְךָ
verses.translit: khy tvb chsdkh mchyym shpty yshbchvnkh
verses.translation: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.translit: khn 'brkhkh bchyy bshmkh 'sh' khpy
verses.translation: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭/דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/שִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל פִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khmv chlb vdshn tshb' npshy vshpty rnnvt yhll py
verses.translation: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

verses.original: אִם זְכַרְתִּ֥י/ךָ עַל יְצוּעָ֑/י בְּ֝/אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'm zkhrtykh 'l ytsv'y b'shmrvt 'hgh bkh
verses.translation: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָ/ה לִּ֑/י וּ/בְ/צֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣י/ךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן
verses.translit: khy hyyt 'zrth ly vbtsl khnpykh 'rnn
verses.translation: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.original: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣/י אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ בִּ֝֗/י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: dbqh npshy 'chrykh by tmkhh ymynkh
verses.translation: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it , shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֗מָּה לְ֭/שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑/י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽ/תַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhmh lshv'h ybqshv npshy yb'v btchtyvt h'rts
verses.translation: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.original: יַגִּירֻ֥/הוּ עַל יְדֵי חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: ygyrhv 'l ydy chrb mnt sh'lym yhyv
verses.translation: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.original: שְׁמַע אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣/י בְ/שִׂיחִ֑/י מִ/פַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: shm' 'lhym qvly bshychy mpchd 'vyb ttsr chyy
verses.translation: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.original: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵ/נִי מִ/סּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝/רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: tstyrny msvd mr'ym mrgsht p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַ/חֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑/ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗/ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר
verses.translit: 'shr shnnv khchrb lshvnm drkhv chtsm dbr mr
verses.translation: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.original: לִ/יר֣וֹת בַּ/מִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗/הוּ וְ/לֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ
verses.translit: lyrvt bmstrym tm pt'm yrhv vl' yyr'v
verses.translation: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.original: יְחַזְּקוּ לָ֨/מוֹ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִ/טְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה לָּֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ychzqv lmv dbr r' ysprv ltmvn mvqshym 'mrv my yr'h lmv
verses.translation: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them , and the heart, is deep.

verses.original: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְ/קֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְ/לֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק
verses.translit: ychpshv 'vlt tmnv chpsh mchpsh vqrb 'ysh vlb 'mq
verses.translation: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּרֵ֗/ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyrm 'lhym chts pt'vm hyv mkhvtm
verses.translation: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְשִׁיל֣וּ/הוּ עָלֵ֣י/מוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑/ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל רֹ֥אֵה בָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhshylvhv 'lymv lshvnm ytnddv khl r'h bm
verses.translation: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭/יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥/הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ
verses.translit: vyyr'v khl 'dm vygydv p'l 'lhym vm'shhv hshkhylv
verses.translation: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD , and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/דָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd shyr
verses.translation: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּ/צִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝/לְ/ךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם נֶֽדֶר
verses.translit: lkh dmyh thlh 'lhym btsyvn vlkh yshlm ndr
verses.translation: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗י/ךָ כָּל בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ
verses.translit: shm' tplh 'dykh khl bshr yb'v
verses.translation: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּ/י פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗י/נוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: dbry 'vnt gbrv mny psh'ynv 'th tkhprm
verses.translation: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּ/תְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥י/ךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּ/ט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shry tbchr vtqrb yshkhn chtsrykh nshb'h btvb bytkh qdsh hykhlkh
verses.translation: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת בְּ/צֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵ/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑/נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל קַצְוֵי אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְ/יָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים
verses.translit: nvr'vt btsdq t'nnv 'lhy ysh'nv mbtch khl qtsvy 'rts vym rchqym
verses.translation: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.original: מֵכִ֣ין הָרִ֣ים בְּ/כֹח֑/וֹ נֶ֝אְזָ֗ר בִּ/גְבוּרָֽה
verses.translit: mkhyn hrym bkhchv n'zr bgbvrh
verses.translation: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּי/הֶ֗ם וַ/הֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: mshbych sh'vn ymym sh'vn glyhm vhmvn l'mym
verses.translation: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤ירְא֨וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵ/אוֹתֹתֶ֑י/ךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי בֹ֖קֶר וָ/עֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין
verses.translit: vyyr'v yshby qtsvt m'vttykh mvts'y bqr v'rb trnyn
verses.translation: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.original: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָ/אָ֨רֶץ וַ/תְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡/הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗/נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗/ם כִּי כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: pqdt h'rts vtshqqh rbt t'shrnh plg 'lhym ml' mym tkhyn dgnm khy khn tkhynh
verses.translation: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.original: תְּלָמֶ֣י/הָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑י/הָ בִּ/רְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗/נָּה צִמְחָ֥/הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: tlmyh rvh ncht gdvdyh brbybym tmggnh tsmchh tbrkh
verses.translation: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.original: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/מַעְגָּלֶ֗י/ךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּ/ן דָּֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: 'trt shnt tvbtkh vm'glykh yr'pvn dshn
verses.translation: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.original: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝/גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה
verses.translit: yr'pv n'vt mdbr vgyl gb'vt tchgrnh
verses.translation: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝/אלֹהִים כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lmntsch shyr mzmvr hry'v l'lhym khl h'rts
verses.translation: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

verses.original: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד שְׁמ֑/וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zmrv khbvd shmv shymv khbvd thltv
verses.translation: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.original: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭/אלֹהִים מַה נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑י/ךָ בְּ/רֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּ/ךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְ/ךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'mrv l'lhym mh nvr' m'shykh brb 'zkh ykhchshv lkh 'ybykh
verses.translation: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.original: כָּל הָ/אָ֤רֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭/ךָ וִֽ/יזַמְּרוּ לָ֑/ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: khl h'rts yshtchvv lkh vyzmrv lkh yzmrv shmkh slh
verses.translation: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

verses.original: לְכ֣וּ וּ֭/רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: lkhv vr'v mp'lvt 'lhym nvr' 'lylh 'l bny 'dm
verses.translation: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.original: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם לְֽ/יַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭/נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְ/רָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hpkh ym lybshh bnhr y'brv brgl shm nshmchh bv
verses.translation: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.original: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּ/גְבוּרָת֨/וֹ עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָי/ו בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַ/סּוֹרְרִ֓ים אַל ירימו יָר֖וּמוּ לָ֣/מוֹ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: mshl bgbvrtv 'vlm 'ynyv bgvym ttspynh hsvrrym 'l yrymv yrvmv lmv slh
verses.translation: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.original: בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ֝/הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brkhv 'mym 'lhynv vhshmy'v qvl thltv
verses.translation: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.original: הַ/שָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁ/נוּ בַּֽ/חַיִּ֑ים וְ/לֹֽא נָתַ֖ן לַ/מּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hshm npshnv bchyym vl' ntn lmvt rglnv
verses.translation: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.original: כִּֽי בְחַנְתָּ֥/נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗/נוּ כִּ/צְרָף כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: khy bchntnv 'lhym tsrptnv khtsrf khsf
verses.translation: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.original: הֲבֵאתָ֥/נוּ בַ/מְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְ/מָתְנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hb'tnv bmtsvdh shmt mv'qh bmtnynv
verses.translation: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.original: הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְ/רֹ֫אשֵׁ֥/נוּ בָּֽאנוּ בָ/אֵ֥שׁ וּ/בַ/מַּ֑יִם וַ֝/תּוֹצִיאֵ֗/נוּ לָֽ/רְוָיָֽה
verses.translit: hrkhbt 'nvsh lr'shnv b'nv b'sh vbmym vtvtsy'nv lrvyh
verses.translation: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place .

verses.original: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְ/ךָ֣ בְ/עוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְ/ךָ֣ נְדָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'bv' bytkh b'vlvt 'shlm lkh ndry
verses.translation: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑/י וְ/דִבֶּר פִּ֝֗/י בַּ/צַּר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr ptsv shpty vdbr py btsr ly
verses.translation: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.original: עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵחִ֣ים אַעֲלֶה לָּ֭/ךְ עִם קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'lvt mchym ''lh lkh 'm qtrt 'ylym ''shh bqr 'm 'tvdym slh
verses.translation: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.original: לְכֽוּ שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭/אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְ/נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: lkhv shm'v v'sprh khl yr'y 'lhym 'shr 'shh lnpshy
verses.translation: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.original: אֵלָ֥י/ו פִּֽ/י קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝/רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'lyv py qr'ty vrvmm tcht lshvny
verses.translation: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.original: אָ֭וֶן אִם רָאִ֣יתִי בְ/לִבִּ֑/י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'vn 'm r'yty blby l' yshm' 'dny
verses.translation: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּ/ק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'khn shm' 'lhym hqshyb bqvl tplty
verses.translation: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥/י וְ֝/חַסְדּ֗/וֹ מֵ/אִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: brvkh 'lhym 'shr l' hsyr tplty vchsdv m'ty
verses.translation: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥ח בִּ/נְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynt mzmvr shyr
verses.translation: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥/נוּ וִֽ/יבָרְכֵ֑/נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖י/ו אִתָּ֣/נוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'lhym ychnnv vybrkhnv y'r pnyv 'tnv slh
verses.translation: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.original: לָ/דַ֣עַת בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑/ךָ בְּ/כָל גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ld't b'rts drkhkh bkhl gvym yshv'tkh
verses.translation: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּ/ךָ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּ/ךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yvdvkh 'mym 'lhym yvdvkh 'mym khlm
verses.translation: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.original: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽ/ירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּ/לְאֻמִּ֓ים בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣/ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yshmchv vyrnnv l'mym khy tshpt 'mym myshvr vl'mym b'rts tnchm slh
verses.translation: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּ/ךָ עַמִּ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּ/ךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yvdvkh 'mym 'lhym yvdvkh 'mym khlm
verses.translation: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑/הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗/נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'rts ntnh ybvlh ybrkhnv 'lhym 'lhynv
verses.translation: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְ/דָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd mzmvr shyr
verses.translation: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.original: יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑י/ו וְ/יָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗י/ו מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yqvm 'lhym ypvtsv 'vybyv vynvsv mshn'yv mpnyv
verses.translation: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.original: כְּ/הִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּ/הִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִ/פְּנֵי אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִ/פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khhndf 'shn tndf khhms dvng mpny 'sh y'bdv rsh'ym mpny 'lhym
verses.translation: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.original: וְֽ/צַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְ/יָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vtsdyqym yshmchv y'ltsv lpny 'lhym vyshyshv bshmchh
verses.translation: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah , and rejoice before him.

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לֵֽ/אלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥/וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָ/רֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭/עֲרָבוֹת בְּ/יָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗/וֹ וְ/עִלְז֥וּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shyrv l'lhym zmrv shmv slv lrkhb b'rbvt byh shmv v'lzv lpnyv
verses.translation: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

verses.original: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְ/דַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּ/מְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'by ytvmym vdyn 'lmnvt 'lhym bm'vn qdshv
verses.translation: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land .

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים בַּ֗יְתָ/ה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּ/כּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה
verses.translit: 'lhym mvshyb ychydym byth mvtsy' 'syrym bkhvshrvt 'kh svrrym shkhnv tschychh
verses.translation: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭/צֵאתְ/ךָ לִ/פְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑/ךָ בְּ/צַעְדְּ/ךָ֖ בִֽ/ישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'lhym bts'tkh lpny 'mkh bts'dkh byshymvn slh
verses.translation: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה אַף שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִ/פְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִ/פְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'rts r'shh 'f shmym ntpv mpny 'lhym zh syny mpny 'lhym 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.original: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְ/ךָ֥ וְ֝/נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: gshm ndbvt tnyf 'lhym nchltkh vnl'h 'th khvnnth
verses.translation: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.original: חַיָּתְ/ךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ בָ֑/הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּ/טוֹבָתְ/ךָ֖ לֶ/עָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: chytkh yshbv bh tkhyn btvbtkh l'ny 'lhym
verses.translation: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it .

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥/י יִתֶּן אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝/מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב
verses.translit: 'dny ytn 'mr hmbshrvt tsb' rb
verses.translation: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּ/ן יִדֹּד֑וּ/ן וּ/נְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: mlkhy tsb'vt yddvn yddvn vnvt byt tchlq shll
verses.translation: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.original: אִֽם תִּשְׁכְּבוּ/ן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַ/כֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝/אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗י/הָ בִּֽ/ירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ
verses.translit: 'm tshkhbvn byn shptym khnpy yvnh nchph bkhsf v'brvtyh byrqrq chrvts
verses.translation: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

verses.original: בְּ/פָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗/הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּ/צַלְמֽוֹן
verses.translit: bprsh shdy mlkhym bh tshlg btslmvn
verses.translation: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

verses.original: הַר אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: hr 'lhym hr bshn hr gbnnym hr bshn
verses.translation: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תְּֽרַצְּדוּ/ן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָ/הָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְ/שִׁבְתּ֑/וֹ אַף יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָ/נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: lmh trtsdvn hrym gbnnym hhr chmd 'lhym lshbtv 'f yhvh yshkhn lntsch
verses.translation: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place .

verses.original: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥/י בָ֝֗/ם סִינַ֥י בַּ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: rkhb 'lhym rbtym 'lpy shn'n 'dny bm syny bqdsh
verses.translation: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them .

verses.original: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַ/מָּר֨וֹם שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/אַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִ/שְׁכֹּ֤ן יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'lyt lmrvm shbyt shby lqcht mtnvt b'dm v'f svrrym lshkhn yh 'lhym
verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.original: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָ/י֮ י֤וֹם י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס לָ֗/נוּ הָ֘/אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬/נוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: brvkh 'dny yvm yvm y'ms lnv h'l yshv'tnv slh
verses.translation: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.

verses.original: הָ֤/אֵ֣ל לָ/נוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽ/מוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְ/לֵ/יהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑/י לַ֝/מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: h'l lnv 'l lmvsh'vt vlyhvh 'dny lmvt tvts'vt
verses.translation: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.original: אַךְ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥י/ו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּ/אֲשָׁמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'kh 'lhym ymchts r'sh 'ybyv qdqd sh'r mthlkh b'shmyv
verses.translation: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָ/י מִ/בָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽ/מְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם
verses.translit: 'mr 'dny mbshn 'shyb 'shyb mmtslvt ym
verses.translation: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְ/ךָ֗ בְּ֫/דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑י/ךָ מֵ/אֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: lm'n tmchts rglkh bdm lshvn khlbykh m'ybym mnhv
verses.translation: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.original: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣י/ךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖/י מַלְכִּ֣/י בַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: r'v hlykhvtykh 'lhym hlykhvt 'ly mlkhy bqdsh
verses.translation: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת
verses.translit: qdmv shrym 'chr ngnym btvkh 'lmvt tvppvt
verses.translation: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.original: בְּֽ֭/מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִ/מְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bmqhlvt brkhv 'lhym yhvh mmqvr yshr'l
verses.translation: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗/ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑/ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: shm bnymn ts'yr rdm shry yhvdh rgmtm shry zblvn shry nptly
verses.translation: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.original: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥/ךָ עוּזָּ֥/ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: tsvh 'lhykh 'zkh 'vzh 'lhym zv p'lt lnv
verses.translation: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.original: מֵֽ֭/הֵיכָלֶ/ךָ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְ/ךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי
verses.translit: mhykhlkh 'l yrvshlm lkh yvbylv mlkhym shy
verses.translation: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

verses.original: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים בְּ/עֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּ/רַצֵּי כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ
verses.translit: g'r chyt qnh 'dt 'byrym b'gly 'mym mtrps brtsy khsf bzr 'mym qrbvt ychptsv
verses.translation: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.original: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗י/ו לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: y'tyv chshmnym mny mtsrym khvsh tryts ydyv l'lhym
verses.translation: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.original: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭/אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: mmlkhvt h'rts shyrv l'lhym zmrv 'dny slh
verses.translation: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

verses.original: לָ֭/רֹכֵב בִּ/שְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝/קוֹל/וֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז
verses.translit: lrkhb bshmy shmy qdm hn ytn bqvlv qvl 'z
verses.translation: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.original: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽ/אלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑/וֹ וְ֝/עֻזּ֗/וֹ בַּ/שְּׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: tnv 'z l'lhym 'l yshr'l g'vtv v'zv bshchqym
verses.translation: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l shvshnym ldvd
verses.translation: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.original: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥/נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: hvshy'ny 'lhym khy b'v mym 'd npsh
verses.translation: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.original: טָבַ֤עְתִּי בִּ/יוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְ/אֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְ/מַעֲמַקֵּי מַ֝֗יִם וְ/שִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְ/נִי
verses.translit: tb'ty byvn mtsvlh v'yn m'md b'ty bm'mqy mym vshblt shtptny
verses.translation: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.original: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְ/קָרְאִ/י֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥/י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑/י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵ/אלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: yg'ty bqr'y nchr grvny khlv 'yny mychl l'lhy
verses.translation: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

verses.original: רַבּ֤וּ מִ/שַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁ/י֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪/י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַ/י אֹיְבַ֣/י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: rbv msh'rvt r'shy shn'y chnm 'tsmv mtsmyty 'yby shqr 'shr l' gzlty 'z 'shyb
verses.translation: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְ/אִוַּלְתִּ֑/י וְ֝/אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗/י מִמְּ/ךָ֥ לֹא נִכְחָֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'lhym 'th yd't l'vlty v'shmvty mmkh l' nkhchdv
verses.translation: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.original: אַל יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨/י קֹוֶי/ךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣/י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑י/ךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l ybshv by qvykh 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'l ykhlmv by mbqshykh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָ֭לֶי/ךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'lykh nsh'ty chrph khsth khlmh pny
verses.translation: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.original: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְ/אֶחָ֑/י וְ֝/נָכְרִ֗י לִ/בְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: mvzr hyyty l'chy vnkhry lbny 'my
verses.translation: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.original: כִּֽי קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְ/ךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְ/נִי וְ/חֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗י/ךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy qn't bytkh 'khltny vchrpvt chvrpykh nplv 'ly
verses.translation: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.original: וָ/אֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַ/צּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑/י וַ/תְּהִ֖י לַ/חֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'bkhh btsvm npshy vthy lchrpvt ly
verses.translation: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֣/ה לְבוּשִׁ֣/י שָׂ֑ק וָ/אֱהִ֖י לָ/הֶ֣ם לְ/מָשָֽׁל
verses.translit: v'tnh lbvshy shq v'hy lhm lmshl
verses.translation: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

verses.original: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭/י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝/נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר
verses.translit: yshychv by yshby sh'r vngynvt shvty shkhr
verses.translation: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD , in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽ/י לְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּ/רָב חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗/נִי בֶּ/אֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny tplty lkh yhvh 't rtsvn 'lhym brb chsdkh 'nny b'mt ysh'kh
verses.translation: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֣/נִי מִ֭/טִּיט וְ/אַל אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝/שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗/י וּ/מִ/מַּֽעֲמַקֵּי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: htsylny mtyt v'l 'tb'h 'ntslh mshn'y vmm'mqy mym
verses.translation: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.original: אַל תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤/נִי שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְ/אַל תִּבְלָעֵ֣/נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְ/אַל תֶּאְטַר עָלַ֖/י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'l tshtpny shblt mym v'l tbl'ny mtsvlh v'l t'tr 'ly b'r pyh
verses.translation: Hear me, O LORD ; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣/נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ כְּ/רֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗י/ךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nny yhvh khy tvb chsdkh khrb rchmykh pnh 'ly
verses.translation: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.original: וְ/אַל תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶי/ךָ מֵֽ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּֽי צַר לִ֝֗/י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'l tstr pnykh m'bdkh khy tsr ly mhr 'nny
verses.translation: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.original: קָרְבָ֣/ה אֶל נַפְשִׁ֣/י גְאָלָ֑/הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣/י פְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: qrbh 'l npshy g'lh lm'n 'yby pdny
verses.translation: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣/י וּ֭/בָשְׁתִּ/י וּ/כְלִמָּתִ֑/י נֶ֝גְדְּ/ךָ֗ כָּל צוֹרְרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'th yd't chrpty vbshty vkhlmty ngdkh khl tsvrry
verses.translation: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.original: חֶרְפָּ֤ה שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗/י וָֽ/אָ֫נ֥וּשָׁ/ה וָ/אֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָ/נ֣וּד וָ/אַ֑יִן וְ֝/לַ/מְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְ/לֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי
verses.translit: chrph shbrh lby v'nvshh v'qvh lnvd v'yn vlmnchmym vl' mts'ty
verses.translation: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּ/בָרוּתִ֣/י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝/לִ/צְמָאִ֗/י יַשְׁק֥וּ/נִי חֹֽמֶץ
verses.translit: vytnv bbrvty r'sh vltsm'y yshqvny chmts
verses.translation: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

verses.original: יְהִֽי שֻׁלְחָנָ֣/ם לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֣ם לְ/פָ֑ח וְ/לִ/שְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְ/מוֹקֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: yhy shlchnm lpnyhm lpch vlshlvmym lmvqsh
verses.translation: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.original: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵי/הֶם מֵ/רְא֑וֹת וּ֝/מָתְנֵ֗י/הֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד
verses.translit: tchshkhnh 'ynyhm mr'vt vmtnyhm tmyd hm'd
verses.translation: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.original: שְׁפָךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑/ךָ וַ/חֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּ/ךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: shpkh 'lyhm z'mkh vchrvn 'pkh yshygm
verses.translation: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

verses.original: תְּהִי טִֽירָתָ֥/ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֗ם אַל יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: thy tyrtm nshmh b'hlyhm 'l yhy yshb
verses.translation: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְ/אֶל מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣י/ךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'shr hkhyt rdpv v'l mkh'vb chllykh ysprv
verses.translation: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.original: תְּֽנָ/ה עָ֭וֺן עַל עֲוֺנָ֑/ם וְ/אַל יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּ/צִדְקָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: tnh 'vn 'l 'vnm v'l yb'v btsdqtkh
verses.translation: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.original: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִ/סֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְ/עִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל יִכָּתֵֽבוּ
verses.translit: ymchv mspr chyym v'm tsdyqym 'l ykhtbv
verses.translation: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.original: וַ֭/אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְ/כוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'ny 'ny vkhv'b yshv'tkh 'lhym tshgbny
verses.translation: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.original: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ/שִׁ֑יר וַ/אֲגַדְּלֶ֥/נּוּ בְ/תוֹדָֽה
verses.translit: 'hllh shm 'lhym bshyr v'gdlnv btvdh
verses.translation: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.original: וְ/תִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭/יהוָה מִ/שּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס
verses.translit: vtytb lyhvh mshvr pr mqrn mprys
verses.translation: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.original: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִ/יחִ֥י לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: r'v 'nvym yshmchv drshy 'lhym vychy lbbkhm
verses.translation: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.original: כִּֽי שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶת אֲ֝סִירָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה
verses.translit: khy shm' 'l 'byvnym yhvh v't 'syryv l' bzh
verses.translation: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּ/הוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָ/אָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽ/כָל רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhllvhv shmym v'rts ymym vkhl rmsh bm
verses.translation: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭/יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/יָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִ/ירֵשֽׁוּ/הָ
verses.translit: khy 'lhym yvshy' tsyvn vybnh 'ry yhvdh vyshbv shm vyrshvh
verses.translation: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.original: לַ֝/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְ/דָוִ֥ד לְ/הַזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd lhzkhyr
verses.translation: Make haste , O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD .

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְ/הַצִּילֵ֑/נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְ/עֶזְרָ֥תִ/י חֽוּשָֽׁ/ה
verses.translit: 'lhym lhtsylny yhvh l'zrty chvshh
verses.translation: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְ/יַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְ/יִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: ybshv vychprv mbqshy npshy ysgv 'chvr vykhlmv chptsy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.original: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑/ם הָ֝/אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח הֶאָֽח
verses.translit: yshvbv 'l 'qb bshtm h'mrym h'ch h'ch
verses.translation: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְ/יִשְׂמְח֨וּ בְּ/ךָ֗ כָּֽל מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥י/ךָ וְ/יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yshyshv vyshmchv bkh khl mbqshykh vy'mrv tmyd ygdl 'lhym 'hby yshv'tkh
verses.translation: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD , make no tarrying.

verses.original: בְּ/ךָֽ יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: bkh yhvh chsyty 'l 'bvshh l'vlm
verses.translation: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.original: בְּ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥/נִי וּֽ/תְפַלְּטֵ֑/נִי הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥/י אָ֝זְנְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: btsdqtkh ttsylny vtpltny hth 'ly 'znkh vhvshy'ny
verses.translation: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.original: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨/י לְ/צ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָ/ב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְ/הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי כִּֽי סַלְעִ֖/י וּ/מְצוּדָתִ֣/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: hyh ly ltsvr m'vn lbv' tmyd tsvyt lhvshy'ny khy sl'y vmtsvdty 'th
verses.translation: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗/י פַּ֭לְּטֵ/נִי מִ/יַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִ/כַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְ/חוֹמֵץ
verses.translit: 'lhy pltny myd rsh' mkhf m'vl vchvmts
verses.translation: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑/י אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥/י מִ/נְּעוּרָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th tqvty 'dny yhvh mbtchy mn'vry
verses.translation: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD : thou art my trust from my youth.

verses.original: עָלֶ֤י/ךָ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִ/בֶּ֗טֶן מִ/מְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּ/י אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑/י בְּ/ךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣/י תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: 'lykh nsmkhty mbtn mm'y 'my 'th gvzy bkh thlty tmyd
verses.translation: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

verses.original: כְּ֭/מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְ/רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝/אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִ/י עֹֽז
verses.translit: khmvpt hyyty lrbym v'th mchsy 'z
verses.translation: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

verses.translit: yml' py thltkh khl hyvm tp'rtkh
verses.translation: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

verses.original: אַֽל תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵ/נִי לְ/עֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּ/כְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗/י אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'l tshlykhny l't zqnh khkhlvt khchy 'l t'zbny
verses.translation: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣/י לִ֑/י וְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: khy 'mrv 'vyby ly vshmry npshy nv'tsv ychdv
verses.translation: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.original: לֵ֭/אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑/וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝/תִפְשׂ֗וּ/הוּ כִּי אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: l'mr 'lhym 'zbv rdpv vtpshvhv khy 'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him .

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑/נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗/י לְ/עֶזְרָ֥תִ/י חיש/ה חֽוּשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: 'lhym 'l trchq mmny 'lhy l'zrty chyshh chvshh
verses.translation: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּ/כְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: ybshv ykhlv shtny npshy y'tv chrph vkhlmh mbqshy r'ty
verses.translation: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.original: וַ֭/אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝/הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל כָּל תְּהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny tmyd 'ychl vhvspty 'l khl thltkh
verses.translation: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

verses.original: פִּ֤/י יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗/ךָ כָּל הַ/יּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת
verses.translit: py yspr tsdqtkh khl hyvm tshv'tkh khy l' yd'ty sprvt
verses.translation: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof .

verses.original: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭/גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֣ לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'bv' bgbrvt 'dny yhvh 'zkhyr tsdqtkh lbdkh
verses.translation: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD : I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥/נִי מִ/נְּעוּרָ֑/י וְ/עַד הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'lhym lmdtny mn'vry v'd hnh 'gyd npl'vtykh
verses.translation: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם עַד זִקְנָ֨ה וְ/שֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥/נִי עַד אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲ/ךָ֣ לְ/ד֑וֹר לְ/כָל יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 'd zqnh vshybh 'lhym 'l t'zbny 'd 'gyd zrv'kh ldvr lkhl ybv' gbvrtkh
verses.translation: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

verses.original: וְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹ/ךָ
verses.translit: vtsdqtkh 'lhym 'd mrvm 'shr 'shyt gdlvt 'lhym my khmvkh
verses.translation: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הראית/נו הִרְאִיתַ֨/נִי צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְ/רָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תחיי/נו תְּחַיֵּ֑י/נִי וּֽ/מִ/תְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'shr hr'ytnv hr'ytny tsrvt rbvt vr'vt tshvb tchyynv tchyyny vmthmvt h'rts tshvb t'lny
verses.translation: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.translit: trb gdlty vtsb tnchmny
verses.translation: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.original: גַּם אֲנִ֤י אוֹדְ/ךָ֣ בִ/כְלִי נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּ/ךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥/י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְ/ךָ֣ בְ/כִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: gm 'ny 'vdkh bkhly nbl 'mtkh 'lhy 'zmrh lkh bkhnvr qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.translit: trnnh shpty khy 'zmrh lkh vnpshy 'shr pdyt
verses.translation: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.original: גַּם לְשׁוֹנִ֗/י כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּי בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm lshvny khl hyvm thgh tsdqtkh khy bshv khy chprv mbqshy r'ty
verses.translation: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.original: לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶי/ךָ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ לְ/בֶן מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: lshlmh 'lhym mshptykh lmlkh tn vtsdqtkh lbn mlkh
verses.translation: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין עַמְּ/ךָ֣ בְ/צֶ֑דֶק וַ/עֲנִיֶּ֥י/ךָ בְ/מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: ydyn 'mkh btsdq v'nyykh bmshpt
verses.translation: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָ/עָ֑ם וּ֝/גְבָע֗וֹת בִּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: ysh'v hrym shlvm l'm vgb'vt btsdqh
verses.translation: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

verses.original: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט עֲֽנִיֵּי עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִֽ/ידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק
verses.translit: yshpt 'nyy 'm yvshy' lbny 'byvn vydkh' 'vshq
verses.translation: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.original: יִֽירָא֥וּ/ךָ עִם שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: yyr'vkh 'm shmsh vlpny yrch dvr dvrym
verses.translation: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.original: יֵ֭רֵד כְּ/מָטָ֣ר עַל גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝/רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yrd khmtr 'l gz khrbybym zrzyf 'rts
verses.translation: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

verses.original: יִֽפְרַח בְּ/יָמָ֥י/ו צַדִּ֑יק וְ/רֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ
verses.translit: yprch bymyv tsdyq vrb shlvm 'd bly yrch
verses.translation: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

verses.original: וְ֭/יֵרְדְּ מִ/יָּ֣ם עַד יָ֑ם וּ֝/מִ/נָּהָ֗ר עַד אַפְסֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyrd mym 'd ym vmnhr 'd 'psy 'rts
verses.translation: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.original: לְ֭/פָנָי/ו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝/אֹיְבָ֗י/ו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: lpnyv ykhr'v tsyym v'ybyv 'pr ylchkhv
verses.translation: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭/אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝/סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ
verses.translit: mlkhy trshysh v'yym mnchh yshybv mlkhy shb' vsb' 'shkhr yqrybv
verses.translation: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֥/וֹ כָל מְלָכִ֑ים כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יַֽעַבְדֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyshtchvv lv khl mlkhym khl gvym y'bdvhv
verses.translation: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝/עָנִ֗י וְֽ/אֵין עֹזֵ֥ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ytsyl 'byvn mshv' v'ny v'yn 'zr lv
verses.translation: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

verses.original: יָ֭חֹס עַל דַּ֣ל וְ/אֶבְי֑וֹן וְ/נַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: ychs 'l dl v'byvn vnpshvt 'byvnym yvshy'
verses.translation: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.original: מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭/מֵ/חָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/יֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣/ם בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mtvkh vmchms yg'l npshm vyyqr dmm b'ynyv
verses.translation: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.original: וִ/יחִ֗י וְ/יִתֶּן ל/וֹ֮ מִ/זְּהַ֪ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְ/יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣/וֹ תָמִ֑יד כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם יְבָרֲכֶֽ/נְהֽוּ
verses.translit: vychy vytn lv mzhb shb' vytpll b'dv tmyd khl hyvm ybrkhnhv
verses.translation: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

verses.original: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת בַּ֨ר בָּ/אָרֶץ֮ בְּ/רֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּ/לְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑/וֹ וְ/יָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝/עִ֗יר כְּ/עֵ֣שֶׂב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yhy pst br b'rts br'sh hrym yr'sh khlbnvn pryv vytsytsv m'yr kh'shb h'rts
verses.translation: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.original: יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨/וֹ לְֽ/עוֹלָ֗ם לִ/פְנֵי שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ ינין יִנּ֪וֹן שְׁ֫מ֥/וֹ וְ/יִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑/וֹ כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: yhy shmv l'vlm lpny shmsh ynyn ynvn shmv vytbrkhv bv khl gvym y'shrvhv
verses.translation: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhym 'lhy yshr'l 'shh npl'vt lbdv
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

verses.original: וּ/בָר֤וּךְ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗/וֹ לְ/ע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְ/יִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹד/וֹ אֶת כֹּ֥ל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְ/אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: vbrvkh shm khbvdv l'vlm vyml' khbvdv 't khl h'rts 'mn v'mn
verses.translation: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.original: כָּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן יִשָֽׁי
verses.translit: khlv tplvt dvd bn yshy
verses.translation: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֭וֹב לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְ/בָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'kh tvb lyshr'l 'lhym lbry lbb
verses.translation: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י כִּ֭/מְעַט נטוי נָטָ֣יוּ רַגְלָ֑/י כְּ֝/אַ֗יִן שפכה שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ אֲשֻׁרָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny khm't ntvy ntyv rgly kh'yn shpkhh shpkhv 'shry
verses.translation: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.original: כִּֽי קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽ/הוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: khy qn'ty bhvllym shlvm rsh'ym 'r'h
verses.translation: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְ/מוֹתָ֗/ם וּ/בָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'yn chrtsbvt lmvtm vbry' 'vlm
verses.translation: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑/מוֹ וְ/עִם אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: b'ml 'nvsh 'ynmv v'm 'dm l' yng'v
verses.translation: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.original: לָ֭/כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְ/מוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: lkhn 'nqtmv g'vh y'tf shyt chms lmv
verses.translation: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

verses.original: יָ֭צָא מֵ/חֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑/מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב
verses.translit: yts' mchlb 'ynmv 'brv mshkhyvt lbb
verses.translation: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.original: יָמִ֤יקוּ וִ/ידַבְּר֣וּ בְ/רָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִ/מָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: ymyqv vydbrv br' 'shq mmrvm ydbrv
verses.translation: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.translit: shtv bshmym pyhm vlshvnm thlkh b'rts
verses.translation: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֤ן ישיב יָשׁ֣וּב עַמּ֣/וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם וּ/מֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: lkhn yshyb yshvb 'mv hlm vmy ml' ymtsv lmv
verses.translation: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

verses.original: וְֽ/אָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע אֵ֑ל וְ/יֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְ/עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'mrv 'ykhh yd' 'l vysh d'h b'lyvn
verses.translation: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.original: הִנֵּה אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְ/שַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ חָֽיִל
verses.translit: hnh 'lh rsh'ym vshlvy 'vlm hshgv chyl
verses.translation: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

verses.original: אַךְ רִ֭יק זִכִּ֣יתִי לְבָבִ֑/י וָ/אֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּ/נִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'kh ryq zkhyty lbby v'rchts bnqyvn khpy
verses.translation: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.original: וָ/אֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ֝/תוֹכַחְתִּ֗/י לַ/בְּקָרִֽים
verses.translit: v'hy ngv' khl hyvm vtvkhchty lbqrym
verses.translation: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

verses.original: אִם אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָ֥ה כְמ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה ד֭וֹר בָּנֶ֣י/ךָ בָגָֽדְתִּי
verses.translit: 'm 'mrty 'sprh khmv hnh dvr bnykh bgdty
verses.translation: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

verses.original: וָֽ֭/אֲחַשְּׁבָ/ה לָ/דַ֣עַת זֹ֑את עָמָ֖ל היא ה֣וּא בְ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'chshbh ld't z't 'ml hy' hv' b'yny
verses.translation: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

verses.original: עַד אָ֭בוֹא אֶל מִקְדְּשֵׁי אֵ֑ל אָ֝בִ֗ינָה לְ/אַחֲרִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'd 'bv' 'l mqdshy 'l 'bynh l'chrytm
verses.translation: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭/חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑/מוֹ הִ֝פַּלְתָּ֗/ם לְ/מַשּׁוּאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'kh bchlqvt tshyt lmv hpltm lmshv'vt
verses.translation: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

verses.original: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה כְ/רָ֑גַע סָ֥פוּ תַ֝֗מּוּ מִן בַּלָּהֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'ykh hyv lshmh khrg' spv tmv mn blhvt
verses.translation: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.original: כַּ/חֲל֥וֹם מֵ/הָקִ֑יץ אֲ֝דֹנָ/י בָּ/עִ֤יר צַלְמָ֬/ם תִּבְזֶֽה
verses.translit: khchlvm mhqyts 'dny b'yr tslmm tbzh
verses.translation: As a dream when one awaketh; so , O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

verses.original: כִּ֭י יִתְחַמֵּ֣ץ לְבָבִ֑/י וְ֝/כִלְיוֹתַ֗/י אֶשְׁתּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: khy ytchmts lbby vkhlyvty 'shtvnn
verses.translation: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִי בַ֭עַר וְ/לֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת הָיִ֥יתִי עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'ny b'r vl' 'd' bhmvt hyyty 'mkh
verses.translation: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י תָמִ֣יד עִמָּ֑/ךְ אָ֝חַ֗זְתָּ בְּ/יַד יְמִינִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny tmyd 'mkh 'chzt byd ymyny
verses.translation: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲצָתְ/ךָ֥ תַנְחֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/אַחַ֗ר כָּב֥וֹד תִּקָּחֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: b'tstkh tnchny v'chr khbvd tqchny
verses.translation: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

verses.original: מִי לִ֥/י בַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝/עִמְּ/ךָ֗ לֹא חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: my ly bshmym v'mkh l' chptsty b'rts
verses.translation: Whom have I in heaven but thee ? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

verses.original: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗/י וּ/לְבָ֫בִ֥/י צוּר לְבָבִ֥/י וְ/חֶלְקִ֗/י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khlh sh'ry vlbby tsvr lbby vchlqy 'lhym l'vlm
verses.translation: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה רְחֵקֶ֣י/ךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ הִ֝צְמַ֗תָּה כָּל זוֹנֶ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy hnh rchqykh y'bdv htsmth khl zvnh mmkh
verses.translation: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫/י ט֥וֹב שַׁתִּ֤י בַּ/אדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑/י לְ֝/סַפֵּ֗ר כָּל מַלְאֲכוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny qrbt 'lhym ly tvb shty b'dny yhvh mchsy lspr khl ml'khvtykh
verses.translation: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD , that I may declare all thy works.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף לָ/מָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָ/נֶ֑צַח יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּ/ךָ֗ בְּ/צֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mshkhyl l'sf lmh 'lhym zncht lntsch y'shn 'pkh bts'n mr'ytkh
verses.translation: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְ/ךָ֨ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑/ךָ הַר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zkhr 'dtkh qnyt qdm g'lt shbt nchltkh hr tsyvn zh shkhnt bv
verses.translation: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

verses.original: הָרִ֣ימָ/ה פְ֭עָמֶי/ךָ לְ/מַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח כָּל הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: hrymh p'mykh lmsh'vt ntsch khl hr' 'vyb bqdsh
verses.translation: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.original: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶי/ךָ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑/ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣/ם אֹתֽוֹת
verses.translit: sh'gv tsrrykh bqrb mv'dkh shmv 'vttm 'tvt
verses.translation: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

verses.original: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּ/מֵבִ֣יא לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה בִּֽ/סֲבָךְ עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: yvd' khmby' lm'lh bsbkh 'ts qrdmvt
verses.translation: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

verses.original: ו/עת וְ֭/עַתָּה פִּתּוּחֶ֣י/הָ יָּ֑חַד בְּ/כַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝/כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת יַהֲלֹמֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: v't v'th ptvchyh ychd bkhshyl vkhylpt yhlmvn
verses.translation: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

verses.translit: shlchv b'sh mqdshkh l'rts chllv mshkhn shmkh
verses.translation: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

verses.original: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭/לִבָּ/ם נִינָ֣/ם יָ֑חַד שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל מוֹעֲדֵי אֵ֣ל בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'mrv blbm nynm ychd shrpv khl mv'dy 'l b'rts
verses.translation: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

verses.original: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗י/נוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ אֵֽין ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא וְ/לֹֽא אִ֝תָּ֗/נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד מָֽה
verses.translit: 'vttynv l' r'ynv 'yn 'vd nby' vl' 'tnv yd' 'd mh
verses.translation: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ לָ/נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: 'd mty 'lhym ychrf tsr yn'ts 'vyb shmkh lntsch
verses.translation: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְ/ךָ וִֽ/ימִינֶ֑/ךָ מִ/קֶּ֖רֶב חוק/ך חֵֽיקְ/ךָ֣ כַלֵּֽה
verses.translit: lmh tshyb ydkh vymynkh mqrb chvqkh chyqkh khlh
verses.translation: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

verses.original: וֵ֭/אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣/י מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'lhym mlkhy mqdm p'l yshv'vt bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְ/עָזְּ/ךָ֣ יָ֑ם שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: 'th pvrrt b'zkh ym shbrt r'shy tnynym 'l hmym
verses.translation: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן תִּתְּנֶ֥/נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְ/עָ֣ם לְ/צִיִּֽים
verses.translit: 'th rtstst r'shy lvytn ttnnv m'khl l'm ltsyym
verses.translation: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָ/נָ֑חַל אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן
verses.translit: 'th bq't m'yn vnchl 'th hvbsht nhrvt 'ytn
verses.translation: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף לְ/ךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָ/שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: lkh yvm 'f lkh lylh 'th hkhynvt m'vr vshmsh
verses.translation: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ קַ֥יִץ וָ֝/חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּ/ם
verses.translit: 'th htsbt khl gbvlvt 'rts qyts vchrf 'th ytsrtm
verses.translation: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

verses.original: זְכָר זֹ֗את א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: zkhr z't 'vyb chrf yhvh v'm nbl n'tsv shmkh
verses.translation: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD , and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

verses.original: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭/חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑/ךָ חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗י/ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָ/נֶֽצַח
verses.translit: 'l ttn lchyt npsh tvrkh chyt 'nyykh 'l tshkhch lntsch
verses.translation: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

verses.original: הַבֵּ֥ט לַ/בְּרִ֑ית כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס
verses.translit: hbt lbryt khy ml'v mchshkhy 'rts n'vt chms
verses.translation: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.original: אַל יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם עָנִ֥י וְ֝/אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l yshb dkh nkhlm 'ny v'byvn yhllv shmkh
verses.translation: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣/ה אֱ֭לֹהִים רִיבָ֣/ה רִיבֶ֑/ךָ זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְ/ךָ֥ מִנִּי נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: qvmh 'lhym rybh rybkh zkhr chrptkh mny nbl khl hyvm
verses.translation: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

verses.original: אַל תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑י/ךָ שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗י/ךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: 'l tshkhch qvl tsrrykh sh'vn qmykh 'lh tmyd
verses.translation: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְ/אָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l tshcht mzmvr l'sf shyr
verses.translation: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

verses.original: ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּ/ךָ֨ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ וְ/קָר֣וֹב שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hvdynv lkh 'lhym hvdynv vqrvb shmkh sprv npl'vtykh
verses.translation: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

verses.original: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט
verses.translit: khy 'qch mv'd 'ny myshrym 'shpt
verses.translation: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.original: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְ/כָל יֹשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣י/הָ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: nmgym 'rts vkhl yshbyh 'nkhy tkhnty 'mvdyh slh
verses.translation: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭/הוֹלְלִים אַל תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝/לָ/רְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן
verses.translit: 'mrty lhvllym 'l thlv vlrsh'ym 'l trymv qrn
verses.translation: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

verses.original: אַל תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַ/מָּר֣וֹם קַרְנְ/כֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְ/צַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק
verses.translit: 'l trymv lmrvm qrnkhm tdbrv btsv'r 'tq
verses.translation: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭/מּוֹצָא וּ/מִֽ/מַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝/לֹ֗א מִ/מִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy l' mmvts' vmm'rb vl' mmdbr hrym
verses.translation: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְ/זֶ֣ה יָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'lhym shpt zh yshpyl vzh yrym
verses.translation: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them .

verses.original: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽ/יַד יְהוָ֡ה וְ/יַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַ/יַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫/זֶּ֥ה אַךְ שְׁ֭מָרֶי/הָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy khvs byd yhvh vyyn chmr ml' mskh vygr mzh 'kh shmryh ymtsv yshtv khl rsh'y 'rts
verses.translation: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.original: וַ֭/אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְ/עֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵ/אלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: v'ny 'gyd l'lm 'zmrh l'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּ/נְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְ/אָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynt mzmvr l'sf shyr
verses.translation: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

verses.original: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nvd' byhvdh 'lhym byshr'l gdvl shmv
verses.translation: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְ/שָׁלֵ֣ם סֻכּ֑/וֹ וּ/מְע֖וֹנָת֣/וֹ בְ/צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy bshlm skhv vm'vntv btsyvn
verses.translation: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.original: שָׁ֭מָּ/ה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְ/חֶ֖רֶב וּ/מִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: shmh shbr rshpy qsht mgn vchrb vmlchmh slh
verses.translation: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.original: נָ֭אוֹר אַתָּ֥ה אַדִּ֗יר מֵֽ/הַרְרֵי טָֽרֶף
verses.translit: n'vr 'th 'dyr mhrry trf
verses.translation: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא מָצְא֖וּ כָל אַנְשֵׁי חַ֣יִל יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'shtvllv 'byry lb nmv shntm vl' mts'v khl 'nshy chyl ydyhm
verses.translation: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.original: מִ֭/גַּעֲרָ֣תְ/ךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְ/רֶ֣כֶב וָ/סֽוּס
verses.translit: mg'rtkh 'lhy y'qb nrdm vrkhb vsvs
verses.translation: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּ/מִֽי יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ מֵ/אָ֥ז אַפֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'th nvr' 'th vmy y'md lpnykh m'z 'pkh
verses.translation: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.original: מִ֭/שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְ/שָׁקָֽטָה
verses.translit: mshmym hshm't dyn 'rts yr'h vshqth
verses.translation: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.original: בְּ/קוּם לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְ/הוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כָּל עַנְוֵי אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: bqvm lmshpt 'lhym lhvshy' khl 'nvy 'rts slh
verses.translation: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

verses.original: כִּֽי חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑/ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר
verses.translit: khy chmt 'dm tvdkh sh'ryt chmt tchgr
verses.translation: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

verses.original: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְ/שַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַ/יהוָ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫י/כֶ֥ם כָּל סְבִיבָ֑י/ו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַ/מּוֹרָֽא
verses.translit: ndrv vshlmv lyhvh 'lhykhm khl sbybyv yvbylv shy lmvr'
verses.translation: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל ידיתון יְדוּת֗וּן לְ/אָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l ydytvn ydvtvn l'sf mzmvr
