verses.translation: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

verses.original: קוֹלִ֣/י אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְ/אֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥/י אֶל אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְ/הַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: qvly 'l 'lhym v'ts'qh qvly 'l 'lhym vh'zyn 'ly
verses.translation: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.original: בְּ/י֥וֹם צָרָתִ/י֮ אֲדֹנָ֪/י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤/י לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְ/לֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: byvm tsrty 'dny drshty ydy lylh ngrh vl' tpvg m'nh hnchm npshy
verses.translation: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.original: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְ/אֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה וְ/תִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣/י סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'zkhrh 'lhym v'hmyh 'shychh vtt'tf rvchy slh
verses.translation: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.original: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑/י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'chzt shmrvt 'yny np'mty vl' 'dbr
verses.translation: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים
verses.translit: chshbty ymym mqdm shnvt 'vlmym
verses.translation: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.original: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗/י בַּ֫/לָּ֥יְלָה עִם לְבָבִ֥/י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַ/יְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'zkhrh ngynty blylh 'm lbby 'shychh vychpsh rvchy
verses.translation: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.original: הַֽ֭/לְ/עוֹלָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח אֲדֹנָ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא יֹסִ֖יף לִ/רְצ֣וֹת עֽוֹד
verses.translit: hl'vlmym yznch 'dny vl' ysyf lrtsvt 'vd
verses.translation: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

verses.original: הֶ/אָפֵ֣ס לָ/נֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑/וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: h'ps lntsch chsdv gmr 'mr ldr vdr
verses.translation: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.original: הֲ/שָׁכַ֣ח חַנּ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל אִם קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝/אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥י/ו סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: hshkhch chnvt 'l 'm qpts b'f rchmyv slh
verses.translation: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

verses.original: וָ֭/אֹמַר חַלּ֣וֹתִ/י הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'mr chlvty hy' shnvt ymyn 'lyvn
verses.translation: I will remember the works of the LORD : surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

verses.original: אזכיר אֶזְכּ֥וֹר מַֽעַלְלֵי יָ֑הּ כִּֽי אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה מִ/קֶּ֣דֶם פִּלְאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'zkhyr 'zkhvr m'lly yh khy 'zkhrh mqdm pl'kh
verses.translation: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

verses.original: וְ/הָגִ֥יתִי בְ/כָל פָּעֳלֶ֑/ךָ וּֽ/בַ/עֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣י/ךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה
verses.translit: vhgyty bkhl p'lkh vb'lylvtykh 'shychh
verses.translation: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑/ךָ מִי אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּֽ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'lhym bqdsh drkhkh my 'l gdvl kh'lhym
verses.translation: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭/אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ בָ/עַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'th h'l 'shh pl' hvd't b'mym 'zkh
verses.translation: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.original: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּ/זְר֣וֹעַ עַמֶּ֑/ךָ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְ/יוֹסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: g'lt bzrv' 'mkh bny y'qb vyvsf slh
verses.translation: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.original: רָ֘א֤וּ/ךָ מַּ֨יִם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּ/ךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: r'vkh mym 'lhym r'vkh mym ychylv 'f yrgzv thmvt
verses.translation: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

verses.original: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף חֲ֝צָצֶ֗י/ךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ
verses.translit: zrmv mym 'bvt qvl ntnv shchqym 'f chtstsykh ythlkhv
verses.translation: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל רַעַמְ/ךָ֨ בַּ/גַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַ/תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: qvl r'mkh bglgl h'yrv brqym tbl rgzh vtr'sh h'rts
verses.translation: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗/ךָ ו/שבילי/ך וּֽ֭/שְׁבִֽילְ/ךָ בְּ/מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝/עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: bym drkhkh vshbylykh vshbylkh bmym rbym v'qbvtykh l' nd'v
verses.translation: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָ/ה עַ֭מִּ/י תּוֹרָתִ֑/י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְ/כֶ֗ם לְ/אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: mshkhyl l'sf h'zynh 'my tvrty htv 'znkhm l'mry py
verses.translation: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.original: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְ/מָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑/י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: 'ptchh bmshl py 'by'h chydvt mny qdm
verses.translation: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַ/נֵּדָעֵ֑/ם וַ֝/אֲבוֹתֵ֗י/נוּ סִפְּרוּ לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'shr shm'nv vnd'm v'bvtynv sprv lnv
verses.translation: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.original: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד מִ/בְּנֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/ד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶ/עֱזוּז֥/וֹ וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: l' nkhchd mbnyhm ldvr 'chrvn msprym thlvt yhvh v'zvzv vnpl'vtyv 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD , and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת בְּֽ/יַעֲקֹ֗ב וְ/תוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּ/יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵ֑י/נוּ לְ֝/הוֹדִיעָ֗/ם לִ/בְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqm 'dvt by'qb vtvrh shm byshr'l 'shr tsvh 't 'bvtynv lhvdy'm lbnyhm
verses.translation: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽ/יסַפְּר֥וּ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v dvr 'chrvn bnym yvldv yqmv vysprv lbnyhm
verses.translation: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

verses.original: וְ/יָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽ/אלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥/ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵ֑ל וּ/מִצְוֺתָ֥י/ו יִנְצֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyshymv b'lhym khslm vl' yshkhchv m'lly 'l vmtsvtyv yntsrv
verses.translation: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ כַּ/אֲבוֹתָ֗/ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּ/מֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹא נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת אֵ֣ל רוּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' yhyv kh'bvtm dvr svrr vmrh dvr l' hkhyn lbv vl' n'mnh 't 'l rvchv
verses.translation: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּ/י֣וֹם קְרָֽב
verses.translit: bny 'prym nvshqy rvmy qsht hpkhv byvm qrb
verses.translation: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.original: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝/בְ/תוֹרָת֗/וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָ/לֶֽכֶת
verses.translit: l' shmrv bryt 'lhym vbtvrtv m'nv llkht
verses.translation: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑י/ו וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshkhchv 'lylvtyv vnpl'vtyv 'shr hr'm
verses.translation: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָ/ם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן
verses.translit: ngd 'bvtm 'shh pl' b'rts mtsrym shdh ts'n
verses.translation: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.original: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַ/יַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑/ם וַֽ/יַּצֶּב מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ נֵֽד
verses.translit: bq' ym vy'byrm vytsb mym khmv nd
verses.translation: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנְחֵ֣/ם בֶּ/עָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְ/כָל הַ֝/לַּ֗יְלָה בְּ/א֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vynchm b'nn yvmm vkhl hlylh b'vr 'sh
verses.translation: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.original: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝/יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּ/תְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: ybq' tsrym bmdbr vyshq khthmvt rbh
verses.translation: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִ/סָּ֑לַע וַ/יּ֖וֹרֶד כַּ/נְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyvts' nvzlym msl' vyvrd khnhrvt mym
verses.translation: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַ/חֲטֹא ל֑/וֹ לַֽ/מְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּ/צִּיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyvsypv 'vd lcht' lv lmrvt 'lyvn btsyh
verses.translation: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַסּוּ אֵ֥ל בִּ/לְבָבָ֑/ם לִֽ/שְׁאָל אֹ֥כֶל לְ/נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vynsv 'l blbbm lsh'l 'khl lnpshm
verses.translation: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽ/אלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲ/י֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַ/עֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vydbrv b'lhym 'mrv hyvkhl 'l l'rkh shlchn bmdbr
verses.translation: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה צ֨וּר וַ/יָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּ/נְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲ/גַם לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְ/עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hn hkhh tsvr vyzvbv mym vnchlym yshtpv hgm lchm yvkhl tt 'm ykhyn sh'r l'mv
verses.translation: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֤ן שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽ/יִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭/אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/גַם אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn shm' yhvh vyt'br v'sh nshqh by'qb vgm 'f 'lh byshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD heard this , and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/לֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽ/ישׁוּעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy l' h'mynv b'lhym vl' btchv byshv'tv
verses.translation: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִ/מָּ֑עַל וְ/דַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח
verses.translit: vytsv shchqym mm'l vdlty shmym ptch
verses.translation: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶ/אֱכֹ֑ל וּ/דְגַן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vymtr 'lyhm mn l'khl vdgn shmym ntn lmv
verses.translation: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָ/הֶ֣ם לָ/שֹֽׂבַע
verses.translit: lchm 'byrym 'khl 'ysh tsydh shlch lhm lshb'
verses.translation: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

verses.original: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יְנַהֵ֖ג בְּ/עֻזּ֣/וֹ תֵימָֽן
verses.translit: ys' qdym bshmym vynhg b'zv tymn
verses.translation: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם כֶּ/עָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽ/כְ/ח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף
verses.translit: vymtr 'lyhm kh'pr sh'r vkhchvl ymym 'vf khnf
verses.translation: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּפֵּל בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑/הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְ/מִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vypl bqrb mchnhv sbyb lmshkhntyv
verses.translation: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאכְל֣וּ וַ/יִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝/תַֽאֲוָתָ֗/ם יָבִ֥א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshb'v m'd vt'vtm yb' lhm
verses.translation: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.original: לֹא זָר֥וּ מִ/תַּאֲוָתָ֑/ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥/ם בְּ/פִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l' zrv mt'vtm 'vd 'khlm bpyhm
verses.translation: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

verses.original: וְ/אַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים עָ֘לָ֤ה בָ/הֶ֗ם וַֽ֭/יַּהֲרֹג בְּ/מִשְׁמַנֵּי/הֶ֑ם וּ/בַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ
verses.translit: v'f 'lhym 'lh bhm vyhrg bmshmnyhm vbchvry yshr'l hkhry'
verses.translation: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ ע֑וֹד וְ/לֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּ/נִפְלְאוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bkhl z't cht'v 'vd vl' h'mynv bnpl'vtyv
verses.translation: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַל בַּ/הֶ֥בֶל יְמֵי/הֶ֑ם וּ֝/שְׁנוֹתָ֗/ם בַּ/בֶּהָלָֽה
verses.translit: vykhl bhbl ymyhm vshnvtm bbhlh
verses.translation: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.original: אִם הֲרָגָ֥/ם וּ/דְרָשׁ֑וּ/הוּ וְ֝/שָׁ֗בוּ וְ/שִֽׁחֲרוּ אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'm hrgm vdrshvhv vshbv vshchrv 'l
verses.translation: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑/ם וְ/אֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyzkhrv khy 'lhym tsvrm v'l 'lyvn g'lm
verses.translation: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.original: וַ/יְפַתּ֥וּ/הוּ בְּ/פִי/הֶ֑ם וּ֝/בִ/לְשׁוֹנָ֗/ם יְכַזְּבוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyptvhv bpyhm vblshvnm ykhzbv lv
verses.translation: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.original: וְ֭/לִבָּ/ם לֹא נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּ/בְרִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlbm l' nkhvn 'mv vl' n'mnv bbrytv
verses.translation: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא רַח֨וּם יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽ/לֹא יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭/הִרְבָּה לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא יָ֝עִיר כָּל חֲמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhv' rchvm ykhpr 'vn vl' yshchyt vhrbh lhshyb 'pv vl' y'yr khl chmtv
verses.translation: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּזְכֹּר כִּי בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְ/לֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: vyzkhr khy bshr hmh rvch hvlkh vl' yshvb
verses.translation: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.original: כַּ֭/מָּה יַמְר֣וּ/הוּ בַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּ/הוּ בִּֽ/ישִׁימֽוֹן
verses.translit: khmh ymrvhv bmdbr y'tsybvhv byshymvn
verses.translation: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.original: וַ/יָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַ/יְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּ/קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ
verses.translit: vyshvbv vynsv 'l vqdvsh yshr'l htvv
verses.translation: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: לֹא זָכְר֥וּ אֶת יָד֑/וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר פָּדָ֥/ם מִנִּי צָֽר
verses.translit: l' zkhrv 't ydv yvm 'shr pdm mny tsr
verses.translation: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭/מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑י/ו וּ֝/מוֹפְתָ֗י/ו בִּ/שְׂדֵה צֹֽעַן
verses.translit: 'shr shm bmtsrym 'tvtyv vmvptyv bshdh ts'n
verses.translation: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

verses.original: וַ/יַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭/דָם יְאֹרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/נֹזְלֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּל יִשְׁתָּיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vyhpkh ldm y'ryhm vnzlyhm bl yshtyvn
verses.translation: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּ/הֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַ/יֹּאכְלֵ֑/ם וּ֝/צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַ/תַּשְׁחִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshlch bhm 'rb vy'khlm vtsprd' vtshchytm
verses.translation: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לֶ/חָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑/ם וִֽ֝/יגִיעָ֗/ם לָ/אַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytn lchsyl ybvlm vygy'm l'rbh
verses.translation: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.original: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּ/בָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑/ם וְ֝/שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗/ם בַּֽ/חֲנָמַֽל
verses.translit: yhrg bbrd gpnm vshqmvtm bchnml
verses.translation: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַ/בָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑/ם וּ֝/מִקְנֵי/הֶ֗ם לָ/רְשָׁפִֽים
verses.translit: vysgr lbrd b'yrm vmqnyhm lrshpym
verses.translation: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּח בָּ֨/ם חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗/וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָ/זַ֣עַם וְ/צָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים
verses.translit: yshlch bm chrvn 'pv 'brh vz'm vtsrh mshlcht ml'khy r'ym
verses.translation: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them .

verses.original: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְ/אַ֫פּ֥/וֹ לֹא חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִ/מָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ֝/חַיָּתָ֗/ם לַ/דֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר
verses.translit: ypls ntyb l'pv l' chshkh mmvt npshm vchytm ldbr hsgyr
verses.translation: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּ/אָהֳלֵי חָֽם
verses.translit: vykh khl bkhvr bmtsrym r'shyt 'vnym b'hly chm
verses.translation: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.translit: vys' khts'n 'mv vynhgm kh'dr bmdbr
verses.translation: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנְחֵ֣/ם לָ֭/בֶטַח וְ/לֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְ/אֶת א֝וֹיְבֵי/הֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vynchm lbtch vl' pchdv v't 'vybyhm khsh hym
verses.translation: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.original: וַ֭/יְבִיאֵ/ם אֶל גְּב֣וּל קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ הַר זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyby'm 'l gbvl qdshv hr zh qnth ymynv
verses.translation: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

verses.original: וַ/יְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֨ם גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭/יַּפִּילֵ/ם בְּ/חֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vygrsh mpnyhm gvym vypylm bchbl nchlh vyshkhn b'hlyhm shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭/יַּמְרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝/עֵדוֹתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vynsv vymrv 't 'lhym 'lyvn v'dvtyv l' shmrv
verses.translation: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.original: וַ/יִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭/יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּ/אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּ/קֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vysgv vybgdv kh'bvtm nhpkhv khqsht rmyh
verses.translation: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְעִיס֥וּ/הוּ בְּ/בָמוֹתָ֑/ם וּ֝/בִ/פְסִילֵי/הֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vykh'ysvhv bbmvtm vbpsylyhm yqny'vhv
verses.translation: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽ/יִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַ/יִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shm' 'lhym vyt'br vym's m'd byshr'l
verses.translation: When God heard this , he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

verses.translit: vytsh mshkhn shlv 'hl shkhn b'dm
verses.translation: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

verses.translit: vytn lshby 'zv vtp'rtv byd tsr
verses.translation: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַ/חֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְ/נַחֲלָת֗/וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר
verses.translit: vysgr lchrb 'mv vbnchltv ht'br
verses.translation: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.original: בַּחוּרָ֥י/ו אָֽכְלָה אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝/בְתוּלֹתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: bchvryv 'khlh 'sh vbtvltyv l' hvllv
verses.translation: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.original: כֹּ֭הֲנָי/ו בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝/אַלְמְנֹתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: khhnyv bchrb nplv v'lmntyv l' tbkhynh
verses.translation: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַ֖ץ כְּ/יָשֵׁ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֑/י כְּ֝/גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִ/יָּֽיִן
verses.translit: vyqts khyshn 'dny khgbvr mtrvnn myyn
verses.translation: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.original: וַ/יַּךְ צָרָ֥י/ו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vykh tsryv 'chvr chrpt 'vlm ntn lmv
verses.translation: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּמְאַס בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽ/בְ/שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר
verses.translit: vym's b'hl yvsf vbshbt 'prym l' bchr
verses.translation: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּבְחַר אֶת שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב
verses.translit: vybchr 't shbt yhvdh 't hr tsyvn 'shr 'hb
verses.translation: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑/וֹ כְּ֝/אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥/הּ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vybn khmv rmym mqdshv kh'rts ysdh l'vlm
verses.translation: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces , like the earth which he hath established for ever.

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּבְחַר בְּ/דָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑/וֹ וַ֝/יִּקָּחֵ֗/הוּ מִֽ/מִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן
verses.translit: vybchr bdvd 'bdv vyqchhv mmkhl't ts'n
verses.translation: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.original: מֵ/אַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥/וֹ לִ֭/רְעוֹת בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: m'chr 'lvt hby'v lr'vt by'qb 'mv vbyshr'l nchltv
verses.translation: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּרְעֵ/ם כְּ/תֹ֣ם לְבָב֑/וֹ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣י/ו יַנְחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyr'm khtm lbbv vbtbvnvt khpyv ynchm
verses.translation: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם בְּֽ/נַחֲלָתֶ֗/ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑/ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְ/עִיִּֽים
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'lhym b'v gvym bnchltkh tm'v 't hykhl qdshkh shmv 't yrvshlm l'yym
verses.translation: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

verses.original: נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗י/ךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְ/ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗י/ךָ לְ/חַיְת/וֹ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ntnv 't nblt 'bdykh m'khl l'vf hshmym bshr chsydykh lchytv 'rts
verses.translation: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨/ם כַּ/מַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְ/אֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: shpkhv dmm khmym sbybvt yrvshlm v'yn qvbr
verses.translation: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them .

verses.original: הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִ/שְׁכֵנֵ֑י/נוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝/קֶ֗לֶס לִ/סְבִיבוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hyynv chrph lshkhnynv l'g vqls lsbybvtynv
verses.translation: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.original: עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֶּאֱנַ֣ף לָ/נֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֥ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֝֗שׁ קִנְאָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'd mh yhvh t'nf lntsch tb'r khmv 'sh qn'tkh
verses.translation: How long, LORD ? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.original: שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְ/ךָ֨ אֶֽל הַ/גּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא יְדָ֫ע֥וּ/ךָ וְ/עַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝/שִׁמְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: shpkh chmtkh 'l hgvym 'shr l' yd'vkh v'l mmlkhvt 'shr bshmkh l' qr'v
verses.translation: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.original: כִּ֭י אָכַ֣ל אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְֽ/אֶת נָוֵ֥/הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ
verses.translit: khy 'khl 't y'qb v't nvhv hshmv
verses.translation: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּזְכָּר לָ/נוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּ/נוּ רַחֲמֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'l tzkhr lnv 'vnt r'shnym mhr yqdmvnv rchmykh khy dlvnv m'd
verses.translation: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

verses.original: עָזְרֵ֤/נוּ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗/נוּ עַל דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הַצִּילֵ֥/נוּ וְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עַל חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗י/נוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'zrnv 'lhy ysh'nv 'l dbr khbvd shmkh vhtsylnv vkhpr 'l cht'tynv lm'n shmkh
verses.translation: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name’s sake.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱֽלֹהֵ֫י/הֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע ב/גיים בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם לְ/עֵינֵ֑י/נוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם עֲבָדֶ֥י/ךָ הַ/שָּׁפֽוּךְ
verses.translit: lmh y'mrv hgvym 'yh 'lhyhm yvd' bgyym bgvym l'ynynv nqmt dm 'bdykh hshpvkh
verses.translation: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

verses.original: תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְ/פָנֶי/ךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּ/גֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲ/ךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה
verses.translit: tbv' lpnykh 'nqt 'syr khgdl zrv'kh hvtr bny tmvth
verses.translation: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

verses.original: וְ/הָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִ/שְׁכֵנֵ֣י/נוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל חֵיקָ֑/ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤/ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּ/ךָ אֲדֹנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vhshb lshkhnynv shb'tym 'l chyqm chrptm 'shr chrpvkh 'dny
verses.translation: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּ/ךָ֨ וְ/צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶ/ךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּ/ךָ֗ לְ/ע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ/דֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'nchnv 'mkh vts'n mr'ytkh nvdh lkh l'vlm ldr vdr nspr thltkh
verses.translation: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְ/אָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l shshnym 'dvt l'sf mzmvr
verses.translation: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.original: רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל הַאֲזִ֗ינָ/ה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּ/צֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַ/כְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָ/ה
verses.translit: r'h yshr'l h'zynh nhg khts'n yvsf yshb hkhrvbym hvpy'h
verses.translation: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּ/בִנְיָ֘מִ֤ן וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה עוֹרְרָ֥/ה אֶת גְּבֽוּרָתֶ֑/ךָ וּ/לְכָ֖/ה לִ/ישֻׁעָ֣תָ/ה לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: lpny 'prym vbnymn vmnshh 'vrrh 't gbvrtkh vlkhh lysh'th lnv
verses.translation: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲשִׁיבֵ֑/נוּ וְ/הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/נִוָּשֵֽׁעָה
verses.translit: 'lhym hshybnv vh'r pnykh vnvsh'h
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֑וֹת עַד מָתַ֥י עָ֝שַׁ֗נְתָּ בִּ/תְפִלַּ֥ת עַמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhym tsb'vt 'd mty 'shnt btplt 'mkh
verses.translation: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱכַלְתָּ/ם לֶ֣חֶם דִּמְעָ֑ה וַ֝/תַּשְׁקֵ֗/מוֹ בִּ/דְמָע֥וֹת שָׁלִֽישׁ
verses.translit: h'khltm lchm dm'h vtshqmv bdm'vt shlysh
verses.translation: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.original: תְּשִׂימֵ֣/נוּ מָ֭דוֹן לִ/שְׁכֵנֵ֑י/נוּ וְ֝/אֹיְבֵ֗י/נוּ יִלְעֲגוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: tshymnv mdvn lshkhnynv v'ybynv yl'gv lmv
verses.translation: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָא֣וֹת הֲשִׁיבֵ֑/נוּ וְ/הָאֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/נִוָּשֵֽׁעָה
verses.translit: 'lhym tsb'vt hshybnv vh'r pnykh vnvsh'h
verses.translation: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.original: גֶּ֭פֶן מִ/מִּצְרַ֣יִם תַּסִּ֑יעַ תְּגָרֵ֥שׁ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם וַ/תִּטָּעֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: gpn mmtsrym tsy' tgrsh gvym vtt'h
verses.translation: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.translit: pnyt lpnyh vtshrsh shrshyh vtml' 'rts
verses.translation: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

verses.original: כָּסּ֣וּ הָרִ֣ים צִלָּ֑/הּ וַ֝/עֲנָפֶ֗י/הָ אַֽרְזֵי אֵֽל
verses.translit: khsv hrym tslh v'npyh 'rzy 'l
verses.translation: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח קְצִירֶ֣/הָ עַד יָ֑ם וְ/אֶל נָ֝הָ֗ר יֽוֹנְקוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: tshlch qtsyrh 'd ym v'l nhr yvnqvtyh
verses.translation: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.original: לָ֭/מָּה פָּרַ֣צְתָּ גְדֵרֶ֑י/הָ וְ֝/אָר֗וּ/הָ כָּל עֹ֥בְרֵי דָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: lmh prtst gdryh v'rvh khl 'bry drkh
verses.translation: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.original: יְכַרְסְמֶ֣/נָּֽה חֲזִ֣יר מִ/יָּ֑עַר וְ/זִ֖יז שָׂדַ֣י יִרְעֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: ykhrsmnh chzyr my'r vzyz shdy yr'nh
verses.translation: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְבָאוֹת֮ שֽׁ֫וּב נָ֥א הַבֵּ֣ט מִ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וּ/רְאֵ֑ה וּ֝/פְקֹ֗ד גֶּ֣פֶן זֹֽאת
verses.translit: 'lhym tsb'vt shvb n' hbt mshmym vr'h vpqd gpn z't
verses.translation: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.original: וְ֭/כַנָּה אֲשֶׁר נָטְעָ֣ה יְמִינֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עַל בֵּ֝֗ן אִמַּ֥צְתָּה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhnh 'shr nt'h ymynkh v'l bn 'mtsth lkh
verses.translation: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.original: שְׂרֻפָ֣ה בָ/אֵ֣שׁ כְּסוּחָ֑ה מִ/גַּעֲרַ֖ת פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: shrph b'sh khsvchh mg'rt pnykh y'bdv
verses.translation: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.original: תְּֽהִי יָ֭דְ/ךָ עַל אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינֶ֑/ךָ עַל בֶּן אָ֝דָ֗ם אִמַּ֥צְתָּ לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: thy ydkh 'l 'ysh ymynkh 'l bn 'dm 'mtst lkh
verses.translation: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא נָס֥וֹג מִמֶּ֑/ךָּ תְּ֝חַיֵּ֗/נוּ וּ/בְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ נִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: vl' nsvg mmkh tchynv vbshmkh nqr'
verses.translation: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל הַ/גִּתִּ֬ית לְ/אָסָֽף
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l hgtyt l'sf
verses.translation: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

verses.original: הַ֭רְנִינוּ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים עוּזֵּ֑/נוּ הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לֵ/אלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: hrnynv l'lhym 'vznv hry'v l'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.original: שְֽׂאוּ זִ֭מְרָה וּ/תְנוּ תֹ֑ף כִּנּ֖וֹר נָעִ֣ים עִם נָֽבֶל
verses.translit: sh'v zmrh vtnv tf khnvr n'ym 'm nbl
verses.translation: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.original: תִּקְע֣וּ בַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֝/כֵּ֗סֶה לְ/י֣וֹם חַגֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: tq'v bchdsh shvpr bkhsh lyvm chgnv
verses.translation: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חֹ֣ק לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֝שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵ/אלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: khy chq lyshr'l hv' mshpt l'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

verses.original: עֵ֤דוּת בִּֽ/יה֘וֹסֵ֤ף שָׂמ֗/וֹ בְּ֭/צֵאת/וֹ עַל אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם שְׂפַ֖ת לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: 'dvt byhvsf shmv bts'tv 'l 'rts mtsrym shpt l' yd'ty 'shm'
verses.translation: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

verses.original: הֲסִיר֣וֹתִי מִ/סֵּ֣בֶל שִׁכְמ֑/וֹ כַּ֝פָּ֗י/ו מִ/דּ֥וּד תַּעֲבֹֽרְנָה
verses.translit: hsyrvty msbl shkhmv khpyv mdvd t'brnh
verses.translation: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

verses.original: בַּ/צָּרָ֥ה קָרָ֗אתָ וָ/אֲחַ֫לְּצֶ֥/ךָּ אֶ֭עֶנְ/ךָ בְּ/סֵ֣תֶר רַ֑עַם אֶבְחָֽנְ/ךָ֨ עַל מֵ֖י מְרִיבָ֣ה סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: btsrh qr't v'chltskh ''nkh bstr r'm 'bchnkh 'l my mrybh slh
verses.translation: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עַ֭מִּ/י וְ/אָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֑/ךְ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם תִּֽשְׁמַֽע לִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm' 'my v''ydh bkh yshr'l 'm tshm' ly
verses.translation: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ֭/ךָ אֵ֣ל זָ֑ר וְ/לֹ֥א תִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לְ/אֵ֣ל נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: l' yhyh bkh 'l zr vl' tshtchvh l'l nkhr
verses.translation: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ הַֽ֭/מַּעַלְ/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַרְחֶב פִּ֝֗י/ךָ וַ/אֲמַלְאֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh hm'lkh m'rts mtsrym hrchb pykh v'ml'hv
verses.translation: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע עַמִּ֣/י לְ/קוֹלִ֑/י וְ֝/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹא אָ֥בָה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vl' shm' 'my lqvly vyshr'l l' 'bh ly
verses.translation: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

verses.original: וָֽ֭/אֲשַׁלְּחֵ/הוּ בִּ/שְׁרִיר֣וּת לִבָּ֑/ם יֵ֝לְכ֗וּ בְּֽ/מוֹעֲצוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'shlchhv bshryrvt lbm ylkhv bmv'tsvtyhm
verses.translation: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

verses.original: ל֗וּ עַ֭מִּ/י שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֑/י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל בִּ/דְרָכַ֥/י יְהַלֵּֽכוּ
verses.translit: lv 'my shm' ly yshr'l bdrkhy yhlkhv
verses.translation: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

verses.original: כִּ֭/מְעַט אוֹיְבֵי/הֶ֣ם אַכְנִ֑יעַ וְ/עַ֥ל צָ֝רֵי/הֶ֗ם אָשִׁ֥יב יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: khm't 'vybyhm 'khny' v'l tsryhm 'shyb ydy
verses.translation: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

verses.original: מְשַׂנְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה יְכַֽחֲשׁוּ ל֑/וֹ וִ/יהִ֖י עִתָּ֣/ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: mshn'y yhvh ykhchshv lv vyhy 'tm l'vlm
verses.translation: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּ/עֲדַת אֵ֑ל בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט
verses.translit: mzmvr l'sf 'lhym ntsb b'dt 'l bqrb 'lhym yshpt
verses.translation: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ עָ֑וֶל וּ/פְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'd mty tshptv 'vl vpny rsh'ym tsh'v slh
verses.translation: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

verses.original: שִׁפְטוּ דַ֥ל וְ/יָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָ/רָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ
verses.translit: shptv dl vytvm 'ny vrsh htsdyqv
verses.translation: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

verses.original: פַּלְּטוּ דַ֥ל וְ/אֶבְי֑וֹן מִ/יַּ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים הַצִּֽילוּ
verses.translit: pltv dl v'byvn myd rsh'ym htsylv
verses.translation: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָֽדְע֨וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּ/חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כָּל מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: l' yd'v vl' ybynv bchshkhh ythlkhv ymvtv khl mvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

verses.original: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּ/בְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ny 'mrty 'lhym 'tm vbny 'lyvn khlkhm
verses.translation: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן כְּ/אָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּ/ן וּ/כְ/אַחַ֖ד הַ/שָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'khn kh'dm tmvtvn vkh'chd hshrym tplv
verses.translation: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣/ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁפְטָ֣/ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: qvmh 'lhym shpth h'rts khy 'th tnchl bkhl hgvym
verses.translation: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְ/אָסָֽף
verses.translit: shyr mzmvr l'sf
verses.translation: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל דֳּמִי לָ֑/ךְ אַל תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְ/אַל תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'lhym 'l dmy lkh 'l tchrsh v'l tshqt 'l
verses.translation: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶי/ךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּ/ן וּ֝/מְשַׂנְאֶ֗י/ךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: khy hnh 'vybykh yhmyvn vmshn'ykh nsh'v r'sh
verses.translation: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

verses.original: עַֽל עַ֭מְּ/ךָ יַעֲרִ֣ימוּ ס֑וֹד וְ֝/יִתְיָעֲצ֗וּ עַל צְפוּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l 'mkh y'rymv svd vyty'tsv 'l tspvnykh
verses.translation: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.original: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְ/נַכְחִידֵ֣/ם מִ/גּ֑וֹי וְ/לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'mrv lkhv vnkhchydm mgvy vl' yzkhr shm yshr'l 'vd
verses.translation: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

verses.original: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗י/ךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ
verses.translit: khy nv'tsv lb ychdv 'lykh bryt ykhrtv
verses.translation: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.original: אָהֳלֵ֣י אֱ֭דוֹם וְ/יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֗ים מוֹאָ֥ב וְ/הַגְרִֽים
verses.translit: 'hly 'dvm vyshm''lym mv'b vhgrym
verses.translation: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.original: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭/עַמּוֹן וַ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר
verses.translit: gbl v'mvn v'mlq plsht 'm yshby tsvr
verses.translation: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

verses.original: גַּם אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑/ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִ/בְנֵי ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: gm 'shvr nlvh 'mm hyv zrv' lbny lvt slh
verses.translation: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה לָ/הֶ֥ם כְּ/מִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽ/סִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝/יָבִ֗ין בְּ/נַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: 'shh lhm khmdyn khsysr' khybyn bnchl qyshvn
verses.translation: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

verses.original: נִשְׁמְד֥וּ בְֽ/עֵין דֹּ֑אר הָ֥יוּ דֹּ֝֗מֶן לָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: nshmdv b'yn d'r hyv dmn l'dmh
verses.translation: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.original: שִׁיתֵ֣/מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵ/מוֹ כְּ/עֹרֵ֣ב וְ/כִ/זְאֵ֑ב וּֽ/כְ/זֶ֥בַח וּ֝/כְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל נְסִיכֵֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: shytmv ndybmv kh'rb vkhz'b vkhzbch vkhtslmn' khl nsykhmv
verses.translation: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑/נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'shr 'mrv nyrshh lnv 't n'vt 'lhym
verses.translation: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗/י שִׁיתֵ֥/מוֹ כַ/גַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝/קַ֗שׁ לִ/פְנֵי רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: 'lhy shytmv khglgl khqsh lpny rvch
verses.translation: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

verses.original: כְּ/אֵ֥שׁ תִּבְעַר יָ֑עַר וּ֝/כְ/לֶהָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט הָרִֽים
verses.translit: kh'sh tb'r y'r vkhlhbh tlht hrym
verses.translation: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן תִּרְדְּפֵ֣/ם בְּ/סַעֲרֶ֑/ךָ וּ/בְ/סוּפָתְ/ךָ֥ תְבַהֲלֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: khn trdpm bs'rkh vbsvptkh tbhlm
verses.translation: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD .

verses.original: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵי/הֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽ/יבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ml' pnyhm qlvn vybqshv shmkh yhvh
verses.translation: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.original: יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ וְ/יִבָּהֲל֥וּ עֲדֵי עַ֗ד וְֽ/יַחְפְּר֥וּ וְ/יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: ybshv vybhlv 'dy 'd vychprv vy'bdv
verses.translation: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH , art the most high over all the earth.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל הַ/גִּתִּ֑ית לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l hgtyt lbny qrch mzmvr
verses.translation: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

verses.original: מַה יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: mh ydydvt mshkhnvtykh yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD : my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

verses.original: נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְ/גַם כָּלְתָ֨ה נַפְשִׁ/י֮ לְ/חַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥/י וּ/בְשָׂרִ֑/י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל חָֽי
verses.translit: nkhsph vgm khlth npshy lchtsrvt yhvh lby vbshry yrnnv 'l 'l chy
verses.translation: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

verses.original: גַּם צִפּ֨וֹר מָ֪צְאָה בַ֡יִת וּ/דְר֤וֹר קֵ֥ן לָ/הּ֮ אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֪תָה אֶפְרֹ֫חֶ֥י/הָ אֶֽת מִ֭זְבְּחוֹתֶי/ךָ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מַ֝לְכִּ֗/י וֵ/אלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: gm tspvr mts'h byt vdrvr qn lh 'shr shth 'prchyh 't mzbchvtykh yhvh tsb'vt mlkhy v'lhy
verses.translation: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֑/ךָ ע֝֗וֹד יְֽהַלְל֥וּ/ךָ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: 'shry yvshby bytkh 'vd yhllvkh slh
verses.translation: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them .

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם עֽוֹז ל֥/וֹ בָ֑/ךְ מְ֝סִלּ֗וֹת בִּ/לְבָבָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm 'vz lv bkh mslvt blbbm
verses.translation: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

verses.original: עֹבְרֵ֤י בְּ/עֵ֣מֶק הַ֭/בָּכָא מַעְיָ֣ן יְשִׁית֑וּ/הוּ גַּם בְּ֝רָכ֗וֹת יַעְטֶ֥ה מוֹרֶֽה
verses.translit: 'bry b'mq hbkh' m'yn yshytvhv gm brkhvt y'th mvrh
verses.translation: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

verses.original: יֵ֭לְכוּ מֵ/חַ֣יִל אֶל חָ֑יִל יֵרָאֶ֖ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ/צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: ylkhv mchyl 'l chyl yr'h 'l 'lhym btsyvn
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.original: יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים צְ֭בָאוֹת שִׁמְעָ֣/ה תְפִלָּתִ֑/י הַאֲזִ֨ינָ/ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhym tsb'vt shm'h tplty h'zynh 'lhy y'qb slh
verses.translation: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

verses.original: מָ֭גִנֵּ/נוּ רְאֵ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ֝/הַבֵּ֗ט פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mgnnv r'h 'lhym vhbt pny mshychkh
verses.translation: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.original: כִּ֤י טֽוֹב י֥וֹם בַּ/חֲצֵרֶ֗י/ךָ מֵ֫/אָ֥לֶף בָּחַ֗רְתִּי הִ֭סְתּוֹפֵף בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֑/י מִ֝/דּ֗וּר בְּ/אָהֳלֵי רֶֽשַׁע
verses.translit: khy tvb yvm bchtsrykh m'lf bchrty hstvpf bbyt 'lhy mdvr b'hly rsh'
verses.translation: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וּ/מָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭/כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע ט֝֗וֹב לַֽ/הֹלְכִ֥ים בְּ/תָמִֽים
verses.translit: khy shmsh vmgn yhvh 'lhym chn vkhbvd ytn yhvh l' ymn' tvb lhlkhym btmym
verses.translation: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmntsch lbny qrch mzmvr
verses.translation: LORD , thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.original: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שבות שְׁבִ֣ית יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: rtsyt yhvh 'rtskh shbt shbvt shbyt y'qb
verses.translation: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.original: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑/ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל חַטָּאתָ֣/ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: nsh't 'vn 'mkh khsyt khl cht'tm slh
verses.translation: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

verses.original: אָסַ֥פְתָּ כָל עֶבְרָתֶ֑/ךָ הֱ֝שִׁיב֗וֹתָ מֵ/חֲר֥וֹן אַפֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'spt khl 'brtkh hshybvt mchrvn 'pkh
verses.translation: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

verses.original: שׁ֭וּבֵ/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑/נוּ וְ/הָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְ/ךָ֣ עִמָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: shvbnv 'lhy ysh'nv vhpr kh'skh 'mnv
verses.translation: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.original: הַ/לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף בָּ֑/נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּ/ךָ֗ לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: hl'vlm t'nf bnv tmshkh 'pkh ldr vdr
verses.translation: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.original: הֲֽ/לֹא אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑/נוּ וְ֝/עַמְּ/ךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hl' 'th tshvb tchynv v'mkh yshmchv bkh
verses.translation: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD , and grant us thy salvation.

verses.original: הַרְאֵ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/יֶשְׁעֲ/ךָ֗ תִּתֶּן לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hr'nv yhvh chsdkh vysh'kh ttn lnv
verses.translation: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.original: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה יְדַבֵּר֮ הָ/אֵ֪ל יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל עַמּ֥/וֹ וְ/אֶל חֲסִידָ֑י/ו וְֽ/אַל יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְ/כִסְלָֽה
verses.translit: 'shm'h mh ydbr h'l yhvh khy ydbr shlvm 'l 'mv v'l chsydyv v'l yshvbv lkhslh
verses.translation: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִ/ירֵאָ֣י/ו יִשְׁע֑/וֹ לִ/שְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּ/אַרְצֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'kh qrvb lyr'yv ysh'v lshkhn khbvd b'rtsnv
verses.translation: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other .

verses.original: חֶֽסֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְ/שָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ
verses.translit: chsd v'mt npgshv tsdq vshlvm nshqv
verses.translation: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.original: אֱ֭מֶת מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝/צֶ֗דֶק מִ/שָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף
verses.translit: 'mt m'rts ttsmch vtsdq mshmym nshqf
verses.translation: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.original: גַּם יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַ/טּ֑וֹב וְ֝/אַרְצֵ֗/נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: gm yhvh ytn htvb v'rtsnv ttn ybvlh
verses.translation: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְ/ךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑/נִי כִּֽי עָנִ֖י וְ/אֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי
verses.translit: tplh ldvd hth yhvh 'znkh 'nny khy 'ny v'byvn 'ny
verses.translation: Bow down thine ear, O LORD , hear me: for I am poor and needy.

verses.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣/ה נַפְשִׁ/י֮ כִּֽי חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּ/ךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑/י הַ/בּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shmrh npshy khy chsyd 'ny hvsh' 'bdkh 'th 'lhy hbvtch 'lykh
verses.translation: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥/נִי אֲדֹנָ֑/י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: chnny 'dny khy 'lykh 'qr' khl hyvm
verses.translation: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

verses.translit: shmch npsh 'bdkh khy 'lykh 'dny npshy 'sh'
verses.translation: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָ/י ט֣וֹב וְ/סַלָּ֑ח וְ/רַב חֶ֝֗סֶד לְ/כָל קֹרְאֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'dny tvb vslch vrb chsd lkhl qr'ykh
verses.translation: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָ/ה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑/י וְ֝/הַקְשִׁ֗יבָ/ה בְּ/ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: h'zynh yhvh tplty vhqshybh bqvl tchnvnvty
verses.translation: Give ear, O LORD , unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.original: בְּ/י֣וֹם צָ֭רָתִ֥/י אֶקְרָאֶ֗/ךָּ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: byvm tsrty 'qr'kh khy t'nny
verses.translation: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

verses.original: אֵין כָּמ֖וֹ/ךָ בָ/אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֗/י וְ/אֵ֣ין כְּֽ/מַעֲשֶֽׂי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'yn khmvkh b'lhym 'dny v'yn khm'shykh
verses.translation: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

verses.original: כָּל גּוֹיִ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ וְ/יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ אֲדֹנָ֑/י וִֽ/יכַבְּד֣וּ לִ/שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khl gvym 'shr 'shyt ybv'v vyshtchvv lpnykh 'dny vykhbdv lshmkh
verses.translation: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

verses.original: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל אַ֭תָּה וְ/עֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy gdvl 'th v'shh npl'vt 'th 'lhym lbdkh
verses.translation: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

verses.original: ה֘וֹרֵ֤/נִי יְהוָ֨ה דַּרְכֶּ֗/ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּ/אֲמִתֶּ֑/ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗/י לְ/יִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hvrny yhvh drkhkh 'hlkh b'mtkh ychd lbby lyr'h shmkh
verses.translation: Teach me thy way, O LORD ; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

verses.original: אוֹדְ/ךָ֤ אֲדֹנָ֣/י אֱ֭לֹהַ/י בְּ/כָל לְבָבִ֑/י וַ/אֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'vdkh 'dny 'lhy bkhl lbby v'khbdh shmkh l'vlm
verses.translation: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

verses.translit: khy chsdkh gdvl 'ly vhtslt npshy msh'vl tchtyh
verses.translation: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ עָלַ֗/י וַ/עֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/לֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּ/ךָ לְ/נֶגְדָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lhym zdym qmv 'ly v'dt 'rytsym bqshv npshy vl' shmvkh lngdm
verses.translation: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָ/י אֵל רַח֣וּם וְ/חַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְ/רַב חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: v'th 'dny 'l rchvm vchnvn 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd v'mt
verses.translation: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.translit: pnh 'ly vchnny tnh 'zkh l'bdkh vhvshy'h lbn 'mtkh
verses.translation: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה עִמִּ֥/י א֗וֹת לְ/ט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְ/יִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣/י וְ/יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥/נִי וְ/נִחַמְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'shh 'my 'vt ltvbh vyr'v shn'y vybshv khy 'th yhvh 'zrtny vnchmtny
verses.translation: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it , and be ashamed: because thou, LORD , hast holpen me, and comforted me.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵי קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗/וֹ בְּ/הַרְרֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: lbny qrch mzmvr shyr ysvdtv bhrry qdsh
verses.translation: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝/כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: 'hb yhvh sh'ry tsyvn mkhl mshkhnvt y'qb
verses.translation: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.original: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑/ךְ עִ֖יר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: nkhbdvt mdbr bkh 'yr h'lhym slh
verses.translation: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֤יר רַ֥הַב וּ/בָבֶ֗ל לְֽ/יֹ֫דְעָ֥/י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/צ֣וֹר עִם כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד שָֽׁם
verses.translit: 'zkhyr rhb vbbl lyd'y hnh plsht vtsvr 'm khvsh zh yld shm
verses.translation: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

verses.original: וּֽ/לֲ/צִיּ֨וֹן יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭/אִישׁ יֻלַּד בָּ֑/הּ וְ/ה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣/הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: vltsyvn y'mr 'ysh v'ysh yld bh vhv' ykhvnnh 'lyvn
verses.translation: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּ/כְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: yhvh yspr bkhtvb 'mym zh yld shm slh
verses.translation: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁרִ֥ים כְּ/חֹלְלִ֑ים כָּֽל מַעְיָנַ֥/י בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vshrym khchllym khl m'yny bkh
verses.translation: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִ/בְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַ/מְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל מָחֲלַ֣ת לְ/עַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְ/הֵימָ֥ן הָ/אֶזְרָחִֽי
verses.translit: shyr mzmvr lbny qrch lmntsch 'l mchlt l'nvt mshkhyl lhymn h'zrchy
verses.translation: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑/י יוֹם צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַ/לַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy yshv'ty yvm ts'qty blylh ngdkh
verses.translation: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא לְ֭/פָנֶי/ךָ תְּפִלָּתִ֑/י הַטֵּֽה אָ֝זְנְ/ךָ֗ לְ/רִנָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: tbv' lpnykh tplty hth 'znkh lrnty
verses.translation: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

verses.original: כִּֽי שָֽׂבְעָ֣ה בְ/רָע֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/חַיַּ֗/י לִ/שְׁא֥וֹל הִגִּֽיעוּ
verses.translit: khy shb'h br'vt npshy vchyy lsh'vl hgy'v
verses.translation: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

verses.original: נֶ֭חְשַׁבְתִּי עִם י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּ/גֶ֣בֶר אֵֽין אֱיָֽל
verses.translit: nchshbty 'm yvrdy bvr hyyty khgbr 'yn 'yl
verses.translation: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

verses.original: בַּ/מֵּתִ֗ים חָ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּמ֤וֹ חֲלָלִ֨ים שֹׁ֥כְבֵי קֶ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֣א זְכַרְתָּ֣/ם ע֑וֹד וְ֝/הֵ֗מָּה מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ נִגְזָֽרוּ
verses.translit: bmtym chpshy khmv chllym shkhby qbr 'shr l' zkhrtm 'vd vhmh mydkh ngzrv
verses.translation: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.original: שַׁ֭תַּ/נִי בְּ/ב֣וֹר תַּחְתִּיּ֑וֹת בְּ֝/מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים בִּ/מְצֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: shtny bbvr tchtyvt bmchshkhym bmtslvt
verses.translation: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

verses.original: עָ֭לַ/י סָמְכָ֣ה חֲמָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/כָל מִ֝שְׁבָּרֶ֗י/ךָ עִנִּ֥יתָ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: 'ly smkhh chmtkh vkhl mshbrykh 'nyt slh
verses.translation: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.original: הִרְחַ֥קְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַ֗/י מִ֫מֶּ֥/נִּי שַׁתַּ֣/נִי תוֹעֵב֣וֹת לָ֑/מוֹ כָּ֝לֻ֗א וְ/לֹ֣א אֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: hrchqt myd'y mmny shtny tv'bvt lmv khl' vl' 'ts'
verses.translation: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD , I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

verses.original: עֵינִ֥/י דָאֲבָ֗ה מִנִּ֫י עֹ֥נִי קְרָאתִ֣י/ךָ יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/כָל י֑וֹם שִׁטַּ֖חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ כַפָּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yny d'bh mny 'ny qr'tykh yhvh bkhl yvm shtchty 'lykh khpy
verses.translation: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

verses.original: הֲ/לַ/מֵּתִ֥ים תַּעֲשֶׂה פֶּ֑לֶא אִם רְ֝פָאִ֗ים יָק֤וּמוּ יוֹד֬וּ/ךָ סֶּֽלָה
verses.translit: hlmtym t'shh pl' 'm rp'ym yqvmv yvdvkh slh
verses.translation: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

verses.translit: hyspr bqbr chsdkh 'mvntkh b'bdvn
verses.translation: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.translit: hyvd' bchshkh pl'kh vtsdqtkh b'rts nshyh
verses.translation: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD ; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יְהוָ֣ה שִׁוַּ֑עְתִּי וּ֝/בַ/בֹּ֗קֶר תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥/י תְקַדְּמֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: v'ny 'lykh yhvh shv'ty vbbqr tplty tqdmkh
verses.translation: LORD , why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

verses.original: לָ/מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּזְנַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֑/י תַּסְתִּ֖יר פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: lmh yhvh tznch npshy tstyr pnykh mmny
verses.translation: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

verses.original: עָ֘נִ֤י אֲנִ֣י וְ/גֹוֵ֣עַ מִ/נֹּ֑עַר נָשָׂ֖אתִי אֵמֶ֣י/ךָ אָפֽוּנָה
verses.translit: 'ny 'ny vgv' mn'r nsh'ty 'mykh 'pvnh
verses.translation: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.original: עָ֭לַ/י עָבְר֣וּ חֲרוֹנֶ֑י/ךָ בִּ֝עוּתֶ֗י/ךָ צִמְּתוּתֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'ly 'brv chrvnykh b'vtykh tsmtvtny
verses.translation: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

verses.original: סַבּ֣וּ/נִי כַ֭/מַּיִם כָּל הַ/יּ֑וֹם הִקִּ֖יפוּ עָלַ֣/י יָֽחַד
verses.translit: sbvny khmym khl hyvm hqypv 'ly ychd
verses.translation: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

verses.original: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְ/אֵיתָ֥ן הָֽ/אֶזְרָחִֽי
verses.translit: mshkhyl l'ytn h'zrchy
verses.translation: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ/דֹ֓ר אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְ/ךָ֣ בְּ/פִֽ/י
verses.translit: chsdy yhvh 'vlm 'shyrh ldr vdr 'vdy' 'mvntkh bpy
verses.translation: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְ/ךָ֣ בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'mrty 'vlm chsd ybnh shmym tkhn 'mvntkh bhm
verses.translation: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.original: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִ/בְחִירִ֑/י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְ/דָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khrty bryt lbchyry nshb'ty ldvd 'bdy
verses.translation: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.original: עַד ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ וּ/בָנִ֨יתִי לְ/דֹר וָ/ד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲ/ךָ֣ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'd 'vlm 'khyn zr'kh vbnyty ldr vdvr khs'kh slh
verses.translation: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD : thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.original: וְ/י֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְ/ךָ֗ בִּ/קְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyvdv shmym pl'kh yhvh 'f 'mvntkh bqhl qdshym
verses.translation: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD ? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD ?

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭/שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַ/יהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה בִּ/בְנֵ֥י אֵלִים
verses.translit: khy my bshchq y'rkh lyhvh ydmh lyhvh bbny 'lym
verses.translation: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

verses.original: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּ/סוֹד קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝/נוֹרָ֗א עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l n'rts bsvd qdshym rbh vnvr' 'l khl sbybyv
verses.translation: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי כָֽמ֖וֹ/ךָ חֲסִ֥ין יָ֑הּ וֶ֝/אֱמֽוּנָתְ/ךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt my khmvkh chsyn yh v'mvntkh sbybvtykh
verses.translation: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּ/גֵא֣וּת הַ/יָּ֑ם בְּ/שׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗י/ו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'th mvshl bg'vt hym bshv' glyv 'th tshbchm
verses.translation: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶ/חָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּ/זְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּ/ךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'th dkh't khchll rhb bzrv' 'zkh pzrt 'vybykh
verses.translation: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף לְ/ךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝/מְלֹאָ֗/הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: lkh shmym 'f lkh 'rts tbl vml'h 'th ysdtm
verses.translation: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

verses.original: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭/יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑/ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝/חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
verses.translit: tspvn vymyn 'th br'tm tbvr vchrmvn bshmkh yrnnv
verses.translation: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְ/ךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lkh zrv' 'm gbvrh t'z ydkh trvm ymynkh
verses.translation: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

verses.original: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭/מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑/ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝/אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tsdq vmshpt mkhvn khs'kh chsd v'mt yqdmv pnykh
verses.translation: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD , in the light of thy countenance.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭/עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽ/אוֹר פָּנֶ֥י/ךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'shry h'm yvd'y trv'h yhvh b'vr pnykh yhlkhvn
verses.translation: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.original: בְּ֭/שִׁמְ/ךָ יְגִיל֣וּ/ן כָּל הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/בְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ
verses.translit: bshmkh ygylvn khl hyvm vbtsdqtkh yrvmv
verses.translation: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.original: כִּֽי תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣/מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝/בִ/רְצֹנְ/ךָ֗ תרים תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khy tp'rt 'zmv 'th vbrtsnkh trym trvm qrnnv
verses.translation: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king. …: or, our shield is of the LORD , and our king is of the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭/יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑/נוּ וְ/לִ/קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khy lyhvh mgnnv vlqdvsh yshr'l mlkhnv
verses.translation: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.original: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ בְ/חָ֡זוֹן לַֽ/חֲסִידֶ֗י/ךָ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵ/עָֽם
verses.translit: 'z dbrt bchzvn lchsydykh vt'mr shvyty 'zr 'l gbvr hrymvty bchvr m'm
verses.translation: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.original: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑/י בְּ/שֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣/י מְשַׁחְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: mts'ty dvd 'bdy bshmn qdshy mshchtyv
verses.translation: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִ/י תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑/וֹ אַף זְרוֹעִ֥/י תְאַמְּצֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'shr ydy tkhvn 'mv 'f zrv'y t'mtsnv
verses.translation: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.original: לֹֽא יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑/וֹ וּ/בֶן עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: l' ysh' 'vyb bv vbn 'vlh l' y'nnv
verses.translation: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.original: וְ/כַתּוֹתִ֣י מִ/פָּנָ֣י/ו צָרָ֑י/ו וּ/מְשַׂנְאָ֥י/ו אֶגּֽוֹף
verses.translit: vkhtvty mpnyv tsryv vmshn'yv 'gvf
verses.translation: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.original: וֶֽ/אֶֽמוּנָתִ֣/י וְ/חַסְדִּ֣/י עִמּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בִ/שְׁמִ֗/י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'mvnty vchsdy 'mv vbshmy trvm qrnv
verses.translation: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י בַ/יָּ֣ם יָד֑/וֹ וּֽ/בַ/נְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vshmty bym ydv vbnhrvt ymynv
verses.translation: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.original: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵ/נִי אָ֣בִ/י אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗/י וְ/צ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hv' yqr'ny 'by 'th 'ly vtsvr yshv'ty
verses.translation: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.original: אַף אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑/הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְ/מַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'f 'ny bkhvr 'tnhv 'lyvn lmlkhy 'rts
verses.translation: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.original: לְ֭/עוֹלָ֗ם אשמור אֶשְׁמָר ל֣/וֹ חַסְדִּ֑/י וּ֝/בְרִיתִ֗/י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'vlm 'shmvr 'shmr lv chsdy vbryty n'mnt lv
verses.translation: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י לָ/עַ֣ד זַרְע֑/וֹ וְ֝/כִסְא֗/וֹ כִּ/ימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vshmty l'd zr'v vkhs'v khymy shmym
verses.translation: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.original: אִם יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָי/ו תּוֹרָתִ֑/י וּ֝/בְ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֗/י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'm y'zbv bnyv tvrty vbmshpty l' ylkhvn
verses.translation: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.original: אִם חֻקֹּתַ֥/י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝/מִצְוֺתַ֗/י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: 'm chqty ychllv vmtsvty l' yshmrv
verses.translation: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֣י בְ/שֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑/ם וּ/בִ/נְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vpqdty bshbt psh'm vbng'ym 'vnm
verses.translation: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.original: וְ֭/חַסְדִּ/י לֹֽא אָפִ֣יר מֵֽ/עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּ/אֱמוּנָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vchsdy l' 'pyr m'mv vl' 'shqr b'mvnty
verses.translation: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.original: לֹא אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑/י וּ/מוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗/י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה
verses.translit: l' 'chll bryty vmvts' shpty l' 'shnh
verses.translation: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

verses.original: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְ/קָדְשִׁ֑/י אִֽם לְ/דָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב
verses.translit: 'cht nshb'ty bqdshy 'm ldvd 'khzb
verses.translation: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.original: זַ֭רְע/וֹ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְ/כִסְא֖/וֹ כַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: zr'v l'vlm yhyh vkhs'v khshmsh ngdy
verses.translation: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.original: כְּ֭/יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/עֵ֥ד בַּ֝/שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: khyrch ykhvn 'vlm v'd bshchq n'mn slh
verses.translation: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַ/תִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם מְשִׁיחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th zncht vtm's ht'brt 'm mshychkh
verses.translation: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

verses.original: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָ/אָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: n'rth bryt 'bdkh chllt l'rts nzrv
verses.translation: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.original: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל גְּדֵרֹתָ֑י/ו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣י/ו מְחִתָּה
verses.translit: prtst khl gdrtyv shmt mbtsryv mchth
verses.translation: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.original: שַׁ֭סֻּ/הוּ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִ/שְׁכֵנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shshv khl 'bry drkh hyh chrph lshkhnyv
verses.translation: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.original: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑י/ו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל אוֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hrymvt ymyn tsryv hshmcht khl 'vybyv
verses.translation: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.original: אַף תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗/וֹ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'f tshyb tsvr chrbv vl' hqymtv bmlchmh
verses.translation: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.translit: hshbt mthrv vkhs'v l'rts mgrth
verses.translation: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.original: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑י/ו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖י/ו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: hqtsrt ymy 'lvmyv h'tyt 'lyv bvshh slh
verses.translation: How long, LORD ? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.original: עַד מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָ/נֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'd mh yhvh tstr lntsch tb'r khmv 'sh chmtkh
verses.translation: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

verses.original: זְכָר אֲנִ֥י מֶה חָ֑לֶד עַל מַה שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל בְּנֵי אָדָֽם
verses.translit: zkhr 'ny mh chld 'l mh shv' br't khl bny 'dm
verses.translation: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.original: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ מִ/יַּד שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: my gbr ychyh vl' yr'h mvt ymlt npshv myd sh'vl slh
verses.translation: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

verses.original: אַיֵּ֤ה חֲסָדֶ֖י/ךָ הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֥ים אֲדֹנָ֑/י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝/דָוִ֗ד בֶּ/אֱמוּנָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'yh chsdykh hr'shnym 'dny nshb't ldvd b'mvntkh
verses.translation: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

verses.original: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָ/י חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥/י בְ֝/חֵיקִ֗/י כָּל רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: zkhr 'dny chrpt 'bdykh sh'ty bchyqy khl rbym 'mym
verses.translation: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD ; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥י/ךָ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shr chrpv 'vybykh yhvh 'shr chrpv 'qbvt mshychkh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

verses.original: תְּפִלָּה֮ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ הָ/אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲֽדֹנָ֗/י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗/נוּ בְּ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: tplh lmshh 'ysh h'lhym 'dny m'vn 'th hyyt lnv bdr vdr
verses.translation: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֤רֶם הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַ/תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְ/תֵבֵ֑ל וּֽ/מֵ/עוֹלָ֥ם עַד ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל
verses.translit: btrm hrym yldv vtchvll 'rts vtbl vm'vlm 'd 'vlm 'th 'l
verses.translation: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

verses.original: תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝/תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי אָדָֽם
verses.translit: tshb 'nvsh 'd dkh' vt'mr shvbv bny 'dm
verses.translation: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽ/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ כְּ/י֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְ/אַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: khy 'lf shnym b'ynykh khyvm 'tmvl khy y'br v'shmvrh blylh
verses.translation: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

verses.original: זְ֭רַמְתָּ/ם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝/בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּ/חָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף
verses.translit: zrmtm shnh yhyv bbqr khchtsyr ychlf
verses.translation: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

verses.original: בַּ֭/בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְ/חָלָ֑ף לָ֝/עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְ/יָבֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: bbqr ytsyts vchlf l'rb ymvll vybsh
verses.translation: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.original: כִּֽי כָלִ֥ינוּ בְ/אַפֶּ֑/ךָ וּֽ/בַ/חֲמָתְ/ךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ
verses.translit: khy khlynv b'pkh vbchmtkh nbhlnv
verses.translation: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

verses.original: שת שַׁתָּ֣ה עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣י/נוּ לְ/נֶגְדֶּ֑/ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗/נוּ לִ/מְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: sht shth 'vntynv lngdkh 'lmnv lm'vr pnykh
verses.translation: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל יָ֭מֵי/נוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְ/עֶבְרָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣י/נוּ כְמוֹ הֶֽגֶה
verses.translit: khy khl ymynv pnv b'brtkh khlynv shnynv khmv hgh
verses.translation: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told .

verses.original: יְמֵֽי שְׁנוֹתֵ֨י/נוּ בָ/הֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְ/אִ֤ם בִּ/גְבוּרֹ֨ת שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭/רָהְבָּ/ם עָמָ֣ל וָ/אָ֑וֶן כִּי גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַ/נָּעֻֽפָ/ה
verses.translit: ymy shnvtynv bhm shb'ym shnh v'm bgbvrt shmvnym shnh vrhbm 'ml v'vn khy gz chysh vn'ph
verses.translation: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.original: מִֽי י֭וֹדֵעַ עֹ֣ז אַפֶּ֑/ךָ וּ֝/כְ/יִרְאָתְ/ךָ֗ עֶבְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: my yvd' 'z 'pkh vkhyr'tkh 'brtkh
verses.translation: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

verses.original: לִ/מְנ֣וֹת יָ֭מֵי/נוּ כֵּ֣ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֝/נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: lmnvt ymynv khn hvd' vnb' lbb chkhmh
verses.translation: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה עַד מָתָ֑י וְ֝/הִנָּחֵ֗ם עַל עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shvbh yhvh 'd mty vhnchm 'l 'bdykh
verses.translation: Return, O LORD , how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

verses.original: שַׂבְּעֵ֣/נוּ בַ/בֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וּֽ/נְרַנְּנָ֥ה וְ֝/נִשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּ/כָל יָמֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: shb'nv bbqr chsdkh vnrnnh vnshmchh bkhl ymynv
verses.translation: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.original: שַׂ֭מְּחֵ/נוּ כִּ/ימ֣וֹת עִנִּיתָ֑/נוּ שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת רָאִ֥ינוּ רָעָֽה
verses.translit: shmchnv khymvt 'nytnv shnvt r'ynv r'h
verses.translation: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.original: יֵרָאֶ֣ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ פָעֳלֶ֑/ךָ וַ֝/הֲדָרְ/ךָ֗ עַל בְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: yr'h 'l 'bdykh p'lkh vhdrkh 'l bnyhm
verses.translation: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

verses.original: וִ/יהִ֤י נֹ֤עַם אֲדֹנָ֥/י אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ עָ֫לֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֭דֵי/נוּ כּוֹנְנָ֥/ה עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דֵ֗י/נוּ כּוֹנְנֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyhy n'm 'dny 'lhynv 'lynv vm'shh ydynv khvnnh 'lynv vm'shh ydynv khvnnhv
verses.translation: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

verses.original: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּ/סֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּ/צֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: yshb bstr 'lyvn btsl shdy ytlvnn
verses.translation: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר לַֽ֭/יהוָה מַחְסִ֣/י וּ/מְצוּדָתִ֑/י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗/י אֶבְטַח בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'mr lyhvh mchsy vmtsvdty 'lhy 'btch bv
verses.translation: I will say of the LORD , He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְ/ךָ מִ/פַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִ/דֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy hv' ytsylkh mpch yqvsh mdbr hvvt
