verses.translation: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.original: בְּ/אֶבְרָת֨/וֹ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭/ךְ וְ/תַֽחַת כְּנָפָ֣י/ו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְֽ/סֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'brtv yskh lkh vtcht khnpyv tchsh tsnh vschrh 'mtv
verses.translation: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

verses.original: לֹא תִ֭ירָא מִ/פַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝/חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם
verses.translit: l' tyr' mpchd lylh mchts y'vf yvmm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.original: מִ֭/דֶּבֶר בָּ/אֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝/קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צָהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: mdbr b'pl yhlkh mqtb yshvd tshrym
verses.translation: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

verses.original: יִפֹּ֤ל מִ/צִּדְּ/ךָ֨ אֶ֗לֶף וּ/רְבָבָ֥ה מִ/ימִינֶ֑/ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: ypl mtsdkh 'lf vrbbh mymynkh 'lykh l' ygsh
verses.translation: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.original: רַ֭ק בְּ/עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְ/שִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: rq b'ynykh tbyt vshlmt rsh'ym tr'h
verses.translation: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑/י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'th yhvh mchsy 'lyvn shmt m'vnkh
verses.translation: Because thou hast made the LORD , which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

verses.original: לֹֽא תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝/נֶ֗גַע לֹא יִקְרַ֥ב בְּ/אָהֳלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' t'nh 'lykh r'h vng' l' yqrb b'hlkh
verses.translation: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַ֭לְאָכָי/ו יְצַוֶּה לָּ֑/ךְ לִ֝/שְׁמָרְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כָל דְּרָכֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy ml'khyv ytsvh lkh lshmrkh bkhl drkhykh
verses.translation: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.original: עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם יִשָּׂא֑וּ/נְ/ךָ פֶּן תִּגֹּ֖ף בָּ/אֶ֣בֶן רַגְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l khpym ysh'vnkh pn tgf b'bn rglkh
verses.translation: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.original: עַל שַׁ֣חַל וָ/פֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְ/תַנִּֽין
verses.translit: 'l shchl vptn tdrkh trms khpyr vtnyn
verses.translation: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בִ֣/י חָ֭שַׁק וַ/אֲפַלְּטֵ֑/הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗/הוּ כִּֽי יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy by chshq v'plthv 'shgbhv khy yd' shmy
verses.translation: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

verses.original: יִקְרָאֵ֨/נִי וְֽ/אֶעֱנֵ֗/הוּ עִמּֽ/וֹ אָנֹכִ֥י בְ/צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗/הוּ וַֽ/אֲכַבְּדֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: yqr'ny v''nhv 'mv 'nkhy btsrh 'chltshv v'khbdhv
verses.translation: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵ֑/הוּ וְ֝/אַרְאֵ֗/הוּ בִּֽ/ישׁוּעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rkh ymym 'shby'hv v'r'hv byshv'ty
verses.translation: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר לְ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: mzmvr shyr lyvm hshbt
verses.translation: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD , and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לְ/הֹד֥וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/לְ/זַמֵּ֖ר לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: tvb lhdvt lyhvh vlzmr lshmkh 'lyvn
verses.translation: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

verses.original: לְ/הַגִּ֣יד בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר חַסְֽדֶּ֑/ךָ וֶ֝/אֱמֽוּנָתְ/ךָ֗ בַּ/לֵּילֽוֹת
verses.translit: lhgyd bbqr chsdkh v'mvntkh blylvt
verses.translation: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

verses.original: עֲֽלֵי עָ֭שׂוֹר וַ/עֲלֵי נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּ/כִנּֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'ly 'shvr v'ly nbl 'ly hgyvn bkhnvr
verses.translation: For thou, LORD , hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣/נִי יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/פָעֳלֶ֑/ךָ בְּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן
verses.translit: khy shmchtny yhvh bp'lkh bm'shy ydykh 'rnn
verses.translation: O LORD , how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.original: מַה גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣י/ךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mh gdlv m'shykh yhvh m'd 'mqv mchshbtykh
verses.translation: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝/כְסִ֗יל לֹא יָבִ֥ין אֶת זֹֽאת
verses.translit: 'ysh b'r l' yd' vkhsyl l' ybyn 't z't
verses.translation: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.original: בִּ/פְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭/יָּצִיצוּ כָּל פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְ/הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥/ם עֲדֵי עַֽד
verses.translit: bprch rsh'ym khmv 'shb vytsytsv khl p'ly 'vn lhshmdm 'dy 'd
verses.translation: But thou, LORD , art most high for evermore.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֥ה מָר֗וֹם לְ/עֹלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th mrvm l'lm yhvh
verses.translation: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD , for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡י/ךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣י/ךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: khy hnh 'ybykh yhvh khy hnh 'ybykh y'bdv ytprdv khl p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣רֶם כִּ/רְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑/י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּ/שֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: vtrm khr'ym qrny blty bshmn r'nn
verses.translation: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.original: וַ/תַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗/י בְּ/שׁ֫וּרָ֥/י בַּ/קָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥/י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vtbt 'yny bshvry bqmym 'ly mr'ym tshm'nh 'zny
verses.translation: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק כַּ/תָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּ/אֶ֖רֶז בַּ/לְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה
verses.translit: tsdyq khtmr yprch kh'rz blbnvn yshgh
verses.translation: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.original: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/חַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י/נוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: shtvlym bbyt yhvh bchtsrvt 'lhynv yprychv
verses.translation: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.original: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּ/ן בְּ/שֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְ/רַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: 'vd ynvbvn bshybh dshnym vr'nnym yhyv
verses.translation: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל תִּמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh g'vt lbsh lbsh yhvh 'z ht'zr 'f tkhvn tbl bl tmvt
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֲ/ךָ֣ מֵ/אָ֑ז מֵֽ/עוֹלָ֣ם אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: nkhvn khs'kh m'z m'vlm 'th
verses.translation: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

verses.original: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑/ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽ/ם
verses.translit: nsh'v nhrvt yhvh nsh'v nhrvt qvlm ysh'v nhrvt dkhym
verses.translation: The floods have lifted up, O LORD , the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.original: מִ/קֹּל֨וֹת מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּ/מָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mqlvt mym rbym 'dyrym mshbry ym 'dyr bmrvm yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.original: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨י/ךָ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְ/בֵיתְ/ךָ֥ נַאֲוָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְ/אֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: 'dtykh n'mnv m'd lbytkh n'vh qdsh yhvh l'rkh ymym
verses.translation: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD , for ever.

verses.original: אֵל נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע
verses.translit: 'l nqmvt yhvh 'l nqmvt hvpy'
verses.translation: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

verses.original: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל גֵּאִֽים
verses.translit: hnsh' shpt h'rts hshb gmvl 'l g'ym
verses.translation: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה עַד מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ
verses.translit: 'd mty rsh'ym yhvh 'd mty rsh'ym y'lzv
verses.translation: LORD , how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.original: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: yby'v ydbrv 'tq yt'mrv khl p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.original: עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽ/נַחֲלָתְ/ךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ
verses.translit: 'mkh yhvh ydkh'v vnchltkh y'nv
verses.translation: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD , and afflict thine heritage.

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְ/גֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽ/יתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ
verses.translit: 'lmnh vgr yhrgv vytvmym yrtschv
verses.translation: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.original: וַ֭/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה יָּ֑הּ וְ/לֹא יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vy'mrv l' yr'h yh vl' ybyn 'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .

verses.original: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּ/עָ֑ם וּ֝/כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ
verses.translit: bynv b'rym b'm vkhsylym mty tshkhylv
verses.translation: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.original: הֲ/נֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲ/לֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט
verses.translit: hnt' 'zn hl' yshm' 'm ytsr 'yn hl' ybyt
verses.translation: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.original: הֲ/יֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲ/לֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽ/מְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: hysr gvym hl' yvkhych hmlmd 'dm d't
verses.translation: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know ?

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: yhvh yd' mchshbvt 'dm khy hmh hbl
verses.translation: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.translit: 'shry hgbr 'shr tysrnv yh vmtvrtkh tlmdnv
verses.translation: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD , and teachest him out of thy law;

verses.original: לְ/הַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭/וֹ מִ֣/ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָ/רָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת
verses.translit: lhshqyt lv mymy r' 'd ykhrh lrsh' shcht
verses.translation: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/נַחֲלָת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב
verses.translit: khy l' ytsh yhvh 'mv vnchltv l' y'zb
verses.translation: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.original: כִּֽי עַד צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝/אַחֲרָ֗י/ו כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: khy 'd tsdq yshvb mshpt v'chryv khl yshry lb
verses.translation: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.original: מִֽי יָק֣וּם לִ֭/י עִם מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝/י עִם פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: my yqvm ly 'm mr'ym my ytytsb ly 'm p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָ/ה לִּ֑/י כִּ/מְעַ֓ט שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: lvly yhvh 'zrth ly khm't shkhnh dvmh npshy
verses.translation: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.original: אִם אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑/י חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'm 'mrty mth rgly chsdkh yhvh ys'dny
verses.translation: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD , held me up.

verses.translit: brb shr'py bqrby tnchvmykh ysh'sh'v npshy
verses.translation: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.original: הַֽ֭/יְחָבְרְ/ךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי חֹֽק
verses.translit: hychbrkh khs' hvvt ytsr 'ml 'ly chq
verses.translation: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.original: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְ/דָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ
verses.translit: ygvdv 'l npsh tsdyq vdm nqy yrshy'v
verses.translation: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣/י לְ/מִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝/אלֹהַ֗/י לְ/צ֣וּר מַחְסִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh ly lmshgb v'lhy ltsvr mchsy
verses.translation: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵי/הֶ֨ם אֶת אוֹנָ֗/ם וּ/בְ/רָעָתָ֥/ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑/ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗/ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyshb 'lyhm 't 'vnm vbr'tm ytsmytm ytsmytm yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea , the LORD our God shall cut them off.

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְ/צ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: lkhv nrnnh lyhvh nry'h ltsvr ysh'nv
verses.translation: O come, let us sing unto the LORD : let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.original: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣י/ו בְּ/תוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝/זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nqdmh pnyv btvdh bzmrvt nry' lv
verses.translation: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'l gdvl yhvh vmlkh gdvl 'l khl 'lhym
verses.translation: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭/יָד/וֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/תוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shr bydv mchqry 'rts vtv'pvt hrym lv
verses.translation: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר ל֣/וֹ הַ֭/יָּם וְ/ה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑/הוּ וְ֝/יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥י/ו יָצָֽרוּ
verses.translit: 'shr lv hym vhv' 'shhv vybsht ydyv ytsrv
verses.translation: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land .

verses.original: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְ/נִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽ/פְנֵי יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂ/נוּ
verses.translit: b'v nshtchvh vnkhr'h nbrkhh lpny yhvh 'shnv
verses.translation: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

verses.original: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ וַ/אֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִית/וֹ וְ/צֹ֣אן יָד֑/וֹ הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם אִֽם בְּ/קֹל֥/וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ
verses.translit: khy hv' 'lhynv v'nchnv 'm mr'ytv vts'n ydv hyvm 'm bqlv tshm'v
verses.translation: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.original: אַל תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְ/כֶם כִּ/מְרִיבָ֑ה כְּ/י֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: 'l tqshv lbbkhm khmrybh khyvm msh bmdbr
verses.translation: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּ/נִי אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּ/נִי גַּם רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr nsvny 'bvtykhm bchnvny gm r'v p'ly
verses.translation: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּ/ד֗וֹר וָ/אֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝/הֵ֗ם לֹא יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rb'ym shnh 'qvt bdvr v'mr 'm t'y lbb hm vhm l' yd'v drkhy
verses.translation: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְ/אַפִּ֑/י אִם יְ֝בֹא֗וּ/ן אֶל מְנוּחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr nshb'ty b'py 'm yb'vn 'l mnvchty
verses.translation: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭/יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh shyrv lyhvh khl h'rts
verses.translation: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD , all the earth.

verses.original: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭/יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑/וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִ/יּֽוֹם לְ֝/י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh brkhv shmv bshrv myvm lyvm yshv'tv
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD , bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.original: סַפְּר֣וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑/וֹ בְּ/כָל הָֽ֝/עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: sprv bgvym khbvdv bkhl h'mym npl'vtyv
verses.translation: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

verses.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּ/מְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd nvr' hv' 'l khl 'lhym
verses.translation: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/עַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝/יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: khy khl 'lhy h'mym 'lylym vyhvh shmym 'shh
verses.translation: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.original: הוֹד וְ/הָדָ֥ר לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו עֹ֥ז וְ֝/תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּ/מִקְדָּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvd vhdr lpnyv 'z vtp'rt bmqdshv
verses.translation: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭/יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָ/עֹֽז
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh mshpchvt 'mym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD , O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַ֭/יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑/וֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּ/בֹ֥אוּ לְ/חַצְרוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv sh'v mnchh vb'v lchtsrvtyv
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.original: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭/יהוָה בְּ/הַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝/פָּנָ֗י/ו כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrt qdsh chylv mpnyv khl h'rts
verses.translation: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

verses.original: אִמְר֤וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֨ם יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּ/מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: 'mrv bgvym yhvh mlkh 'f tkhvn tbl bl tmvt ydyn 'mym bmyshrym
verses.translation: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭/שָּׁמַיִם וְ/תָגֵ֣ל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝/יָּ֗ם וּ/מְלֹאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yshmchv hshmym vtgl h'rts yr'm hym vml'v
verses.translation: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

verses.original: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑/וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל עֲצֵי יָֽעַר
verses.translit: y'lz shdy vkhl 'shr bv 'z yrnnv khl 'tsy y'r
verses.translation: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִ/שְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּ/צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝/עַמִּ֗ים בֶּ/אֱמוּנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lpny yhvh khy b' khy b' lshpt h'rts yshpt tbl btsdq v'mym b'mvntv
verses.translation: Before the LORD : for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh tgl h'rts yshmchv 'yym rbym
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .

verses.original: עָנָ֣ן וַ/עֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑י/ו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝/מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'nn v'rpl sbybyv tsdq vmshpt mkhvn khs'v
verses.translation: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

verses.original: אֵ֭שׁ לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּ/תְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'sh lpnyv tlkh vtlht sbyb tsryv
verses.translation: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

verses.original: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣י/ו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַ/תָּחֵ֣ל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: h'yrv brqyv tbl r'th vtchl h'rts
verses.translation: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.original: הָרִ֗ים כַּ/דּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝/לִּ/פְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hrym khdvng nmsv mlpny yhvh mlpny 'dvn khl h'rts
verses.translation: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD , at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.original: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑/וֹ וְ/רָא֖וּ כָל הָ/עַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hgydv hshmym tsdqv vr'v khl h'mym khbvdv
verses.translation: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ כָּל עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַ/מִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּ/אֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֝/וֹ כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: ybshv khl 'bdy psl hmthllym b'lylym hshtchvv lv khl 'lhym
verses.translation: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

verses.original: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַ/תִּשְׂמַ֨ח צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭/תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shm'h vtshmch tsyvn vtglnh bnvt yhvdh lm'n mshptykh yhvh
verses.translation: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'th yhvh 'lyvn 'l khl h'rts m'd n'lyt 'l khl 'lhym
verses.translation: For thou, LORD , art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.original: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑י/ו מִ/יַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'hby yhvh shn'v r' shmr npshvt chsydyv myd rsh'ym ytsylm
verses.translation: Ye that love the LORD , hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.original: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַ/צַּדִּ֑יק וּֽ/לְ/יִשְׁרֵי לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: 'vr zr' ltsdyq vlyshry lb shmchh
verses.translation: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.original: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ֝/הוֹד֗וּ לְ/זֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: shmchv tsdyqym byhvh vhvdv lzkhr qdshv
verses.translation: Rejoice in the LORD , ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֨ה שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה לּ֥/וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗/וֹ וּ/זְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: mzmvr shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh khy npl'vt 'shh hvshy'h lv ymynv vzrv' qdshv
verses.translation: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

verses.original: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ֝/גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdy' yhvh yshv'tv l'yny hgvym glh tsdqtv
verses.translation: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨/וֹ וֶֽ/אֱֽמוּנָת/וֹ֮ לְ/בֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: zkhr chsdv v'mvntv lbyt yshr'l r'v khl 'psy 'rts 't yshv't 'lhynv
verses.translation: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.original: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭/יהוָה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְ/רַנְּנ֣וּ וְ/זַמֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: hry'v lyhvh khl h'rts ptschv vrnnv vzmrv
verses.translation: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה בְּ/כִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝/כִנּ֗וֹר וְ/ק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh bkhnvr bkhnvr vqvl zmrh
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.original: בַּ֭/חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְ/ק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bchtstsrvt vqvl shvpr hry'v lpny hmlkh yhvh
verses.translation: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD , the King.

verses.original: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭/יָּם וּ/מְלֹא֑/וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְ/יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: yr'm hym vml'v tbl vyshby bh
verses.translation: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.original: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
verses.translit: nhrvt ymch'v khf ychd hrym yrnnv
verses.translation: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

verses.original: לִֽ/פְֽנֵי יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִ/שְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּ/צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝/עַמִּ֗ים בְּ/מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: lpny yhvh khy b' lshpt h'rts yshpt tbl btsdq v'mym bmyshrym
verses.translation: Before the LORD ; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh yrgzv 'mym yshb khrvbym tnvt h'rts
verses.translation: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה בְּ/צִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְ/רָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל הָֽ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: yhvh btsyvn gdvl vrm hv' 'l khl h'mym
verses.translation: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְ/ךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְ/נוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא
verses.translit: yvdv shmkh gdvl vnvr' qdvsh hv'
verses.translation: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

verses.original: וְ/עֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝/צְדָקָ֗ה בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֤ב אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ
verses.translit: v'z mlkh mshpt 'hb 'th khvnnt myshrym mshpt vtsdqh by'qb 'th 'shyt
verses.translation: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ וְֽ֭/הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַ/הֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗י/ו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא
verses.translit: rvmmv yhvh 'lhynv vhshtchvv lhdm rglyv qdvsh hv'
verses.translation: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

verses.original: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֨ן בְּֽ/כֹהֲנָ֗י/ו וּ֭/שְׁמוּאֵל בְּ/קֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑/וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְ/ה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: mshh v'hrn bkhhnyv vshmv'l bqr'y shmv qr'ym 'l yhvh vhv' y'nm
verses.translation: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD , and he answered them.

verses.original: בְּ/עַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗י/ו וְ/חֹ֣ק נָֽתַן לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: b'mvd 'nn ydbr 'lyhm shmrv 'dtyv vchq ntn lmv
verses.translation: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/נוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥/ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/נֹקֵ֗ם עַל עֲלִילוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv 'th 'nytm 'l nsh' hyyt lhm vnqm 'l 'lylvtm
verses.translation: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ וְ֭/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְ/הַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ כִּֽי קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: rvmmv yhvh 'lhynv vhshtchvv lhr qdshv khy qdvsh yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/תוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝/יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mzmvr ltvdh hry'v lyhvh khl h'rts
verses.translation: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all ye lands.

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝/פָנָ֗י/ו בִּ/רְנָנָֽה
verses.translit: 'bdv 't yhvh bshmchh b'v lpnyv brnnh
verses.translation: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.original: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא עָ֭שָׂ/נוּ ו/לא וְ/ל֣/וֹ אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗/וֹ וְ/צֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: d'v khy yhvh hv' 'lhym hv' 'shnv vl' vlv 'nchnv 'mv vts'n mr'ytv
verses.translation: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨י/ו בְּ/תוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥י/ו בִּ/תְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ ל֝֗/וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'v sh'ryv btvdh chtsrtyv bthlh hvdv lv brkhv shmv
verses.translation: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

verses.original: כִּי ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/עַד דֹּ֥ר וָ֝/דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tvb yhvh l'vlm chsdv v'd dr vdr 'mvntv
verses.translation: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה
verses.translit: ldvd mzmvr chsd vmshpt 'shyrh lkh yhvh 'zmrh
verses.translation: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD , will I sing.

verses.original: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה בְּ/דֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑/י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּ/תָם לְ֝בָבִ֗/י בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shkhylh bdrkh tmym mty tbv' 'ly 'thlkh btm lbby bqrb byty
verses.translation: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.original: לֹֽא אָשִׁ֨ית לְ/נֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗/י דְּֽבַר בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: l' 'shyt lngd 'yny dbr bly'l 'shh stym shn'ty l' ydbq by
verses.translation: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.original: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑/נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע
verses.translit: lbb 'qsh ysvr mmny r' l' 'd'
verses.translation: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person .

verses.original: מלושני מְלָשְׁנִ֬י בַ/סֵּ֨תֶר רֵעֵ/הוּ֮ אוֹת֪/וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּ/רְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל
verses.translit: mlvshny mlshny bstr r'hv 'vtv 'tsmyt gbh 'ynym vrchb lbb 'tv l' 'vkhl
verses.translation: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.original: עֵינַ֤/י בְּ/נֶֽאֶמְנֵי אֶרֶץ֮ לָ/שֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥/י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'yny bn'mny 'rts lshbt 'mdy hlkh bdrkh tmym hv' yshrtny
verses.translation: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

verses.original: לֹֽא יֵשֵׁ֨ב בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִ/י֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְ/נֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: l' yshb bqrb byty 'shh rmyh dbr shqrym l' ykhvn lngd 'yny
verses.translation: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

verses.original: לַ/בְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל רִשְׁעֵי אָ֑רֶץ לְ/הַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽ/עִיר יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: lbqrym 'tsmyt khl rsh'y 'rts lhkhryt m'yr yhvh khl p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD .

verses.original: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְ/עָנִ֣י כִֽי יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tplh l'ny khy y'tf vlpny yhvh yshpkh shychv
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O LORD , and let my cry come unto thee.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣/ה תְפִלָּתִ֑/י וְ֝/שַׁוְעָתִ֗/י אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ תָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: yhvh shm'h tplty vshv'ty 'lykh tbv'
verses.translation: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.original: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨י/ךָ מִמֶּ/נִּי֮ בְּ/י֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥/י הַטֵּֽה אֵלַ֥/י אָזְנֶ֑/ךָ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'l tstr pnykh mmny byvm tsr ly hth 'ly 'znkh byvm 'qr' mhr 'nny
verses.translation: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

verses.original: כִּֽי כָל֣וּ בְ/עָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑/י וְ֝/עַצְמוֹתַ֗/י כְּ/מוֹ קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: khy khlv b'shn ymy v'tsmvty khmv qd nchrv
verses.translation: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.original: הוּכָּֽה כָ֭/עֵשֶׂב וַ/יִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑/י כִּֽי שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵ/אֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: hvkhh kh'shb vybsh lby khy shkhchty m'khl lchmy
verses.translation: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑/י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗/י לִ/בְשָׂרִֽ/י
verses.translit: mqvl 'nchty dbqh 'tsmy lbshry
verses.translation: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.original: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִ/קְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּ/כ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: dmyty lq't mdbr hyyty khkhvs chrbvt
verses.translation: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

verses.original: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָ/אֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝/צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל גָּֽג
verses.translit: shqdty v'hyh khtspvr bvdd 'l gg
verses.translation: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּ/נִי אוֹיְבָ֑/י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗/י בִּ֣/י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: khl hyvm chrpvny 'vyby mhvlly by nshb'v
verses.translation: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.original: כִּי אֵ֭פֶר כַּ/לֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝/שִׁקֻּוַ֗/י בִּ/בְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי
verses.translit: khy 'pr khlchm 'khlty vshqvy bbkhy mskhty
verses.translation: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.translit: mpny z'mkh vqtspkh khy nsh'tny vtshlykhny
verses.translation: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

verses.original: יָ֭מַ/י כְּ/צֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝/אֲנִ֗י כָּ/עֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: ymy khtsl ntvy v'ny kh'shb 'ybsh
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD , shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝/זִכְרְ/ךָ֗ לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: v'th yhvh l'vlm tshb vzkhrkh ldr vdr
verses.translation: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי עֵ֥ת לְ֝/חֶֽנְנָ֗/הּ כִּי בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: 'th tqvm trchm tsyvn khy 't lchnnh khy b' mv'd
verses.translation: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

verses.original: כִּֽי רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶי/ךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶ֑י/הָ וְֽ/אֶת עֲפָרָ֥/הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ
verses.translit: khy rtsv 'bdykh 't 'bnyh v't 'prh ychnnv
verses.translation: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD , and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽ/כָל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ אֶת כְּבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyyr'v gvym 't shm yhvh vkhl mlkhy h'rts 't khbvdkh
verses.translation: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

verses.original: כִּֽי בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּ/כְבוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy bnh yhvh tsyvn nr'h bkhbvdv
verses.translation: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

verses.original: פָּ֭נָה אֶל תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָ/עַרְעָ֑ר וְ/לֹֽא בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת תְּפִלָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: pnh 'l tplt h'r'r vl' bzh 't tpltm
verses.translation: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD .

verses.original: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְ/ד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְ/עַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל יָֽהּ
verses.translit: tkhtb z't ldvr 'chrvn v'm nbr' yhll yh
verses.translation: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

verses.original: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִ/מְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִ/שָּׁמַ֤יִם אֶל אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט
verses.translit: khy hshqyf mmrvm qdshv yhvh mshmym 'l 'rts hbyt
verses.translation: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.original: לִ֭/שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝/פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה
verses.translit: lshm' 'nqt 'syr lptch bny tmvth
verses.translation: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.original: לְ/סַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭/צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝/תְהִלָּת֗/וֹ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: lspr btsyvn shm yhvh vthltv byrvshlm
verses.translation: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD .

verses.original: בְּ/הִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝/מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַ/עֲבֹ֥ד אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bhqbts 'mym ychdv vmmlkhvt l'bd 't yhvh
verses.translation: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

verses.original: עִנָּ֖ה בַ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ כח/ו כֹּחִ֗/י קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nh bdrkh khchv khchy qtsr ymy
verses.translation: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗/י אַֽל תַּ֭עֲלֵ/נִי בַּ/חֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑/י בְּ/ד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'mr 'ly 'l t'lny bchtsy ymy bdvr dvrym shnvtykh
verses.translation: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

verses.original: לְ֭/פָנִים הָ/אָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣י/ךָ שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: lpnym h'rts ysdt vm'shh ydykh shmym
verses.translation: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְ/אַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭/כֻלָּ/ם כַּ/בֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּ/לְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣/ם וְֽ/יַחֲלֹֽפוּ
verses.translit: hmh y'bdv v'th t'md vkhlm khbgd yblv khlbvsh tchlypm vychlpv
verses.translation: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה ה֑וּא וּ֝/שְׁנוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ
verses.translit: v'th hv' vshnvtykh l' ytmv
verses.translation: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁ/י אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כָל קְ֝רָבַ֗/י אֶת שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: ldvd brkhy npshy 't yhvh vkhl qrby 't shm qdshv
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁ/י אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אַל תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל גְּמוּלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: brkhy npshy 't yhvh v'l tshkhchy khl gmvlyv
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.original: הַ/סֹּלֵ֥חַ לְ/כָל עֲוֺנֵ֑/כִי הָ֝/רֹפֵ֗א לְ/כָל תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְ/כִי
verses.translit: hslch lkhl 'vnkhy hrp' lkhl tchl'ykhy
verses.translation: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

verses.original: הַ/גּוֹאֵ֣ל מִ/שַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְ/כִי הַֽ֝/מְעַטְּרֵ֗/כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְ/רַחֲמִֽים
verses.translit: hgv'l mshcht chyykhy hm'trkhy chsd vrchmym
verses.translation: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.original: הַ/מַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּ/טּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑/ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּ/נֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְ/כִי
verses.translit: hmshby' btvb 'dykh ttchdsh khnshr n'vrykhy
verses.translation: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝/מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְ/כָל עֲשׁוּקִֽים
verses.translit: 'shh tsdqvt yhvh vmshptym lkhl 'shvqym
verses.translation: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.original: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣י/ו לְ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָי/ו
verses.translit: yvdy' drkhyv lmshh lbny yshr'l 'lylvtyv
verses.translation: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

verses.original: רַח֣וּם וְ/חַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְ/רַב חָֽסֶד
verses.translit: rchvm vchnvn yhvh 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd
verses.translation: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.original: לֹֽא לָ/נֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְ/לֹ֖א לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר
verses.translit: l' lntsch yryb vl' l'vlm ytvr
verses.translation: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

verses.original: לֹ֣א כַ֭/חֲטָאֵי/נוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑/נוּ וְ/לֹ֥א כַ֝/עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗י/נוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: l' khcht'ynv 'shh lnv vl' kh'vntynv gml 'lynv
verses.translation: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כִ/גְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗/וֹ עַל יְרֵאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy khgbh shmym 'l h'rts gbr chsdv 'l yr'yv
verses.translation: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

verses.original: כִּ/רְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽ/מַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗/נּוּ אֶת פְּשָׁעֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khrchq mzrch mm'rb hrchyq mmnv 't psh'ynv
verses.translation: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.original: כְּ/רַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל יְרֵאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khrchm 'b 'l bnym rchm yhvh 'l yr'yv
verses.translation: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

verses.original: כִּי ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑/נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: khy hv' yd' ytsrnv zkhvr khy 'pr 'nchnv
verses.translation: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

verses.original: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּ/חָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑י/ו כְּ/צִ֥יץ הַ֝/שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ
verses.translit: 'nvsh khchtsyr ymyv khtsyts hshdh khn ytsyts
verses.translation: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה בּ֣/וֹ וְ/אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/לֹא יַכִּירֶ֖/נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy rvch 'brh bv v'ynnv vl' ykhyrnv 'vd mqvmv
verses.translation: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

verses.original: וְ/חֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה מֵ/עוֹלָ֣ם וְ/עַד ע֭וֹלָם עַל יְרֵאָ֑י/ו וְ֝/צִדְקָת֗/וֹ לִ/בְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים
verses.translit: vchsd yhvh m'vlm v'd 'vlm 'l yr'yv vtsdqtv lbny bnym
verses.translation: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

verses.original: לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑/וֹ וּ/לְ/זֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗י/ו לַ/עֲשׂוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lshmry brytv vlzkhry pqdyv l'shvtm
verses.translation: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭/שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑/וֹ וּ֝/מַלְכוּת֗/וֹ בַּ/כֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה
verses.translit: yhvh bshmym hkhyn khs'v vmlkhvtv bkhl mshlh
verses.translation: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥י/ו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑/וֹ לִ֝/שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּ/ק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brkhv yhvh ml'khyv gbry khch 'shy dbrv lshm' bqvl dbrv
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל צְבָאָ֑י/ו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗י/ו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brkhv yhvh khl tsb'yv mshrtyv 'shy rtsvnv
verses.translation: Bless ye the LORD , all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה כָּֽל מַעֲשָׂ֗י/ו בְּ/כָל מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑/וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: brkhv yhvh khl m'shyv bkhl mqmvt mmshltv brkhy npshy 't yhvh
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD , O my soul.

verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗/י אֶת יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַ/י גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְ/הָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ
verses.translit: brkhy npshy 't yhvh yhvh 'lhy gdlt m'd hvd vhdr lbsht
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.original: עֹֽטֶה א֭וֹר כַּ/שַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּ/יְרִיעָֽה
verses.translit: 'th 'vr khshlmh nvth shmym khyry'h
verses.translation: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.original: הַ֥/מְקָרֶֽה בַ/מַּ֗יִם עֲֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥י/ו הַ/שָּׂם עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑/וֹ הַֽ֝/מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: hmqrh bmym 'lyvtyv hshm 'bym rkhvbv hmhlkh 'l khnpy rvch
verses.translation: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣י/ו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗י/ו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט
verses.translit: 'shh ml'khyv rvchvt mshrtyv 'sh lht
verses.translation: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.original: יָֽסַד אֶ֭רֶץ עַל מְכוֹנֶ֑י/הָ בַּל תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: ysd 'rts 'l mkhvnyh bl tmvt 'vlm v'd
verses.translation: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

verses.original: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּ/לְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑/וֹ עַל הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: thvm khlbvsh khsytv 'l hrym y'mdv mym
verses.translation: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.original: מִן גַּעֲרָ֣תְ/ךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּ/ן מִן ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְ/ךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: mn g'rtkh ynvsvn mn qvl r'mkh ychpzvn
verses.translation: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

verses.original: יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: y'lv hrym yrdv bq'vt 'l mqvm zh ysdt lhm
verses.translation: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.original: גְּֽבוּל שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּ/ן בַּל יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּ/ן לְ/כַסּ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: gbvl shmt bl y'brvn bl yshvbvn lkhsvt h'rts
verses.translation: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.original: הַֽ/מְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּ/נְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hmshlch m'ynym bnchlym byn hrym yhlkhvn
verses.translation: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

verses.original: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל חַיְת֣/וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshqv khl chytv shdy yshbrv pr'ym tsm'm
verses.translation: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.original: עֲ֭לֵי/הֶם עוֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִ/בֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ קֽוֹל
verses.translit: 'lyhm 'vf hshmym yshkhvn mbyn 'p'ym ytnv qvl
verses.translation: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

verses.original: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵ/עֲלִיּוֹתָ֑י/ו מִ/פְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗י/ךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mshqh hrym m'lyvtyv mpry m'shykh tshb' h'rts
verses.translation: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

verses.original: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר לַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭/עֵשֶׂב לַ/עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָ/אָדָ֑ם לְ/ה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mtsmych chtsyr lbhmh v'shb l'bdt h'dm lhvtsy' lchm mn h'rts
verses.translation: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.original: וְ/יַ֤יִן יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְ/הַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝/לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyyn yshmch lbb 'nvsh lhtshyl pnym mshmn vlchm lbb 'nvsh ys'd
verses.translation: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע
verses.translit: yshb'v 'tsy yhvh 'rzy lbnvn 'shr nt'
verses.translation: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'shr shm tsprym yqnnv chsydh brvshym byth
verses.translation: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

verses.original: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭/גְּבֹהִים לַ/יְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽ/שְׁפַנִּֽים
verses.translit: hrym hgbhym ly'lym sl'ym mchsh lshpnym
verses.translation: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

verses.original: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְ/מוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shh yrch lmv'dym shmsh yd' mbv'v
verses.translation: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.original: תָּֽשֶׁת חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣/יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽ/וֹ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל חַיְת/וֹ יָֽעַר
verses.translit: tsht chshkh vyhy lylh bv trmsh khl chytv y'r
verses.translation: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .

verses.original: הַ֭/כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַ/טָּ֑רֶף וּ/לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵ/אֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hkhpyrym sh'gym ltrf vlbqsh m'l 'khlm
verses.translation: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

verses.original: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭/שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּ/ן וְ/אֶל מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗/ם יִרְבָּצֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: tzrch hshmsh y'spvn v'l m'vntm yrbtsvn
verses.translation: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.original: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְ/פָעֳל֑/וֹ וְֽ/לַ/עֲבֹ֖דָת֣/וֹ עֲדֵי עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: yts' 'dm lp'lv vl'bdtv 'dy 'rb
verses.translation: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.original: מָֽה רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨י/ךָ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּ/ם בְּ/חָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mh rbv m'shykh yhvh khlm bchkhmh 'shyt ml'h h'rts qnynkh
verses.translation: O LORD , how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה הַ/יָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּ/רְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְ/אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם גְּדֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: zh hym gdvl vrchb ydym shm rmsh v'yn mspr chyvt qtnvt 'm gdlvt
verses.translation: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.original: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּ/ן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְ/שַֽׂחֶק בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shm 'nyvt yhlkhvn lvytn zh ytsrt lshchq bv
verses.translation: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

verses.original: כֻּ֭לָּ/ם אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּ/ן לָ/תֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣/ם בְּ/עִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khlm 'lykh yshbrvn ltt 'khlm b'tv
verses.translation: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭/הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּ/ן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְ/ךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ/ן טֽוֹב
verses.translit: ttn lhm ylqtvn tptch ydkh yshb'vn tvb
verses.translation: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

verses.original: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶי/ךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּ/ן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָ/ם יִגְוָע֑וּ/ן וְֽ/אֶל עֲפָרָ֥/ם יְשׁוּבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: tstyr pnykh ybhlvn tsf rvchm ygv'vn v'l 'prm yshvbvn
verses.translation: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲ/ךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּ/ן וּ֝/תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: tshlch rvchkh ybr'vn vtchdsh pny 'dmh
verses.translation: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.original: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/מַעֲשָֽׂי/ו
verses.translit: yhy khbvd yhvh l'vlm yshmch yhvh bm'shyv
verses.translation: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

verses.original: הַ/מַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭/אָרֶץ וַ/תִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּ/הָרִ֣ים וְֽ/יֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ
verses.translit: hmbyt l'rts vtr'd yg' bhrym vy'shnv
verses.translation: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

verses.original: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַ/יהוָ֣ה בְּ/חַיָּ֑/י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵ/אלֹהַ֣/י בְּ/עוֹדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shyrh lyhvh bchyy 'zmrh l'lhy b'vdy
verses.translation: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.original: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣י/ו שִׂיחִ֑/י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: y'rb 'lyv shychy 'nkhy 'shmch byhvh
verses.translation: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD .

verses.original: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים מִן הָ/אָ֡רֶץ וּ/רְשָׁעִ֤ים ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗/ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁ/י אֶת יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: ytmv cht'ym mn h'rts vrsh'ym 'vd 'ynm brkhy npshy 't yhvh hllv yh
verses.translation: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD , O my soul. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭/יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּ/שְׁמ֑/וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝/עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lylvtyv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD ; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭/וֹ זַמְּרוּ ל֑/וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּ/כָל נִפְלְאוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shyrv lv zmrv lv shychv bkhl npl'vtyv
verses.translation: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.original: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hthllv bshm qdshv yshmch lb mbqshy yhvh
verses.translation: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְ/עֻזּ֑/וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣י/ו תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: drshv yhvh v'zv bqshv pnyv tmyd
verses.translation: Seek the LORD , and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥י/ו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗י/ו וּ/מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽי/ו
verses.translit: zkhrv npl'vtyv 'shr 'shh mptyv vmshpty pyv
verses.translation: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.original: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑/וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽי/ו
verses.translit: zr' 'brhm 'bdv bny y'qb bchyryv
verses.translation: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.original: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ בְּ/כָל הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hv' yhvh 'lhynv bkhl h'rts mshptyv
verses.translation: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.original: זָכַ֣ר לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִית֑/וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְ/אֶ֣לֶף דּֽוֹר
verses.translit: zkhr l'vlm brytv dbr tsvh l'lf dvr
verses.translation: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּ/שְׁב֖וּעָת֣/וֹ לְ/יִשְׂחָֽק
verses.translit: 'shr khrt 't 'brhm vshbv'tv lyshchq
verses.translation: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣/הָ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֣ב לְ/חֹ֑ק לְ֝/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mydh ly'qb lchq lyshr'l bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לְ/ךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l'mr lkh 'tn 't 'rts khn'n chbl nchltkhm
verses.translation: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.original: בִּֽ֭/הְיוֹתָ/ם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝/מְעַ֗ט וְ/גָרִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bhyvtm mty mspr khm't vgrym bh
verses.translation: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִ/גּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי מִ֝/מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vythlkhv mgvy 'l gvy mmmlkhh 'l 'm 'chr
verses.translation: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.original: לֹֽא הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְ/עָשְׁקָ֑/ם וַ/יּ֖וֹכַח עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים
verses.translit: l' hnych 'dm l'shqm vyvkhch 'lyhm mlkhym
verses.translation: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.original: אַֽל תִּגְּע֥וּ בִ/מְשִׁיחָ֑/י וְ֝/לִ/נְבִיאַ/י אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'l tg'v bmshychy vlnby'y 'l tr'v
verses.translation: Saying , Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל מַטֵּה לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר
verses.translit: vyqr' r'b 'l h'rts khl mth lchm shbr
verses.translation: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝/עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: shlch lpnyhm 'ysh l'bd nmkhr yvsf
verses.translation: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

verses.original: עִנּ֣וּ בַ/כֶּ֣בֶל רגלי/ו רַגְל֑/וֹ בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'nv bkhbl rglyv rglv brzl b'h npshv
verses.translation: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.original: עַד עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא דְבָר֑/וֹ אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'd 't b' dbrv 'mrt yhvh tsrpthv
verses.translation: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַ/יַּתִּירֵ֑/הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽ/יְפַתְּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: shlch mlkh vytyrhv mshl 'mym vyptchhv
verses.translation: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.original: שָׂמ֣/וֹ אָד֣וֹן לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ וּ֝/מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּ/כָל קִנְיָנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shmv 'dvn lbytv vmshl bkhl qnynv
verses.translation: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.original: לֶ/אְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣י/ו בְּ/נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/זְקֵנָ֥י/ו יְחַכֵּֽם
verses.translit: l'sr shryv bnpshv vzqnyv ychkhm
verses.translation: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝/יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ חָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' yshr'l mtsrym vy'qb gr b'rts chm
verses.translation: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּ֣פֶר אֶת עַמּ֣/וֹ מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝/יַּֽעֲצִמֵ/הוּ מִ/צָּרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vypr 't 'mv m'd vy'tsmhv mtsryv
verses.translation: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּ/ם לִ/שְׂנֹ֣א עַמּ֑/וֹ לְ֝/הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּ/עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hpkh lbm lshn' 'mv lhtnkhl b'bdyv
verses.translation: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.original: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֑/וֹ אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shlch mshh 'bdv 'hrn 'shr bchr bv
verses.translation: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.original: שָֽׂמוּ בָ֭/ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתוֹתָ֑י/ו וּ֝/מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם
verses.translit: shmv bm dbry 'tvtyv vmptym b'rts chm
verses.translation: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.original: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַ/יַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְ/לֹֽא מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת דברו/ו דְּבָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shlch chshkh vychshkh vl' mrv 't dbrvv dbrv
verses.translation: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.original: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת מֵימֵי/הֶ֣ם לְ/דָ֑ם וַ֝/יָּ֗מֶת אֶת דְּגָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hpkh 't mymyhm ldm vymt 't dgtm
verses.translation: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.original: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣/ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝/חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shrts 'rtsm tsprd'ym bchdry mlkhyhm
verses.translation: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַ/יָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּ/כָל גְּבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mr vyb' 'rb khnym bkhl gbvlm
verses.translation: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

verses.original: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵי/הֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָב֣וֹת בְּ/אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ntn gshmyhm brd 'sh lhbvt b'rtsm
verses.translation: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָ/ם וּ/תְאֵנָתָ֑/ם וַ֝/יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykh gpnm vt'ntm vyshbr 'ts gbvlm
verses.translation: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.original: אָ֭מַר וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝/יֶ֗לֶק וְ/אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: 'mr vyb' 'rbh vylq v'yn mspr
verses.translation: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל כָּל עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּ/אַרְצָ֑/ם וַ֝/יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'khl khl 'shb b'rtsm vy'khl pry 'dmtm
verses.translation: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ כָּל בְּכ֣וֹר בְּ/אַרְצָ֑/ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְ/כָל אוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykh khl bkhvr b'rtsm r'shyt lkhl 'vnm
verses.translation: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יּוֹצִיאֵ/ם בְּ/כֶ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֑ב וְ/אֵ֖ין בִּ/שְׁבָטָ֣י/ו כּוֹשֵֽׁל
verses.translit: vyvtsy'm bkhsf vzhb v'yn bshbtyv khvshl
verses.translation: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.original: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּ/צֵאתָ֑/ם כִּֽי נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣/ם עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shmch mtsrym bts'tm khy npl pchdm 'lyhm
verses.translation: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.original: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְ/מָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝/אֵ֗שׁ לְ/הָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: prsh 'nn lmskh v'sh lh'yr lylh
verses.translation: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.original: שָׁאַ֣ל וַ/יָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְ/לֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: sh'l vyb' shlv vlchm shmym yshby'm
verses.translation: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.original: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַ/יָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּ/צִּיּ֥וֹת נָהָֽר
verses.translit: ptch tsvr vyzvbv mym hlkhv btsyvt nhr
verses.translation: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.original: כִּֽי זָ֭כַר אֶת דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ אֶֽת אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy zkhr 't dbr qdshv 't 'brhm 'bdv
verses.translation: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֣א עַמּ֣/וֹ בְ/שָׂשׂ֑וֹן בְּ֝/רִנָּ֗ה אֶת בְּחִירָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyvts' 'mv bshshvn brnh 't bchyryv
verses.translation: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭/הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַ/עֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: vytn lhm 'rtsvt gvym v'ml l'mym yyrshv
verses.translation: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

verses.original: בַּ/עֲב֤וּר יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּי/ו וְ/תוֹרֹתָ֥י/ו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: b'bvr yshmrv chqyv vtvrtyv yntsrv hllv yh
verses.translation: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַֽלְלוּ יָ֨הּ הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hllv yh hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my ymll gbvrvt yhvh yshmy' khl thltv
verses.translation: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD ? who can shew forth all his praise?

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְ/כָל עֵֽת
verses.translit: 'shry shmry mshpt 'shh tsdqh bkhl 't
verses.translation: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

verses.original: זָכְרֵ֣/נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּ/רְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑/ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗/נִי בִּ/ישׁוּעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: zkhrny yhvh brtsvn 'mkh pqdny byshv'tkh
verses.translation: Remember me, O LORD , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

verses.original: לִ/רְא֤וֹת בְּ/ט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗י/ךָ לִ֭/שְׂמֹחַ בְּ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑/ךָ לְ֝/הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם נַחֲלָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lr'vt btvbt bchyrykh lshmch bshmcht gvykh lhthll 'm nchltkh
verses.translation: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם אֲבוֹתֵ֗י/נוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: cht'nv 'm 'bvtynv h'vynv hrsh'nv
verses.translation: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.original: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤י/נוּ בְ/מִצְרַ֨יִם לֹא הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יַּמְר֖וּ עַל יָ֣ם בְּ/יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: 'bvtynv bmtsrym l' hshkhylv npl'vtykh l' zkhrv 't rb chsdykh vymrv 'l ym bym svf
verses.translation: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יּוֹשִׁיעֵ/ם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑/וֹ לְ֝/הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת גְּבוּרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyvshy'm lm'n shmv lhvdy' 't gbvrtv
verses.translation: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְעַ֣ר בְּ/יַם ס֭וּף וַֽ/יֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַ/יּוֹלִיכֵ֥/ם בַּ֝/תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vyg'r bym svf vychrb vyvlykhm bthmvt khmdbr
verses.translation: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יּוֹשִׁיעֵ/ם מִ/יַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝/יִּגְאָלֵ֗/ם מִ/יַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: vyvshy'm myd shvn' vyg'lm myd 'vyb
verses.translation: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַסּוּ מַ֥יִם צָרֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝/הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר
verses.translit: vykhsv mym tsryhm 'chd mhm l' nvtr
verses.translation: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.original: וַ/יַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִ/דְבָרָ֑י/ו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mynv bdbryv yshyrv thltv
verses.translation: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.original: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑י/ו לֹֽא חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַ/עֲצָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mhrv shkhchv m'shyv l' chkhv l'tstv
verses.translation: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ/יְנַסּוּ אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽ/ישִׁימֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyt'vv t'vh bmdbr vynsv 'l byshymvn
verses.translation: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭/הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑/ם וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּ/נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vytn lhm sh'ltm vyshlch rzvn bnpshm
verses.translation: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.original: וַ/יְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭/מֹשֶׁה בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝/אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqn'v lmshh bmchnh l'hrn qdvsh yhvh
verses.translation: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD .

verses.original: תִּפְתַּח אֶ֭רֶץ וַ/תִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝/תְּכַ֗ס עַל עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם
verses.translit: tptch 'rts vtbl' dtn vtkhs 'l 'dt 'byrm
verses.translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְעַר אֵ֥שׁ בַּ/עֲדָתָ֑/ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: vtb'r 'sh b'dtm lhbh tlht rsh'ym
verses.translation: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.original: יַעֲשׂוּ עֵ֥גֶל בְּ/חֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝/יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְ/מַסֵּכָֽה
verses.translit: y'shv 'gl bchrb vyshtchvv lmskhh
verses.translation: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.original: וַ/יָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדָ֑/ם בְּ/תַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב
verses.translit: vymyrv 't khbvdm btbnyt shvr 'khl 'shb
verses.translation: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.original: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑/ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: shkhchv 'l mvshy'm 'shh gdlvt bmtsrym
verses.translation: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.original: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: npl'vt b'rts chm nvr'vt 'l ym svf
verses.translation: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽ/הַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥/ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗/וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּ/פֶּ֣רֶץ לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗/וֹ מֵֽ/הַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: vy'mr lhshmydm lvly mshh bchyrv 'md bprts lpnyv lhshyb chmtv mhshchyt
verses.translation: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them .

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִ/דְבָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vym'sv b'rts chmdh l' h'mynv ldbrv
verses.translation: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyrgnv b'hlyhm l' shm'v bqvl yhvh
verses.translation: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣/וֹ לָ/הֶ֑ם לְ/הַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vysh' ydv lhm lhpyl 'vtm bmdbr
verses.translation: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָ/ם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝/לְ/זָרוֹתָ֗/ם בָּ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vlhpyl zr'm bgvym vlzrvtm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.original: וַ֭/יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְ/בַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝/יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים
verses.translit: vytsmdv lb'l p'vr vy'khlv zbchy mtym
verses.translation: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּ/מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/תִּפְרָץ בָּ֝֗/ם מַגֵּפָֽה
verses.translit: vykh'ysv bm'llyhm vtprts bm mgph
verses.translation: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַ/יְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝/תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַ/מַּגֵּפָֽה
verses.translit: vy'md pynchs vypll vt'tsr hmgph
verses.translation: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭/וֹ לִ/צְדָקָ֑ה לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ֝/דֹ֗ר עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vtchshb lv ltsdqh ldr vdr 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֥רַע לְ֝/מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּ/עֲבוּרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqtsypv 'l my mrybh vyr' lmshh b'bvrm
verses.translation: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.original: כִּֽי הִמְר֥וּ אֶת רוּח֑/וֹ וַ֝/יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּ/שְׂפָתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy hmrv 't rvchv vybt' bshptyv
verses.translation: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.original: לֹֽא הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l' hshmydv 't h'mym 'shr 'mr yhvh lhm
verses.translation: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝/יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyt'rbv bgvym vylmdv m'shyhm
verses.translation: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ לָ/הֶ֣ם לְ/מוֹקֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'bdv 't 'tsbyhm vyhyv lhm lmvqsh
verses.translation: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת בְּ֭נֵי/הֶם וְ/אֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם לַ/שֵּֽׁדִים
verses.translit: vyzbchv 't bnyhm v't bnvtyhm lshdym
verses.translation: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם בְּנֵ֘י/הֶ֤ם וּֽ/בְנוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַ/עֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַ/תֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ בַּ/דָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyshpkhv dm nqy dm bnyhm vbnvtyhm 'shr zbchv l'tsby khn'n vtchnf h'rts bdmym
verses.translation: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.original: וַ/יִּטְמְא֥וּ בְ/מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם וַ֝/יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּ/מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytm'v bm'shyhm vyznv bm'llyhm
verses.translation: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/עַמּ֑/וֹ וַ֝/יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh b'mv vyt'b 't nchltv
verses.translation: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם בְּ/יַד גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ/יִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝/הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytnm byd gvym vymshlv bhm shn'yhm
verses.translation: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְחָצ֥וּ/ם אוֹיְבֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ֝/יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vylchtsvm 'vybyhm vykhn'v tcht ydm
verses.translation: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.original: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥/ם וְ֭/הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַ/עֲצָתָ֑/ם וַ֝/יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּ/עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: p'mym rbvt ytsylm vhmh ymrv b'tstm vymkhv b'vnm
verses.translation: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.translit: vyr' btsr lhm bshm'v 't rntm
verses.translation: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑/וֹ וַ֝/יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּ/רֹ֣ב חסד/ו חֲסָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyzkhr lhm brytv vynchm khrb chsdv chsdyv
verses.translation: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣/ם לְ/רַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝/פְנֵ֗י כָּל שׁוֹבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytn 'vtm lrchmym lpny khl shvbyhm
verses.translation: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.original: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨/נוּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ וְ/קַבְּצֵ/נוּ֮ מִֽן הַ/גּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭/הֹדוֹת לְ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑/ךָ לְ֝/הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּ/תְהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hvshy'nv yhvh 'lhynv vqbtsnv mn hgvym lhdvt lshm qdshkh lhshtbch bthltkh
verses.translation: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן הָ֤/עוֹלָ֨ם וְ/עַ֬ד הָ/עוֹלָ֗ם וְ/אָמַ֖ר כָּל הָ/עָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l mn h'vlm v'd h'vlm v'mr khl h'm 'mn hllv yh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD , for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗/ם מִ/יַּד צָֽר
verses.translit: y'mrv g'vly yhvh 'shr g'lm myd tsr
verses.translation: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.original: וּֽ/מֵ/אֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥/ם מִ/מִּזְרָ֥ח וּ/מִֽ/מַּעֲרָ֑ב מִ/צָּפ֥וֹן וּ/מִ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vm'rtsvt qbtsm mmzrch vmm'rb mtspvn vmym
verses.translation: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.original: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭/מִּדְבָּר בִּ/ישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: t'v bmdbr byshymvn drkh 'yr mvshb l' mts'v
verses.translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.original: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗/ם בָּ/הֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף
verses.translit: r'bym gm tsm'ym npshm bhm tt'tf
verses.translation: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּ/צַּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם מִ֝/מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyts'qv 'l yhvh btsr lhm mmtsvqvtyhm ytsylm
verses.translation: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּֽדְרִיכֵ/ם בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝/לֶ֗כֶת אֶל עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב
verses.translit: vydrykhm bdrkh yshrh llkht 'l 'yr mvshb
verses.translation: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו לִ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yvdv lyhvh chsdv vnpl'vtyv lbny 'dm
verses.translation: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.original: כִּי הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא טֽוֹב
verses.translit: khy hshby' npsh shqqh vnpsh r'bh ml' tvb
verses.translation: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.original: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ/צַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּ/בַרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: yshby chshkh vtslmvt 'syry 'ny vbrzl
