verses.translation: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

verses.original: כִּֽי הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי אֵ֑ל וַ/עֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ
verses.translit: khy hmrv 'mry 'l v'tst 'lyvn n'tsv
verses.translation: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּ/עָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑/ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְ/אֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר
verses.translit: vykhn' b'ml lbm khshlv v'yn 'zr
verses.translation: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּ/צַּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם מִ֝/מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyz'qv 'l yhvh btsr lhm mmtsqvtyhm yvshy'm
verses.translation: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.original: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵ/ם מֵ/חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ/צַלְמָ֑וֶת וּ/מוֹסְר֖וֹתֵי/הֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק
verses.translit: yvtsy'm mchshkh vtslmvt vmvsrvtyhm yntq
verses.translation: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו לִ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yvdv lyhvh chsdv vnpl'vtyv lbny 'dm
verses.translation: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.original: כִּֽי שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּ/בְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: khy shbr dltvt nchsht vbrychy brzl gd'
verses.translation: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים מִ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑/ם וּֽ֝/מֵ/עֲוֺֽנֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ
verses.translit: 'vlym mdrkh psh'm vm'vntyhm yt'nv
verses.translation: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.original: כָּל אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וַ֝/יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: khl 'khl tt'b npshm vygy'v 'd sh'ry mvt
verses.translation: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּ/צַּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם מִ֝/מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyz'qv 'l yhvh btsr lhm mmtsqvtyhm yvshy'm
verses.translation: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָר/וֹ וְ/יִרְפָּאֵ֑/ם וִֽ֝/ימַלֵּ֗ט מִ/שְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshlch dbrv vyrp'm vymlt mshchytvtm
verses.translation: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו לִ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yvdv lyhvh chsdv vnpl'vtyv lbny 'dm
verses.translation: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.original: וְ֭/יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽ/יסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣י/ו בְּ/רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: vyzbchv zbchy tvdh vysprv m'shyv brnh
verses.translation: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.original: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭/יָּם בָּ/אֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּ/מַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: yvrdy hym b'nyvt 'shy ml'khh bmym rbym
verses.translation: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו בִּ/מְצוּלָֽה
verses.translit: hmh r'v m'shy yhvh vnpl'vtyv bmtsvlh
verses.translation: These see the works of the LORD , and his wonders in the deep.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭/יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַ/תְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr vy'md rvch s'rh vtrvmm glyv
verses.translation: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

verses.original: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗/ם בְּ/רָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג
verses.translit: y'lv shmym yrdv thvmvt npshm br'h ttmvgg
verses.translation: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.original: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭/יָנוּעוּ כַּ/שִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְ/כָל חָ֝כְמָתָ֗/ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע
verses.translit: ychvgv vynv'v khshkhvr vkhl chkhmtm ttbl'
verses.translation: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּ/צַּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם וּֽ֝/מִ/מְּצֽוּקֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyts'qv 'l yhvh btsr lhm vmmtsvqtyhm yvtsy'm
verses.translation: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

verses.original: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִ/דְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝/יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: yqm s'rh ldmmh vychshv glyhm
verses.translation: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝/יַּנְחֵ֗/ם אֶל מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshmchv khy yshtqv vynchm 'l mchvz chptsm
verses.translation: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗י/ו לִ/בְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yvdv lyhvh chsdv vnpl'vtyv lbny 'dm
verses.translation: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.original: וִֽ֭/ירֹמְמוּ/הוּ בִּ/קְהַל עָ֑ם וּ/בְ/מוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyrmmvhv bqhl 'm vbmvshb zqnym yhllvhv
verses.translation: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְ/מִדְבָּ֑ר וּ/מֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְ/צִמָּאֽוֹן
verses.translit: yshm nhrvt lmdbr vmts'y mym ltsm'vn
verses.translation: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִ/מְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝/רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'rts pry lmlchh mr't yshby bh
verses.translation: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽ/אֲגַם מַ֑יִם וְ/אֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְ/מֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: yshm mdbr l'gm mym v'rts tsyh lmts'y mym
verses.translation: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝/יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב
verses.translit: vyvshb shm r'bym vykhvnnv 'yr mvshb
verses.translation: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַ/יִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝/יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה
verses.translit: vyzr'v shdvt vyt'v khrmym vy'shv pry tbv'h
verses.translation: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָרֲכֵ֣/ם וַ/יִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝/בְהֶמְתָּ֗/ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט
verses.translit: vybrkhm vyrbv m'd vbhmtm l' ym'yt
verses.translation: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַ/יָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵ/עֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְ/יָגֽוֹן
verses.translit: vym'tv vyshchv m'tsr r'h vygvn
verses.translation: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.original: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝/יַּתְעֵ֗/ם בְּ/תֹ֣הוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: shpkh bvz 'l ndybym vyt'm bthv l' drkh
verses.translation: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵ/ע֑וֹנִי וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝/צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyshgb 'byvn m'vny vyshm khts'n mshpchvt
verses.translation: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְ/יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ/כָל עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: yr'v yshrym vyshmchv vkhl 'vlh qptsh pyh
verses.translation: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.original: מִי חָכָ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁמָר אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝/יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: my chkhm vyshmr 'lh vytbvnnv chsdy yhvh
verses.translation: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: shyr mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣/י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝/אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף כְּבוֹדִֽ/י
verses.translit: nkhvn lby 'lhym 'shyrh v'zmrh 'f khbvdy
verses.translation: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.original: ע֭וּרָֽ/ה הַ/נֵּ֥בֶל וְ/כִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר
verses.translit: 'vrh hnbl vkhnvr ''yrh shchr
verses.translation: I will praise thee, O LORD , among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.original: אוֹדְ/ךָ֖ בָ/עַמִּ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝/אֲזַמֶּרְ/ךָ֗ בַּל אֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'vdkh b'mym yhvh v'zmrkh bl 'mym
verses.translation: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.original: כִּֽי גָד֣וֹל מֵֽ/עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְֽ/עַד שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy gdvl m'l shmym chsdkh v'd shchqym 'mtkh
verses.translation: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.original: ר֣וּמָ/ה עַל שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: rvmh 'l shmym 'lhym v'l khl h'rts khbvdkh
verses.translation: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּ/ן יְדִידֶ֑י/ךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָ/ה יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֣ וַ/עֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: lm'n ychltsvn ydydykh hvshy'h ymynkh v'nny
verses.translation: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּ/קָדְשׁ֗/וֹ אֶעְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְ/עֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד
verses.translit: 'lhym dbr bqdshv ''lzh 'chlqh shkhm v'mq skhvt 'mdd
verses.translation: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.original: לִ֤/י גִלְעָ֨ד לִ֤/י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭/אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑/י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽ/י
verses.translit: ly gl'd ly mnshh v'prym m'vz r'shy yhvdh mchqqy
verses.translation: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗/י עַל אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑/י עֲלֵֽי פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע
verses.translit: mv'b syr rchtsy 'l 'dvm 'shlykh n'ly 'ly plsht 'trv''
verses.translation: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵ/נִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣/נִי עַד אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: my yblny 'yr mbtsr my nchny 'd 'dvm
verses.translation: Wilt not thou , O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא אֱלֹהִ֥ים זְנַחְתָּ֑/נוּ וְֽ/לֹא תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּ/צִבְאֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hl' 'lhym znchtnv vl' tts' 'lhym btsb'tynv
verses.translation: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.original: הָֽבָ/ה לָּ֣/נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִ/צָּ֑ר וְ֝/שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם
verses.translit: hbh lnv 'zrt mtsr vshv' tshv't 'dm
verses.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ לְ/דָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗/י אַֽל תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd mzmvr 'lhy thlty 'l tchrsh
verses.translation: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.original: כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽ/פִי מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣/י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗/י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: khy py rsh' vpy mrmh 'ly ptchv dbrv 'ty lshvn shqr
verses.translation: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.original: וְ/דִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּ/נִי וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּ/נִי חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: vdbry shn'h sbbvny vylchmvny chnm
verses.translation: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת אַהֲבָתִ֥/י יִשְׂטְנ֗וּ/נִי וַ/אֲנִ֥י תְפִלָּֽה
verses.translit: tcht 'hbty yshtnvny v'ny tplh
verses.translation: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֘שִׂ֤ימוּ עָלַ֣/י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה וְ֝/שִׂנְאָ֗ה תַּ֣חַת אַהֲבָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshymv 'ly r'h tcht tvbh vshn'h tcht 'hbty
verses.translation: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.original: הַפְקֵ֣ד עָלָ֣י/ו רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝/שָׂטָ֗ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד עַל יְמִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hpqd 'lyv rsh' vshtn y'md 'l ymynv
verses.translation: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.translit: bhshptv yts' rsh' vtpltv thyh lcht'h
verses.translation: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.original: יִֽהְיֽוּ יָמָ֥י/ו מְעַטִּ֑ים פְּ֝קֻדָּת֗/וֹ יִקַּ֥ח אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: yhyv ymyv m'tym pqdtv yqch 'chr
verses.translation: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ בָנָ֥י/ו יְתוֹמִ֑ים וְ֝/אִשְׁתּ/וֹ אַלְמָנָֽה
verses.translit: yhyv bnyv ytvmym v'shtv 'lmnh
verses.translation: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.original: וְ/נ֤וֹעַ יָנ֣וּעוּ בָנָ֣י/ו וְ/שִׁאֵ֑לוּ וְ֝/דָרְשׁ֗וּ מֵ/חָרְבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vnv' ynv'v bnyv vsh'lv vdrshv mchrbvtyhm
verses.translation: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.original: יְנַקֵּ֣שׁ נ֭וֹשֶׁה לְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ וְ/יָבֹ֖זּוּ זָרִ֣ים יְגִיעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ynqsh nvshh lkhl 'shr lv vybzv zrym ygy'v
verses.translation: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.original: אַל יְהִי ל֭/וֹ מֹשֵׁ֣ךְ חָ֑סֶד וְֽ/אַל יְהִ֥י ח֝וֹנֵ֗ן לִ/יתוֹמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l yhy lv mshkh chsd v'l yhy chvnn lytvmyv
verses.translation: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.original: יְהִֽי אַחֲרִית֥/וֹ לְ/הַכְרִ֑ית בְּ/ד֥וֹר אַ֝חֵ֗ר יִמַּ֥ח שְׁמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhy 'chrytv lhkhryt bdvr 'chr ymch shmm
verses.translation: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.original: יִזָּכֵ֤ר עֲוֺ֣ן אֲ֭בֹתָי/ו אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/חַטַּ֥את אִ֝מּ֗/וֹ אַל תִּמָּֽח
verses.translit: yzkhr 'vn 'btyv 'l yhvh vcht't 'mv 'l tmch
verses.translation: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD ; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.original: יִהְי֣וּ נֶֽגֶד יְהוָ֣ה תָּמִ֑יד וְ/יַכְרֵ֖ת מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhyv ngd yhvh tmyd vykhrt m'rts zkhrm
verses.translation: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹ֥א זָכַר֮ עֲשׂ֪וֹת חָ֥סֶד וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ עָנִ֣י וְ֭/אֶבְיוֹן וְ/נִכְאֵ֨ה לֵבָ֬ב לְ/מוֹתֵֽת
verses.translit: y'n 'shr l' zkhr 'shvt chsd vyrdf 'ysh 'ny v'byvn vnkh'h lbb lmvtt
verses.translation: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֣ב קְ֭לָלָה וַ/תְּבוֹאֵ֑/הוּ וְֽ/לֹא חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ֝/בְרָכָ֗ה וַ/תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'hb qllh vtbv'hv vl' chpts bbrkhh vtrchq mmnv
verses.translation: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.translit: vylbsh qllh khmdv vtb' khmym bqrbv vkhshmn b'tsmvtyv
verses.translation: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.original: תְּהִי ל֭/וֹ כְּ/בֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝/לְ/מֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: thy lv khbgd y'th vlmzch tmyd ychgrh
verses.translation: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.original: זֹ֤את פְּעֻלַּ֣ת שֹׂ֭טְנַ/י מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הַ/דֹּבְרִ֥ים רָ֝֗ע עַל נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: z't p'lt shtny m't yhvh vhdbrym r' 'l npshy
verses.translation: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD , and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה יְה֘וִ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֗/י עֲֽשֵׂה אִ֭תִּ/י לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב חַ֝סְדְּ/ךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'dny 'shh 'ty lm'n shmkh khy tvb chsdkh htsylny
verses.translation: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָנִ֣י וְ/אֶבְי֣וֹן אָנֹ֑כִי וְ֝/לִבִּ֗/י חָלַ֥ל בְּ/קִרְבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'ny v'byvn 'nkhy vlby chll bqrby
verses.translation: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.original: כְּ/צֵל כִּ/נְטוֹת֥/וֹ נֶהֱלָ֑כְתִּי נִ֝נְעַ֗רְתִּי כָּֽ/אַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: khtsl khntvtv nhlkhty nn'rty kh'rbh
verses.translation: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.translit: brkhy khshlv mtsvm vbshry khchsh mshmn
verses.translation: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י הָיִ֣יתִי חֶרְפָּ֣ה לָ/הֶ֑ם יִ֝רְא֗וּ/נִי יְנִיע֥וּ/ן רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: v'ny hyyty chrph lhm yr'vny yny'vn r'shm
verses.translation: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.original: עָ֭זְרֵ/נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵ֣/נִי כְ/חַסְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'zrny yhvh 'lhy hvshy'ny khchsdkh
verses.translation: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.original: וְֽ֭/יֵדְעוּ כִּי יָ֣דְ/ךָ זֹּ֑את אַתָּ֖ה יְהוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyd'v khy ydkh z't 'th yhvh 'shyth
verses.translation: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD , hast done it.

verses.original: יְקַֽלְלוּ הֵמָּה֮ וְ/אַתָּ֪ה תְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ קָ֤מוּ וַ/יֵּבֹ֗שׁוּ וְֽ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ יִשְׂמָֽח
verses.translit: yqllv hmh v'th tbrkh qmv vybshv v'bdkh yshmch
verses.translation: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.original: יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שׂוֹטְנַ֣/י כְּלִמָּ֑ה וְ/יַעֲט֖וּ כַ/מְעִ֣יל בָּשְׁתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: ylbshv shvtny khlmh vy'tv khm'yl bshtm
verses.translation: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.original: א֘וֹדֶ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה מְאֹ֣ד בְּ/פִ֑/י וּ/בְ/ת֖וֹךְ רַבִּ֣ים אֲהַֽלְלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'vdh yhvh m'd bpy vbtvkh rbym 'hllnv
verses.translation: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַ֭עֲמֹד לִ/ימִ֣ין אֶבְי֑וֹן לְ֝/הוֹשִׁ֗יעַ מִ/שֹּׁפְטֵ֥י נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy y'md lymyn 'byvn lhvshy' mshpty npshv
verses.translation: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה לַֽ/אדֹנִ֗/י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽ/ימִינִ֑/י עַד אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗י/ךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְ/רַגְלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ldvd mzmvr n'm yhvh l'dny shb lymyny 'd 'shyt 'ybykh hdm lrglykh
verses.translation: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.original: מַטֵּֽה עֻזְּ/ךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִ/צִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mth 'zkh yshlch yhvh mtsyvn rdh bqrb 'ybykh
verses.translation: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.original: עַמְּ/ךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּ/י֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥/ךָ בְּֽ/הַדְרֵי קֹ֭דֶשׁ מֵ/רֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝/ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'mkh ndbt byvm chylkh bhdry qdsh mrchm mshchr lkh tl yldtykh
verses.translation: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה וְ/לֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה כֹהֵ֥ן לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם עַל דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh vl' ynchm 'th khhn l'vlm 'l dbrty mlkhy tsdq
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥/י עַל יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ בְּ/יוֹם אַפּ֣/וֹ מְלָכִֽים
verses.translit: 'dny 'l ymynkh mchts byvm 'pv mlkhym
verses.translation: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭/גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: ydyn bgvym ml' gvyvt mchts r'sh 'l 'rts rbh
verses.translation: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.original: מִ֭/נַּחַל בַּ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: mnchl bdrkh yshth 'l khn yrym r'sh
verses.translation: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּ/כָל לֵבָ֑ב בְּ/ס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: hllv yh 'vdh yhvh bkhl lbb bsvd yshrym v'dh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.original: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְ/כָל חֶפְצֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: gdlym m'shy yhvh drvshym lkhl chptsyhm
verses.translation: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.original: הוֹד וְ/הָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑/וֹ וְ֝/צִדְקָת֗/וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: hvd vhdr p'lv vtsdqtv 'mdt l'd
verses.translation: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְ/נִפְלְאֹתָ֑י/ו חַנּ֖וּן וְ/רַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: zkhr 'shh lnpl'tyv chnvn vrchvm yhvh
verses.translation: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.original: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽ/ירֵאָ֑י/ו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: trf ntn lyr'yv yzkhr l'vlm brytv
verses.translation: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.original: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂי/ו הִגִּ֣יד לְ/עַמּ֑/וֹ לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ֝/הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: khch m'shyv hgyd l'mv ltt lhm nchlt gvym
verses.translation: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָי/ו אֱמֶ֣ת וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל פִּקּוּדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: m'shy ydyv 'mt vmshpt n'mnym khl pqvdyv
verses.translation: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

verses.original: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָ/עַ֣ד לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּ/אֱמֶ֥ת וְ/יָשָֽׁר
verses.translit: smvkhym l'd l'vlm 'shvym b'mt vyshr
verses.translation: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.original: פְּד֤וּת שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְ/עַמּ֗/וֹ צִוָּֽה לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑/וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְ/נוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pdvt shlch l'mv tsvh l'vlm brytv qdvsh vnvr' shmv
verses.translation: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.original: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְ/כָל עֹשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗/וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: r'shyt chkhmh yr't yhvh shkhl tvb lkhl 'shyhm thltv 'mdt l'd
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ אַשְׁרֵי אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝/מִצְוֺתָ֗י/ו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: hllv yh 'shry 'ysh yr' 't yhvh bmtsvtyv chpts m'd
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD , that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.original: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭/אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑/וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ
verses.translit: gbvr b'rts yhyh zr'v dvr yshrym ybrkh
verses.translation: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.original: הוֹן וָ/עֹ֥שֶׁר בְּ/בֵית֑/וֹ וְ֝/צִדְקָת֗/וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: hvn v'shr bbytv vtsdqtv 'mdt l'd
verses.translation: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.original: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּ/חֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַ/יְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְ/רַח֣וּם וְ/צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: zrch bchshkh 'vr lyshrym chnvn vrchvm vtsdyq
verses.translation: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.original: טֽוֹב אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּ/מַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣י/ו בְּ/מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: tvb 'ysh chvnn vmlvh ykhlkhl dbryv bmshpt
verses.translation: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.original: כִּֽי לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם לֹא יִמּ֑וֹט לְ/זֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: khy l'vlm l' ymvt lzkhr 'vlm yhyh tsdyq
verses.translation: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.original: מִ/שְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗/וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: mshmv'h r'h l' yyr' nkhvn lbv btch byhvh
verses.translation: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD .

verses.original: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּ/וֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר יִרְאֶ֣ה בְ/צָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: smvkh lbv l' yyr' 'd 'shr yr'h btsryv
verses.translation: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

verses.original: פִּזַּ֤ר נָ֘תַ֤ן לָ/אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָת/וֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָ/עַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗/וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּ/כָבֽוֹד
verses.translit: pzr ntn l'byvnym tsdqtv 'mdt l'd qrnv trvm bkhbvd
verses.translation: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.original: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה וְ/כָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣י/ו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְ/נָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
verses.translit: rsh' yr'h vkh's shnyv ychrq vnms t'vt rsh'ym t'bd
verses.translation: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hllv yh hllv 'bdy yhvh hllv 't shm yhvh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Praise, O ye servants of the LORD , praise the name of the LORD .

verses.original: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝/עַתָּ֗ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: yhy shm yhvh mbrkh m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.original: מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹא֑/וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mmzrch shmsh 'd mbv'v mhll shm yhvh
verses.translation: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.

verses.original: רָ֖ם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: rm 'l khl gvym yhvh 'l hshmym khbvdv
verses.translation: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.original: מִ֭י כַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ הַֽ/מַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָ/שָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: my khyhvh 'lhynv hmgbyhy lshbt
verses.translation: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.original: הַֽ/מַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִ/רְא֑וֹת בַּ/שָּׁמַ֥יִם וּ/בָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hmshpyly lr'vt bshmym vb'rts
verses.translation: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.original: מְקִֽימִ֣י מֵ/עָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵֽ֝/אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: mqymy m'pr dl m'shpt yrym 'byvn
verses.translation: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.original: לְ/הוֹשִׁיבִ֥י עִם נְדִיבִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם נְדִיבֵ֥י עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lhvshyby 'm ndybym 'm ndyby 'mv
verses.translation: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.original: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַ/בַּ֗יִת אֵֽם הַ/בָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: mvshyby 'qrt hbyt 'm hbnym shmchh hllv yh
verses.translation: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: בְּ/צֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵ/עַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז
verses.translit: bts't yshr'l mmtsrym byt y'qb m'm l'z
verses.translation: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.original: הָיְתָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֣ה לְ/קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hyth yhvdh lqdshv yshr'l mmshlvtyv
verses.translation: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

verses.original: הַ/יָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַ/יָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְ/אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: hym r'h vyns hyrdn ysb l'chvr
verses.translation: The sea saw it , and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.original: הֶֽ֭/הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְ/אֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּ/בְנֵי צֹֽאן
verses.translit: hhrym rqdv kh'ylym gb'vt khbny ts'n
verses.translation: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.original: מַה לְּ/ךָ֣ הַ֭/יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְ/אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: mh lkh hym khy tnvs hyrdn tsb l'chvr
verses.translation: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

verses.original: הֶֽ֭/הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְ/אֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּ/בְנֵי צֹֽאן
verses.translit: hhrym trqdv kh'ylym gb'vt khbny ts'n
verses.translation: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.original: מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝/לִּ/פְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: mlpny 'dvn chvly 'rts mlpny 'lvh y'qb
verses.translation: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.original: הַ/הֹפְכִ֣י הַ/צּ֣וּר אֲגַם מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְ/מַעְיְנ/וֹ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: hhpkhy htsvr 'gm mym chlmysh lm'ynv mym
verses.translation: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.original: לֹ֤א לָ֥/נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥/נוּ כִּֽי לְ֭/שִׁמְ/ךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל חַ֝סְדְּ/ךָ֗ עַל אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' lnv yhvh l' lnv khy lshmkh tn khbvd 'l chsdkh 'l 'mtkh
verses.translation: Not unto us, O LORD , not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

verses.original: לָ֭/מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lmh y'mrv hgvym 'yh n' 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

verses.original: וֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֥י/נוּ בַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵ֣ץ עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: v'lhynv bshmym khl 'shr chpts 'shh
verses.translation: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.original: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּי/הֶם כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: 'tsbyhm khsf vzhb m'shh ydy 'dm
verses.translation: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.original: פֶּֽה לָ֭/הֶם וְ/לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝/הֶ֗ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ
verses.translit: ph lhm vl' ydbrv 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v
verses.translation: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.original: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭/הֶם וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝/הֶ֗ם וְ/לֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'znym lhm vl' yshm'v 'f lhm vl' yrychvn
verses.translation: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.original: יְדֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/לֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּ/ן רַ֭גְלֵי/הֶם וְ/לֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּ/גְרוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ydyhm vl' ymyshvn rglyhm vl' yhlkhv l' yhgv bgrvnm
verses.translation: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹ/הֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khmvhm yhyv 'shyhm khl 'shr btch bhm
verses.translation: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בְּטַ֣ח בַּ/יהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖/ם וּ/מָגִנָּ֣/ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: yshr'l btch byhvh 'zrm vmgnm hv'
verses.translation: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD : he is their help and their shield.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית אַ֭הֲרֹן בִּטְח֣וּ בַ/יהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖/ם וּ/מָגִנָּ֣/ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: byt 'hrn btchv byhvh 'zrm vmgnm hv'
verses.translation: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD : he is their help and their shield.

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בִּטְח֣וּ בַ/יהוָ֑ה עֶזְרָ֖/ם וּ/מָגִנָּ֣/ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: yr'y yhvh btchv byhvh 'zrm vmgnm hv'
verses.translation: Ye that fear the LORD , trust in the LORD : he is their help and their shield.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ זְכָרָ֪/נוּ יְבָ֫רֵ֥ךְ יְ֭בָרֵךְ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְ֝בָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: yhvh zkhrnv ybrkh ybrkh 't byt yshr'l ybrkh 't byt 'hrn
verses.translation: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.original: יְ֭בָרֵךְ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝/קְּטַנִּ֗ים עִם הַ/גְּדֹלִֽים
verses.translit: ybrkh yr'y yhvh hqtnym 'm hgdlym
verses.translation: He will bless them that fear the LORD , both small and great.

verses.original: יֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם עֲ֝לֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/עַל בְּנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: ysf yhvh 'lykhm 'lykhm v'l bnykhm
verses.translation: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.original: בְּרוּכִ֣ים אַ֭תֶּם לַ/יהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: brvkhym 'tm lyhvh 'shh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

verses.original: הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם שָׁ֭מַיִם לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ֝/הָ/אָ֗רֶץ נָתַ֥ן לִ/בְנֵי אָדָֽם
verses.translit: hshmym shmym lyhvh vh'rts ntn lbny 'dm
verses.translation: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’s : but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.original: לֹ֣א הַ֭/מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָ֑הּ וְ֝/לֹ֗א כָּל יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה
verses.translit: l' hmtym yhllv yh vl' khl yrdy dvmh
verses.translation: The dead praise not the LORD , neither any that go down into silence.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ יָ֗הּ מֵֽ/עַתָּ֥ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: v'nchnv nbrkh yh m'th v'd 'vlm hllv yh
verses.translation: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD .

verses.original: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֑ה אֶת ק֝וֹלִ֗/י תַּחֲנוּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'hbty khy yshm' yhvh 't qvly tchnvny
verses.translation: I love the LORD , because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣/וֹ לִ֑/י וּ/בְ/יָמַ֥/י אֶקְרָֽא
verses.translit: khy hth 'znv ly vbymy 'qr'
verses.translation: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּ/נִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֗וֶת וּ/מְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּ/נִי צָרָ֖ה וְ/יָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא
verses.translit: 'ppvny chbly mvt vmtsry sh'vl mts'vny tsrh vygvn 'mts'
verses.translation: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥/ה נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vbshm yhvh 'qr' 'nh yhvh mlth npshy
verses.translation: Then called I upon the name of the LORD ; O LORD , I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.original: חַנּ֣וּן יְהֹוָ֣ה וְ/צַדִּ֑יק וֵ֖/אלֹהֵ֣י/נוּ מְרַחֵֽם
verses.translit: chnvn yhvh vtsdyq v'lhynv mrchm
verses.translation: Gracious is the LORD , and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְ/לִ֣/י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: shmr pt'ym yhvh dlvty vly yhvshy'
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.original: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁ/י לִ/מְנוּחָ֑יְ/כִי כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְ/כִי
verses.translit: shvby npshy lmnvchykhy khy yhvh gml 'lykhy
verses.translation: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗/י מִ֫/מָּ֥וֶת אֶת עֵינִ֥/י מִן דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת רַגְלִ֥/י מִ/דֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: khy chltst npshy mmvt 't 'yny mn dm'h 't rgly mdchy
verses.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.original: אֶ֭תְהַלֵּךְ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝/אַרְצ֗וֹת הַֽ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: 'thlkh lpny yhvh b'rtsvt hchyym
verses.translation: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.original: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: h'mnty khy 'dbr 'ny 'nyty m'd
verses.translation: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אָמַ֣רְתִּי בְ/חָפְזִ֑/י כָּֽל הָ/אָדָ֥ם כֹּזֵֽב
verses.translit: 'ny 'mrty bchpzy khl h'dm khzb
verses.translation: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

verses.original: מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב לַ/יהוָ֑ה כָּֽל תַּגְמוּל֥וֹ/הִי עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: mh 'shyb lyhvh khl tgmvlvhy 'ly
verses.translation: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

verses.original: כּוֹס יְשׁוּע֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֑א וּ/בְ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא
verses.translit: khvs yshv'vt 'sh' vbshm yhvh 'qr'
verses.translation: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD .

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַ/י לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָ/ה נָּ֝֗א לְ/כָל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ndry lyhvh 'shlm ngdh n' lkhl 'mv
verses.translation: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.

verses.original: יָ֭קָר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝/מָּ֗וְתָ/ה לַ/חֲסִידָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yqr b'yny yhvh hmvth lchsydyv
verses.translation: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

verses.original: אָֽנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥/ךָ אֲֽנִי עַ֭בְדְּ/ךָ בֶּן אֲמָתֶ֑/ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְ/מוֹסֵרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nh yhvh khy 'ny 'bdkh 'ny 'bdkh bn 'mtkh ptcht lmvsry
verses.translation: O LORD , truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

verses.original: לְֽ/ךָ אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ/בְ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא
verses.translit: lkh 'zbch zbch tvdh vbshm yhvh 'qr'
verses.translation: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD .

verses.original: נְ֭דָרַ/י לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם נֶגְדָ/ה נָּ֝֗א לְ/כָל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ndry lyhvh 'shlm ngdh n' lkhl 'mv
verses.translation: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,

verses.original: בְּ/חַצְר֤וֹת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽ/ת֘וֹכֵ֤/כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: bchtsrvt byt yhvh btvkhkhy yrvshlm hllv yh
verses.translation: In the courts of the LORD’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּ/הוּ כָּל הָ/אֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: hllv 't yhvh khl gvym shbchvhv khl h'mym
verses.translation: O praise the LORD , all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨י/נוּ חַסְדּ֗/וֹ וֶֽ/אֱמֶת יְהוָ֥ה לְ/עוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: khy gbr 'lynv chsdv v'mt yhvh l'vlm hllv yh
verses.translation: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: יֹֽאמַר נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'mr n' yshr'l khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֥א בֵֽית אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'mrv n' byt 'hrn khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'mrv n' yr'y yhvh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: מִֽן הַ֭/מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖/נִי בַ/מֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ
verses.translit: mn hmtsr qr'ty yh 'nny bmrchb yh
verses.translation: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭/י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣/י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: yhvh ly l' 'yr' mh y'shh ly 'dm
verses.translation: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭/י בְּ/עֹזְרָ֑/י וַ֝/אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְ/שֹׂנְאָֽ/י
verses.translit: yhvh ly b'zry v'ny 'r'h bshn'y
verses.translation: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַ/חֲס֥וֹת בַּ/יהוָ֑ה מִ֝/בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: tvb lchsvt byhvh mbtch b'dm
verses.translation: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לַ/חֲס֥וֹת בַּ/יהוָ֑ה מִ֝/בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּ/נְדִיבִֽים
verses.translit: tvb lchsvt byhvh mbtch bndybym
verses.translation: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

verses.original: כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּ/נִי בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽ/ם
verses.translit: khl gvym sbbvny bshm yhvh khy 'mylm
verses.translation: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

verses.original: סַבּ֥וּ/נִי גַם סְבָב֑וּ/נִי בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽ/ם
verses.translit: sbvny gm sbbvny bshm yhvh khy 'mylm
verses.translation: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.original: סַבּ֤וּ/נִי כִ/דְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּ/אֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽ/ם
verses.translit: sbvny khdbvrym d'khv kh'sh qvtsym bshm yhvh khy 'mylm
verses.translation: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.original: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣/נִי לִ/נְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖/יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: dchh dchytny lnpl vyhvh 'zrny
verses.translation: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

verses.original: עָזִּ֣/י וְ/זִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽ/יְהִי לִ֝֗/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: 'zy vzmrt yh vyhy ly lyshv'h
verses.translation: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל רִנָּ֬ה וִֽ/ישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּ/אָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל
verses.translit: qvl rnh vyshv'h b'hly tsdyqym ymyn yhvh 'shh chyl
verses.translation: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.original: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל
verses.translit: ymyn yhvh rvmmh ymyn yhvh 'shh chyl
verses.translation: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.original: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝/אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ
verses.translit: l' 'mvt khy 'chyh v'spr m'shy yh
verses.translation: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD .

verses.original: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣/נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝/לַ/מָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ysr ysrny yh vlmvt l' ntnny
verses.translation: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.original: פִּתְחוּ לִ֥/י שַׁעֲרֵי צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא בָ֝/ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ
verses.translit: ptchv ly sh'ry tsdq 'b' bm 'vdh yh
verses.translation: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD :

verses.original: זֶֽה הַ/שַּׁ֥עַר לַ/יהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zh hsh'r lyhvh tsdyqym yb'v bv
verses.translation: This gate of the LORD , into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.original: א֭וֹדְ/ךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑/נִי וַ/תְּהִי לִ֝֗/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: 'vdkh khy 'nytny vthy ly lyshv'h
verses.translation: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.original: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַ/בּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה
verses.translit: 'bn m'sv hbvnym hyth lr'sh pnh
verses.translation: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

verses.original: מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּ/עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: m't yhvh hyth z't hy' npl't b'ynynv
verses.translation: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes. …: Heb. from the LORD

verses.original: זֶה הַ֭/יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְ/נִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zh hyvm 'shh yhvh ngylh vnshmchh bv
verses.translation: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.original: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥/ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥/ה נָּֽא
verses.translit: 'n' yhvh hvshy'h n' 'n' yhvh htslychh n'
verses.translation: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD : O LORD , I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭/בָּא בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּ/כֶ֗ם מִ/בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: brvkh hb' bshm yhvh brkhnvkhm mbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD : we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: אֵ֤ל יְהוָה֮ וַ/יָּ֪אֶר לָ֥/נוּ אִסְרוּ חַ֥ג בַּ/עֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: 'l yhvh vy'r lnv 'srv chg b'btym 'd qrnvt hmzbch
verses.translation: God is the LORD , which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.original: אֵלִ֣/י אַתָּ֣ה וְ/אוֹדֶ֑/ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗/י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'ly 'th v'vdkh 'lhy 'rvmmkh
verses.translation: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝/הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'shry tmymy drkh hhlkhym btvrt yhvh
verses.translation: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD .

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗י/ו בְּ/כָל לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'shry ntsry 'dtyv bkhl lb ydrshvhv
verses.translation: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

verses.original: אַ֭ף לֹֽא פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּ/דְרָכָ֥י/ו הָלָֽכוּ
verses.translit: 'f l' p'lv 'vlh bdrkhyv hlkhv
verses.translation: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.original: אַ֭תָּה צִוִּ֥יתָה פִקֻּדֶ֗י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'th tsvyth pqdykh lshmr m'd
verses.translation: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

verses.original: אַ֭חֲלַי יִכֹּ֥נוּ דְרָכָ֗/י לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'chly ykhnv drkhy lshmr chqykh
verses.translation: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

verses.original: אָ֥ז לֹא אֵב֑וֹשׁ בְּ֝/הַבִּיטִ֗/י אֶל כָּל מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'z l' 'bvsh bhbyty 'l khl mtsvtykh
verses.translation: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

verses.original: א֭וֹדְ/ךָ בְּ/יֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝/לָמְדִ֗/י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'vdkh byshr lbb blmdy mshpty tsdqkh
verses.translation: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

verses.original: אֶת חֻקֶּ֥י/ךָ אֶשְׁמֹ֑ר אַֽל תַּעַזְבֵ֥/נִי עַד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 't chqykh 'shmr 'l t'zbny 'd m'd
verses.translation: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

verses.original: בַּ/מֶּ֣ה יְזַכֶּה נַּ֭עַר אֶת אָרְח֑/וֹ לִ֝/שְׁמֹ֗ר כִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bmh yzkhh n'r 't 'rchv lshmr khdbrkh
verses.translation: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל לִבִּ֥/י דְרַשְׁתִּ֑י/ךָ אַל תַּ֝שְׁגֵּ֗/נִי מִ/מִּצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bkhl lby drshtykh 'l tshgny mmtsvtykh
verses.translation: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

verses.original: בְּ֭/לִבִּ/י צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: blby tspnty 'mrtkh lm'n l' 'cht' lkh
verses.translation: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.original: בָּר֖וּךְ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֗ה לַמְּדֵ֥/נִי חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: brvkh 'th yhvh lmdny chqykh
verses.translation: Blessed art thou, O LORD : teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׂפָתַ֥/י סִפַּ֑רְתִּי כֹּ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bshpty sprty khl mshpty pykh
verses.translation: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.original: בְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ שַׂ֗שְׂתִּי כְּ/עַ֣ל כָּל הֽוֹן
verses.translit: bdrkh 'dvtykh shshty kh'l khl hvn
verses.translation: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.original: בְּ/פִקֻּדֶ֥י/ךָ אָשִׂ֑יחָה וְ֝/אַבִּ֗יטָה אֹרְחֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bpqdykh 'shychh v'byth 'rchtykh
verses.translation: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

verses.translit: bchqtykh 'sht'sh' l' 'shkhch dbrkh
verses.translation: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

verses.original: גְּמֹ֖ל עַֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ אֶֽחְיֶ֗ה וְ/אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: gml 'l 'bdkh 'chyh v'shmrh dbrkh
verses.translation: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.original: גַּל עֵינַ֥/י וְ/אַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת מִ/תּוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: gl 'yny v'byth npl'vt mtvrtkh
verses.translation: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

verses.original: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָ/אָ֑רֶץ אַל תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗/נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: gr 'nkhy b'rts 'l tstr mmny mtsvtykh
verses.translation: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.original: גָּרְסָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣/י לְ/תַאֲבָ֑ה אֶֽל מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥י/ךָ בְ/כָל עֵֽת
verses.translit: grsh npshy lt'bh 'l mshptykh bkhl 't
verses.translation: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

verses.original: גָּ֭עַרְתָּ זֵדִ֣ים אֲרוּרִ֑ים הַ֝/שֹּׁגִים מִ/מִּצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: g'rt zdym 'rvrym hshgym mmtsvtykh
verses.translation: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

verses.original: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭/עָלַ/י חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָ/ב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣י/ךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: gl m'ly chrph vbvz khy 'dtykh ntsrty
verses.translation: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣/י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּ/ךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּ/חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: gm yshbv shrym by ndbrv 'bdkh yshych bchqykh
verses.translation: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

verses.original: גַּֽם עֵ֭דֹתֶי/ךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֗/י אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲצָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm 'dtykh sh'sh'y 'nshy 'tsty
verses.translation: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

verses.translit: dbqh l'pr npshy chyny khdbrkh
verses.translation: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.original: דְּרָכַ֣/י סִ֭פַּרְתִּי וַֽ/תַּעֲנֵ֗/נִי לַמְּדֵ֥/נִי חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: drkhy sprty vt'nny lmdny chqykh
verses.translation: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ פִּקּוּדֶ֥י/ךָ הֲבִינֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/אָשִׂ֗יחָה בְּ/נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: drkh pqvdykh hbynny v'shychh bnpl'vtykh
verses.translation: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.original: דָּלְפָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י מִ/תּוּגָ֑ה קַ֝יְּמֵ֗/נִי כִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: dlph npshy mtvgh qymny khdbrkh
verses.translation: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ שֶׁ֭קֶר הָסֵ֣ר מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וְֽ/תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ חָנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: drkh shqr hsr mmny vtvrtkh chnny
verses.translation: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ אֱמוּנָ֥ה בָחָ֑רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥י/ךָ שִׁוִּֽיתִי
verses.translit: drkh 'mvnh bchrty mshptykh shvyty
verses.translation: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me .

verses.original: דָּבַ֥קְתִּי בְ/עֵֽדְוֺתֶ֑י/ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל תְּבִישֵֽׁ/נִי
verses.translit: dbqty b'dvtykh yhvh 'l tbyshny
verses.translation: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD , put me not to shame.

verses.original: דֶּֽרֶךְ מִצְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ אָר֑וּץ כִּ֖י תַרְחִ֣יב לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: drkh mtsvtykh 'rvts khy trchyb lby
verses.translation: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

verses.original: הוֹרֵ֣/נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗י/ךָ וְ/אֶצְּרֶ֥/נָּה עֵֽקֶב
verses.translit: hvrny yhvh drkh chqykh v'tsrnh 'qb
verses.translation: Teach me, O LORD , the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

verses.original: הֲ֭בִינֵ/נִי וְ/אֶצְּרָ֥ה תֽוֹרָתֶ֗/ךָ וְ/אֶשְׁמְרֶ֥/נָּה בְ/כָל לֵֽב
verses.translit: hbynny v'tsrh tvrtkh v'shmrnh bkhl lb
verses.translation: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.original: הַ֭דְרִיכֵ/נִי בִּ/נְתִ֣יב מִצְוֺתֶ֑י/ךָ כִּי ב֥/וֹ חָפָֽצְתִּי
verses.translit: hdrykhny bntyb mtsvtykh khy bv chptsty
verses.translation: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.original: הַט לִ֭בִּ/י אֶל עֵדְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/אַ֣ל אֶל בָּֽצַע
verses.translit: ht lby 'l 'dvtykh v'l 'l bts'
verses.translation: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַ/י מֵ/רְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּ/דְרָכֶ֥/ךָ חַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: h'br 'yny mr'vt shv' bdrkhkh chyny
verses.translation: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.original: הָקֵ֣ם לְ֭/עַבְדְּ/ךָ אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לְ/יִרְאָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hqm l'bdkh 'mrtkh 'shr lyr'tkh
verses.translation: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

verses.original: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִ/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣י/ךָ טוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: h'br chrpty 'shr ygrty khy mshptykh tvbym
verses.translation: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לְ/פִקֻּדֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ חַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hnh t'bty lpqdykh btsdqtkh chyny
verses.translation: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

verses.original: וִֽ/יבֹאֻ֣/נִי חֲסָדֶ֣/ךָ יְהוָ֑ה תְּ֝שֽׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֗ כְּ/אִמְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyb'ny chsdkh yhvh tshv'tkh kh'mrtkh
verses.translation: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD , even thy salvation, according to thy word.

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽעֱנֶ֣ה חֹרְפִ֣/י דָבָ֑ר כִּֽי בָ֝טַחְתִּי בִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v''nh chrpy dbr khy btchty bdbrkh
verses.translation: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

verses.original: וְֽ/אַל תַּצֵּ֬ל מִ/פִּ֣/י דְבַר אֱמֶ֣ת עַד מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣/ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: v'l ttsl mpy dbr 'mt 'd m'd khy lmshptkh ychlty
verses.translation: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

verses.original: וְ/אֶשְׁמְרָ֖ה תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ תָמִ֗יד לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: v'shmrh tvrtkh tmyd l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְהַלְּכָ֥ה בָ/רְחָבָ֑ה כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣י/ךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי
verses.translit: v'thlkhh brchbh khy pqdykh drshty
verses.translation: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

verses.original: וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭/עֵדֹתֶי/ךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְ/לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: v'dbrh b'dtykh ngd mlkhym vl' 'bvsh
verses.translation: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.original: וְ/אֶשְׁתַּֽעֲשַׁ֥ע בְּ/מִצְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהָֽבְתִּי
verses.translit: v'sht'sh' bmtsvtykh 'shr 'hbty
verses.translation: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.original: וְ/אֶשָּֽׂא כַפַּ֗/י אֶֽל מִ֭צְוֺתֶי/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְ/אָשִׂ֥יחָה בְ/חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'sh' khpy 'l mtsvtykh 'shr 'hbty v'shychh bchqykh
verses.translation: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

verses.original: זְכֹר דָּבָ֥ר לְ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ עַ֝֗ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽחַלְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: zkhr dbr l'bdkh 'l 'shr ychltny
verses.translation: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

verses.original: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣/י בְ/עָנְיִ֑/י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְ/נִי
verses.translit: z't nchmty b'nyy khy 'mrtkh chytny
verses.translation: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.original: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣/נִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝/תּֽוֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי
verses.translit: zdym hlytsny 'd m'd mtvrtkh l' ntyty
verses.translation: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/עוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וָֽ/אֶתְנֶחָֽם
verses.translit: zkhrty mshptykh m'vlm yhvh v'tnchm
verses.translation: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD ; and have comforted myself.

verses.original: זַלְעָפָ֣ה אֲ֭חָזַתְ/נִי מֵ/רְשָׁעִ֑ים עֹ֝זְבֵ֗י תּוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: zl'ph 'chztny mrsh'ym 'zby tvrtkh
verses.translation: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.original: זְ֭מִרוֹת הָֽיוּ לִ֥/י חֻקֶּ֗י/ךָ בְּ/בֵ֣ית מְגוּרָֽ/י
verses.translit: zmrvt hyv ly chqykh bbyt mgvry
verses.translation: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַ/לַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝/אֶשְׁמְרָ֗/ה תּוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: zkhrty blylh shmkh yhvh v'shmrh tvrtkh
verses.translation: I have remembered thy name, O LORD , in the night, and have kept thy law.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָֽיְתָה לִּ֑/י כִּ֖י פִקֻּדֶ֣י/ךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: z't hyth ly khy pqdykh ntsrty
verses.translation: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

verses.original: חֶלְקִ֖/י יְהוָ֥ה אָמַ֗רְתִּי לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chlqy yhvh 'mrty lshmr dbrykh
verses.translation: Thou art my portion, O LORD : I have said that I would keep thy words.

verses.original: חִלִּ֣יתִי פָנֶ֣י/ךָ בְ/כָל לֵ֑ב חָ֝נֵּ֗/נִי כְּ/אִמְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chlyty pnykh bkhl lb chnny kh'mrtkh
verses.translation: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֥בְתִּי דְרָכָ֑/י וָ/אָשִׁ֥יבָ/ה רַ֝גְלַ֗/י אֶל עֵדֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chshbty drkhy v'shybh rgly 'l 'dtykh
verses.translation: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.original: חַ֭שְׁתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי לִ֝/שְׁמֹ֗ר מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chshty vl' htmhmhty lshmr mtsvtykh
verses.translation: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑/נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: chbly rsh'ym 'vdny tvrtkh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.original: חֲצֽוֹת לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְ/הוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑/ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chtsvt lylh 'qvm lhvdvt lkh 'l mshpty tsdqkh
verses.translation: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.original: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּ/ךָ וּ֝/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chbr 'ny lkhl 'shr yr'vkh vlshmry pqvdykh
verses.translation: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

verses.original: חַסְדְּ/ךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָ/אָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥י/ךָ לַמְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: chsdkh yhvh ml'h h'rts chqykh lmdny
verses.translation: The earth, O LORD , is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: ט֭וֹב עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִֽם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֑ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: tvb 'shyt 'm 'bdkh yhvh khdbrkh
verses.translation: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD , according unto thy word.

verses.original: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָ/דַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑/נִי כִּ֖י בְ/מִצְוֺתֶ֣י/ךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי
verses.translit: tvb t'm vd't lmdny khy bmtsvtykh h'mnty
verses.translation: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.original: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝/עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: trm ''nh 'ny shgg v'th 'mrtkh shmrty
verses.translation: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

verses.original: טוֹב אַתָּ֥ה וּ/מֵטִ֗יב לַמְּדֵ֥/נִי חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tvb 'th vmtyb lmdny chqykh
verses.translation: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣/י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּ/כָל לֵ֤ב אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tplv 'ly shqr zdym 'ny bkhl lb 'tsr pqvdykh
verses.translation: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

verses.original: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּ/חֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑/ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי
verses.translit: tpsh khchlb lbm 'ny tvrtkh sh'sh'ty
verses.translation: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

verses.original: טֽוֹב לִ֥/י כִֽי עֻנֵּ֑יתִי לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶלְמַ֥ד חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tvb ly khy 'nyty lm'n 'lmd chqykh
verses.translation: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

verses.original: טֽוֹב לִ֥/י תֽוֹרַת פִּ֑י/ךָ מֵ֝/אַלְפֵ֗י זָהָ֥ב וָ/כָֽסֶף
verses.translit: tvb ly tvrt pykh m'lpy zhb vkhsf
verses.translation: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.original: יָדֶ֣י/ךָ עָ֭שׂוּ/נִי וַֽ/יְכוֹנְנ֑וּ/נִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗/נִי וְ/אֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ydykh 'shvny vykhvnnvny hbynny v'lmdh mtsvtykh
verses.translation: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.original: יְ֭רֵאֶי/ךָ יִרְא֣וּ/נִי וְ/יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: yr'ykh yr'vny vyshmchv khy ldbrkh ychlty
verses.translation: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

verses.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑י/ךָ וֶ֝/אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yd'ty yhvh khy tsdq mshptykh v'mvnh 'nytny
verses.translation: I know, O LORD , that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

verses.original: יְהִי נָ֣א חַסְדְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/נַחֲמֵ֑/נִי כְּ/אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֥ לְ/עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhy n' chsdkh lnchmny kh'mrtkh l'bdkh
verses.translation: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.original: יְבֹא֣וּ/נִי רַחֲמֶ֣י/ךָ וְ/אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה כִּי תֽ֝וֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ שַֽׁעֲשֻׁעָֽ/י
verses.translit: yb'vny rchmykh v'chyh khy tvrtkh sh'sh'y
verses.translation: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּ/נִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּ/פִקּוּדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ybshv zdym khy shqr 'vtvny 'ny 'shych bpqvdykh
verses.translation: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ לִ֣/י יְרֵאֶ֑י/ךָ ו/ידעו וְ֝/יֹדְעֵ֗י עֵדֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yshvbv ly yr'ykh vyd'v vyd'y 'dtykh
verses.translation: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

verses.original: יְהִֽי לִבִּ֣/י תָמִ֣ים בְּ/חֻקֶּ֑י/ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: yhy lby tmym bchqykh lm'n l' 'bvsh
verses.translation: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

verses.original: כָּלְתָ֣ה לִ/תְשׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֣ נַפְשִׁ֑/י לִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: khlth ltshv'tkh npshy ldbrkh ychlty
verses.translation: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

verses.original: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַ/י לְ/אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ לֵ֝/אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khlv 'yny l'mrtkh l'mr mty tnchmny
verses.translation: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.original: כִּֽי הָ֭יִיתִי כְּ/נֹ֣אד בְּ/קִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: khy hyyty khn'd bqytvr chqykh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

verses.original: כַּ/מָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְ/רֹדְפַ֣/י מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khmh ymy 'bdkh mty t'shh brdpy mshpt
verses.translation: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.original: כָּֽרוּ לִ֣/י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְ/תוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khrv ly zdym shychvt 'shr l' khtvrtkh
verses.translation: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

verses.original: כָּל מִצְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ אֱמוּנָ֑ה שֶׁ֖קֶר רְדָפ֣וּ/נִי עָזְרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khl mtsvtykh 'mvnh shqr rdpvny 'zrny
verses.translation: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

verses.original: כִּ֭/מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּ/נִי בָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ֝/אֲנִ֗י לֹא עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khm't khlvny b'rts v'ny l' 'zbty pqvdykh
verses.translation: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.original: כְּ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ חַיֵּ֑/נִי וְ֝/אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵד֥וּת פִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khchsdkh chyny v'shmrh 'dvt pykh
verses.translation: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

verses.original: לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝בָרְ/ךָ֗ נִצָּ֥ב בַּ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: l'vlm yhvh dbrkh ntsb bshmym
verses.translation: For ever, O LORD , thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.original: לְ/דֹ֣ר וָ֭/דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑/ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: ldr vdr 'mvntkh khvnnt 'rts vt'md
verses.translation: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

verses.original: לְֽ֭/מִשְׁפָּטֶי/ךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַ/יּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַ/כֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: lmshptykh 'mdv hyvm khy hkhl 'bdykh
verses.translation: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְ/ךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑/י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְ/עָנְיִֽ/י
verses.translit: lvly tvrtkh sh'sh'y 'z 'bdty b'nyy
verses.translation: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.original: לְ֭/עוֹלָם לֹא אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗/ם חִיִּיתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: l'vlm l' 'shkhch pqvdykh khy bm chyytny
verses.translation: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.original: לְֽ/ךָ אֲ֭נִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣י/ךָ דָרָֽשְׁתִּי
verses.translit: lkh 'ny hvshy'ny khy pqvdykh drshty
verses.translation: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.original: לִ֤/י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְ/אַבְּדֵ֑/נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗י/ךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: ly qvv rsh'ym l'bdny 'dtykh 'tbvnn
verses.translation: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.original: לְֽ/כָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְ/ךָ֣ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: lkhl tkhlh r'yty qts rchbh mtsvtkh m'd
verses.translation: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.original: מָֽה אָהַ֥בְתִּי תוֹרָתֶ֑/ךָ כָּל הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם הִ֣יא שִׂיחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: mh 'hbty tvrtkh khl hyvm hy' shychty
verses.translation: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.original: מֵ֭/אֹ֣יְבַ/י תְּחַכְּמֵ֣/נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם הִיא לִֽ/י
verses.translit: m'yby tchkhmny mtsvtkh khy l'vlm hy' ly
verses.translation: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.original: מִ/כָּל מְלַמְּדַ֥/י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿ/י
verses.translit: mkhl mlmdy hshkhlty khy 'dvtykh shychh ly
verses.translation: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.original: מִ/זְּקֵנִ֥ים אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣י/ךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: mzqnym 'tbvnn khy pqvdykh ntsrty
verses.translation: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.original: מִ/כָּל אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑/י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mkhl 'rch r' khl'ty rgly lm'n 'shmr dbrkh
verses.translation: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.original: מִ/מִּשְׁפָּטֶ֥י/ךָ לֹא סָ֑רְתִּי כִּֽי אַ֝תָּ֗ה הוֹרֵתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mmshptykh l' srty khy 'th hvrtny
verses.translation: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.original: מַה נִּמְלְצ֣וּ לְ֭/חִכִּ/י אִמְרָתֶ֗/ךָ מִ/דְּבַ֥שׁ לְ/פִֽ/י
verses.translit: mh nmltsv lchkhy 'mrtkh mdbsh lpy
verses.translation: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.original: מִ/פִּקּוּדֶ֥י/ךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי כָּל אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: mpqvdykh 'tbvnn 'l khn shn'ty khl 'rch shqr
verses.translation: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.original: נֵר לְ/רַגְלִ֥/י דְבָרֶ֑/ךָ וְ֝/א֗וֹר לִ/נְתִיבָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: nr lrgly dbrkh v'vr lntybty
verses.translation: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.translit: nshb'ty v'qymh lshmr mshpty tsdqkh
verses.translation: I have sworn, and I will perform it , that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.original: נַעֲנֵ֥יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד יְ֝הוָ֗ה חַיֵּ֥/נִי כִ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: n'nyty 'd m'd yhvh chyny khdbrkh
verses.translation: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD , according unto thy word.

verses.original: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭/י רְצֵה נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽ/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥י/ךָ לַמְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ndbvt py rtsh n' yhvh vmshptykh lmdny
verses.translation: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD , and teach me thy judgments.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֣/י בְ/כַפִּ֣/י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝/תֽוֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: npshy bkhpy tmyd vtvrtkh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.original: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑/י וּ֝/מִ/פִּקּוּדֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי
verses.translit: ntnv rsh'ym pch ly vmpqvdykh l' t'yty
verses.translation: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.original: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣י/ךָ לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣/י הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: nchlty 'dvtykh l'vlm khy shshvn lby hmh
verses.translation: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.original: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּ/י לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗י/ךָ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב
verses.translit: ntyty lby l'shvt chqykh l'vlm 'qb
verses.translation: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

verses.original: סֵעֲפִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְֽ/תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי
verses.translit: s'pym shn'ty vtvrtkh 'hbty
verses.translation: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.original: סִתְרִ֣/י וּ/מָגִנִּ֣/י אָ֑תָּה לִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: stry vmgny 'th ldbrkh ychlty
verses.translation: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.original: סֽוּרוּ מִמֶּ֥/נִּי מְרֵעִ֑ים וְ֝/אֶצְּרָ֗ה מִצְוֺ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: svrv mmny mr'ym v'tsrh mtsvt 'lhy
verses.translation: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.original: סָמְכֵ֣/נִי כְ/אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֣ וְ/אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וְ/אַל תְּ֝בִישֵׁ֗/נִי מִ/שִּׂבְרִֽ/י
verses.translit: smkhny kh'mrtkh v'chyh v'l tbyshny mshbry
verses.translation: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.original: סְעָדֵ֥/נִי וְ/אִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה וְ/אֶשְׁעָ֖ה בְ/חֻקֶּ֣י/ךָ תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: s'dny v'vsh'h v'sh'h bchqykh tmyd
verses.translation: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.original: סָ֭לִיתָ כָּל שׁוֹגִ֣ים מֵ/חֻקֶּ֑י/ךָ כִּי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר תַּרְמִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: slyt khl shvgym mchqykh khy shqr trmytm
verses.translation: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

verses.original: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל רִשְׁעֵי אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝/כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: sgym hshbt khl rsh'y 'rts lkhn 'hbty 'dtykh
verses.translation: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.translit: smr mpchdkh bshry vmmshptykh yr'ty
verses.translation: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.original: עָ֭שִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּ֣ט וָ/צֶ֑דֶק בַּל תַּ֝נִּיחֵ֗/נִי לְ/עֹֽשְׁקָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shyty mshpt vtsdq bl tnychny l'shqy
verses.translation: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.original: עֲרֹ֣ב עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/ט֑וֹב אַֽל יַעַשְׁקֻ֥/נִי זֵדִֽים
verses.translit: 'rb 'bdkh ltvb 'l y'shqny zdym
verses.translation: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.original: עֵ֭ינַ/י כָּל֣וּ לִֽ/ישׁוּעָתֶ֑/ךָ וּ/לְ/אִמְרַ֥ת צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'yny khlv lyshv'tkh vl'mrt tsdqkh
verses.translation: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ כְ/חַסְדֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/חֻקֶּ֥י/ךָ לַמְּדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'shh 'm 'bdkh khchsdkh vchqykh lmdny
verses.translation: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: עַבְדְּ/ךָ אָ֥נִי הֲבִינֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/אֵדְעָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'bdkh 'ny hbynny v'd'h 'dtykh
verses.translation: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.original: עֵ֭ת לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה הֵ֝פֵ֗רוּ תּוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 't l'shvt lyhvh hprv tvrtkh
verses.translation: It is time for thee , LORD , to work: for they have made void thy law.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֭ן אָהַ֣בְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶ֑י/ךָ מִ/זָּהָ֥ב וּ/מִ/פָּֽז
verses.translit: 'l khn 'hbty mtsvtykh mzhb vmpz
verses.translation: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֤ן כָּל פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי
verses.translit: 'l khn khl pqvdy khl yshrty khl 'rch shqr shn'ty
verses.translation: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

verses.original: פְּלָא֥וֹת עֵדְוֺתֶ֑י/ךָ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן נְצָרָ֥תַ/ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: pl'vt 'dvtykh 'l khn ntsrtm npshy
verses.translation: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.original: פֵּ֖תַח דְּבָרֶ֥י/ךָ יָאִ֗יר מֵבִ֥ין פְּתָיִֽים
verses.translit: ptch dbrykh y'yr mbyn ptyym
verses.translation: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.original: פִּֽ/י פָ֭עַרְתִּי וָ/אֶשְׁאָ֑פָ/ה כִּ֖י לְ/מִצְוֺתֶ֣י/ךָ יָאָֽבְתִּי
verses.translit: py p'rty v'sh'ph khy lmtsvtykh y'bty
verses.translation: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.translit: pnh 'ly vchnny khmshpt l'hby shmkh
verses.translation: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

verses.original: פְּ֭עָמַ/י הָכֵ֣ן בְּ/אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ וְֽ/אַל תַּשְׁלֶט בִּ֥/י כָל אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: p'my hkhn b'mrtkh v'l tshlt by khl 'vn
verses.translation: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.original: פְּ֭דֵ/נִי מֵ/עֹ֣שֶׁק אָדָ֑ם וְ֝/אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה פִּקּוּדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: pdny m'shq 'dm v'shmrh pqvdykh
verses.translation: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.original: פָּ֭נֶי/ךָ הָאֵ֣ר בְּ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/לַמְּדֵ֗/נִי אֶת חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: pnykh h'r b'bdkh vlmdny 't chqykh
verses.translation: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑/י עַ֝֗ל לֹא שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: plgy mym yrdv 'yny 'l l' shmrv tvrtkh
verses.translation: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝/יָשָׁ֗ר מִשְׁפָּטֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tsdyq 'th yhvh vyshr mshptykh
verses.translation: Righteous art thou, O LORD , and upright are thy judgments.

verses.original: צִ֭וִּיתָ צֶ֣דֶק עֵדֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וֶֽ/אֱמוּנָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: tsvyt tsdq 'dtykh v'mvnh m'd
verses.translation: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

verses.original: צִמְּתַ֥תְ/נִי קִנְאָתִ֑/י כִּֽי שָׁכְח֖וּ דְבָרֶ֣י/ךָ צָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: tsmttny qn'ty khy shkhchv dbrykh tsry
verses.translation: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.original: צְרוּפָ֖ה אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֥ מְאֹ֗ד וְֽ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ אֲהֵבָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tsrvph 'mrtkh m'd v'bdkh 'hbh
verses.translation: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

verses.original: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְ/נִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: ts'yr 'nkhy vnbzh pqdykh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.original: צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֣ צֶ֣דֶק לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וְֽ/תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: tsdqtkh tsdq l'vlm vtvrtkh 'mt
verses.translation: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

verses.original: צַר וּ/מָצ֥וֹק מְצָא֑וּ/נִי מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽ/י
verses.translit: tsr vmtsvq mts'vny mtsvtykh sh'sh'y
verses.translation: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

verses.original: צֶ֖דֶק עֵדְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ לְ/עוֹלָ֗ם הֲבִינֵ֥/נִי וְ/אֶחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: tsdq 'dvtykh l'vlm hbynny v'chyh
verses.translation: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.original: קָרָ֣אתִי בְ/כָל לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥י/ךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה
verses.translit: qr'ty bkhl lb 'nny yhvh chqykh 'tsrh
verses.translation: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD : I will keep thy statutes.

verses.original: קְרָאתִ֥י/ךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה עֵדֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: qr'tykh hvshy'ny v'shmrh 'dtykh
verses.translation: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.original: קִדַּ֣מְתִּי בַ֭/נֶּשֶׁף וָ/אֲשַׁוֵּ֑עָ/ה ל/דברי/ך לִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֥ יִחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: qdmty bnshf v'shv'h ldbrykh ldbrkh ychlty
verses.translation: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ עֵ֭ינַ/י אַשְׁמֻר֑וֹת לָ֝/שִׂ֗יחַ בְּ/אִמְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
