verses.translit: qdmv 'yny 'shmrvt lshych b'mrtkh
verses.translation: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.translit: qvly shm'h khchsdkh yhvh khmshptkh chyny
verses.translation: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD , quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.original: קָ֭רְבוּ רֹדְפֵ֣י זִמָּ֑ה מִ/תּוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ רָחָֽקוּ
verses.translit: qrbv rdpy zmh mtvrtkh rchqv
verses.translation: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וְֽ/כָל מִצְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: qrvb 'th yhvh vkhl mtsvtykh 'mt
verses.translation: Thou art near, O LORD ; and all thy commandments are truth.

verses.original: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵ/עֵדֹתֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: qdm yd'ty m'dtykh khy l'vlm ysdtm
verses.translation: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.original: רְאֵֽה עָנְיִ֥/י וְ/חַלְּצֵ֑/נִי כִּי תֽ֝וֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: r'h 'nyy vchltsny khy tvrtkh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.original: רִיבָ֣/ה רִ֭יבִ/י וּ/גְאָלֵ֑/נִי לְ/אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֥ חַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: rybh ryby vg'lny l'mrtkh chyny
verses.translation: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.original: רָח֣וֹק מֵ/רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּֽי חֻ֝קֶּי/ךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: rchvq mrsh'ym yshv'h khy chqykh l' drshv
verses.translation: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.original: רַחֲמֶ֖י/ךָ רַבִּ֥ים יְהוָ֑ה כְּֽ/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֥י/ךָ חַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: rchmykh rbym yhvh khmshptykh chyny
verses.translation: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD : quicken me according to thy judgments.

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣/י וְ/צָרָ֑/י מֵ֝/עֵדְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי
verses.translit: rbym rdpy vtsry m'dvtykh l' ntyty
verses.translation: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽ/אֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָ/ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ
verses.translit: r'yty bgdym v'tqvtth 'shr 'mrtkh l' shmrv
verses.translation: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.original: רְ֭אֵה כִּי פִקּוּדֶ֣י/ךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ חַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: r'h khy pqvdykh 'hbty yhvh khchsdkh chyny
verses.translation: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD , according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.original: רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְ/ךָ֥ אֱמֶ֑ת וּ֝/לְ/עוֹלָ֗ם כָּל מִשְׁפַּ֥ט צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: r'sh dbrkh 'mt vl'vlm khl mshpt tsdqkh
verses.translation: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

verses.original: שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּ/נִי חִנָּ֑ם ו/מ/דברי/ך וּ֝/מִ/דְּבָרְ/ךָ֗ פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: shrym rdpvny chnm vmdbrykh vmdbrkh pchd lby
verses.translation: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.original: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ כְּ֝/מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב
verses.translit: shsh 'nkhy 'l 'mrtkh khmvts' shll rb
verses.translation: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂ֭נֵאתִי וַ/אֲתַעֵ֑בָה תּוֹרָתְ/ךָ֥ אָהָֽבְתִּי
verses.translit: shqr shn'ty v't'bh tvrtkh 'hbty
verses.translation: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭/יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑י/ךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shb' byvm hlltykh 'l mshpty tsdqkh
verses.translation: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְ/אֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אֵֽין לָ֥/מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל
verses.translit: shlvm rb l'hby tvrtkh v'yn lmv mkhshvl
verses.translation: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.original: שִׂבַּ֣רְתִּי לִֽ/ישׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וּֽ/מִצְוֺתֶ֥י/ךָ עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: shbrty lyshv'tkh yhvh vmtsvtykh 'shyty
verses.translation: LORD , I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י עֵדֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וָ/אֹהֲבֵ֥/ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: shmrh npshy 'dtykh v'hbm m'd
verses.translation: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶי/ךָ וְ/עֵדֹתֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֖י כָל דְּרָכַ֣/י נֶגְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shmrty pqvdykh v'dtykh khy khl drkhy ngdkh
verses.translation: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.original: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣/י לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: tqrb rnty lpnykh yhvh khdbrkh hbynny
verses.translation: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD : give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא תְּחִנָּתִ֣/י לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ כְּ֝/אִמְרָתְ/ךָ֗ הַצִּילֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: tbv' tchnty lpnykh kh'mrtkh htsylny
verses.translation: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.original: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣/י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣/נִי חֻקֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tb'nh shpty thlh khy tlmdny chqykh
verses.translation: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.original: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִ/י אִמְרָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֖י כָל מִצְוֺתֶ֣י/ךָ צֶּֽדֶק
verses.translit: t'n lshvny 'mrtkh khy khl mtsvtykh tsdq
verses.translation: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

verses.original: תְּהִֽי יָדְ/ךָ֥ לְ/עָזְרֵ֑/נִי כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣י/ךָ בָחָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: thy ydkh l'zrny khy pqvdykh bchrty
verses.translation: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.original: תָּאַ֣בְתִּי לִֽ/ישׁוּעָתְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝/תֽוֹרָתְ/ךָ֗ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָֽ/י
verses.translit: t'bty lyshv'tkh yhvh vtvrtkh sh'sh'y
verses.translation: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD ; and thy law is my delight.

verses.translit: tchy npshy vthllkh vmshptkh y'zrny
verses.translation: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.original: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּ/שֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: t'yty khshh 'bd bqsh 'bdkh khy mtsvtykh l' shkhchty
verses.translation: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶל יְ֭הוָה בַּ/צָּרָ֣תָ/ה לִּ֑/י קָ֝רָ֗אתִי וַֽ/יַּעֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt 'l yhvh btsrth ly qr'ty vy'nny
verses.translation: In my distress I cried unto the LORD , and he heard me.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הַצִּ֣ילָ/ה נַ֭פְשִׁ/י מִ/שְּׂפַת שֶׁ֑קֶר מִ/לָּשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: yhvh htsylh npshy mshpt shqr mlshvn rmyh
verses.translation: Deliver my soul, O LORD , from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.original: מַה יִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭/ךָ וּ/מַה יֹּסִ֥יף לָ֗/ךְ לָשׁ֥וֹן רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: mh ytn lkh vmh ysyf lkh lshvn rmyh
verses.translation: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.original: חִצֵּ֣י גִבּ֣וֹר שְׁנוּנִ֑ים עִ֝֗ם גַּחֲלֵ֥י רְתָמִֽים
verses.translit: chtsy gbvr shnvnym 'm gchly rtmym
verses.translation: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.original: אֽוֹיָה לִ֭/י כִּי גַ֣רְתִּי מֶ֑שֶׁךְ שָׁ֝כַ֗נְתִּי עִֽם אָהֳלֵ֥י קֵדָֽר
verses.translit: 'vyh ly khy grty mshkh shkhnty 'm 'hly qdr
verses.translation: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.original: רַ֭בַּת שָֽׁכְנָה לָּ֣/הּ נַפְשִׁ֑/י עִ֝֗ם שׂוֹנֵ֥א שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: rbt shkhnh lh npshy 'm shvn' shlvm
verses.translation: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.original: אֲֽנִי שָׁ֭לוֹם וְ/כִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר הֵ֝֗מָּה לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'ny shlvm vkhy 'dbr hmh lmlchmh
verses.translation: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר לַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַ/י אֶל הֶ/הָרִ֑ים מֵ֝/אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽ/י
verses.translit: shyr lm'lvt 'sh' 'yny 'l hhrym m'yn yb' 'zry
verses.translation: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרִ/י מֵ/עִ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'zry m'm yhvh 'shh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: My help cometh from the LORD , which made heaven and earth.

verses.original: אַל יִתֵּ֣ן לַ/מּ֣וֹט רַגְלֶ֑/ךָ אַל יָ֝נ֗וּם שֹֽׁמְרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l ytn lmvt rglkh 'l ynvm shmrkh
verses.translation: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא יָ֭נוּם וְ/לֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh l' ynvm vl' yyshn shvmr yshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑/ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּ/ךָ֗ עַל יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh shmrkh yhvh tslkh 'l yd ymynkh
verses.translation: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֗ם הַ/שֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא יַכֶּ֗/כָּה וְ/יָרֵ֥חַ בַּ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: yvmm hshmsh l' ykhkhh vyrch blylh
verses.translation: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְ/ךָ֥ מִ/כָּל רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh yshmrkh mkhl r' yshmr 't npshkh
verses.translation: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְ/ךָ֥ וּ/בוֹאֶ֑/ךָ מֵֽ֝/עַתָּ֗ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: yhvh yshmr ts'tkh vbv'kh m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּעֲל֗וֹת לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּ/אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑/י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd shmchty b'mrym ly byt yhvh nlkh
verses.translation: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: עֹ֭מְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑י/נוּ בִּ֝/שְׁעָרַ֗יִ/ךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'mdvt hyv rglynv bsh'rykh yrvshlm
verses.translation: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.original: יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַ/בְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝/עִ֗יר שֶׁ/חֻבְּרָה לָּ֥/הּ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: yrvshlm hbnvyh kh'yr shchbrh lh ychdv
verses.translation: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.original: שֶׁ/שָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝/הֹד֗וֹת לְ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shshm 'lv shbtym shbty yh 'dvt lyshr'l lhdvt lshm yhvh
verses.translation: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD , unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּ/ה יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְ/בֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: khy shmh yshbv khs'vt lmshpt khs'vt lbyt dvyd
verses.translation: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.original: שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: sh'lv shlvm yrvshlm yshlyv 'hbykh
verses.translation: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.original: יְהִֽי שָׁל֥וֹם בְּ/חֵילֵ֑/ךְ שַׁ֝לְוָ֗ה בְּ/אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: yhy shlvm bchylkh shlvh b'rmnvtykh
verses.translation: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣/י וְ/רֵעָ֑/י אֲדַבְּרָה נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lm'n 'chy vr'y 'dbrh n' shlvm bkh
verses.translation: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lm'n byt yhvh 'lhynv 'bqshh tvb lkh
verses.translation: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶי/ךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת עֵינַ֑/י הַ֝/יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt 'lykh nsh'ty 't 'yny hyshby bshmym
verses.translation: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה כְ/עֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵי/הֶ֗ם כְּ/עֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥/הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵי/נוּ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁ/יְּחָנֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hnh kh'yny 'bdym 'l yd 'dvnyhm kh'yny shpchh 'l yd gbrth khn 'ynynv 'l yhvh 'lhynv 'd shychnnv
verses.translation: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.original: חָנֵּ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑/נוּ כִּֽי רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז
verses.translit: chnnv yhvh chnnv khy rb shb'nv bvz
verses.translation: Have mercy upon us, O LORD , have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.original: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה לָּ֪/הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥/נוּ הַ/לַּ֥עַג הַ/שַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝/בּ֗וּז לִ/גְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: rbt shb'h lh npshnv hl'g hsh'nnym hbvz lg'yvnym
verses.translation: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּעֲל֗וֹת לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁ/הָ֣יָה לָ֑/נוּ יֹֽאמַר נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd lvly yhvh shhyh lnv y'mr n' yshr'l
verses.translation: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁ/הָ֣יָה לָ֑/נוּ בְּ/ק֖וּם עָלֵ֣י/נוּ אָדָֽם
verses.translit: lvly yhvh shhyh lnv bqvm 'lynv 'dm
verses.translation: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּ/נוּ בַּ/חֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣/ם בָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'zy chyym bl'vnv bchrvt 'pm bnv
verses.translation: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי הַ/מַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּ/נוּ נַ֗֜חְלָ/ה עָבַ֥ר עַל נַפְשֵֽׁ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'zy hmym shtpvnv nchlh 'br 'l npshnv
verses.translation: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.original: אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל נַפְשֵׁ֑/נוּ הַ֝/מַּ֗יִם הַ/זֵּֽידוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: 'zy 'br 'l npshnv hmym hzydvnym
verses.translation: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁ/לֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥/נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְ/שִׁנֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh shl' ntnnv trf lshnyhm
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD , who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.original: נַפְשֵׁ֗/נוּ כְּ/צִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִ/פַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַ/פַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַ/אֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ
verses.translit: npshnv khtspvr nmlth mpch yvqshym hpch nshbr v'nchnv nmltnv
verses.translation: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.original: עֶ֭זְרֵ/נוּ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'zrnv bshm yhvh 'shh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: Our help is in the name of the LORD , who made heaven and earth.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַ/בֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּ/יהוָ֑ה כְּֽ/הַר צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt hbtchym byhvh khhr tsyvn l' ymvt l'vlm yshb
verses.translation: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

verses.original: יְֽרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥/הּ וַ֭/יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְ/עַמּ֑/וֹ מֵ֝/עַתָּ֗ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: yrvshlm hrym sbyb lh vyhvh sbyb l'mv m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָ/רֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֪ל הַֽ/צַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַ/צַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּ/עַוְלָ֬תָ/ה יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy l' ynvch shbt hrsh' 'l gvrl htsdyqym lm'n l' yshlchv htsdyqym b'vlth ydyhm
verses.translation: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.original: הֵיטִ֣יבָ/ה יְ֭הוָה לַ/טּוֹבִ֑ים וְ֝/לִֽ/ישָׁרִ֗ים בְּ/לִבּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hytybh yhvh ltvbym vlyshrym blbvtm
verses.translation: Do good, O LORD , unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗/ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣/ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhmtym 'qlqlvtm yvlykhm yhvh 't p'ly h'vn shlvm 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּ/שׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּ/חֹלְמִֽים
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt bshvb yhvh 't shybt tsyvn hyynv khchlmym
verses.translation: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.original: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּי/נוּ֮ וּ/לְשׁוֹנֵ֪/נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: 'z yml' shchvq pynv vlshvnnv rnh 'z y'mrv bgvym hgdyl yhvh l'shvt 'm 'lh
verses.translation: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

verses.original: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗/נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים
verses.translit: hgdyl yhvh l'shvt 'mnv hyynv shmchym
verses.translation: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת שבות/נו שְׁבִיתֵ֑/נוּ כַּ/אֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּ/נֶּֽגֶב
verses.translit: shvbh yhvh 't shbvtnv shbytnv kh'pyqym bngb
verses.translation: Turn again our captivity, O LORD , as the streams in the south.

verses.original: הַ/זֹּרְעִ֥ים בְּ/דִמְעָ֗ה בְּ/רִנָּ֥ה יִקְצֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: hzr'ym bdm'h brnh yqtsrv
verses.translation: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.original: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ וּ/בָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ הַ֫/זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א יָב֥וֹא בְ/רִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hlvkh ylkh vbkhh nsh' mshkh hzr' b' ybv' brnh nsh' 'lmtyv
verses.translation: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him .

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לִ/שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם יְהוָ֤ה לֹא יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣י/ו בּ֑/וֹ אִם יְהוָ֥ה לֹֽא יִשְׁמָר עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt lshlmh 'm yhvh l' ybnh byt shv' 'mlv bvnyv bv 'm yhvh l' yshmr 'yr shv' shqd shvmr
verses.translation: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא לָ/כֶ֨ם מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵי ק֡וּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָ/עֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִֽ/ידִיד֣/וֹ שֵׁנָֽא
verses.translit: shv' lkhm mshkhymy qvm m'chry shbt 'khly lchm h'tsbym khn ytn lydydv shn'
verses.translation: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַ/בָּֽטֶן
verses.translit: hnh nchlt yhvh bnym shkhr pry hbtn
verses.translation: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD : and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

verses.original: כְּ/חִצִּ֥ים בְּ/יַד גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַ/נְּעוּרִֽים
verses.translit: khchtsym byd gbvr khn bny hn'vrym
verses.translation: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַ/גֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת אַשְׁפָּת֗/וֹ מֵ֫/הֶ֥ם לֹֽא יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: 'shry hgbr 'shr ml' 't 'shptv mhm l' ybshv khy ydbrv 't 'vybym bsh'r
verses.translation: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝/הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּ/דְרָכָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt 'shry khl yr' yhvh hhlkh bdrkhyv
verses.translation: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD ; that walketh in his ways.

verses.original: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּי/ךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/ט֣וֹב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ygy' khpykh khy t'khl 'shrykh vtvb lkh
verses.translation: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be , and it shall be well with thee.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתְּ/ךָ֤ כְּ/גֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥/ךָ בָּ֭נֶי/ךָ כִּ/שְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְ/שֻׁלְחָנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shtkh khgpn pryh byrkhty bytkh bnykh khshtly zytym sbyb lshlchnkh
verses.translation: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh khy khn ybrkh gbr yr' yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD .

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֗ה מִ/צִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭/רְאֵה בְּ/ט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ybrkhkh yhvh mtsyvn vr'h btvb yrvshlm khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.original: וּ/רְאֵֽה בָנִ֥ים לְ/בָנֶ֑י/ךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vr'h bnym lbnykh shlvm 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּ/נִי מִ/נְּעוּרַ֑/י יֹֽאמַר נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt rbt tsrrvny mn'vry y'mr n' yshr'l
verses.translation: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

verses.original: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּ/נִי מִ/נְּעוּרָ֑/י גַּ֝ם לֹא יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: rbt tsrrvny mn'vry gm l' ykhlv ly
verses.translation: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.original: עַל גַּ֭בִּ/י חָרְשׁ֣וּ חֹרְשִׁ֑ים הֶ֝אֱרִ֗יכוּ ל/מענות/ם לְ/מַעֲנִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l gby chrshv chrshym h'rykhv lm'nvtm lm'nytm
verses.translation: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צַדִּ֑יק קִ֝צֵּ֗ץ עֲב֣וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: yhvh tsdyq qtsts 'bvt rsh'ym
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.original: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְ/יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֑וֹר כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: ybshv vysgv 'chvr khl shn'y tsyvn
verses.translation: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.original: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּ/חֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֑וֹת שֶׁ/קַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: yhyv khchtsyr ggvt shqdmt shlf ybsh
verses.translation: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.original: שֶׁ/לֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפּ֥/וֹ קוֹצֵ֗ר וְ/חִצְנ֥/וֹ מְעַמֵּֽר
verses.translit: shl' ml' khpv qvtsr vchtsnv m'mr
verses.translation: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א אָֽמְר֨וּ הָ/עֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת יְהוָ֥ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְ/כֶ֗ם בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' 'mrv h'brym brkht yhvh 'lykhm brkhnv 'tkhm bshm yhvh
verses.translation: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּעֲל֑וֹת מִ/מַּעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt mm'mqym qr'tykh yhvh
verses.translation: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD .

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ/י֮ שִׁמְעָ֪/ה בְ/ק֫וֹלִ֥/י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶי/ךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝/ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'dny shm'h bqvly thyynh 'znykh qshbvt lqvl tchnvny
verses.translation: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.original: אִם עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמָר יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗/י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: 'm 'vnvt tshmr yh 'dny my y'md
verses.translation: If thou, LORD , shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.original: כִּֽי עִמְּ/ךָ֥ הַ/סְּלִיחָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן תִּוָּרֵֽא
verses.translit: khy 'mkh hslychh lm'n tvr'
verses.translation: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.original: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְֽ/לִ/דְבָר֥/וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: qvyty yhvh qvth npshy vldbrv hvchlty
verses.translation: I wait for the LORD , my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥/י לַֽ/אדֹנָ֑/י מִ/שֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝/בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: npshy l'dny mshmrym lbqr shmrym lbqr
verses.translation: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.original: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל יְה֫וָה כִּֽי עִם יְהוָ֥ה הַ/חֶ֑סֶד וְ/הַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣/וֹ פְדֽוּת
verses.translit: ychl yshr'l 'l yhvh khy 'm yhvh hchsd vhrbh 'mv pdvt
verses.translation: Let Israel hope in the LORD : for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.original: וְ֭/הוּא יִפְדֶּ֣ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝/כֹּ֗ל עֲוֺנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhv' ypdh 't yshr'l mkhl 'vntyv
verses.translation: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה לֹא גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּ/י וְ/לֹא רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא הִלַּ֓כְתִּי בִּ/גְדֹל֖וֹת וּ/בְ/נִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd yhvh l' gbh lby vl' rmv 'yny vl' hlkhty bgdlvt vbnpl'vt mmny
verses.translation: LORD , my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי וְ/דוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥/י כְּ֭/גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑/וֹ כַּ/גָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣/י נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: 'm l' shvyty vdvmmty npshy khgml 'ly 'mv khgml 'ly npshy
verses.translation: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.original: יַחֵ֣ל יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל אֶל יְהוָ֑ה מֵֽ֝/עַתָּ֗ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: ychl yshr'l 'l yhvh m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר יְהוָ֥ה לְ/דָוִ֑ד אֵ֝ת כָּל עֻנּוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt zkhvr yhvh ldvd 't khl 'nvtv
verses.translation: LORD , remember David, and all his afflictions:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַ/יהוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַ/אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: 'shr nshb' lyhvh ndr l'byr y'qb
verses.translation: How he sware unto the LORD , and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

verses.original: אִם אָ֭בֹא בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑/י אִם אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'b' b'hl byty 'm ''lh 'l 'rsh ytsv'y
verses.translation: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.original: אִם אֶתֵּ֣ן שְׁנַ֣ת לְ/עֵינָ֑/י לְֽ/עַפְעַפַּ֥/י תְּנוּמָֽה
verses.translit: 'm 'tn shnt l'yny l'p'py tnvmh
verses.translation: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.original: עַד אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַ/יהוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַ/אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: 'd 'mts' mqvm lyhvh mshkhnvt l'byr y'qb
verses.translation: Until I find out a place for the LORD , an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה שְׁמַֽעֲנ֥וּ/הָ בְ/אֶפְרָ֑תָה מְ֝צָאנ֗וּ/הָ בִּ/שְׂדֵי יָֽעַר
verses.translit: hnh shm'nvh b'prth mts'nvh bshdy y'r
verses.translation: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.original: נָב֥וֹאָה לְ/מִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֑י/ו נִ֝שְׁתַּחֲוֶ֗ה לַ/הֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: nbv'h lmshkhnvtyv nshtchvh lhdm rglyv
verses.translation: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.original: קוּמָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה לִ/מְנוּחָתֶ֑/ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַ/אֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh lmnvchtkh 'th v'rvn 'zkh
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD , into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֥י/ךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ צֶ֑דֶק וַ/חֲסִידֶ֥י/ךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
verses.translit: khhnykh ylbshv tsdq vchsydykh yrnnv
verses.translation: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.original: בַּ֭/עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ אַל תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: b'bvr dvd 'bdkh 'l tshb pny mshychkh
verses.translation: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּֽע יְהוָ֨ה לְ/דָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹֽא יָשׁ֪וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥/נָּה מִ/פְּרִ֥י בִטְנְ/ךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְ/כִסֵּא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh ldvd 'mt l' yshvb mmnh mpry btnkh 'shyt lkhs' lkh
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.original: אִֽם יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨י/ךָ בְּרִיתִ/י֮ וְ/עֵדֹתִ֥/י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥/ם גַּם בְּנֵי/הֶ֥ם עֲדֵי עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְ/כִסֵּא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'm yshmrv bnykh bryty v'dty zv 'lmdm gm bnyhm 'dy 'd yshbv lkhs' lkh
verses.translation: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.original: כִּֽי בָחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/צִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗/הּ לְ/מוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy bchr yhvh btsyvn 'vh lmvshb lv
verses.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

verses.original: זֹאת מְנוּחָתִ֥/י עֲדֵי עַ֑ד פֹּֽה אֵ֝שֵׁ֗ב כִּ֣י אִוִּתִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: z't mnvchty 'dy 'd ph 'shb khy 'vtyh
verses.translation: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.original: צֵ֭ידָ/הּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗י/הָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: tsydh brkh 'brkh 'byvnyh 'shby' lchm
verses.translation: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/כֹהֲנֶי/הָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝/חֲסִידֶ֗י/הָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
verses.translit: vkhhnyh 'lbysh ysh' vchsydyh rnn yrnnv
verses.translation: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְ/דָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִ/מְשִׁיחִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm 'tsmych qrn ldvd 'rkhty nr lmshychy
verses.translation: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.original: א֭וֹיְבָי/ו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝/עָלָ֗י/ו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'vybyv 'lbysh bsht v'lyv ytsyts nzrv
verses.translation: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽ/מַּעֲל֗וֹת לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה טּ֭וֹב וּ/מַה נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם יָֽחַד
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt ldvd hnh mh tvb vmh n'ym shbt 'chym gm ychd
verses.translation: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.original: כַּ/שֶּׁ֤מֶן הַ/טּ֨וֹב עַל הָ/רֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל הַ/זָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝/יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khshmn htvb 'l hr'sh yrd 'l hzqn zqn 'hrn shyrd 'l py mdvtyv
verses.translation: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.original: כְּ/טַל חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁ/יֹּרֵד֮ עַל הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת הַ/בְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד הָ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khtl chrmvn shyrd 'l hrry tsyvn khy shm tsvh yhvh 't hbrkhh chyym 'd h'vlm
verses.translation: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽ/מַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה כָּל עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָ/עֹמְדִ֥ים בְּ/בֵית יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּ/לֵּילֽוֹת
verses.translit: shyr hm'lvt hnh brkhv 't yhvh khl 'bdy yhvh h'mdym bbyt yhvh blylvt
verses.translation: Behold, bless ye the LORD , all ye servants of the LORD , which by night stand in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: שְׂאֽוּ יְדֵ/כֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝/בָרֲכוּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: sh'v ydkhm qdsh vbrkhv 't yhvh
verses.translation: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD .

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִ/צִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ybrkhkh yhvh mtsyvn 'shh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hllv yh hllv 't shm yhvh hllv 'bdy yhvh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the name of the LORD ; praise him , O ye servants of the LORD .

verses.original: שֶׁ֣֭/עֹֽמְדִים בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝/חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: sh'mdym bbyt yhvh bchtsrvt byt 'lhynv
verses.translation: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD , in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ יָהּ כִּי ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝/שְׁמ֗/וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים
verses.translit: hllv yh khy tvb yhvh zmrv lshmv khy n'ym
verses.translation: Praise the LORD ; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣/וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִ/סְגֻלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy y'qb bchr lv yh yshr'l lsgltv
verses.translation: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝/אֲדֹנֵ֗י/נוּ מִ/כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'ny yd'ty khy gdvl yhvh v'dnynv mkhl 'lhym
verses.translation: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּ/שָּׁמַ֥יִם וּ/בָ/אָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝/יַּמִּ֗ים וְ/כָל תְּהוֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: khl 'shr chpts yhvh 'shh bshmym vb'rts bymym vkhl thvmvt
verses.translation: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.original: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִ/קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫/אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַ/מָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא ר֝וּחַ מֵ/אֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: m'lh nsh'ym mqtsh h'rts brqym lmtr 'shh mvts' rvch m'vtsrvtyv
verses.translation: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.original: שֶֽׁ֭/הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝/אָדָ֗ם עַד בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: shhkhh bkhvry mtsrym m'dm 'd bhmh
verses.translation: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.original: שָׁלַ֤ח אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭/מֹפְתִים בְּ/תוֹכֵ֣/כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝/פַרְעֹ֗ה וּ/בְ/כָל עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shlch 'tvt vmptym btvkhkhy mtsrym bpr'h vbkhl 'bdyv
verses.translation: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.original: שֶֽׁ֭/הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝/הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים
verses.translit: shhkhh gvym rbym vhrg mlkhym 'tsvmym
verses.translation: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.original: לְ/סִיח֤וֹן מֶ֤לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭/לְ/עוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝/לְ/כֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: lsychvn mlkh h'mry vl'vg mlkh hbshn vlkhl mmlkhvt khn'n
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣/ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntn 'rtsm nchlh nchlh lyshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְ/ךָ֥ לְ/דֹר וָ/דֹֽר
verses.translit: yhvh shmkh l'vlm yhvh zkhrkh ldr vdr
verses.translation: Thy name, O LORD , endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD , throughout all generations.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑/וֹ וְ/עַל עֲ֝בָדָ֗י/ו יִתְנֶחָֽם
verses.translit: khy ydyn yhvh 'mv v'l 'bdyv ytnchm
verses.translation: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.original: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭/גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: 'tsby hgvym khsf vzhb m'shh ydy 'dm
verses.translation: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.original: פֶּֽה לָ֭/הֶם וְ/לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝/הֶ֗ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ
verses.translit: ph lhm vl' ydbrv 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v
verses.translation: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.original: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭/הֶם וְ/לֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין יֶשׁ ר֥וּחַ בְּ/פִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'znym lhm vl' y'zynv 'f 'yn ysh rvch bpyhm
verses.translation: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.original: כְּ֭מוֹ/הֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khmvhm yhyv 'shyhm khl 'shr btch bhm
verses.translation: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byt yshr'l brkhv 't yhvh byt 'hrn brkhv 't yhvh
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , O house of Israel: bless the LORD , O house of Aaron:

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭/לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byt hlvy brkhv 't yhvh yr'y yhvh brkhv 't yhvh
verses.translation: Bless the LORD , O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD , bless the LORD .

verses.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה מִ/צִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh mtsyvn shkhn yrvshlm hllv yh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv l'lhy h'lhym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לַ/אֲדֹנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv l'dny h'dnym khy l'lm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/עֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'shh npl'vt gdlvt lbdv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭/שָּׁמַיִם בִּ/תְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'shh hshmym btbvnh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/רֹקַ֣ע הָ֭/אָרֶץ עַל הַ/מָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lrq' h'rts 'l hmym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ֭/עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'shh 'vrym gdlym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: אֶת הַ֭/שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְ/מֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּ/יּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't hshmsh lmmshlt byvm khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: אֶת הַ/יָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭/כוֹכָבִים לְ/מֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּ/לָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't hyrch vkhvkhbym lmmshlvt blylh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/מַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּ/בְכוֹרֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lmkhh mtsrym bbkhvryhm khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִ/תּוֹכָ֑/ם כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyvts' yshr'l mtvkhm khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: בְּ/יָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּ/בִ/זְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: byd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/גֹזֵ֣ר יַם ס֭וּף לִ/גְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lgzr ym svf lgzrym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּ/תוֹכ֑/וֹ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vh'byr yshr'l btvkhv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וְ/נִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְ/חֵיל֣/וֹ בְ/יַם ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vn'r pr'h vchylv bym svf khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ/מוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּ/וֹ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lmvlykh 'mv bmdbr khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: לְ֭/מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lmkhh mlkhym gdlym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וַֽ֭/יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhrg mlkhym 'dyrym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: לְ֭/סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lsychvn mlkh h'mry khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וּ֭/לְ/עוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl'vg mlkh hbshn khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣/ם לְ/נַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntn 'rtsm lnchlh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑/וֹ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nchlh lyshr'l 'bdv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: שֶׁ֭/בְּ/שִׁפְלֵ/נוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑/נוּ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shbshplnv zkhr lnv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְרְקֵ֥/נוּ מִ/צָּרֵ֑י/נוּ כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyprqnv mtsrynv khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ntn lchm lkhl bshr khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לְ/אֵ֣ל הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv l'l hshmym khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: עַ֥ל נַהֲר֨וֹת בָּבֶ֗ל שָׁ֣ם יָ֭שַׁבְנוּ גַּם בָּכִ֑ינוּ בְּ֝/זָכְרֵ֗/נוּ אֶת צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'l nhrvt bbl shm yshbnv gm bkhynv bzkhrnv 't tsyvn
verses.translation: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.original: עַֽל עֲרָבִ֥ים בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/הּ תָּ֝לִ֗ינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l 'rbym btvkhh tlynv khnrvtynv
verses.translation: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם שְֽׁאֵל֪וּ/נוּ שׁוֹבֵ֡י/נוּ דִּבְרֵי שִׁ֭יר וְ/תוֹלָלֵ֣י/נוּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה שִׁ֥ירוּ לָ֝֗/נוּ מִ/שִּׁ֥יר צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: khy shm sh'lvnv shvbynv dbry shyr vtvllynv shmchh shyrv lnv mshyr tsyvn
verses.translation: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.original: אֵ֗יךְ נָשִׁ֥יר אֶת שִׁיר יְהוָ֑ה עַ֝֗ל אַדְמַ֥ת נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: 'ykh nshyr 't shyr yhvh 'l 'dmt nkhr
verses.translation: How shall we sing the LORD’s song in a strange land?

verses.original: אִֽם אֶשְׁכָּחֵ֥/ךְ יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח יְמִינִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'shkhchkh yrvshlm tshkhch ymyny
verses.translation: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning .

verses.original: תִּדְבַּ֥ק לְשׁוֹנִ֨/י לְ/חִכִּ/י֮ אִם לֹ֪א אֶ֫זְכְּרֵ֥/כִי אִם לֹ֣א אַ֭עֲלֶה אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֑ם עַ֝֗ל רֹ֣אשׁ שִׂמְחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: tdbq lshvny lchkhy 'm l' 'zkhrkhy 'm l' ''lh 't yrvshlm 'l r'sh shmchty
verses.translation: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָ֨ה לִ/בְנֵ֬י אֱד֗וֹם אֵת֮ י֤וֹם יְֽרוּשָׁ֫לִָ֥ם הָ֭/אֹ֣מְרִים עָ֤רוּ עָ֑רוּ עַ֝֗ד הַ/יְס֥וֹד בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: zkhr yhvh lbny 'dvm 't yvm yrvshlm h'mrym 'rv 'rv 'd hysvd bh
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD , the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it , rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

verses.original: בַּת בָּבֶ֗ל הַ/שְּׁד֫וּדָ֥ה אַשְׁרֵ֥י שֶׁ/יְשַׁלֶּם לָ֑/ךְ אֶת גְּ֝מוּלֵ֗/ךְ שֶׁ/גָּמַ֥לְתְּ לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: bt bbl hshdvdh 'shry shyshlm lkh 't gmvlkh shgmlt lnv
verses.translation: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י שֶׁ/יֹּאחֵ֓ז וְ/נִפֵּ֬ץ אֶֽת עֹ֝לָלַ֗יִ/ךְ אֶל הַ/סָּֽלַע
verses.translit: 'shry shy'chz vnpts 't 'llykh 'l hsl'
verses.translation: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד אוֹדְ/ךָ֥ בְ/כָל לִבִּ֑/י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: ldvd 'vdkh bkhl lby ngd 'lhym 'zmrkh
verses.translation: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.original: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁ/ךָ֡ וְ/א֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת שְׁמֶ֗/ךָ עַל חַסְדְּ/ךָ֥ וְ/עַל אֲמִתֶּ֑/ךָ כִּֽי הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל כָּל שִׁ֝מְ/ךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shtchvh 'l hykhl qdshkh v'vdh 't shmkh 'l chsdkh v'l 'mtkh khy hgdlt 'l khl shmkh 'mrtkh
verses.translation: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.original: בְּ/י֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽ/תַּעֲנֵ֑/נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖/נִי בְ/נַפְשִׁ֣/י עֹֽז
verses.translit: byvm qr'ty vt'nny trhbny bnpshy 'z
verses.translation: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ/ךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל מַלְכֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yvdvkh yhvh khl mlkhy 'rts khy shm'v 'mry pykh
verses.translation: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD , when they hear the words of thy mouth.

verses.original: וְ֭/יָשִׁירוּ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshyrv bdrkhy yhvh khy gdvl khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD : for great is the glory of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּי רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְ/שָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝/גָבֹ֗הַּ מִ/מֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע
verses.translit: khy rm yhvh vshpl yr'h vgbh mmrchq yyd'
verses.translation: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

verses.original: אִם אֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥/נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַ/י תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/ת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣/נִי יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm 'lkh bqrb tsrh tchyny 'l 'f 'yby tshlch ydkh vtvshy'ny ymynkh
verses.translation: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥/י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣י/ךָ אַל תֶּֽרֶף
verses.translit: yhvh ygmr b'dy yhvh chsdkh l'vlm m'shy ydykh 'l trf
verses.translation: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD , endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

verses.original: לַ֭/מְנַצֵּחַ לְ/דָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗/נִי וַ/תֵּדָֽע
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd mzmvr yhvh chqrtny vtd'
verses.translation: O LORD , thou hast searched me, and known me .

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣/י וְ/קוּמִ֑/י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝/רֵעִ֗/י מֵ/רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: 'th yd't shbty vqvmy bnth lr'y mrchvq
verses.translation: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.original: אָרְחִ֣/י וְ/רִבְעִ֣/י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽ/כָל דְּרָכַ֥/י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה
verses.translit: 'rchy vrb'y zryt vkhl drkhy hskhnth
verses.translation: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּ/לְשׁוֹנִ֑/י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy 'yn mlh blshvny hn yhvh yd't khlh
verses.translation: For there is not a word in my tongue, but , lo, O LORD , thou knowest it altogether.

verses.original: אָח֣וֹר וָ/קֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑/נִי וַ/תָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣/י כַּפֶּֽ/כָה
verses.translit: 'chvr vqdm tsrtny vtsht 'ly khpkhh
verses.translation: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.original: פלאיה פְּלִ֣יאָֽה דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑/נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא א֥וּכַֽל לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: pl'yh ply'h d't mmny nshgbh l' 'vkhl lh
verses.translation: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.original: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵ/רוּחֶ֑/ךָ וְ֝/אָ֗נָה מִ/פָּנֶ֥י/ךָ אֶבְרָֽח
verses.translit: 'nh 'lkh mrvchkh v'nh mpnykh 'brch
verses.translation: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.original: אִם אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְ/אַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'm 'sq shmym shm 'th v'tsy'h sh'vl hnkh
verses.translation: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there .

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם
verses.translit: 'sh' khnpy shchr 'shkhnh b'chryt ym
verses.translation: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.original: גַּם שָׁ֭ם יָדְ/ךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑/נִי וְֽ/תֹאחֲזֵ֥/נִי יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: gm shm ydkh tnchny vt'chzny ymynkh
verses.translation: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.original: וָ֭/אֹמַר אַךְ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'mr 'kh chshkh yshvpny vlylh 'vr b'dny
verses.translation: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.original: גַּם חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥/ךָ וְ֭/לַיְלָה כַּ/יּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝/חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּ/אוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: gm chshkh l' ychshykh mmkh vlylh khyvm y'yr khchshykhh kh'vrh
verses.translation: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee .

verses.original: כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑/י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗/נִי בְּ/בֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th qnyt khlyty tskhny bbtn 'my
verses.translation: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

verses.original: אֽוֹדְ/ךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/נַפְשִׁ֗/י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'vdkh 'l khy nvr'vt nplyty npl'ym m'shykh vnpshy yd't m'd
verses.translation: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

verses.original: לֹא נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗/י מִ֫מֶּ֥/ךָּ אֲשֶׁר עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַ/סֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽ/תַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: l' nkhchd 'tsmy mmkh 'shr 'shyty bstr rqmty btchtyvt 'rts
verses.translation: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.original: גָּלְמִ֤/י רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/עַֽל סִפְרְ/ךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪/ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ ו/לא וְ/ל֖/וֹ אֶחָ֣ד בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: glmy r'v 'ynykh v'l sprkh khlm ykhtbv ymym ytsrv vl' vlv 'chd bhm
verses.translation: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

verses.original: וְ/לִ֗/י מַה יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣י/ךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vly mh yqrv r'ykh 'l mh 'tsmv r'shyhm
verses.translation: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

verses.original: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵ/ם מֵ/ח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּ/ן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְ/עוֹדִ֥/י עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'sprm mchvl yrbvn hqytsty v'vdy 'mkh
verses.translation: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

verses.original: אִם תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: 'm tqtl 'lvh rsh' v'nshy dmym svrv mny
verses.translation: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻ/ךָ לִ/מְזִמָּ֑ה נָשֻׂ֖א לַ/שָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shr y'mrkh lmzmh nsh' lshv' 'rykh
verses.translation: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

verses.original: הֲ/לֽוֹא מְשַׂנְאֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝/בִ/תְקוֹמְמֶ֗י/ךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט
verses.translit: hlv' mshn'ykh yhvh 'shn' vbtqvmmykh 'tqvtt
verses.translation: Do not I hate them, O LORD , that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.original: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑י/ם לְ֝/אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: tkhlyt shn'h shn'tym l'vybym hyv ly
verses.translation: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

verses.original: חָקְרֵ֣/נִי אֵ֭ל וְ/דַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑/י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗/נִי וְ/דַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽ/י
verses.translit: chqrny 'l vd' lbby bchnny vd' shr'py
verses.translation: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

verses.original: וּ/רְאֵ֗ה אִם דֶּֽרֶךְ עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑/י וּ֝/נְחֵ֗/נִי בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vr'h 'm drkh 'tsb by vnchny bdrkh 'vlm
verses.translation: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.original: לַ/מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: Deliver me, O LORD , from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.original: חַלְּצֵ֣/נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵ/אָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: chltsny yhvh m'dm r' m'ysh chmsym tntsrny
verses.translation: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּ/לֵ֑ב כָּל י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'shr chshbv r'vt blb khl yvm ygvrv mlchmvt
verses.translation: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

verses.original: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָ/ם֮ כְּֽמוֹ נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣י/מוֹ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: shnnv lshvnm khmv nchsh chmt 'khshvb tcht shptymv slh
verses.translation: Keep me, O LORD , from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֤/נִי יְהוָ֨ה מִ֘/ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑/נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִ/דְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: shmrny yhvh mydy rsh' m'ysh chmsym tntsrny 'shr chshbv ldchvt p'my
verses.translation: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.original: טָֽמְנֽוּ גֵאִ֨ים פַּ֡ח לִ֗/י וַ/חֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְ/יַד מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ לִ֣/י סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: tmnv g'ym pch ly vchblym prshv rsht lyd m'gl mqshym shtv ly slh
verses.translation: I said unto the LORD , Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD .

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭/יהוָה אֵ֣לִ/י אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mrty lyhvh 'ly 'th h'zynh yhvh qvl tchnvny
verses.translation: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.original: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָ/י עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑/י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝/רֹאשִׁ֗/י בְּ/י֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק
verses.translit: yhvh 'dny 'z yshv'ty skhth lr'shy byvm nshq
verses.translation: Grant not, O LORD , the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.original: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥/וֹ אַל תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: 'l ttn yhvh m'vyy rsh' zmmv 'l tpq yrvmv slh
verses.translation: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.original: רֹ֥אשׁ מְסִבָּ֑/י עֲמַ֖ל שְׂפָתֵ֣י/מוֹ יכסו/מו יְכַסֵּֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: r'sh msby 'ml shptymv ykhsvmv ykhsmv
verses.translation: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.original: ימיטו יִמּ֥וֹטוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑/ם בְּ֝/מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל יָקֽוּמוּ
verses.translit: ymytv ymvtv 'lyhm gchlym b'sh yplm bmhmrvt bl yqvmv
verses.translation: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him .

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫/אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗/נּוּ לְ/מַדְחֵפֹֽת
verses.translit: 'ysh lshvn bl ykhvn b'rts 'ysh chms r' ytsvdnv lmdchpt
verses.translation: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

verses.original: ידעת יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים
verses.translit: yd't yd'ty khy y'shh yhvh dyn 'ny mshpt 'bynym
verses.translation: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִי/ךָ ח֣וּשָׁ/ה לִּ֑/י הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה ק֝וֹלִ֗/י בְּ/קָרְאִ/י לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh qr'tykh chvshh ly h'zynh qvly bqr'y lkh
verses.translation: LORD , I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

verses.original: תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣/י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗/י מִנְחַת עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: tkhvn tplty qtrt lpnykh msh't khpy mncht 'rb
verses.translation: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.original: שִׁיתָ֣/ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְ/פִ֑/י נִ֝צְּרָ֗/ה עַל דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽ/י
verses.translit: shyth yhvh shmrh lpy ntsrh 'l dl shpty
verses.translation: Set a watch, O LORD , before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.original: אַל תַּט לִבִּ֨/י לְ/דָבָ֪ר רָ֡ע לְ/הִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת בְּ/רֶ֗שַׁע אֶת אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּ/בַל אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּ/מַנְעַמֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l tt lby ldbr r' lht'vll 'llvt brsh' 't 'yshym p'ly 'vn vbl 'lchm bmn'myhm
verses.translation: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.original: יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽ/נִי צַדִּ֨יק חֶ֡סֶד וְֽ/יוֹכִיחֵ֗/נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑/י כִּי ע֥וֹד וּ֝/תְפִלָּתִ֗/י בְּ/רָעוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: yhlmny tsdyq chsd vyvkhychny shmn r'sh 'l yny r'shy khy 'vd vtplty br'vtyhm
verses.translation: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

verses.original: נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽ/ידֵי סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/שָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗/י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ
verses.translit: nshmtv bydy sl' shptyhm vshm'v 'mry khy n'mv
verses.translation: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּ/בֹקֵ֣עַ בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗י/נוּ לְ/פִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל
verses.translit: khmv plch vbq' b'rts npzrv 'tsmynv lpy sh'vl
verses.translation: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣/י עֵינָ֑/י בְּ/כָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: khy 'lykh yhvh 'dny 'yny bkhh chsyty 'l t'r npshy
verses.translation: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֗/נִי מִ֣/ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑/י וּ֝/מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: shmrny mydy pch yqshv ly vmqshvt p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.original: יִפְּל֣וּ בְ/מַכְמֹרָ֣י/ו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד אֶעֱבֽוֹר
verses.translit: yplv bmkhmryv rsh'ym ychd 'nkhy 'd ''bvr
verses.translation: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ/דָוִ֑ד בִּ/הְיוֹת֖/וֹ בַ/מְּעָרָ֣ה תְפִלָּֽה
verses.translit: mshkhyl ldvd bhyvtv bm'rh tplh
verses.translation: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

verses.original: ק֭וֹלִ/י אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗/י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן
verses.translit: qvly 'l yhvh 'z'q qvly 'l yhvh 'tchnn
verses.translation: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.original: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו שִׂיחִ֑/י צָ֝רָתִ֗/י לְ/פָנָ֥י/ו אַגִּֽיד
verses.translit: 'shpkh lpnyv shychy tsrty lpnyv 'gyd
verses.translation: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.original: בְּ/הִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨/י רוּחִ֗/י וְ/אַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥/י בְּ/אֹֽרַח ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽ/י
verses.translit: bht'tf 'ly rvchy v'th yd't ntybty b'rch zv 'hlkh tmnv pch ly
verses.translation: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.original: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין וּ/רְאֵה֮ וְ/אֵֽין לִ֪/י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑/נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְ/נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hbyt ymyn vr'h v'yn ly mkhyr 'bd mnvs mmny 'yn dvrsh lnpshy
verses.translation: I cried unto thee, O LORD : I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.original: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑/י חֶ֝לְקִ֗/י בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/חַיִּים
verses.translit: z'qty 'lykh yhvh 'mrty 'th mchsy chlqy b'rts hchyym
verses.translation: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָ/ה אֶֽל רִנָּתִ/י֮ כִּֽי דַלּ֪וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥/נִי מֵ/רֹדְפַ֑/י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: hqshybh 'l rnty khy dlvty m'd htsylny mrdpy khy 'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗/י הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה אֶל תַּחֲנוּנַ֑/י בֶּ/אֱמֻנָתְ/ךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗/נִי בְּ/צִדְקָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh shm' tplty h'zynh 'l tchnvny b'mntkh 'nny btsdqtkh
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O LORD , give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/אַל תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭/מִשְׁפָּט אֶת עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא יִצְדַּ֖ק לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ כָל חָֽי
verses.translit: v'l tbv' bmshpt 't 'bdkh khy l' ytsdq lpnykh khl chy
verses.translation: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.original: כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב נַפְשִׁ֗/י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭/אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑/י הוֹשִׁיבַ֥/נִי בְ֝/מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּ/מֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy rdf 'vyb npshy dkh' l'rts chyty hvshybny bmchshkhym khmty 'vlm
verses.translation: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣/י רוּחִ֑/י בְּ֝/תוֹכִ֗/י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vtt'tf 'ly rvchy btvkhy yshtvmm lby
verses.translation: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים מִ/קֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְ/כָל פָּעֳלֶ֑/ךָ בְּֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ
verses.translit: zkhrty ymym mqdm hgyty bkhl p'lkh bm'shh ydykh 'shvchch
verses.translation: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

verses.original: פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣/י אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ נַפְשִׁ֓/י כְּ/אֶֽרֶץ עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְ/ךָ֣ סֶֽלָה
verses.translit: prshty ydy 'lykh npshy kh'rts 'yph lkh slh
verses.translation: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

verses.original: מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨/נִי יְהוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֪ה ר֫וּחִ֥/י אַל תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וְ֝/נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: mhr 'nny yhvh khlth rvchy 'l tstr pnykh mmny vnmshlty 'm yrdy bvr
verses.translation: Hear me speedily, O LORD : my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤/נִי בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר חַסְדֶּ/ךָ֮ כִּֽי בְ/ךָ֪ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗/נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי אֵ֝לֶי/ךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: hshmy'ny bbqr chsdkh khy bkh btchty hvdy'ny drkh zv 'lkh khy 'lykh nsh'ty npshy
verses.translation: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֖/נִי מֵ/אֹיְבַ֥/י יְהוָ֗ה אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ כִסִּֽתִי
verses.translit: htsylny m'yby yhvh 'lykh khsty
verses.translation: Deliver me, O LORD , from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

verses.original: לַמְּדֵ֤/נִי לַֽ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶ/ךָ֮ כִּֽי אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥/י רוּחֲ/ךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗/נִי בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר
verses.translit: lmdny l'shvt rtsvnkh khy 'th 'lvhy rvchkh tvbh tnchny b'rts myshvr
verses.translation: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑/נִי בְּ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֓ תוֹצִ֖יא מִ/צָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: lm'n shmkh yhvh tchyny btsdqtkh tvtsy' mtsrh npshy
verses.translation: Quicken me, O LORD , for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/חַסְדְּ/ךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥/י וְֽ֭/הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑/י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vbchsdkh ttsmyt 'yby vh'bdt khl tsrry npshy khy 'ny 'bdkh
verses.translation: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

verses.original: לְ/דָוִ֨ד בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה צוּרִ֗/י הַֽ/מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣/י לַ/קְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗/י לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: ldvd brvkh yhvh tsvry hmlmd ydy lqrb 'tsb'vty lmlchmh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

verses.original: חַסְדִּ֥/י וּ/מְצוּדָתִ/י֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֪/י וּֽ/מְפַלְטִ֫/י לִ֥/י מָ֭גִנִּ/י וּ/ב֣/וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָ/רוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣/י תַחְתָּֽ/י
verses.translit: chsdy vmtsvdty mshgby vmplty ly mgny vbv chsyty hrvdd 'my tchty
verses.translation: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מָה אָ֭דָם וַ/תֵּדָעֵ֑/הוּ בֶּן אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ וַֽ/תְּחַשְּׁבֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: yhvh mh 'dm vtd'hv bn 'nvsh vtchshbhv
verses.translation: LORD , what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

verses.original: אָ֭דָם לַ/הֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗י/ו כְּ/צֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: 'dm lhbl dmh ymyv khtsl 'vbr
verses.translation: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה הַט שָׁמֶ֣י/ךָ וְ/תֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּ/הָרִ֣ים וְֽ/יֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ
verses.translit: yhvh ht shmykh vtrd g' bhrym vy'shnv
verses.translation: Bow thy heavens, O LORD , and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.original: בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּ/תְפִיצֵ֑/ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗י/ךָ וּ/תְהֻמֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: brvq brq vtpytsm shlch chtsykh vthmm
verses.translation: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

verses.original: שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗י/ךָ מִ/מָּ֫ר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣/נִי וְ֭/הַצִּילֵ/נִי מִ/מַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝/יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: shlch ydykh mmrvm ptsny vhtsylny mmym rbym myd bny nkhr
verses.translation: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭י/הֶם דִּבֶּר שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝/ימִינָ֗/ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: 'shr pyhm dbr shv' vymynm ymyn shqr
verses.translation: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ אָשִׁ֣ירָה לָּ֑/ךְ בְּ/נֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר אֲזַמְּרָה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'lhym shyr chdsh 'shyrh lkh bnbl 'shvr 'zmrh lkh
verses.translation: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

verses.original: הַ/נּוֹתֵ֥ן תְּשׁוּעָ֗ה לַ/מְּלָ֫כִ֥ים הַ֭/פּוֹצֶה אֶת דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדּ֗/וֹ מֵ/חֶ֥רֶב רָעָֽה
verses.translit: hnvtn tshv'h lmlkhym hpvtsh 't dvd 'bdv mchrb r'h
verses.translation: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.original: פְּצֵ֥/נִי וְ/הַצִּילֵ/נִי֮ מִ/יַּ֪ד בְּֽנֵי נֵ֫כָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּ֭י/הֶם דִּבֶּר שָׁ֑וְא וִֽ֝/ימִינָ֗/ם יְמִ֣ין שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: ptsny vhtsylny myd bny nkhr 'shr pyhm dbr shv' vymynm ymyn shqr
verses.translation: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨י/נוּ כִּ/נְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֪ים בִּֽ/נְעוּרֵ֫י/הֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥י/נוּ כְ/זָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל
verses.translit: 'shr bnynv khnt'ym mgdlym bn'vryhm bnvtynv khzvyt mchtbvt tbnyt hykhl
verses.translation: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

verses.original: מְזָוֵ֣י/נוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִ/זַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣/נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּ/חוּצוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: mzvynv ml'ym mpyqym mzn 'l zn ts'vnnv m'lypvt mrbbvt bchvtsvtynv
verses.translation: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

verses.original: אַלּוּפֵ֗י/נוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין פֶּ֭רֶץ וְ/אֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְ/אֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּ/רְחֹבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'lvpynv msblym 'yn prts v'yn yvts't v'yn tsvchh brchbtynv
verses.translation: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭/עָם שֶׁ/כָּ֣כָה לּ֑/וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝/עָ֗ם שֶׁ/יֲהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'shry h'm shkhkhh lv 'shry h'm shyhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea , happy is that people, whose God is the LORD .

verses.original: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְ/דָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְ/ךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/אֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְ/ךָ֗ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: thlh ldvd 'rvmmkh 'lvhy hmlkh v'brkhh shmkh l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/אֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְ/ךָ֗ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: bkhl yvm 'brkhkh v'hllh shmkh l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּ/מְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝/לִ/גְדֻלָּת֗/וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר
verses.translit: gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd vlgdltv 'yn chqr
verses.translation: Great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.original: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭/דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑י/ךָ וּ/גְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣י/ךָ יַגִּֽידוּ
verses.translit: dvr ldvr yshbch m'shykh vgbvrtykh ygydv
verses.translation: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

verses.original: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/דִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣י/ךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה
verses.translit: hdr khbvd hvdkh vdbry npl'vtykh 'shychh
verses.translation: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

verses.original: וֶ/עֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣י/ךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ ו/גדולתי/ך וּ/גְדוּלָּתְ/ךָ֥ אֲסַפְּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'zvz nvr'tykh y'mrv vgdvltykh vgdvltkh 'sprnh
verses.translation: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר רַב טוּבְ/ךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ
verses.translit: zkhr rb tvbkh yby'v vtsdqtkh yrnnv
verses.translation: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

verses.original: חַנּ֣וּן וְ/רַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּ/גְדָל חָֽסֶד
verses.translit: chnvn vrchvm yhvh 'rkh 'pym vgdl chsd
verses.translation: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

verses.original: טוֹב יְהוָ֥ה לַ/כֹּ֑ל וְ֝/רַחֲמָ֗י/ו עַל כָּל מַעֲשָֽׂי/ו
verses.translit: tvb yhvh lkhl vrchmyv 'l khl m'shyv
verses.translation: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ/ךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל מַעֲשֶׂ֑י/ךָ וַ֝/חֲסִידֶ֗י/ךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּ/כָה
verses.translit: yvdvkh yhvh khl m'shykh vchsydykh ybrkhvkhh
verses.translation: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD ; and thy saints shall bless thee.

verses.original: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְ/ךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּ/גְבוּרָתְ/ךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: khbvd mlkhvtkh y'mrv vgbvrtkh ydbrv
verses.translation: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

verses.original: לְ/הוֹדִ֤יעַ לִ/בְנֵ֣י הָ֭/אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑י/ו וּ֝/כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lhvdy' lbny h'dm gbvrtyv vkhbvd hdr mlkhvtv
verses.translation: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

verses.original: מַֽלְכוּתְ/ךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝/מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כָל דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: mlkhvtkh mlkhvt khl 'lmym vmmshltkh bkhl dvr vdvr
verses.translation: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.original: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְ/כָל הַ/נֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝/זוֹקֵ֗ף לְ/כָל הַ/כְּפוּפִֽים
verses.translit: svmkh yhvh lkhl hnplym vzvqf lkhl hkhpvpym
verses.translation: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

verses.original: עֵֽינֵי כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְ/אַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן לָ/הֶ֖ם אֶת אָכְלָ֣/ם בְּ/עִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'yny khl 'lykh yshbrv v'th nvtn lhm 't 'khlm b'tv
verses.translation: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

verses.original: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת יָדֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְ/כָל חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן
verses.translit: pvtch 't ydkh vmshby' lkhl chy rtsvn
verses.translation: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֑י/ו וְ֝/חָסִ֗יד בְּ/כָל מַעֲשָֽׂי/ו
verses.translit: tsdyq yhvh bkhl drkhyv vchsyd bkhl m'shyv
verses.translation: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְ/כָל קֹרְאָ֑י/ו לְ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣/הוּ בֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: qrvb yhvh lkhl qr'yv lkhl 'shr yqr'hv b'mt
verses.translation: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

verses.original: רְצוֹן יְרֵאָ֥י/ו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽ/אֶת שַׁוְעָתָ֥/ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְ/יוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: rtsvn yr'yv y'shh v't shv'tm yshm' vyvshy'm
verses.translation: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת כָּל אֹהֲבָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל הָ/רְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד
verses.translit: shvmr yhvh 't khl 'hbyv v't khl hrsh'ym yshmyd
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

verses.original: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר פִּ֥/י וִ/יבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשׁ֗/וֹ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד
verses.translit: thlt yhvh ydbr py vybrkh khl bshr shm qdshv l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD : and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.original: הַֽלְלוּ יָ֡הּ הַלְלִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hllv yh hlly npshy 't yhvh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Praise the LORD , O my soul.

verses.original: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/חַיָּ֑/י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽ/אלֹהַ֣/י בְּ/עוֹדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'hllh yhvh bchyy 'zmrh l'lhy b'vdy
verses.translation: While I live will I praise the LORD : I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

verses.original: אַל תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִ/נְדִיבִ֑ים בְּ/בֶן אָדָ֓ם שֶׁ֤/אֵֽין ל֥/וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: 'l tbtchv bndybym bbn 'dm sh'yn lv tshv'h
verses.translation: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

verses.original: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּח/וֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְ/אַדְמָת֑/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ֝/ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: tts' rvchv yshb l'dmtv byvm hhv' 'bdv 'shtntyv
verses.translation: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤/אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּ/עֶזְר֑/וֹ שִׂ֝בְר֗/וֹ עַל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'shry sh'l y'qb b'zrv shbrv 'l yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֶת הַ/יָּ֥ם וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֑/ם הַ/שֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'shh shmym v'rts 't hym v't khl 'shr bm hshmr 'mt l'vlm
verses.translation: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט לָ/עֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָ/רְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים
verses.translit: 'shh mshpt l'shvqym ntn lchm lr'bym yhvh mtyr 'svrym
verses.translation: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: yhvh pqch 'vrym yhvh zqf khpvpym yhvh 'hb tsdyqym
