verses.translation: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת גֵּרִ֗ים יָת֣וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעוֹדֵ֑ד וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת
verses.translit: yhvh shmr 't grym ytvm v'lmnh y'vdd vdrkh rsh'ym y'vt
verses.translation: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

verses.original: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוָ֨ה לְ/עוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִ/ךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְ/דֹ֥ר וָ/דֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: ymlkh yhvh l'vlm 'lhykh tsyvn ldr vdr hllv yh
verses.translation: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ כִּי ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה
verses.translit: hllv yh khy tvb zmrh 'lhynv khy n'ym n'vh thlh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD : for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

verses.original: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס
verses.translit: bvnh yrvshlm yhvh ndchy yshr'l ykhns
verses.translation: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

verses.original: הָ֭/רֹפֵא לִ/שְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝/מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְ/עַצְּבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hrp' lshbvry lb vmchbsh l'tsbvtm
verses.translation: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

verses.original: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַ/כּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝/כֻלָּ֗/ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: mvnh mspr lkhvkhbym lkhlm shmvt yqr'
verses.translation: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣י/נוּ וְ/רַב כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝/תְבוּנָת֗/וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: gdvl 'dvnynv vrb khch ltbvntv 'yn mspr
verses.translation: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

verses.original: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: m'vdd 'nvym yhvh mshpyl rsh'ym 'dy 'rts
verses.translation: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

verses.original: עֱנ֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה בְּ/תוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י/נוּ בְ/כִנּֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'nv lyhvh btvdh zmrv l'lhynv bkhnvr
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

verses.original: הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם בְּ/עָבִ֗ים הַ/מֵּכִ֣ין לָ/אָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַ/מַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר
verses.translit: hmkhsh shmym b'bym hmkhyn l'rts mtr hmtsmych hrym chtsyr
verses.translation: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִ/בְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑/הּ לִ/בְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: nvtn lbhmh lchmh lbny 'rb 'shr yqr'v
verses.translation: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

verses.original: לֹ֤א בִ/גְבוּרַ֣ת הַ/סּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא בְ/שׁוֹקֵ֖י הָ/אִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה
verses.translit: l' bgbvrt hsvs ychpts l' bshvqy h'ysh yrtsh
verses.translation: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.original: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת יְרֵאָ֑י/ו אֶת הַֽ/מְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְ/חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: rvtsh yhvh 't yr'yv 't hmychlym lchsdv
verses.translation: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

verses.original: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִ/ךְ צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: shbchy yrvshlm 't yhvh hlly 'lhykh tsyvn
verses.translation: Praise the LORD , O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

verses.translit: khy chzq brychy sh'rykh brkh bnykh bqrbkh
verses.translation: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.original: הַ/שָּׂם גְּבוּלֵ֥/ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hshm gbvlkh shlvm chlb chtym yshby'kh
verses.translation: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

verses.original: הַ/שֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣/וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hshlch 'mrtv 'rts 'd mhrh yrvts dbrv
verses.translation: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

verses.original: הַ/נֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּ/צָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּ/אֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר
verses.translit: hntn shlg khtsmr khpvr kh'pr ypzr
verses.translation: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

verses.original: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣/וֹ כְ/פִתִּ֑ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗/וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: mshlykh qrchv khptym lpny qrtv my y'md
verses.translation: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣/וֹ וְ/יַמְסֵ֑/ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗/וֹ יִזְּלוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: yshlch dbrv vymsm yshb rvchv yzlv mym
verses.translation: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

verses.original: מַגִּ֣יד דבר/ו דְּבָרָ֣י/ו לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥י/ו וּ֝/מִשְׁפָּטָ֗י/ו לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mgyd dbrv dbryv ly'qb chqyv vmshptyv lyshr'l
verses.translation: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

verses.original: לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן לְ/כָל גּ֗וֹי וּ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל יְדָע֗וּ/ם הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: l' 'shh khn lkhl gvy vmshptym bl yd'vm hllv yh
verses.translation: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ בַּ/מְּרוֹמִֽים
verses.translit: hllv yh hllv 't yhvh mn hshmym hllvhv bmrvmym
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights. . Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּ/הוּ כָל מַלְאָכָ֑י/ו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ כָּל צבא/ו צְבָאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hllvhv khl ml'khyv hllvhv khl tsb'v tsb'yv
verses.translation: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ/הוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְ/יָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ כָּל כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר
verses.translit: hllvhv shmsh vyrch hllvhv khl khvkhby 'vr
verses.translation: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ/הוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝/הַ/מַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵ/עַ֬ל הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: hllvhv shmy hshmym vhmym 'shr m'l hshmym
verses.translation: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֭וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְ/נִבְרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: yhllv 't shm yhvh khy hv' tsvh vnbr'v
verses.translation: Let them praise the name of the LORD : for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמִידֵ֣/ם לָ/עַ֣ד לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם חָק נָ֝תַ֗ן וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'mydm l'd l'vlm chq ntn vl' y'bvr
verses.translation: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת יְ֭הוָה מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ תַּ֝נִּינִ֗ים וְ/כָל תְּהֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: hllv 't yhvh mn h'rts tnynym vkhl thmvt
verses.translation: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

verses.original: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭/בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְ/קִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'sh vbrd shlg vqytvr rvch s'rh 'shh dbrv
verses.translation: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.original: הֶ/הָרִ֥ים וְ/כָל גְּבָע֑וֹת עֵ֥ץ פְּ֝רִ֗י וְ/כָל אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: hhrym vkhl gb'vt 'ts pry vkhl 'rzym
verses.translation: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.original: הַֽ/חַיָּ֥ה וְ/כָל בְּהֵמָ֑ה רֶ֝֗מֶשׂ וְ/צִפּ֥וֹר כָּנָֽף
verses.translit: hchyh vkhl bhmh rmsh vtspvr khnf
verses.translation: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

verses.original: מַלְכֵי אֶ֭רֶץ וְ/כָל לְאֻמִּ֑ים שָׂ֝רִ֗ים וְ/כָל שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mlkhy 'rts vkhl l'mym shrym vkhl shpty 'rts
verses.translation: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.original: בַּחוּרִ֥ים וְ/גַם בְּתוּל֑וֹת זְ֝קֵנִ֗ים עִם נְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: bchvrym vgm btvlvt zqnym 'm n'rym
verses.translation: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

verses.original: יְהַלְל֤וּ אֶת שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣/וֹ לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ ה֝וֹד֗/וֹ עַל אֶ֥רֶץ וְ/שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: yhllv 't shm yhvh khy nshgb shmv lbdv hvdv 'l 'rts vshmym
verses.translation: Let them praise the name of the LORD : for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן לְ/עַמּ֡/וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽ/כָל חֲסִידָ֗י/ו לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם קְרֹב֗/וֹ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: vyrm qrn l'mv thlh lkhl chsydyv lbny yshr'l 'm qrbv hllv yh
verses.translation: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭/יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗/וֹ בִּ/קְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים
verses.translit: hllv yh shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh thltv bqhl chsydym
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּ/עֹשָׂ֑י/ו בְּנֵֽי צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְ/מַלְכָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yshmch yshr'l b'shyv bny tsyvn ygylv bmlkhm
verses.translation: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.original: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣/וֹ בְ/מָח֑וֹל בְּ/תֹ֥ף וְ֝/כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhllv shmv bmchvl btf vkhnvr yzmrv lv
verses.translation: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

verses.original: כִּֽי רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּ/עַמּ֑/וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּ/ישׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: khy rvtsh yhvh b'mv yp'r 'nvym byshv'h
verses.translation: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

verses.original: יַעְלְז֣וּ חֲסִידִ֣ים בְּ/כָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: y'lzv chsydym bkhbvd yrnnv 'l mshkhbvtm
verses.translation: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּ/גְרוֹנָ֑/ם וְ/חֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּ/יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: rvmmvt 'l bgrvnm vchrb pypyvt bydm
verses.translation: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

verses.original: לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹכֵחֹ֗ת בַּל אֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: l'shvt nqmh bgvym tvkhcht bl 'mym
verses.translation: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

verses.original: לֶ/אְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵי/הֶ֣ם בְּ/זִקִּ֑ים וְ֝/נִכְבְּדֵי/הֶ֗ם בְּ/כַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: l'sr mlkhyhm bzqym vnkhbdyhm bkhbly brzl
verses.translation: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.original: לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּ/הֶ֨ם מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְ/כָל חֲסִידָ֗י/ו הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: l'shvt bhm mshpt khtvb hdr hv' lkhl chsydyv hllv yh
verses.translation: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַֽלְלוּ אֵ֥ל בְּ/קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ בִּ/רְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hllv yh hllv 'l bqdshv hllvhv brqy' 'zv
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD . Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּ/הוּ בִ/גְבוּרֹתָ֑י/ו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ כְּ/רֹ֣ב גֻּדְלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hllvhv bgbvrtyv hllvhv khrb gdlv
verses.translation: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ/הוּ בְּ/תֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ בְּ/נֵ֣בֶל וְ/כִנּֽוֹר
verses.translit: hllvhv btq' shvpr hllvhv bnbl vkhnvr
verses.translation: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּ/הוּ בְ/תֹ֣ף וּ/מָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ בְּ/מִנִּ֥ים וְ/עוּגָֽב
verses.translit: hllvhv btf vmchvl hllvhv bmnym v'vgb
verses.translation: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּ/הוּ בְ/צִלְצְלֵי שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ/הוּ בְּֽ/צִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: hllvhv btsltsly shm' hllvhv btsltsly trv'h
verses.translation: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הַ֭/נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֗הּ הַֽלְלוּ יָֽהּ
verses.translit: khl hnshmh thll yh hllv yh
verses.translation: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .

verses.original: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mshly shlmh bn dvd mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

verses.original: לָ/דַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּ/מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝/הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה
verses.translit: ld't chkhmh vmvsr lhbyn 'mry bynh
verses.translation: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

verses.original: לָ֭/קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝/מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּ/מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: lqcht mvsr hshkhl tsdq vmshpt vmyshrym
verses.translation: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

verses.original: לָ/תֵ֣ת לִ/פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝/נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּ/מְזִמָּֽה
verses.translit: ltt lpt'ym 'rmh ln'r d't vmzmh
verses.translation: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

verses.original: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְ/י֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝/נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה
verses.translit: yshm' chkhm vyvsf lqch vnbvn tchblvt yqnh
verses.translation: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

verses.original: לְ/הָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּ/מְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְ/חִידֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lhbyn mshl vmlytsh dbry chkhmym vchydtm
verses.translation: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝/מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ
verses.translit: yr't yhvh r'shyt d't chkhmh vmvsr 'vylym bzv
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִ/י מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑י/ךָ וְ/אַל תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm' bny mvsr 'bykh v'l ttsh tvrt 'mkh
verses.translation: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

verses.original: כִּ֤י לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְ/רֹאשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ֝/עֲנָקִ֗ים לְ/גַרְגְּרֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy lvyt chn hm lr'shkh v'nqym lgrgrtykh
verses.translation: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

verses.original: בְּנִ֡/י אִם יְפַתּ֥וּ/ךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל תֹּבֵֽא
verses.translit: bny 'm yptvkh cht'ym 'l tb'
verses.translation: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

verses.original: אִם יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪/ה אִ֫תָּ֥/נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְ/דָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְ/נָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: 'm y'mrv lkhh 'tnv n'rbh ldm ntspnh lnqy chnm
verses.translation: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

verses.original: נִ֭בְלָעֵ/ם כִּ/שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝/תְמִימִ֗ים כְּ/י֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: nbl'm khsh'vl chyym vtmymym khyvrdy bvr
verses.translation: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

verses.original: כָּל ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣י/נוּ שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: khl hvn yqr nmts' nml' btynv shll
verses.translation: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

verses.original: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְ/ךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּ/תוֹכֵ֑/נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/כֻלָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: gvrlkh tpyl btvkhnv khys 'chd yhyh lkhlnv
verses.translation: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

verses.original: בְּנִ֗/י אַל תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑/ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְ/ךָ֗ מִ/נְּתִיבָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny 'l tlkh bdrkh 'tm mn' rglkh mntybtm
verses.translation: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵי/הֶם לָ/רַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝/ימַהֲר֗וּ לִ/שְׁפָּךְ דָּֽם
verses.translit: khy rglyhm lr' yrvtsv vymhrv lshpkh dm
verses.translation: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

verses.original: כִּֽי חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָ/רָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝/עֵינֵ֗י כָל בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף
verses.translit: khy chnm mzrh hrsht b'yny khl b'l khnf
verses.translation: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

verses.original: וְ֭/הֵם לְ/דָמָ֣/ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְ/נַפְשֹׁתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhm ldmm y'rbv ytspnv lnpshtm
verses.translation: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣י/ו יִקָּֽח
verses.translit: khn 'rchvt khl bts' bts' 't npsh b'lyv yqch
verses.translation: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּ/ח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝/רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: chkhmvt bchvts trnh brchbvt ttn qvlh
verses.translation: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

verses.original: בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּ/פִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּ/עִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥י/הָ תֹאמֵֽר
verses.translit: br'sh hmyvt tqr' bptchy sh'rym b'yr 'mryh t'mr
verses.translation: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying ,

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֣י פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְ/לֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ֝/כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ דָֽעַת
verses.translit: 'd mty ptym t'hbv pty vltsym ltsvn chmdv lhm vkhsylym yshn'v d't
verses.translation: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.original: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽ/ת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥/י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָ/כֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑/י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣/י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: tshvbv ltvkhchty hnh 'by'h lkhm rvchy 'vdy'h dbry 'tkhm
verses.translation: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַ/תְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗/י וְ/אֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: y'n qr'ty vtm'nv ntyty ydy v'yn mqshyb
verses.translation: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

verses.original: וַ/תִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל עֲצָתִ֑/י וְ֝/תוֹכַחְתִּ֗/י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: vtpr'v khl 'tsty vtvkhchty l' 'bytm
verses.translation: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

verses.original: גַּם אֲ֭נִי בְּ/אֵידְ/כֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּ/בֹ֣א פַחְדְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: gm 'ny b'ydkhm 'shchq 'l'g bb' pchdkhm
verses.translation: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

verses.original: בְּ/בֹ֤א כ/שאוה כְ/שׁוֹאָ֨ה פַּחְדְּ/כֶ֗ם וְֽ֭/אֵידְ/כֶם כְּ/סוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּ/בֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵי/כֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְ/צוּקָֽה
verses.translit: bb' khsh'vh khshv'h pchdkhm v'ydkhm khsvph y'th bb' 'lykhm tsrh vtsvqh
verses.translation: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻ/נְנִי וְ/לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗/נְנִי וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽ/נְנִי
verses.translit: 'z yqr'nny vl' ''nh yshchrnny vl' ymts'nny
verses.translation: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

verses.original: תַּ֭חַת כִּי שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְ/יִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: tcht khy shn'v d't vyr't yhvh l' bchrv
verses.translation: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD :

verses.original: לֹא אָב֥וּ לַ/עֲצָתִ֑/י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל תּוֹכַחְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: l' 'bv l'tsty n'tsv khl tvkhchty
verses.translation: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/יֹאכְלוּ מִ/פְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑/ם וּֽ/מִ/מֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵי/הֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: vy'khlv mpry drkhm vmm'tstyhm yshb'v
verses.translation: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑/ם וְ/שַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy mshvbt ptym thrgm vshlvt khsylym t'bdm
verses.translation: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

verses.original: וְ/שֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭/י יִשְׁכָּן בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝/שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִ/פַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vshm' ly yshkhn btch vsh'nn mpchd r'h
verses.translation: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י אִם תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑/י וּ֝/מִצְוֺתַ֗/י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bny 'm tqch 'mry vmtsvty ttspn 'tkh
verses.translation: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

verses.original: לְ/הַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽ/חָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑/ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּ/ךָ֗ לַ/תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: lhqshyb lchkhmh 'znkh tth lbkh ltbvnh
verses.translation: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַ/בִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝/תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'm lbynh tqr' ltbvnh ttn qvlkh
verses.translation: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

verses.original: אִם תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥/נָּה כַ/כָּ֑סֶף וְֽ/כַ/מַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'm tbqshnh khkhsf vkhmtmvnym tchpshnh
verses.translation: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/דַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא
verses.translit: 'z tbyn yr't yhvh vd't 'lhym tmts'
verses.translation: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD , and find the knowledge of God.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝/פִּ֗י/ו דַּ֣עַת וּ/תְבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: khy yhvh ytn chkhmh mpyv d't vtbvnh
verses.translation: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

verses.original: ו/צפן יִצְפֹּ֣ן לַ֭/יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְ/הֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם
verses.translit: vtspn ytspn lyshrym tvshyh mgn lhlkhy tm
verses.translation: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

verses.original: לִ֭/נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ חסיד/ו חֲסִידָ֣י/ו יִשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: lntsr 'rchvt mshpt vdrkh chsydv chsydyv yshmr
verses.translation: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝/מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל מַעְגַּל טֽוֹב
verses.translit: 'z tbyn tsdq vmshpt vmyshrym khl m'gl tvb
verses.translation: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea , every good path.

verses.original: כִּֽי תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְ/לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/דַ֗עַת לְֽ/נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם
verses.translit: khy tbv' chkhmh blbkh vd't lnpshkh yn'm
verses.translation: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

verses.original: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗י/ךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽ/כָּה
verses.translit: mzmh tshmr 'lykh tbvnh tntsrkhh
verses.translation: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

verses.original: לְ֭/הַצִּ֣ילְ/ךָ מִ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝/אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
verses.translit: lhtsylkh mdrkh r' m'ysh mdbr thpkhvt
verses.translation: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things;

verses.original: הַ֭/עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝/לֶ֗כֶת בְּ/דַרְכֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: h'zbym 'rchvt yshr llkht bdrkhy chshkh
verses.translation: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

verses.original: הַ֭/שְּׂמֵחִים לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽ/תַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע
verses.translit: hshmchym l'shvt r' ygylv bthpkhvt r'
verses.translation: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵי/הֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝/נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּ/מַעְגְּלוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr 'rchtyhm 'qshym vnlvzym bm'glvtm
verses.translation: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

verses.original: לְ֭/הַצִּ֣ילְ/ךָ מֵ/אִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝/נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥י/הָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה
verses.translit: lhtsylkh m'shh zrh mnkhryh 'mryh hchlyqh
verses.translation: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

verses.original: הַ֭/עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣י/הָ שָׁכֵֽחָה
verses.translit: h'zbt 'lvf n'vryh v't bryt 'lhyh shkhchh
verses.translation: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑/הּ וְ/אֶל רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy shchh 'l mvt byth v'l rp'ym m'gltyh
verses.translation: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

verses.original: כָּל בָּ֭אֶי/הָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּ/ן וְ/לֹֽא יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: khl b'yh l' yshvbvn vl' yshygv 'rchvt chyym
verses.translation: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְ/אָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: lm'n tlkh bdrkh tvbym v'rchvt tsdyqym tshmr
verses.translation: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men , and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝/תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy yshrym yshkhnv 'rts vtmymym yvtrv bh
verses.translation: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

verses.original: וּ֭/רְשָׁעִים מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝/בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vrsh'ym m'rts ykhrtv vbvgdym yschv mmnh
verses.translation: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י תּוֹרָתִ֣/י אַל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝/מִצְוֺתַ֗/י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bny tvrty 'l tshkhch vmtsvty ytsr lbkh
verses.translation: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּ/שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝/שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy 'rkh ymym vshnvt chyym vshlvm yvsypv lkh
verses.translation: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

verses.original: חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥/ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥/ם עַל גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑י/ךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗/ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chsd v'mt 'l y'zbkh qshrm 'l grgrvtykh khtbm 'l lvch lbkh
verses.translation: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

verses.original: וּ/מְצָא חֵ֖ן וְ/שֵֽׂכֶל ט֑וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vmts' chn vshkhl tvb b'yny 'lhym v'dm
verses.translation: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל יְ֭הוָה בְּ/כָל לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אֶל בִּֽ֝ינָתְ/ךָ֗ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵֽן
verses.translit: btch 'l yhvh bkhl lbkh v'l byntkh 'l tsh'n
verses.translation: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל דְּרָכֶ֥י/ךָ דָעֵ֑/הוּ וְ֝/ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bkhl drkhykh d'hv vhv' yyshr 'rchtykh
verses.translation: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

verses.original: אַל תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְ/ס֣וּר מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: 'l thy chkhm b'ynykh yr' 't yhvh vsvr mr'
verses.translation: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD , and depart from evil.

verses.original: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְ/שָׁרֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/שִׁקּ֗וּי לְ/עַצְמוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: rp'vt thy lshrkh vshqvy l'tsmvtykh
verses.translation: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת יְ֭הוָה מֵ/הוֹנֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/מֵ/רֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל תְּבוּאָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khbd 't yhvh mhvnkh vmr'shyt khl tbv'tkh
verses.translation: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

verses.original: וְ/יִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣י/ךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝/תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥י/ךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ
verses.translit: vyml'v 'smykh shb' vtyrvsh yqbykh yprtsv
verses.translation: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣/י אַל תִּמְאָ֑ס וְ/אַל תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּ/תוֹכַחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mvsr yhvh bny 'l tm's v'l tqts btvkhchtv
verses.translation: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD ; neither be weary of his correction:

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝/כְ/אָ֗ב אֶת בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה
verses.translit: khy 't 'shr y'hb yhvh yvkhych vkh'b 't bn yrtsh
verses.translation: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝/אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm mts' chkhmh v'dm ypyq tbvnh
verses.translation: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָ/הּ מִ/סְּחַר כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝/מֵ/חָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy tvb schrh mschr khsf vmchrvts tbv'th
verses.translation: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

verses.original: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מ/פניים מִ/פְּנִינִ֑ים וְ/כָל חֲ֝פָצֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: yqrh hy' mpnyym mpnynym vkhl chptsykh l' yshvv bh
verses.translation: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽ/ימִינָ֑/הּ בִּ֝/שְׂמֹאולָ֗/הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְ/כָבֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'rkh ymym bymynh bshm'vlh 'shr vkhbvd
verses.translation: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֥י/הָ דַרְכֵי נֹ֑עַם וְֽ/כָל נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣י/הָ שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: drkhyh drkhy n'm vkhl ntybvtyh shlvm
verses.translation: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.original: עֵץ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַ/מַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑/הּ וְֽ/תֹמְכֶ֥י/הָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר
verses.translit: 'ts chyym hy' lmchzyqym bh vtmkhyh m'shr
verses.translation: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּ/חָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּ/תְבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: yhvh bchkhmh ysd 'rts khvnn shmym btbvnh
verses.translation: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

verses.original: בְּ֭/דַעְתּ/וֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝/שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ טָֽל
verses.translit: bd'tv thvmvt nbq'v vshchqym yr'pv tl
verses.translation: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י אַל יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּ/מְזִמָּֽה
verses.translit: bny 'l ylzv m'ynykh ntsr tshyh vmzmh
verses.translation: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

verses.original: וְ/יִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְ/נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וְ֝/חֵ֗ן לְ/גַרְגְּרֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhyv chyym lnpshkh vchn lgrgrtykh
verses.translation: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

verses.original: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָ/בֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/רַגְלְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף
verses.translit: 'z tlkh lbtch drkhkh vrglkh l' tgvf
verses.translation: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

verses.original: אִם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝/שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽ/עָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm tshkhb l' tpchd vshkhbt v'rbh shntkh
verses.translation: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

verses.original: אַל תִּ֭ירָא מִ/פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּ/מִ/שֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא
verses.translit: 'l tyr' mpchd pt'm vmsh't rsh'ym khy tb'
verses.translation: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְ/כִסְלֶ֑/ךָ וְ/שָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְ/ךָ֣ מִ/לָּֽכֶד
verses.translit: khy yhvh yhyh bkhslkh vshmr rglkh mlkhd
verses.translation: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

verses.original: אַל תִּמְנַע ט֥וֹב מִ/בְּעָלָ֑י/ו בִּ/הְי֨וֹת לְ/אֵ֖ל ידי/ך יָדְ/ךָ֣ לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: 'l tmn' tvb mb'lyv bhyvt l'l ydykh ydkh l'shvt
verses.translation: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .

verses.original: אַל תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר ל/רעי/ך לְ/רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֨ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭/שׁוּב וּ/מָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְ/יֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l t'mr lr'ykh lr'kh lkh vshvb vmchr 'tn vysh 'tkh
verses.translation: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

verses.original: אַל תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל רֵעֲ/ךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְ/הֽוּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָ/בֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l tchrsh 'l r'kh r'h vhv' yvshb lbtch 'tkh
verses.translation: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

verses.original: אַל תרוב תָּרִ֣יב עִם אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם לֹ֖א גְמָלְ/ךָ֣ רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'l trvb tryb 'm 'dm chnm 'm l' gmlkh r'h
verses.translation: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

verses.original: אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּ/אִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְ/אַל תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l tqn' b'ysh chms v'l tbchr bkhl drkhyv
verses.translation: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽ/אֶת יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tv'bt yhvh nlvz v't yshrym svdv
verses.translation: For the froward is abomination to the LORD : but his secret is with the righteous.

verses.original: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּ/בֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּ/נְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: m'rt yhvh bbyt rsh' vnvh tsdyqym ybrkh
verses.translation: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

verses.original: אִם לַ/לֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא יָלִ֑יץ ו/ל/עניים וְ֝/לַ/עֲנָוִ֗ים יִתֶּן חֵֽן
verses.translit: 'm lltsym hv' ylyts vl'nyym vl'nvym ytn chn
verses.translation: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

verses.original: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝/כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן
verses.translit: khbvd chkhmym ynchlv vkhsylym mrym qlvn
verses.translation: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝/הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָ/דַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: shm'v bnym mvsr 'b vhqshybv ld't bynh
verses.translation: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/כֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗/י אַֽל תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ
verses.translit: khy lqch tvb ntty lkhm tvrty 'l t'zbv
verses.translation: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

verses.original: כִּי בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְ/אָבִ֑/י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝/יָחִ֗יד לִ/פְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy bn hyyty l'by rkh vychyd lpny 'my
verses.translation: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּרֵ֗/נִי וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗/י יִֽתְמָךְ דְּבָרַ֥/י לִבֶּ֑/ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣/י וֶֽ/חְיֵֽה
verses.translit: vyrny vy'mr ly ytmkh dbry lbkh shmr mtsvty vchyh
verses.translation: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

verses.original: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְ/אַל תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽ/אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: qnh chkhmh qnh bynh 'l tshkhch v'l tt m'mry py
verses.translation: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

verses.translit: 'l t'zbh vtshmrkh 'hbh vttsrkh
verses.translation: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ/בְ/כָל קִ֝נְיָנְ/ךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה
verses.translit: r'shyt chkhmh qnh chkhmh vbkhl qnynkh qnh bynh
verses.translation: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

verses.translit: slslh vtrvmmkh tkhbdkh khy tchbqnh
verses.translation: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭/רֹאשְׁ/ךָ לִוְיַת חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: ttn lr'shkh lvyt chn 'trt tp'rt tmgnkh
verses.translation: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִ/י וְ/קַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑/י וְ/יִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝/ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: shm' bny vqch 'mry vyrbv lkh shnvt chyym
verses.translation: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

verses.original: בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑י/ךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗י/ךָ בְּ/מַעְגְּלֵי יֹֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: bdrkh chkhmh hrtykh hdrkhtykh bm'gly yshr
verses.translation: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

verses.original: בְּֽ֭/לֶכְתְּ/ךָ לֹא יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אִם תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל
verses.translit: blkhtkh l' ytsr ts'dkh v'm trvts l' tkhshl
verses.translation: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּ/מּוּסָ֣ר אַל תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗/הָ כִּי הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hchzq bmvsr 'l trf ntsrh khy hy' chyykh
verses.translation: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

verses.original: בְּ/אֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל תָּבֹ֑א וְ/אַל תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים
verses.translit: b'rch rsh'ym 'l tb' v'l t'shr bdrkh r'ym
verses.translation: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men .

verses.original: פְּרָעֵ֥/הוּ אַל תַּעֲבָר בּ֑/וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵ/עָלָ֣י/ו וַ/עֲבֽוֹר
verses.translit: pr'hv 'l t'br bv shth m'lyv v'bvr
verses.translation: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽ/נִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗/ם אִם לֹ֥א יכשולו יַכְשִֽׁילוּ
verses.translit: khy l' yshnv 'm l' yr'v vngzlh shntm 'm l' ykhshvlv ykhshylv
verses.translation: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְ/יֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: khy lchmv lchm rsh' vyyn chmsym yshtv
verses.translation: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

verses.original: וְ/אֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּ/א֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝/א֗וֹר עַד נְכ֥וֹן הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'rch tsdyqym kh'vr ngh hvlkh v'vr 'd nkhvn hyvm
verses.translation: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽ/אֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּ/מֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: drkh rsh'ym kh'plh l' yd'v bmh ykhshlv
verses.translation: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י לִ/דְבָרַ֣/י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָ/ה לַ֝/אֲמָרַ֗/י הַט אָזְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bny ldbry hqshybh l'mry ht 'znkh
verses.translation: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

verses.original: אַל יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗/ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l ylyzv m'ynykh shmrm btvkh lbbkh
verses.translation: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

verses.original: כִּֽי חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְ/מֹצְאֵי/הֶ֑ם וּֽ/לְ/כָל בְּשָׂר֥/וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: khy chyym hm lmts'yhm vlkhl bshrv mrp'
verses.translation: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

verses.original: מִֽ/כָּל מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑/ךָ כִּֽי מִ֝מֶּ֗/נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: mkhl mshmr ntsr lbkh khy mmnv tvts'vt chyym
verses.translation: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּ/ךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּ/לְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: hsr mmkh 'qshvt ph vlzvt shptym hrchq mmkh
verses.translation: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶי/ךָ לְ/נֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝/עַפְעַפֶּ֗י/ךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'ynykh lnkhch ybytv v'p'pykh yyshrv ngdkh
verses.translation: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

verses.original: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑/ךָ וְֽ/כָל דְּרָכֶ֥י/ךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ
verses.translit: pls m'gl rglkh vkhl drkhykh ykhnv
verses.translation: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

verses.original: אַֽל תֵּט יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְ/ךָ֣ מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: 'l tt ymyn vshm'vl hsr rglkh mr'
verses.translation: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י לְ/חָכְמָתִ֣/י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָ/ה לִ֝/תְבוּנָתִ֗/י הַט אָזְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bny lchkhmty hqshybh ltbvnty ht 'znkh
verses.translation: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת וְ֝/דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥י/ךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: lshmr mzmvt vd't shptykh yntsrv
verses.translation: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְ/חָלָ֖ק מִ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy npt ttpnh shpty zrh vchlq mshmn chkhh
verses.translation: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

verses.original: וְֽ֭/אַחֲרִיתָ/הּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽ/לַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּ/חֶ֣רֶב פִּיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'chryth mrh khl'nh chdh khchrb pyvt
verses.translation: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

verses.original: רַ֭גְלֶי/הָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝א֗וֹל צְעָדֶ֥י/הָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ
verses.translit: rglyh yrdvt mvt sh'vl ts'dyh ytmkhv
verses.translation: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗י/הָ לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע
verses.translit: 'rch chyym pn tpls n'v m'gltyh l' td'
verses.translation: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them .

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑/י וְ/אַל תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵ/אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th bnym shm'v ly v'l tsvrv m'mry py
verses.translation: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

verses.original: הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵ/עָלֶ֣י/הָ דַרְכֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אַל תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hrchq m'lyh drkhkh v'l tqrb 'l ptch byth
verses.translation: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

verses.original: פֶּן תִּתֵּ֣ן לַ/אֲחֵרִ֣ים הוֹדֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/שְׁנֹתֶ֗י/ךָ לְ/אַכְזָרִֽי
verses.translit: pn ttn l'chrym hvdkh vshntykh l'khzry
verses.translation: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

verses.original: פֶּֽן יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑/ךָ וַ֝/עֲצָבֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/בֵ֣ית נָכְרִֽי
verses.translit: pn yshb'v zrym khchkh v'tsbykh bbyt nkhry
verses.translation: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

verses.translit: vnhmt b'chrytkh bkhlvt bshrkh vsh'rkh
verses.translation: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

verses.original: וְֽ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝/תוֹכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mrt 'ykh shn'ty mvsr vtvkhcht n'ts lby
verses.translation: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

verses.original: וְֽ/לֹא שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּ/ק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑/י וְ֝/לִֽ/מְלַמְּדַ֗/י לֹא הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vl' shm'ty bqvl mvry vlmlmdy l' htyty 'zny
verses.translation: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

verses.original: כִּ֭/מְעַט הָיִ֣יתִי בְ/כָל רָ֑ע בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל וְ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: khm't hyyty bkhl r' btvkh qhl v'dh
verses.translation: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

verses.original: שְׁתֵה מַ֥יִם מִ/בּוֹרֶ֑/ךָ וְ֝/נֹזְלִ֗ים מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shth mym mbvrkh vnzlym mtvkh b'rkh
verses.translation: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

verses.original: יָפ֣וּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣י/ךָ ח֑וּצָ/ה בָּ֝/רְחֹב֗וֹת פַּלְגֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: ypvtsv m'yntykh chvtsh brchbvt plgy mym
verses.translation: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ לְ/ךָ֥ לְ/בַדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אֵ֖ין לְ/זָרִ֣ים אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yhyv lkh lbdkh v'yn lzrym 'tkh
verses.translation: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.

verses.original: יְהִֽי מְקוֹרְ/ךָ֥ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝/שְׂמַ֗ח מֵ/אֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhy mqvrkh brvkh vshmch m'sht n'vrkh
verses.translation: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

verses.original: אַיֶּ֥לֶת אֲהָבִ֗ים וְֽ/יַעֲלַ֫ת חֵ֥ן דַּ֭דֶּי/הָ יְרַוֻּ֣/ךָ בְ/כָל עֵ֑ת בְּ֝/אַהֲבָתָ֗/הּ תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: 'ylt 'hbym vy'lt chn ddyh yrvkh bkhl 't b'hbth tshgh tmyd
verses.translation: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֤/מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣/י בְ/זָרָ֑ה וּ֝/תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vlmh tshgh bny bzrh vtchbq chq nkhryh
verses.translation: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֹ֨כַח עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽ/כָל מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥י/ו מְפַלֵּֽס
verses.translit: khy nkhch 'yny yhvh drkhy 'ysh vkhl m'gltyv mpls
verses.translation: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD , and he pondereth all his goings.

verses.original: עַֽווֹנוֹתָ֗י/ו יִלְכְּדֻ/נ֥וֹ אֶת הָ/רָשָׁ֑ע וּ/בְ/חַבְלֵ֥י חַ֝טָּאת֗/וֹ יִתָּמֵֽךְ
verses.translit: 'vvnvtyv ylkhdnv 't hrsh' vbchbly cht'tv ytmkh
verses.translation: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

verses.original: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּ/אֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר וּ/בְ/רֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתּ֣/וֹ יִשְׁגֶּֽה
verses.translit: hv' ymvt b'yn mvsr vbrb 'vltv yshgh
verses.translation: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

verses.translit: bny 'm 'rbt lr'kh tq't lzr khpykh
verses.translation: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

verses.original: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְ/אִמְרֵי פִ֑י/ךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּ/אִמְרֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: nvqsht b'mry pykh nlkhdt b'mry pykh
verses.translation: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא בְּנִ֡/י וְֽ/הִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְ/כַף רֵעֶ֑/ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּ/רְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shh z't 'pv' bny vhntsl khy b't bkhf r'kh lkh htrps vrhb r'ykh
verses.translation: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

verses.original: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וּ֝/תְנוּמָ֗ה לְ/עַפְעַפֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l ttn shnh l'ynykh vtnvmh l'p'pykh
verses.translation: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

verses.original: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּ/צְבִ֣י מִ/יָּ֑ד וּ֝/כְ/צִפּ֗וֹר מִ/יַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: hntsl khtsby myd vkhtspvr myd yqvsh
verses.translation: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter , and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

verses.original: לֵֽךְ אֶל נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣י/הָ וַ/חֲכָֽם
verses.translit: lkh 'l nmlh 'tsl r'h drkhyh vchkhm
verses.translation: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין לָ֥/הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּ/מֹשֵֽׁל
verses.translit: 'shr 'yn lh qtsyn shtr vmshl
verses.translation: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין בַּ/קַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑/הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝/קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tkhyn bqyts lchmh 'grh bqtsyr m'khlh
verses.translation: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִ/שְּׁנָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'd mty 'tsl tshkhb mty tqvm mshntkh
verses.translation: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִ/שְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: m't shnvt m't tnvmvt m't chbq ydym lshkhb
verses.translation: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.translit: vb' khmhlkh r'shkh vmchsrkh kh'ysh mgn
verses.translation: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'dm bly'l 'ysh 'vn hvlkh 'qshvt ph
verses.translation: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

verses.original: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭/עֵינָ/ו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּ/רַגְלָ֑/ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּ/אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: qrts b'ynv mll brglv mrh b'tsb'tyv
verses.translation: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

verses.original: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת בְּ/לִבּ֗/וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּ/כָל עֵ֑ת מדנים מִדְיָנִ֥ים יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: thpkhvt blbv chrsh r' bkhl 't mdnym mdynym yshlch
verses.translation: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑/וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְ/אֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: 'l khn pt'm ybv' 'ydv pt' yshbr v'yn mrp'
verses.translation: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

verses.original: שֶׁשׁ הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝/שֶׁ֗בַע תועבות תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: shsh hnh shn' yhvh vshb' tv'bvt tv'bt npshv
verses.translation: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

verses.original: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝/יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם נָקִֽי
verses.translit: 'ynym rmvt lshvn shqr vydym shpkhvt dm nqy
verses.translation: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.original: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָ/ר֥וּץ לָֽ/רָעָה
verses.translit: lb chrsh mchshbvt 'vn rglym mmhrvt lrvts lr'h
verses.translation: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּ/מְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים
verses.translit: ypych khzbym 'd shqr vmshlch mdnym byn 'chym
verses.translation: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִ/י מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑י/ךָ וְ/אַל תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ntsr bny mtsvt 'bykh v'l ttsh tvrt 'mkh
verses.translation: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֣/ם עַל לִבְּ/ךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עָ֝נְדֵ֗/ם עַל גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qshrm 'l lbkh tmyd 'ndm 'l grgrtkh
verses.translation: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

verses.original: בְּ/הִתְהַלֶּכְ/ךָ֨ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗/ךְ בְּֽ֭/שָׁכְבְּ/ךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ֝/הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bhthlkhkh tnchh 'tkh bshkhbkh tshmr 'lykh vhqytsvt hy' tshychkh
verses.translation: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְ/ת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְ/דֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר
verses.translit: khy nr mtsvh vtvrh 'vr vdrkh chyym tvkhchvt mvsr
verses.translation: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

verses.original: לִ֭/שְׁמָרְ/ךָ מֵ/אֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵֽ֝/חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: lshmrkh m'sht r' mchlqt lshvn nkhryh
verses.translation: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

verses.translit: 'l tchmd ypyh blbbkh v'l tqchkh b'p'pyh
verses.translation: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְעַד אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם וְ/אֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד
verses.translit: khy b'd 'shh zvnh 'd khkhr lchm v'sht 'ysh npsh yqrh ttsvd
verses.translation: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

verses.original: הֲ/יַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּ/חֵיק֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְגָדָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה
verses.translit: hychth 'ysh 'sh bchyqv vbgdyv l' tshrpnh
verses.translation: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.original: אִם יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל הַ/גֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝/רַגְלָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה
verses.translit: 'm yhlkh 'ysh 'l hgchlym vrglyv l' tkhvynh
verses.translation: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭/בָּא אֶל אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khn hb' 'l 'sht r'hv l' ynqh khl hng' bh
verses.translation: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

verses.original: לֹא יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭/גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְ/מַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗/וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב
verses.translit: l' ybvzv lgnb khy ygnvb lml' npshv khy yr'b
verses.translation: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

verses.original: וְ֭/נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת כָּל ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣/וֹ יִתֵּֽן
verses.translit: vnmts' yshlm shb'tym 't khl hvn bytv ytn
verses.translation: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

verses.original: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗/וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂ/נָּה
verses.translit: n'f 'shh chsr lb mshchyt npshv hv' y'shnh
verses.translation: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

verses.original: נֶֽגַע וְ/קָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝/חֶרְפָּת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה
verses.translit: ng' vqlvn ymts' vchrptv l' tmchh
verses.translation: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

verses.original: כִּֽי קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת גָּ֑בֶר וְ/לֹֽא יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּ/י֣וֹם נָקָֽם
verses.translit: khy qn'h chmt gbr vl' ychmvl byvm nqm
verses.translation: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.original: לֹא יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל כֹּ֑פֶר וְ/לֹֽא יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה שֹֽׁחַד
verses.translit: l' ysh' pny khl khpr vl' y'bh khy trbh shchd
verses.translation: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

verses.translit: bny shmr 'mry vmtsvty ttspn 'tkh
verses.translation: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣/י וֶ/חְיֵ֑ה וְ֝/תוֹרָתִ֗/י כְּ/אִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shmr mtsvty vchyh vtvrty kh'yshvn 'ynykh
verses.translation: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֥/ם עַל אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑י/ךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗/ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qshrm 'l 'tsb'tykh khtbm 'l lvch lbkh
verses.translation: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭/חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִ/י אָ֑תְּ וּ֝/מֹדָ֗ע לַ/בִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: 'mr lchkhmh 'chty 't vmd' lbynh tqr'
verses.translation: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

verses.original: לִ֭/שְׁמָרְ/ךָ מֵ/אִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝/נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥י/הָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה
verses.translit: lshmrkh m'shh zrh mnkhryh 'mryh hchlyqh
verses.translation: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

verses.original: כִּ֭י בְּ/חַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑/י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣/י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי
verses.translit: khy bchlvn byty b'd 'shnby nshqpty
verses.translation: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֤רֶא בַ/פְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַ/בָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר לֵֽב
verses.translit: v'r' bpt'ym 'bynh bbnym n'r chsr lb
verses.translation: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭/שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑/הּ וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣/הּ יִצְעָֽד
verses.translit: 'br bshvq 'tsl pnh vdrkh byth yts'd
verses.translation: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

verses.original: בְּ/נֶֽשֶׁף בְּ/עֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּ/אִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַ/אֲפֵלָֽה
verses.translit: bnshf b'rb yvm b'yshvn lylh v'plh
verses.translation: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּ/נְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב
verses.translit: vhnh 'shh lqr'tv shyt zvnh vntsrt lb
verses.translation: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

verses.original: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְ/סֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝/בֵיתָ֗/הּ לֹא יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hmyh hy' vsrrt bbyth l' yshkhnv rglyh
verses.translation: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

verses.original: פַּ֤עַם בַּ/ח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּ/רְחֹב֑וֹת וְ/אֵ֖צֶל כָּל פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב
verses.translit: p'm bchvts p'm brchbvt v'tsl khl pnh t'rb
verses.translation: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

verses.original: וְ/הֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭/וֹ וְ/נָ֣שְׁקָה לּ֑/וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗י/הָ וַ/תֹּ֣אמַר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhchzyqh bv vnshqh lv h'zh pnyh vt'mr lv
verses.translation: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑/י הַ֝/יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: zbchy shlmym 'ly hyvm shlmty ndry
verses.translation: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִ/קְרָאתֶ֑/ךָ לְ/שַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗י/ךָ וָ/אֶמְצָאֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'l khn yts'ty lqr'tkh lshchr pnykh v'mts'kh
verses.translation: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

verses.original: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑/י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: mrbdym rbdty 'rshy chtbvt 'tvn mtsrym
verses.translation: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt.

verses.original: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑/י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְ/קִנָּמֽוֹן
verses.translit: npty mshkhby mr 'hlym vqnmvn
verses.translation: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.original: לְכָ֤/ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד הַ/בֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּ/אֳהָבִֽים
verses.translit: lkhh nrvh ddym 'd hbqr nt'lsh b'hbym
verses.translation: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָ/אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/בֵית֑/וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ מֵ/רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: khy 'yn h'ysh bbytv hlkh bdrkh mrchvq
verses.translation: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

verses.original: צְֽרוֹר הַ֭/כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ לְ/י֥וֹם הַ֝/כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsrvr hkhsf lqch bydv lyvm hkhs' yb' bytv
verses.translation: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

verses.translit: httv brb lqchh bchlq shptyh tdychnv
verses.translation: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

verses.original: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗י/הָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭/שׁוֹר אֶל טָ֣בַח יָב֑וֹא וּ֝/כְ/עֶ֗כֶס אֶל מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל
verses.translit: hvlkh 'chryh pt'm khshvr 'l tbch ybv' vkh'khs 'l mvsr 'vyl
verses.translation: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

verses.original: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗/וֹ כְּ/מַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל פָּ֑ח וְ/לֹֽא יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי בְ/נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'd yplch chts khbdv khmhr tspvr 'l pch vl' yd' khy bnpshv hv'
verses.translation: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑/י וְ֝/הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְ/אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th bnym shm'v ly vhqshybv l'mry py
verses.translation: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

verses.original: אַל יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל דְּרָכֶ֣י/הָ לִבֶּ֑/ךָ אַל תֵּ֝תַע בִּ/נְתִיבוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'l ysht 'l drkhyh lbkh 'l tt' bntybvtyh
verses.translation: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

verses.original: כִּֽי רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝/עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל הֲרֻגֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy rbym chllym hpylh v'tsmym khl hrgyh
verses.translation: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

verses.original: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑/הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל חַדְרֵי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: drkhy sh'vl byth yrdvt 'l chdry mvt
verses.translation: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝/תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hl' chkhmh tqr' vtbvnh ttn qvlh
verses.translation: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

verses.original: בְּ/רֹאשׁ מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה
verses.translit: br'sh mrvmym 'ly drkh byt ntybvt ntsbh
verses.translation: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

verses.original: לְ/יַד שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְ/פִי קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה
verses.translit: lyd sh'rym lpy qrt mbv' ptchym trnh
verses.translation: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

verses.original: אֲלֵי/כֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝/קוֹלִ֗/י אֶל בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: 'lykhm 'yshym 'qr' vqvly 'l bny 'dm
verses.translation: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

verses.original: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝/כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב
verses.translit: hbynv pt'ym 'rmh vkhsylym hbynv lb
verses.translation: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

verses.original: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּ/מִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗/י מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: shm'v khy ngydym 'dbr vmptch shpty myshrym
verses.translation: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑/י וְ/תוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣/י רֶֽשַׁע
verses.translit: khy 'mt yhgh chkhy vtv'bt shpty rsh'
verses.translation: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.original: בְּ/צֶ֥דֶק כָּל אִמְרֵי פִ֑/י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝/הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְ/עִקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: btsdq khl 'mry py 'yn bhm nptl v'qsh
verses.translation: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣/ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַ/מֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝/ישָׁרִ֗ים לְ/מֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: khlm nkhchym lmbyn vyshrym lmts'y d't
verses.translation: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

verses.original: קְחֽוּ מוּסָרִ֥/י וְ/אַל כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝/דַ֗עַת מֵ/חָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר
verses.translit: qchv mvsry v'l khsf vd't mchrvts nbchr
verses.translation: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.original: כִּֽי טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִ/פְּנִינִ֑ים וְ/כָל חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy tvbh chkhmh mpnynym vkhl chptsym l' yshvv bh
verses.translation: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

verses.original: אֲֽנִי חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְ/דַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא
verses.translit: 'ny chkhmh shkhnty 'rmh vd't mzmvt 'mts'
verses.translation: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

verses.original: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְ/גָא֨וֹן וְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּ/פִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי
verses.translit: yr't yhvh shn't r' g'h vg'vn vdrkh r' vpy thpkhvt shn'ty
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

verses.original: לִֽ/י עֵ֭צָה וְ/תוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣/י גְבוּרָֽה
verses.translit: ly 'tsh vtvshyh 'ny bynh ly gbvrh
verses.translation: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

verses.original: בִּ֭/י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝/רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: by mlkhym ymlkhv vrvznym ychqqv tsdq
verses.translation: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

verses.original: בִּ֭/י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝/נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: by shrym yshrv vndybym khl shpty tsdq
verses.translation: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אהבי/ה אֹהֲבַ֣/י אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝/מְשַׁחֲרַ֗/י יִמְצָאֻֽ/נְנִי
verses.translit: 'ny 'hbyh 'hby 'hb vmshchry ymts'nny
verses.translation: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׁר וְ/כָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑/י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: 'shr vkhbvd 'ty hvn 'tq vtsdqh
verses.translation: Riches and honour are with me; yea , durable riches and righteousness.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִ/י מֵ/חָר֣וּץ וּ/מִ/פָּ֑ז וּ֝/תְבוּאָתִ֗/י מִ/כֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר
verses.translit: tvb pryy mchrvts vmpz vtbv'ty mkhsf nbchr
verses.translation: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

verses.original: בְּ/אֹֽרַח צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּ֝/ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: b'rch tsdqh 'hlkh btvkh ntybvt mshpt
verses.translation: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

verses.original: לְ/הַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥/י יֵ֑שׁ וְ/אֹצְרֹ֖תֵי/הֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא
verses.translit: lhnchyl 'hby ysh v'tsrtyhm 'ml'
verses.translation: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָ/נִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣י/ו מֵ/אָֽז
verses.translit: yhvh qnny r'shyt drkhv qdm mp'lyv m'z
verses.translation: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

verses.original: מֵ֭/עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵ/רֹ֗אשׁ מִ/קַּדְמֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: m'vlm nskhty mr'sh mqdmy 'rts
verses.translation: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

verses.original: בְּ/אֵין תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּ/אֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: b'yn thmvt chvllty b'yn m'ynvt nkhbdy mym
verses.translation: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִ/פְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: btrm hrym htb'v lpny gb'vt chvllty
verses.translation: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

verses.original: עַד לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְ/חוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝/רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל
verses.translit: 'd l' 'shh 'rts vchvtsvt vr'sh 'prvt tbl
verses.translation: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

verses.original: בַּ/הֲכִינ֣/וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּ/ח֥וּק/וֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם
verses.translit: bhkhynv shmym shm 'ny bchvqv chvg 'l pny thvm
verses.translation: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

verses.original: בְּ/אַמְּצ֣/וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִ/מָּ֑עַל בַּ֝/עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם
verses.translit: b'mtsv shchqym mm'l b'zvz 'ynvt thvm
verses.translation: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

verses.original: בְּ/שׂ֘וּמ֤/וֹ לַ/יָּ֨ם חֻקּ֗/וֹ וּ֭/מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ פִ֑י/ו בְּ֝/חוּק֗/וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bshvmv lym chqv vmym l' y'brv pyv bchvqv mvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗/וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽ/אֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו בְּ/כָל עֵֽת
verses.translit: v'hyh 'tslv 'mvn v'hyh sh'sh'ym yvm yvm mshchqt lpnyv bkhl 't
verses.translation: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

verses.original: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּ/תֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ֝/שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗/י אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: mshchqt btbl 'rtsv vsh'sh'y 't bny 'dm
verses.translation: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑/י וְ֝/אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥/י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: v'th bnym shm'v ly v'shry drkhy yshmrv
verses.translation: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַ/חֲכָ֗מוּ וְ/אַל תִּפְרָֽעוּ
verses.translit: shm'v mvsr vchkhmv v'l tpr'v
verses.translation: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥/י לִ/שְׁקֹ֣ד עַל דַּ֭לְתֹתַ/י י֤וֹם י֑וֹם לִ֝/שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm shm' ly lshqd 'l dltty yvm yvm lshmr mzvzt ptchy
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִ/י מצאי מָצָ֣א חַיִּ֑ים וַ/יָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵ/יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy mts'y mts'y mts' chyym vypq rtsvn myhvh
verses.translation: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD .

verses.original: וְֽ֭/חֹטְאִ/י חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ כָּל מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗/י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: vcht'y chms npshv khl mshn'y 'hbv mvt
verses.translation: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑/הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣י/הָ שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: chkhmvt bnth byth chtsbh 'mvdyh shb'h
verses.translation: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

verses.original: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָ/הּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑/הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tbchh tbchh mskhh yynh 'f 'rkhh shlchnh
verses.translation: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

verses.original: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣י/הָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת
verses.translit: shlchh n'rtyh tqr' 'l gpy mrmy qrt
verses.translation: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

verses.original: מִי פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my pty ysr hnh chsr lb 'mrh lv
verses.translation: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽ/לַחֲמִ֑/י וּ֝/שְׁת֗וּ בְּ/יַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי
verses.translit: lkhv lchmv blchmy vshtv byyn mskhty
verses.translation: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

verses.original: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽ/חְי֑וּ וְ֝/אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: 'zbv pt'ym vchyv v'shrv bdrkh bynh
verses.translation: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

verses.original: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣/וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּ/מוֹכִ֖יחַ לְ/רָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ysr lts lqch lv qlvn vmvkhych lrsh' mvmv
verses.translation: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

verses.original: אַל תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן יִשְׂנָאֶ֑/ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝/חָכָ֗ם וְ/יֶאֱהָבֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'l tvkhch lts pn yshn'kh hvkhch lchkhm vy'hbkh
verses.translation: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

verses.original: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭/חָכָם וְ/יֶחְכַּם ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝/צַדִּ֗יק וְ/י֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח
verses.translit: tn lchkhm vychkhm 'vd hvd' ltsdyq vyvsf lqch
verses.translation: Give instruction to a wise man , and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man , and he will increase in learning.

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/דַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: tchlt chkhmh yr't yhvh vd't qdshym bynh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

verses.original: כִּי בִ֭/י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝/ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: khy by yrbv ymykh vyvsypv lkh shnvt chyym
verses.translation: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

verses.translit: 'm chkhmt chkhmt lkh vltst lbdkh tsh'
verses.translation: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it .

verses.original: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּ/בַל יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה
verses.translit: 'sht khsylvt hmyh ptyvt vbl yd'h mh
verses.translation: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/יָשְׁבָה לְ/פֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑/הּ עַל כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת
verses.translit: vyshbh lptch byth 'l khs' mrmy qrt
verses.translation: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.original: לִ/קְרֹ֥א לְ/עֹֽבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝/מְיַשְּׁרִ֗ים אֹֽרְחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lqr' l'bry drkh hmyshrym 'rchvtm
verses.translation: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

verses.original: מִי פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַ/חֲסַר לֵ֝֗ב וְ/אָ֣מְרָה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my pty ysr hnh vchsr lb v'mrh lv
verses.translation: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

verses.original: מַֽיִם גְּנוּבִ֥ים יִמְתָּ֑קוּ וְ/לֶ֖חֶם סְתָרִ֣ים יִנְעָֽם
verses.translit: mym gnvbym ymtqv vlchm strym yn'm
verses.translation: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

verses.original: וְֽ/לֹא יָ֭דַע כִּֽי רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּ/עִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vl' yd' khy rp'ym shm b'mqy sh'vl qr'yh
verses.translation: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

verses.original: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּ/בֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mshly shlmh bn chkhm yshmch 'b vbn khsyl tvgt 'mv
verses.translation: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

verses.original: לֹא י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝/צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: l' yv'ylv 'vtsrvt rsh' vtsdqh ttsyl mmvt
verses.translation: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

verses.original: לֹֽא יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְ/הַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף
verses.translit: l' yr'yb yhvh npsh tsdyq vhvt rsh'ym yhdf
verses.translation: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

verses.original: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף רְמִיָּ֑ה וְ/יַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר
verses.translit: r'sh 'shh khf rmyh vyd chrvtsym t'shyr
verses.translation: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

verses.original: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭/קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝/קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ
verses.translit: 'gr bqyts bn mshkhyl nrdm bqtsyr bn mbysh
verses.translation: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

verses.original: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
verses.translit: brkhvt lr'sh tsdyq vpy rsh'ym ykhsh chms
verses.translation: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִ/בְרָכָ֑ה וְ/שֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב
verses.translit: zkhr tsdyq lbrkhh vshm rsh'ym yrqb
verses.translation: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

verses.original: חֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶ/אֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
verses.translit: chkhm lb yqch mtsvt v'vyl shptym ylbt
verses.translation: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭/תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּ/מְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗י/ו יִוָּדֵֽעַ
verses.translit: hvlkh btm ylkh btch vm'qsh drkhyv yvd'
verses.translation: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

verses.original: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶ/אֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט
verses.translit: qrts 'yn ytn 'tsbt v'vyl shptym ylbt
verses.translation: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס
verses.translit: mqvr chyym py tsdyq vpy rsh'ym ykhsh chms
verses.translation: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

verses.original: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה
verses.translit: shn'h t'vrr mdnym v'l khl psh'ym tkhsh 'hbh
verses.translation: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

verses.original: בְּ/שִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝/שֵׁ֗בֶט לְ/גֵ֣ו חֲסַר לֵֽב
verses.translit: bshpty nbvn tmts' chkhmh vshbt lgv chsr lb
verses.translation: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

verses.original: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ דָ֑עַת וּ/פִֽי אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה
verses.translit: chkhmym ytspnv d't vpy 'vyl mchth qrbh
verses.translation: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

verses.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑/וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: hvn 'shyr qryt 'zv mchtt dlym ryshm
verses.translation: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

verses.original: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְ/חַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: p'lt tsdyq lchyym tbv't rsh' lcht't
verses.translation: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭/חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְ/עוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה
verses.translit: 'rch lchyym shvmr mvsr v'vzb tvkhcht mt'h
verses.translation: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וּ/מוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל
verses.translit: mkhsh shn'h shpty shqr vmvts' dbh hv' khsyl
