verses.translation: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

verses.original: בְּ/רֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל פָּ֑שַׁע וְ/חֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣י/ו מַשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: brb dbrym l' ychdl psh' vchshkh shptyv mshkhyl
verses.translation: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּ/מְעָֽט
verses.translit: khsf nbchr lshvn tsdyq lb rsh'ym khm't
verses.translation: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝/אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּ/חֲסַר לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ
verses.translit: shpty tsdyq yr'v rbym v'vylym bchsr lb ymvtv
verses.translation: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

verses.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְ/לֹֽא יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: brkht yhvh hy' t'shyr vl' yvsf 'tsb 'mh
verses.translation: The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

verses.original: כִּ/שְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭/כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝/חָכְמָ֗ה לְ/אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: khshchvq lkhsyl 'shvt zmh vchkhmh l'ysh tbvnh
verses.translation: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

verses.original: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/תַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
verses.translit: mgvrt rsh' hy' tbv'nv vt'vt tsdyqym ytn
verses.translation: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

verses.original: כַּ/עֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְ/אֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝/צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: kh'bvr svph v'yn rsh' vtsdyq ysvd 'vlm
verses.translation: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

verses.original: כַּ/חֹ֤מֶץ לַ/שִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְ/כֶ/עָשָׁ֥ן לָ/עֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝/עָצֵ֗ל לְ/שֹׁלְחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khchmts lshnym vkh'shn l'ynym khn h'tsl lshlchyv
verses.translation: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּ/שְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה
verses.translit: yr't yhvh tvsyf ymym vshnvt rsh'ym tqtsrnh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְ/תִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד
verses.translit: tvchlt tsdyqym shmchh vtqvt rsh'ym t'bd
verses.translation: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

verses.original: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭/תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝/מְחִתָּ֗ה לְ/פֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: m'vz ltm drkh yhvh vmchth lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם בַּל יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝/רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tsdyq l'vlm bl ymvt vrsh'ym l' yshkhnv 'rts
verses.translation: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

verses.original: פִּֽי צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּ/לְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: py tsdyq ynvb chkhmh vlshvn thpkhvt tkhrt
verses.translation: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּ/ן רָצ֑וֹן וּ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
verses.translit: shpty tsdyq yd'vn rtsvn vpy rsh'ym thpkhvt
verses.translation: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

verses.original: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: m'zny mrmh tv'bt yhvh v'bn shlmh rtsvnv
verses.translation: A false balance is abomination to the LORD : but a just weight is his delight.

verses.original: בָּֽא זָ֭דוֹן וַ/יָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽ/אֶת צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: b' zdvn vyb' qlvn v't tsnv'ym chkhmh
verses.translation: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

verses.original: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑/ם וְ/סֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים ו/שד/ם יְשָׁדֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: tmt yshrym tnchm vslf bvgdym vshdm yshdm
verses.translation: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

verses.original: לֹא יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּ/י֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝/צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: l' yv'yl hvn byvm 'brh vtsdqh ttsyl mmvt
verses.translation: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְ/רִשְׁעָת֗/וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: tsdqt tmym tyshr drkhv vbrsh'tv ypl rsh'
verses.translation: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑/ם וּ֝/בְ/הַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: tsdqt yshrym ttsylm vbhvt bgdym ylkhdv
verses.translation: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

verses.original: בְּ/מ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ/תוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה
verses.translit: bmvt 'dm rsh' t'bd tqvh vtvchlt 'vnym 'bdh
verses.translation: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק מִ/צָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: tsdyq mtsrh nchlts vyb' rsh' tchtyv
verses.translation: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

verses.original: בְּ/פֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וּ֝/בְ/דַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ
verses.translit: bph chnf yshcht r'hv vbd't tsdyqym ychltsv
verses.translation: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

verses.original: בְּ/ט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּ/בַ/אֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: btvb tsdyqym t'lts qryh vb'bd rsh'ym rnh
verses.translation: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.original: בְּ/בִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּ/בְ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס
verses.translit: bbrkht yshrym trvm qrt vbpy rsh'ym thrs
verses.translation: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.original: בָּז לְ/רֵעֵ֥/הוּ חֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְ/אִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ
verses.translit: bz lr'hv chsr lb v'ysh tbvnvt ychrysh
verses.translation: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה סּ֑וֹד וְ/נֶאֱמַן ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר
verses.translit: hvlkh rkhyl mglh svd vn'mn rvch mkhsh dbr
verses.translation: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

verses.original: בְּ/אֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל עָ֑ם וּ֝/תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּ/רֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ
verses.translit: b'yn tchblvt ypl 'm vtshv'h brb yv'ts
verses.translation: Where no counsel is , the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.original: רַע יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְ/שֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ
verses.translit: r' yrv' khy 'rb zr vshn' tq'ym bvtch
verses.translation: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝/עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ עֹֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: 'sht chn ttmkh khbvd v'rytsym ytmkhv 'shr
verses.translation: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

verses.original: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְ/עֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗/וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי
verses.translit: gml npshv 'ysh chsd v'khr sh'rv 'khzry
verses.translation: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת שָׁ֑קֶר וְ/זֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: rsh' 'shh p'lt shqr vzr' tsdqh shkhr 'mt
verses.translation: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

verses.original: כֵּן צְדָקָ֥ה לְ/חַיִּ֑ים וּ/מְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְ/מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khn tsdqh lchyym vmrdf r'h lmvtv
verses.translation: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי לֵ֑ב וּ֝/רְצוֹנ֗/וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh 'qshy lb vrtsvnv tmymy drkh
verses.translation: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD : but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

verses.original: יָ֣ד לְ֭/יָד לֹא יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְ/זֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט
verses.translit: yd lyd l' ynqh r' vzr' tsdyqym nmlt
verses.translation: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּ/אַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְ/סָ֣רַת טָֽעַם
verses.translit: nzm zhb b'f chzyr 'shh yph vsrt t'm
verses.translation: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה
verses.translit: t'vt tsdyqym 'kh tvb tqvt rsh'ym 'brh
verses.translation: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְ/נוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְ/חוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝/יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ לְ/מַחְסֽוֹר
verses.translit: ysh mpzr vnvsf 'vd vchvshkh myshr 'kh lmchsvr
verses.translation: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

verses.original: נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝/מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא
verses.translit: npsh brkhh tdshn vmrvh gm hv' yvr'
verses.translation: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

verses.original: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣/הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝/בְרָכָ֗ה לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר
verses.translit: mn' br yqbhv l'vm vbrkhh lr'sh mshbyr
verses.translation: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְ/דֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: shchr tvb ybqsh rtsvn vdrsh r'h tbv'nv
verses.translation: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭/עָשְׁר/וֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝/כֶ/עָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ
verses.translit: bvtch b'shrv hv' ypl vkh'lh tsdyqym yprchv
verses.translation: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

verses.original: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭ית/וֹ יִנְחַל ר֑וּחַ וְ/עֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַ/חֲכַם לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'vkhr bytv ynchl rvch v'bd 'vyl lchkhm lb
verses.translation: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.original: פְּֽרִי צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְ/לֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם
verses.translit: pry tsdyq 'ts chyym vlqch npshvt chkhm
verses.translation: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי רָשָׁ֥ע וְ/חוֹטֵֽא
verses.translit: hn tsdyq b'rts yshlm 'f khy rsh' vchvt'
verses.translation: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
